story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puis je me suis trop senti à l'aise pour le finir.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sounds like a successful rest day
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: On dirait une journée de repos réussie.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I think I needed a day like this
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je pense que j'avais besoin d'une journée comme celle-ci.
Un peu endormi, mais plus léger

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I promised myself an early night
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je me suis promis une nuit tôt.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're going to make me smile at my phone again
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu vas me faire sourire à nouveau devant mon téléphone 😊

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Comment s'est passée le reste de ta journée ?
J'ai cuisiné quelque chose de simple.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: So how was your first session?
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Alors, comment s'est passée ta première séance ?

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I thought you were supposed to get a dream body
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Je pensais que tu devais obtenir un corps de rêve.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I still did more today than you've done all week
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: J'ai quand même fait plus aujourd'hui que toi toute la semaine.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Being carried through a workout doesn't count
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Être portée pendant un entraînement ça ne compte pas.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Neither does lying in bed and pretending to be useful
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Tout comme rester au lit à faire semblant d'être utile.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Be carefull, your secretary might take some long vacation
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Fais attention, ta secrétaire pourrait prendre des vacances prolongées.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Yooo
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Yooo

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I am performing a public service
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Je rends un service public

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Sure
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Bien sûr

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: But for real, hope they clear you soon
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Mais sérieusement, j'espère qu'ils te libéreront bientôt.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Being stuck like that must be annoying as hell
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Être coincé comme ça doit être sacrément énervant.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: It is, imagiine having to play games all day
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: C'est, imagine devoir jouer à des jeux toute la journée.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I just want to move normally again
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Je veux juste pouvoir bouger normalement à nouveau.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: You asshole
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Espèce de connard

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I will make fun of you for being slow in real life too
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Je vais me moquer de toi pour être lent dans la vraie vie aussi.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Can't wait
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: J'ai hâte

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Until then, wanna play something
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: D'ici là, tu veux jouer à quelque chose ?

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Yooo
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Yo

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I still have way too much free time
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: J'ai encore beaucoup trop de temps libre.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Yeah, I'm down, i have free time too
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Ouais, je suis partant, j'ai aussi du temps libre.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Good
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Bon

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I need someone to blame when we lose
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: J'ai besoin de quelqu'un à blâmer quand nous perdons.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: You heard anything from the doctor yet
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Tu as eu des nouvelles du docteur ?

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Not yet
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Pas encore

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I have a check-up today, then another on Friday
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: J'ai un contrôle aujourd'hui, puis un autre vendredi

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Hopefully they tell me I can get the cast off soon
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: J'espère qu'ils me diront que je peux enlever le plâtre bientôt.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Finally
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Enfin

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: You might actually stop living inside your phone
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Tu pourrais en fait arrêter de vivre à l'intérieur de ton téléphone.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: You say that like you are not texting me right now
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Tu dis ça comme si tu ne m'envoyais pas de message en ce moment.

story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Different
story/DAY11/DAY11_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Différent

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I think I can start doing some light exercises today
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Je pense que je peux commencer à faire quelques exercices légers aujourd'hui

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Just be careful and don't overdo it
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Fais juste attention et ne force pas trop

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I don't want to set back my recovery
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Je ne veux pas retarder ma récupération

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Please keep it elevated when you can
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: S'il te plaît, garde-le surélevé quand tu peux

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Do you have any idea what time your work might start?
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: As-tu une idée de l'heure à laquelle ton travail pourrait commencer ?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: They said it can happen at any time between 9 AM and 6 PM
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ils ont dit que ça pouvait arriver à tout moment entre 9h et 18h

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: So I need to try to do everything else outside that window
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Donc je dois essayer de faire tout le reste en dehors de cette plage horaire

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Then I will prepare breakfast and bring it to you
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Alors je vais préparer le petit déjeuner et te l'apporter

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: That way you can stay ready if they contact you
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Comme ça, tu peux rester prête s'ils te contactent

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I'm bringing it up to your room
I made something filling, just in case
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: J'ai préparé quelque chose de copieux, au cas où

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I have not been called yet
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Je n'ai pas encore été appelé

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: But I'm keeping an eye on the site and the live feeds anyway
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Mais je garde un œil sur le site et les flux en direct quand même
Mange tant que tu peux alors

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: And call me if you need anything
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Et appelle-moi si tu as besoin de quoi que ce soit

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: My leg feels about the same
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ma jambe se sent à peu près pareil
Mieux, c'est vraiment une bonne nouvelle
J'espère que ça va continuer à s'améliorer

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Read the question twice before answering
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Lis la question deux fois avant de répondre

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: If I die, delete my search history
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Si je meurs, supprime mon historique de recherche

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And tell my friends I was not that stupid 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Et dis à mes amis que je n'étais pas si stupide 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Pretending to be a girl who understands chapters
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Faisant semblant d'être une fille qui comprend les chapitres

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Because you bullied me with quizzes
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Parce que tu m'as harcelée avec des quiz

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay now I have a problem
You're going out looking like that and I'm supposed to stay calm?
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu sors comme ça et je suis censé rester calme ?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The most beautiful girl in the world is going to university and I won't even be there to protect her
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: La plus belle fille du monde va à l'université et je ne serai même pas là pour la protéger.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You're the only one for me anyway ❤️
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu es le seul pour moi de toute façon ❤️

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And the one I'm thinking about
If someone comes near me, I'll kick him in the balls 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Si quelqu'un s'approche de moi, je lui donnerai un coup de pied dans les couilles 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I kind of like it when you're like that 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: J'aime bien quand tu es comme ça 😌
Bonne chance pour survivre à l'université.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And good luck at work later
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Et bonne chance au travail tout à l'heure.
Et ça vient à peine de commencer

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then my part time job after
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ensuite, mon emploi à temps partiel après

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: At least I tried to look cute to survive it
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Au moins, j'ai essayé d'avoir l'air mignonne pour y survivre.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: And luckily, I'm not working today
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Et heureusement, je ne travaille pas aujourd'hui.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: I think we went too hard yesterday
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Je pense qu'on a trop forcé hier.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: My legs are filing a complaint
For once, you said something smart
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Pour une fois, tu as dit quelque chose de sensé.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'm glad I found something like this
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Je suis contente d'avoir trouvé quelque chose comme ça

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: It sounds much better for you than anything outside the house
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ça a l'air bien mieux pour toi que tout ce qui est à l'extérieur de la maison

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'm going to cook for everyone soon
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Je vais bientôt cuisiner pour tout le monde
Je mettrai ta portion de côté

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Whenever you're hungry, just tell me
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Quand tu as faim, dis-le-moi simplement

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'll heat it up and bring it to you
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Je le réchaufferai et te l'apporterai
Tu as faim pour le déjeuner?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: This is something I can do
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: C'est quelque chose que je peux faire

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: And it makes me feel useful too
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Et ça me fait aussi me sentir utile

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: But only if you rest too
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Mais seulement si tu te reposes aussi

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I had a big session from 10 to 11:30
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: J'ai eu une grosse session de 10h à 11h30

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Mise à jour de la pause 😇

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: This is my after-class brain fried face
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Voilà ma tête de cerveau cramé après les cours

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Well, I need to go recover from this trauma now
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Bon, je dois maintenant me remettre de ce traumatisme

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Maybe a walk outside will help
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Peut-être qu'une petite balade dehors aidera

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I will go for a walk before the next test
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Je vais faire un tour avant le prochain test

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I will be back after the test!

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: D'accord, profite bien de ta balade !

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I will try to enjoy it 😌
I am not sure if I can enjoy anything right now, but I will try 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Je ne suis pas sûre de pouvoir apprécier quoi que ce soit en ce moment, mais je vais essayer 😌
Une question avait l'air en colère
Comme si elle était vraiment en colère contre moi
C'est déjà une moitié de stratégie

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: But fine, i'm not a pussy
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Mais bon, je ne suis pas une mauviette.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: But if I fall, you're cleaning it
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Mais si je tombe, tu nettoies.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I hope you burn your mouth
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: J'espère que tu vas te brûler la bouche.
J'ai préparé quelque chose à manger.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Only if you bring it to me
You remember I have a cast on my leg, right?
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu te souviens que j'ai un plâtre à la jambe, non ?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: And I remember you still have two hands
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Et je me souviens que tu as encore deux mains.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Did you actually take some time for yourself today?
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Tu as vraiment pris un peu de temps pour toi aujourd'hui ?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I was resting on the couch while waiting for you to finish work
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Je me reposais sur le canapé en attendant que tu finisses le travail

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'm glad you finally slowed down for a bit
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Je suis contente que tu aies enfin ralenti un peu

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Actually, do you want to come downstairs and watch something with me?
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: En fait, tu veux descendre et regarder quelque chose avec moi ?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I just need to take a shower first
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Je dois juste prendre une douche d'abord

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Do you need help getting into the shower?
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Tu as besoin d'aide pour entrer dans la douche ?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: But if I need help, I'll call you
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Mais si j'ai besoin d'aide, je t'appellerai
J'ai fini le travail pour aujourd'hui

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: It's a little difficult staying focused for hours and paying attention to everything
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: C'est un peu difficile de rester concentré pendant des heures et de faire attention à tout

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: But it's still better than working in a supermarket or doing something physical right now
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Mais c'est quand même mieux que de travailler dans un supermarché ou de faire quelque chose de physique en ce moment

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Your leg probably agrees with that too 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ta jambe doit probablement être d'accord avec ça aussi 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: But being this smart is exhausting
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Mais être aussi intelligente, c'est épuisant

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I can still come over and traumatize you more than the test
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Je peux toujours venir te traumatiser plus que le test

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: At your pace I think I will survive until tomorrow 😇
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: À ton rythme, je pense que je vais survivre jusqu'à demain 😇

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Maybe even the day after if I am lucky
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Peut-être même le jour d'après si j'ai de la chance
Rire tant que tu le peux encore
Menacer une étudiante fragile et épuisée 😔

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: This is my exhausted victim face 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Voilà ma tête de victime épuisée 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And yet you keep texting me
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Et pourtant, tu continues à m'envoyer des messages

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Which is very annoying for me
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ce qui est très agaçant pour moi

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Time to turn off my brain
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Il est temps d'éteindre mon cerveau

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You should get some rest then
I will try to sleep early tonight 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Je vais essayer de dormir tôt ce soir 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I am tired, not a grandma 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Je suis fatiguée, pas une grand-mère 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: That walk was not long enough to recover from the trauma of the test 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Cette balade n'était pas assez longue pour me remettre du traumatisme du test 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: My brain feels like soup right now 😵‍💫
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Mon cerveau ressemble à de la soupe en ce moment 😵‍💫

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I moved around the house a bit again
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'ai un peu bougé dans la maison à nouveau.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And then I played for a while
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Et puis j'ai joué pendant un moment

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And the doctor came to see me later
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Et le docteur est venu me voir plus tard.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: If everything looks good, I should be able to get the cast off soon
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Si tout semble bon, je devrais pouvoir enlever le plâtre bientôt.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay wait I'm actually so happy right now 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: D'accord, attends, je suis vraiment si heureux en ce moment 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That makes me really happy for you
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ça me rend vraiment heureux pour toi.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You'll have to tell me exactly how it goes
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu devras me dire exactement comment ça se passe.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay, I have to go soon or I'm going to be late for work 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: D'accord, je dois y aller bientôt sinon je vais être en retard au travail 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And good luck for the rest of the day
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Et bonne chance pour le reste de la journée.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So I guess that's a win 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Donc je suppose que c'est une victoire 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: That might count as a workout
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Ça pourrait compter comme un entraînement.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Don't make me regret thanking you earlier
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Ne me fais pas regretter de t'avoir remercié plus tôt.
Mes bras me font encore mal.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: And my hands are not much better
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Et mes mains ne sont pas beaucoup mieux.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I think the controller would finish us tonight
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Je pense que la manette nous achèverait ce soir.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'm going to finish my anime and sleep
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Je vais finir mon anime et dormir.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: If I can lift the blanket without dying
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Si je peux soulever la couverture sans mourir.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Je suis tellement heureux pour toi

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: That makes me want to hug you right now
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Ça me donne envie de te faire un câlin tout de suite.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Because you're getting one when I see you 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Parce que tu en auras un quand je te verrai 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: So what are we doing first when the cast is gone?
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Alors, que faisons-nous en premier quand le casting est parti ?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: I just got back from work
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Je viens de rentrer du travail.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Without me worrying every two seconds
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Sans que je m'inquiète toutes les deux secondes

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: And maybe our park date too ❤️
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Et peut-être notre rendez-vous au parc aussi ❤️

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Maybe even something wilder after that
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Peut-être même quelque chose de plus sauvage après ça.
Une très très longue séance de câlins

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: I'm not even that tired somehow 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Je ne suis même pas si fatigué d'une certaine manière 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: I'm eating right now but I'm still smiling like an idiot
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Je mange en ce moment mais je souris toujours comme un idiot.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: You look very cute for someone who's eating
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Tu es très mignon(ne) pour quelqu'un qui mange.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Send me one more later when you're changed and ready for bed
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Envoie-moi un autre plus tard quand tu seras changé et prêt pour le lit.
Peut-être que si tu demandes gentiment

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Changed, clean, and ready to sleep 🤍
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Changé, propre, et prêt à dormir 🤍

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Stop complimenting me or I'm never going to sleep 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Arrête de me complimenter ou je ne vais jamais dormir 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Now I'm really going to sleep before I fall asleep holding my phone
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Maintenant, je vais vraiment dormir avant de m'endormir en tenant mon téléphone.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: And dream about our future park date
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Et rêve de notre rendez-vous au parc.
Déjà en train de le faire 😌❤️
Comment ça s'est passé, le rendez-vous ?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: I should be able to get the cast off soon
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Je devrais pouvoir enlever le plâtre bientôt.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: It makes me happy that you want to get some fresh air
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ça me rend heureuse que tu veuilles prendre l'air

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: But are you sure your not going to hurt yourself?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Mais es-tu sûr de ne pas vouloir te blesser ?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I think I can handle it
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Je pense que je peux gérer

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I just need to get out of the house for a little while
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: J'ai juste besoin de sortir un peu de la maison

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: If it's too much, we can always take a break
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Si c'est trop, on peut toujours faire une pause

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I should be ready in about fifteen minutes
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Je devrais être prête dans environ quinze minutes
Ok, je vais me préparer aussi
Une matinée tranquille, ça fait du bien

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I was thinking of trying to go outside this morning
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Je pensais essayer de sortir ce matin

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Would you like to come with me?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: What a bad start 😭
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Quel mauvais départ 😭

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He says it like I am not allowed to fail
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Il dit ça comme si je n'avais pas le droit d'échouer

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Which is rude but also helpful
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ce qui est impoli mais aussi utile

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You are quite smart
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tu es plutôt intelligente

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Well thanks I guess ?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Eh bien merci je suppose ?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Also he just walked past and gave me the professor nod
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Il est juste passé et m'a fait un signe de la tête de prof

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Good sign right ??
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Bon signe, non ??

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Emotional regulation source shifting. Pressing too hard may cause defensive minimization.
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Source de régulation émotionnelle en cours de changement. Appuyer trop fort peut provoquer une minimisation défensive.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Ask if his attention helps her calm down
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Demande-lui si son attention t'aide à te calmer

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Let her focus before class
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Laisse-la se concentrer avant le cours

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Does it help when he checks on you like that?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ça t'aide quand il prend de tes nouvelles comme ça ?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I am outside class
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Je suis devant la classe

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Maybe
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Peut-être

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Do not make a psychology documentary about it
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ne fais pas un documentaire psychologique là-dessus

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I just need to pass 😭
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Je veux juste réussir 😭

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Go focus. You can survive this.
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Concentre-toi. Tu peux t'en sortir.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That is the correct supportive answer
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: C'est la bonne réponse de soutien

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Gold star maybe
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Peut-être une étoile d'or

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If I die, delete my search history
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Si je meurs, supprime mon historique de recherche

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Pretending to be a girl who understands chapters
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Faisant semblant d'être une fille qui comprend les chapitres

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And tell my friends I was academically brave 😭
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Et dis à mes amis que j'ai été courageuse académiquement 😭

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You revised yesterday
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tu as révisé hier

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Because he bullied me with structure
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Parce qu'il m'a embêtée avec sa structure

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Respectfully
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Respectueusement

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He told me to breathe and read the question twice
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Il m'a dit de respirer et de relire la question deux fois

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That is good advice
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: C'est un bon conseil

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I know
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Je sais

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I feel a bit more useful there
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je me sens un peu plus utile là-bas

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now I have actual things to take care of
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Maintenant, j'ai de vraies choses à gérer.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll probably stay longer than usual
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je vais probablement rester plus longtemps que d'habitude.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Be careful not to overdo it
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Fais attention à ne pas en faire trop

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I actually have a lot to do today
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai en fait beaucoup à faire aujourd'hui.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Since they gave me more responsibilities i need to be there more often
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Depuis qu'ils m'ont donné plus de responsabilités, je dois être là plus souvent.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You might be the next one whith a cast
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Tu pourrais être le prochain avec un plâtre

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Don't trip on your first day back
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ne trébuche pas le premier jour de retour

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'll try not to embarrass you
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: J'essaierai de ne pas te mettre mal à l'aise

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You manage that without even trying
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Tu y arrives sans même essayer

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Did the doctor finally put you out of your misery?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Le docteur t'a enfin sorti de ta misère ?
Ça se passe plutôt bien en fait

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I should be able to walk again soon
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Je devrais pouvoir marcher à nouveau bientôt

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I was getting tired of waiting for you every time we went somewhere
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Je commençais à en avoir marre d'attendre à chaque fois qu'on sortait

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You make it sound like I'm slowing you down on purpose
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: On dirait que tu ralentis exprès

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: What time do you start at the bar today?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: À quelle heure commences-tu au bar aujourd'hui ?
Et je finirai plus tard aussi

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But I'll make a little more money because of it !
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Mais je vais gagner un peu plus d'argent grâce à ça !

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Just make sure you don't get too tired
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Assure-toi juste de ne pas trop te fatiguer

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But thank you for worrying about me ❤️
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Mais merci de t'inquiéter pour moi ❤️

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That walk did me a lot of good
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Cette balade m'a fait beaucoup de bien

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: We didn't exactly go very far
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: On n'est pas vraiment allés très loin

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: And we came back pretty quickly too 😄
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Et on est revenus assez vite aussi 😄

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But it was perfect for me
It didn't bother me at all
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ça ne m'a pas du tout dérangé

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: We'll try to do it more often then
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: On essaiera de le faire plus souvent alors

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Le cours a été survécu, en gros 😭

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: My professor wants me to come by his office before the next class
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mon prof veut que je passe le voir avant le prochain cours

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just five minutes to check what I missed
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Juste cinq minutes pour vérifier ce que j'ai raté

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That is a lot of extra attention
He is taking it really seriously
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Il prend ça vraiment au sérieux
Candidat détecté pour une incohérence dans la chronologie

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Subject reports brief office review between classes
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Le sujet rapporte une brève révision au bureau entre les cours
Surveillance de la persistance de l'emplacement réel

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I want to believe this is just a quick review, so why am I already bracing for something else?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je veux croire que ce n'est qu'une petite révision, alors pourquoi est-ce que je me prépare déjà à autre chose ?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I need a walk after this
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: J'ai besoin d'une petite marche après ça

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Professor and you both making sense is unfair
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: C'est pas juste que le prof et toi ayez tous les deux du sens
Une question avait l'air en colère

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But I read it twice like he said
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mais je l'ai lu deux fois comme il a dit

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Which is better than guessing while internally screaming
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ce qui est mieux que de deviner en hurlant intérieurement

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Je suis à la salle de sport
Tu es à la salle de sport ?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll be home a bit later
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Je serai rentré un peu plus tard
Pourquoi ça ne le serait pas ?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: What time are you coming home?
There's no reason for anything to go wrong
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Il n'y a aucune raison que ça se passe mal

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll text you when I'm home
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Je t'enverrai un message quand je serai rentré

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:evelyn}} needs your help with something in the attic
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:evelyn}} a besoin de ton aide pour quelque chose dans le grenier
Je viens de voir tes messages
Je reste un peu plus longtemps

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Hey, I prepared dinner for tonight 😊
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Hé, j'ai préparé le dîner pour ce soir 😊

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And you, don't go to bed too late
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Et toi, ne te couche pas trop tard

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: If you can't go downstairs, just ask {{name:hailey}} or {{name:mason}} to bring it to you
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Si tu ne peux pas descendre, demande simplement à {{name:hailey}} ou {{name:mason}} de te l'apporter

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I hope it's going to be okay
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: J'espère que ça va bien se passer

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: My manager isn't supposed to be working tonight
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Mon responsable n'est pas censé travailler ce soir

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Then try to enjoy the shift with your coworkers
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Alors essaie de profiter de ton service avec tes collègues

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He said I can send him one answer tonight if I panic
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Il a dit que je pouvais lui envoyer une réponse ce soir si je panique

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: This is my exhausted victim face
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Voici ma tête de victime épuisée

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Don't fall asleep in the couch
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ne t'endors pas sur le canapé
Je ne le ferai pas, je te jure

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: unless i close my eyes for a second
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: À moins que je ferme les yeux une seconde

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You keep texting me anyway, that should keep you awake
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Tu continues à m'envoyer des messages, ça devrait te tenir éveillée

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But yeah, i'm going straight to bed
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Mais ouais, je vais directement au lit
Mon cerveau est de la soupe
La révision au bureau a-t-elle aidé ?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He noticed the exact part I messed up
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Il a remarqué exactement la partie que j'ai ratée

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But not in a bad way
It feels good to be trusted with more things
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça fait du bien d'être confié avec plus de choses.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know it probably sounds boring from the outside
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je sais que ça doit probablement sembler ennuyeux de l'extérieur.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not if you're happy about it
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pas si tu es content à ce sujet.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's strict, but he explains things clearly
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il est strict, mais il explique les choses clairement.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just don't want today to become heavy
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne veux tout simplement pas que aujourd'hui devienne lourd.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll text you after work if I'm not dead 😅
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je te texterai après le travail si je ne suis pas mort 😅
Essayez de ne pas être mort

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But work is moving fast today
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mais le travail avance vite aujourd'hui.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm still learning where everything is and what they expect from me
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'apprends encore où tout se trouve et ce qu'ils attendent de moi.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: J'ai pris quelque chose après l'entraînement

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You could still come sit with us
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Tu pourrais toujours venir t'asseoir avec nous

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Am I really going to have to come drag you out of your room?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Je vais vraiment devoir venir te traîner hors de ta chambre ?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Good luck climbing the stairs with your leg
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Bonne chance pour monter les escaliers avec ta jambe

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Behavior change detected after gym session
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Changement de comportement détecté après la séance de gym

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Subject avoided shared dinner without clear explanation
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Le sujet a évité le dîner partagé sans explication claire

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Conversation pattern deviates from established baseline
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Le schéma de conversation dévie de la base établie

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: The joke sounds like {{name:mason}}, but the distance doesn't feel familiar.
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: La blague ressemble bien à {{name:mason}}, mais cette distance ne lui ressemble pas.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Straight to the shower and your room?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Directement sous la douche et dans ta chambre ?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I don't know just making sure
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Je ne sais pas, je vérifie juste

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: He's demanding but... it pushes me in a good way
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Il est exigeant mais... ça me pousse dans le bon sens.
On dirait que tu l'aimes bien.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I like the way he works
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: J'aime la façon dont il travaille

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I just want things to stay simple right now
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Je veux juste que les choses restent simples en ce moment.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm not trying to make things tense
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Je n'essaie pas de rendre les choses tendues.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Everything feels heavier when I'm like this
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Tout semble plus lourd quand je suis comme ça.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll probably just shower and go to bed
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Je vais probablement juste prendre une douche et aller au lit.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I wouldn't make it past ten minutes
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Je ne tiendrais pas dix minutes.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I didn't expect to handle that much today
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Je ne m'attendais pas à gérer autant aujourd'hui.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Actually, things moved faster than expected
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: En fait, les choses ont avancé plus vite que prévu

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I received a lot of notifications last night and this morning
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: J'ai reçu beaucoup de notifications hier soir et ce matin

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: There are already enough requests for me to choose a good profile
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Il y a déjà assez de demandes pour que je puisse choisir un bon profil

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: If everything looks right, you might be able to do your first outing today
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Si tout semble bon, tu pourrais faire ta première sortie aujourd'hui

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: That is why we will start slowly
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: C'est pourquoi nous allons commencer doucement

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Maybe just one or two hours outside, nothing more
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Peut-être juste une ou deux heures dehors, pas plus

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Just enough for you to get used to it and see how it feels
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Juste assez pour que tu t'habitues et que tu vois comment ça se passe

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I was afraid you were going to tell me it would be something long right away
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: J'avais peur que tu me dises que ce serait quelque chose de long tout de suite

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Then I will go get ready
Message me when you know more, okay?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Envoie-moi un message quand tu en sais plus, d'accord ?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Please do not push yourself too much today
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: S'il te plaît, ne te pousse pas trop aujourd'hui

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Where are we with the work?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Où en sommes-nous avec le travail ?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Mentally prepared to suffer for your grades
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mentalement préparée à souffrir pour tes notes

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But definitely ready to see my handsome {{name:tutor}} 😌
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mais je suis trop impatiente de voir mon beau {{name:tutor}} 😌

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And of course you're not thinking about your studies
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Et bien sûr, tu ne penses pas à tes études

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He's still coming to make you study, you know
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Il vient toujours pour te faire étudier, tu sais

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Ethan said he wants to review the weak points he noticed yesterday
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ethan a dit qu'il voulait revoir les points faibles qu'il a remarqués hier

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Your peace was never going to survive exam season
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ta paix n'allait jamais survivre à la saison des examens

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: School outfit check before I disappear into class
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Vérification de la tenue scolaire avant que je disparaisse en cours

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That's the nicest fake compliment I've heard today 😊
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: C'est le plus gentil faux compliment que j'ai entendu aujourd'hui 😊

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm officially on my way to school
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Je suis officiellement en route pour l'école
C'est juste ce qu'on appelle être éveillé

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I hate how accurate that is 😭
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Je déteste à quel point c'est vrai 😭

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Ready for another study session later?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Prête pour une autre session d'étude plus tard ?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Enough to function like a normal human
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Assez pour fonctionner comme un humain normal
C'est tout ce dont nous avons besoin

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought about what you said the other day
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai pensé à ce que tu as dit l'autre jour.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need to get ready or I'm going to be late 😭
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je dois me préparer ou je vais être en retard 😭

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I didn't even wake up during the night for once 😌
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je ne me suis même pas réveillé pendant la nuit pour une fois 😌

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I feel a lot more awake today
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je me sens beaucoup plus éveillé aujourd'hui.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Hey, how are you feeling this morning?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Hey, comment tu te sens ce matin ?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Perfect
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Parfait

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'll book another coaching session for you today
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Je vais réserver une autre séance de coaching pour toi aujourd'hui.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: No fucking way
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Pas question.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Everything hurts
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Tout me fait mal.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You need to give me at least one day to recover
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Tu dois me laisser au moins un jour pour récupérer.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Then you better shut up and let me make noise as much as i want
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Alors tu ferais mieux de te taire et de me laisser faire du bruit autant que je veux.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Alright alright
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: D'accord d'accord

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: How about we play a game together and call it even?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Et si on jouait ensemble et qu'on appelait ça un match nul ?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Maybe
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Peut-être

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Come on
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Allez

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'm good
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Je vais bien

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'll even let you lose with dignity
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Je te laisserai même perdre avec dignité.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Why?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Pourquoi ?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Because you made so much noise in your room this morning that you woke me up
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Parce que tu as fait tellement de bruit dans ta chambre ce matin que tu m'as réveillée.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Sorry princess
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Désolée, princesse.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I didn't know you needed your beauty sleep
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Je ne savais pas que tu avais besoin de ton sommeil de beauté.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You should be more worried about yours
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Tu devrais t'inquiéter davantage pour le tien.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Your face needs all the help it can get
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ta tête a besoin de toute l'aide qu'elle peut obtenir.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I hope your whole body is sore today
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: J'espère que tout ton corps est douloureux aujourd'hui.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: It already is
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: C'est déjà le cas.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Hey
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Hé

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: He must feel really lonely in his life to ask for that on an app
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Il doit vraiment se sentir seul dans sa vie pour demander ça sur une appli

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: It happens more often than people think
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ça arrive plus souvent qu'on ne le pense

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Some people spend their whole life working and end up with no one to talk to
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Certaines personnes passent leur vie à travailler et finissent sans personne à qui parler

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: For them, even one calm hour with someone kind can mean a lot
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Pour eux, même une heure calme avec quelqu'un de gentil peut signifier beaucoup

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I think I understand a little better what I am supposed to do now
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Je pense que je comprends un peu mieux ce que je suis censée faire maintenant

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Not just be pretty and sit there
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Pas juste être jolie et rester là

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But actually make him feel less alone for a while
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Mais vraiment lui faire sentir moins seul pendant un moment

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Exactly
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Exactement

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: And you are naturally good at that
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Et tu es naturellement douée pour ça

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I hope so
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: J'espère bien

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I found a really good profile
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: J'ai trouvé un profil vraiment intéressant

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I am going to get ready and then I will go
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Je vais me préparer et ensuite j'y vais

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I will keep you updated, okay?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Je te tiendrai au courant, d'accord ?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Okay
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: D'accord

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Good luck {{name:evelyn}}
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Bonne chance {{name:evelyn}}

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: You will do great
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu vas assurer

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Thank you 😊
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Merci 😊

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: 1 H 30 LATER
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: 1 H 30 PLUS TARD

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Already?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Déjà ?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: What kind of profile?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: C'est quel genre de profil ?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: A man around your age
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Un homme à peu près de ton âge

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: He's name is Laurent
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Il s'appelle Laurent

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Single, businessman, the kind of person who works all the time and barely has a personal life
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Célibataire, homme d'affaires, le genre de personne qui travaille tout le temps et a à peine une vie personnelle

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: He said he would like to spend a little time with a girl
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Il a dit qu'il aimerait passer un peu de temps avec une fille
