story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Je n'ai toujours pas vu de lumière dans ta chambre quand je suis passée

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I will come upstairs and drop off your clean clothes
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Je vais monter et te déposer tes vêtements propres

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Do well tonight and we can discuss benefits 😇
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Fais bien ce soir et on pourra discuter des avantages 😇

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Many chances to regret my choices
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Beaucoup de chances de regretter mes choix

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I will probably need help after the second one
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Je vais probablement avoir besoin d'aide après le deuxième

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Now I have no excuse to fail 😭
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Maintenant, je n'ai plus d'excuse pour échouer 😭

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Go to your classes, quickly before I heal completely
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Va à tes cours, vite avant que je guérisse complètement

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: The injured tutor threat level is rising 😔
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Le niveau de menace du prof particulier blessé augmente 😔

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: If I learn anything against my will, I am blaming you 💅
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Si j'apprends quoi que ce soit contre ma volonté, je te tiens responsable 💅

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Blink twice if your leg is being dramatic
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Cligne des yeux deux fois si ta jambe fait des siennes
Mes devoirs ont une formation théâtrale

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I still need my favorite tutor functional
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: J'ai encore besoin de mon tuteur préféré en forme

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I would have wanted that too
You would have had to protect me from the evil sky 😌
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu aurais dû me protéger du ciel maléfique 😌

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I take that responsibility very seriously
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je prends cette responsabilité très au sérieux.
Je suis essentiellement un spécialiste des tempêtes.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Send me a picture of my brave survivor then
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Envoie-moi une photo de mon brave survivant alors.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I haven't finished doing my makeup yet 😭
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je n'ai pas encore fini de me maquiller 😭

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I didn't say full glam was required
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je n'ai pas dit que le glamour complet était requis.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You get the almost ready version
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu as la version presque prête.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And don't forget your leg exercises today
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Et n'oublie pas tes exercices de jambes aujourd'hui.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: There was a storm during the night
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Il y a eu une tempête pendant la nuit.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay maybe more than a little
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: D'accord, peut-être un peu plus qu'un peu.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I really wanted to sleep with you
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je voulais vraiment dormir avec toi.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: You say that like you're the responsible one
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Tu parles comme si tu étais la responsable
C'est pas bien haut comme barre
Mais je l'ai quand même franchie
Encore un peu douloureuse, mais ça va

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Maybe we do a small session today
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: On pourrait faire une petite séance aujourd'hui
Donc rien de ce que tu as prévu toi-même

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: I'm trying to be responsible here

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'm going to do some grocery shopping
Is there anything you want me to buy?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Tu veux que j'achète quelque chose ?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Could you get me a water bottle or a flask?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Peux-tu me prendre une bouteille d'eau ou un thermos ?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Something I can keep in my room with clean water
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Quelque chose que je peux garder dans ma chambre avec de l'eau propre

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'll see what I can find
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Je vais voir ce que je peux trouver

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'll try not to come back too late
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: J'essaierai de ne pas revenir trop tard

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Do you have time to bring me something to eat?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Tu as le temps de m'apporter quelque chose à manger ?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'll heat up your lunch and bring it to you
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Je vais réchauffer ton déjeuner et te l'apporter

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'm coming to pick up your plate
Do you need anything else while I'm here?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Tu as besoin de quelque chose d'autre pendant que je suis là ?
Non, je pense que ça va

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Do not say it like that
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ne dis pas ça comme ça
Ça me fait passer pour responsable 💅

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Your bullying tutor method might be working
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ta méthode de tuteur intimidant pourrait fonctionner

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Can you ask {{name:mason}} if {{mason:he}} can come pick me up at university?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Tu peux demander à {{name:mason}} {{mason:he|s'il|si elle}} peut venir me chercher à la fac ?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I would ask {{mason:him}} myself but {{mason:he}} is less scary when you are involved
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Je {{mason:him|lui|lui}} demanderais moi-même, mais {{mason:he|il|elle}} fait moins peur quand tu t'en mêles.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I will take care of it
But if you get home early, you revise again
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Mais si tu rentres tôt, tu révises encore

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I knew there was a trap
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Je savais qu'il y avait un piège

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You cannot say that after I survived class
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Tu ne peux pas dire ça après que j'ai survécu au cours
Alors je vais soumettre des preuves

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I am way too cute to be forced to revise 😇
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Je suis beaucoup trop mignonne pour être forcée à réviser 😇
Les étudiants mignons révisent quand même

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: This is discrimination against adorable people 😭
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: C'est de la discrimination contre les gens adorables 😭
Et peut-être que je vais réviser

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I'll destroy you on that game
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Je vais te détruire à ce jeu

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I see you still have hope
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Je vois que tu as encore de l'espoir

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Go to work before you embarrass yourself more
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Va bosser avant de te ridiculiser encore plus

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Enjoy the silence while it lasts
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Profite du silence tant que ça dure

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: And why would that interest me?
Because your day is clearly empty without my updates
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Parce que ta journée est clairement vide sans mes nouvelles

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Bold of you to assume that
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: C'est audacieux de ta part de penser ça

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I try to match the audience
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: J'essaie de m'adapter à mon public

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: If I don't get home too late tonight
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Si je ne rentre pas trop tard ce soir

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I can already transfer you 300 dollars
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Je peux déjà te transférer 300 dollars
Ils me paient tous les jours

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: So I already received money for the work I did
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Donc j'ai déjà reçu de l'argent pour le travail que j'ai fait

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I do not even know how to thank you for doing all this
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Je ne sais même pas comment te remercier pour tout ça

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: How was your second day of work?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Comment s'est passé ton deuxième jour de travail ?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: A smile and a kiss, then
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Un sourire et un bisou, alors

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Then I may have to send you more of them
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Alors je vais peut-être devoir t'en envoyer plus
Je ne vais pas me plaindre 😄

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Come eat before dinner gets cold
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Viens manger avant que le dîner ne refroidisse

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: And do not go to bed too late tonight
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Et ne te couche pas trop tard ce soir

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: It was calmer than yesterday too
I managed to buy everything we needed
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: J'ai réussi à acheter tout ce dont on avait besoin
Mais il y a un problème

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: We are almost out of money
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: On est presque à court d'argent

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I have decided to be useful tonight
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: J'ai décidé d'être utile ce soir

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: So I am repaying my debt
{{name:hailey}} comes into your room to bring you food and clean your room
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: {{name:hailey}} entre dans ta chambre pour t'apporter de la nourriture et nettoyer ta chambre

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I am a generous little angel 😇
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Je suis une petite ange généreuse 😇

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: But you unplugged my whole PC while cleaning
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Mais tu as débranché tout mon PC en nettoyant
Non, je ne l'ai pas fait
Tu as tiré sur les câbles

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: How dare you take a picture of me?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Comment oses-tu prendre une photo de moi ?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: It clearly shows you touching the cables
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ça montre clairement que tu touches les câbles
Non, ça ne montre pas ça

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Thanks for asking {{name:mason}} to pick me up
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Merci d'avoir demandé à {{name:mason}} de venir me chercher

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: It shows a hardworking innocent girl being framed
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ça montre une fille innocente qui travaille dur se faire piéger
Ce n'est pas une preuve suffisante 💅

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You are literally holding the cable
Maybe the cable attacked me first
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Peut-être que le câble m'a attaqué en premier

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You do not know the full story
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Tu ne connais pas toute l'histoire

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And you are taking secret pictures of me
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Et tu prends des photos secrètes de moi

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Go revise before you destroy more electronics
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Va réviser avant de détruire plus d'électroniques

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: But if the PC dies, it was already weak
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Mais si le PC meurt, c'était déjà faible

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Elevated heart rate spike detected during recent private interaction
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Fréquence cardiaque élevée détectée lors d'une interaction privée récente
Croisement des marqueurs visuels et émotionnels...

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Capture émotionnelle pertinente archivée dans les preuves HAK

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Being close to {{name:hailey}} stayed with me, and I want more moments like that.
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Cette proximité avec {{name:hailey}} me reste en tête, et j'ai envie d'autres moments comme ça.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Alive, safe, and only mildly dramatic
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Vivante, en sécurité, et seulement légèrement dramatique

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I still need to get home
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je dois encore rentrer chez moi.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I finally collapsed on the couch
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je me suis enfin effondré sur le canapé.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I'm stealing snacks from the kitchen like a little rat
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Et je vole des collations dans la cuisine comme un petit rat.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm really sorry I missed your calls
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je suis vraiment désolé d'avoir manqué tes appels.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a very glamorous day of stress and minor disasters
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'ai eu une journée très glamour de stress et de petits désastres.
Trop de choses à la fois

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And one customer who acted like I personally ruined his life
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Et un client qui a agi comme si j'avais personnellement ruiné sa vie.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I kept thinking about being home and talking to you though
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je n'arrêtais pas de penser à être chez moi et à te parler pourtant.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That part you can do now
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Cette partie, tu peux le faire maintenant.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's why I wanted to stay here with you a little longer
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: C'est pourquoi je voulais rester ici avec toi un peu plus longtemps.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You still shouldn't go to bed too late
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu ne devrais toujours pas te coucher trop tard.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I just wanted a little more of you first
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je voulais juste un peu plus de toi d'abord.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You'll have more of me tomorrow
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu auras plus de moi demain

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And hopefully tomorrow will be easier for you too
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Et j'espère qu'il sera plus facile pour toi aussi demain.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You always say the annoyingly right thing 😌
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu dis toujours la chose agaçante mais juste 😌

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Go take your shower when you're done eating
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Va prendre ta douche quand tu as fini de manger.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And send you a pic of me?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Et t'envoyer une photo de moi ?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But only because I've missed you all day
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mais seulement parce que tu m'as manqué toute la journée.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Promise you won't show it to anyone
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Promets que tu ne le montreras à personne.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm still in my work clothes 😭
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je suis encore en vêtements de travail 😭

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look so good ( and sexy ) I almost died
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu es tellement beau ( et sexy ) que j'ai failli mourir.
Tu dis ça à chaque fois.
Parce que c'est vrai à chaque fois

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I won't be able to right now
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je ne pourrai pas en ce moment.
Je me suis dit que tu étais débordé.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It felt like the whole day was just problem after problem
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: On aurait dit que toute la journée n'était que des problèmes après des problèmes.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: J'ai fini ma douche

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: You took that loss pretty hard
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Tu as pris cette défaite assez mal
Profite tant que tu peux
C'est de la chance de débutant

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: That's a lot of excuses for one evening
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Ça fait beaucoup d'excuses pour une soirée

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Next time we should bet something
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: La prochaine fois, on devrait parier quelque chose
Ça, ça a l'air intéressant

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Loser owes the winner a favor
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Le perdant doit un service au gagnant
Accord

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I hope you don't lose too often then 😏
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: J'espère que tu ne perds pas trop souvent alors 😏
On verra ça.
Je suis prête
Bonne nuit
Nuit
JOUR 13

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Come get your ass kicked in 5 minutes
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Viens te faire botter le cul dans 5 minutes

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I've been waiting all day to make you cry
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: J'attends toute la journée pour te faire pleurer
Continue de rêver

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'll try not to laugh too much
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Je vais essayer de ne pas trop rire

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: We'll see who's laughing in a few minutes
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: On verra qui rira dans quelques minutes
3 HEURES PLUS TARD

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Do you need a teddy bear to sleep tonight? 😏
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Tu as besoin d'un ours en peluche pour dormir ce soir ? 😏

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Hey, I made breakfast for you 😊
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Hé, j'ai préparé le petit déjeuner pour toi 😊

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I had plenty of time, so I made breakfast
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: J'avais plein de temps, donc j'ai fait le petit déjeuner
Mais ne fais pas non plus trop d'efforts.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: You have to deal with your manager every day
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Tu dois gérer ton manager tous les jours.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: It's the least I can do around the house
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: C'est le minimum que je puisse faire à la maison.
C'est vraiment gentil de ta part.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'll be downstairs when you're ready
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Je serai en bas quand tu seras prête.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Okay, give me a few minutes 😊
Take your time getting up and get some rest
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Prends ton temps pour te lever et repose-toi.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: You had a long night at work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Tu as eu une longue nuit au travail.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'm so sorry, I slept way too much
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Je suis vraiment désolée, j'ai trop dormi.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I didn't even hear my alarm
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Je n'ai même pas entendu mon réveil.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: You worked late, it's normal to be tired
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Tu as travaillé tard, c'est normal d'être fatiguée.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He said to come by if the second class exposes my tragic gaps
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Il a dit de passer si le deuxième cours expose mes tragiques lacunes

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm sure his words were nicer
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Je suis sûre que ses mots étaient plus gentils

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You are relying on him a lot

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Je compte sur le fait de réussir

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He just happens to know how to make my brain behave
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Il sait juste comment faire fonctionner mon cerveau

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Now I have no excuse to fail
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Maintenant, je n'ai plus d'excuse pour échouer

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If I learn anything against my will, I am blaming both of you 💅
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Si j'apprends quoi que ce soit contre ma volonté, je vous tiens tous les deux responsables 💅
J'ai besoin que tout le monde soit opérationnel

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And probably professor rescue after the second one
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Et probablement un sauvetage du prof après le deuxième

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Part-time job from morning to evening
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Emploi à temps partiel de matin à soir
Une petite photo avant de partir 😅

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I can
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je te texterai quand je pourrai.
J'avais vraiment besoin de ce sommeil.
Mais je me sens bien maintenant

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Hey, how are you feeling this morning?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Hey, comment tu te sens ce matin ?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I was starting to think the doctor had fixed your personality too
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Je commençais à penser que le docteur avait aussi réparé ta personnalité

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Not even medicine can save yours
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Même pas la médecine ne peut sauver la tienne
J'ai besoin de ton aide plus tard

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I need to reconnect a few things in my room
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Je dois reconnecter quelques trucs dans ma chambre

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: The console, the screen and some cables
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: La console, l'écran et quelques câbles
Quelque chose ne fonctionne pas correctement

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: And you need me for that?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Et tu as besoin de moi pour ça ?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You might actually be useful for once
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Tu pourrais en fait être utile une fois

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Then your console can stay broken
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Alors ta console peut rester cassée
S'il te plaît, aide-moi plus tard 😒
Tu ne l'entendras pas deux fois

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Can't I ask how you're doing?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Je ne peux pas demander comment tu vas ?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: It was almost better when you kept your mouth shut
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: C'était presque mieux quand tu gardais ta bouche fermée

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Thanks again for this morning
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Merci encore pour ce matin

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That looks delicious
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ça a l'air délicieux.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Good 😊
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Bien 😊

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Then it was worth the effort
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Alors ça valait le coup.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: By the way, are you working the same hours tonight?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Au fait, tu travailles aux mêmes horaires ce soir ?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: No
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Non

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Since my manager is working tonight, I'm back to my usual schedule
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Comme mon manager travaille ce soir, je retourne à mon emploi du temps habituel.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I'll leave a little earlier
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Donc je vais partir un peu plus tôt.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Then make sure you take some time for yourself before work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Alors assure-toi de prendre un peu de temps pour toi avant le travail.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I will 😊
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Je vais essayer 😊

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I'm going to watch some TV for a bit
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Je vais regarder un peu la télé.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: It's nothing, really
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ce n'est rien, vraiment.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: And then I'll start getting ready
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Et ensuite je vais commencer à me préparer.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That sounds like a good plan 😊
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ça a l'air d'un bon plan 😊.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe for you
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Peut-être pour toi.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But I still think it was really sweet
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Mais je pense toujours que c'était vraiment gentil.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I made a cake for you
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Alors j'ai fait un gâteau pour toi.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: You didn't have to do that
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu n'étais pas obligée de faire ça.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But I'm definitely not complaining 😄
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Mais je ne vais certainement pas me plaindre 😄.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I hope you'll like it
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: J'espère que ça te plaira.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Wow
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Wow

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If you get home early, you revise
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Si tu rentres tôt, tu révises
Les étudiants mignons révisent quand même

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Professor said he can bring me home when he's done with work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Le professeur a dit qu'il pouvait me ramener quand il aura fini de travailler

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So I am waiting in the school office
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Donc j'attends dans le bureau de l'école

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It is quieter than the hallway
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: C'est plus calme que dans le couloir

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: And he said he's almost done
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Et il a dit qu'il avait presque fini

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So I will just wait here
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Donc je vais juste attendre ici
Peut-être que je vais réviser un peu

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It actually went kind of well
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: En fait, ça s'est plutôt bien passé

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Subject accepted professor's offer instead of waiting for alternative pickup
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Le sujet a accepté l'offre du professeur au lieu d'attendre un autre transport

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Pattern of one-on-one contact frequency continues to increase
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Le schéma de contact en tête-à-tête continue d'augmenter

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Behavior remains explainable but trend analysis flagged for review
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Le comportement reste explicable mais l'analyse des tendances est signalée pour révision

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: His help is becoming part of her routine, and that makes me uneasy.
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Son aide prend sa place dans sa routine, et ça me met mal à l'aise.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Professor provided transportation following a private revision session. Interaction remains within a plausible academic context, though HAK notes a growing pattern of personal assistance and increased familiarity.
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Le professeur a fourni le transport après une session de révision privée. L'interaction reste dans un contexte académique plausible, bien que HAK note un schéma croissant d'assistance personnelle et d'augmentation de la familiarité.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm leaving the school office now
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je quitte le bureau de l'école maintenant
À tout à l'heure à la maison

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Do not say it like a proud spreadsheet
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ne le dis pas comme un tableau Excel fier

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I feel safer asking when you are involved
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je me sens plus en sécurité quand tu es impliqué

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You're using that leg as an excuse for everything now
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Tu utilises cette jambe comme excuse pour tout maintenant
On appelle ça travailler plus intelligemment

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You really should stop watching business videos
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Tu devrais vraiment arrêter de regarder des vidéos sur les affaires

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: So... are you bringing the groceries?
But only because I don't trust you to shop alone
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Mais seulement parce que je ne te fais pas confiance pour faire les courses seul
Tu vois ? Au fond, tu es sympa

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Just because I'm outside doesn't mean I'm your personal delivery service
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Juste parce que je suis dehors, ça ne veut pas dire que je suis ton service de livraison personnel

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Can't you help a poor injured man? 😔
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Tu ne peux pas aider un pauvre homme blessé ? 😔

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Hey, I'm about to leave for work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Salut, je m'apprête à partir au travail

Hey, I'm on my break
How is it going?
It's okay
But we got the new outfits my manager ordered
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Mais on a reçu les nouvelles tenues que mon manager a commandées

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And honestly I don't like them at all
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Et honnêtement, je ne les aime pas du tout

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: What do the others think about them?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Que pensent les autres de ces tenues ?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Most of them are pretty divided
But everyone listens to whatever the manager says
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Mais tout le monde écoute ce que dit le manager

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: So we'll have to wear them no matter what
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Donc on va devoir les porter quoi qu'il arrive

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Everything is ready for dinner as usual
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Tout est prêt pour le dîner comme d'habitude

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Just tell yourself it's only for work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Dis-toi que c'est juste pour le travail

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And try to make the best of it
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Et essaie d'en tirer le meilleur

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'll try
You'll be fine
I know you can handle it
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Je sais que tu peux le gérer

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Thanks ❤️
I need to get back to work now
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Je dois retourner au travail maintenant

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Good luck
See you tomorrow since I won't get to see you tonight
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: On se voit demain, je ne te verrai pas ce soir

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: See you tomorrow 😊
{{name:hailey}} will bring it to your room so you don't have to move around too much
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: {{name:hailey}} l'apportera dans ta chambre pour que tu n'aies pas à trop bouger

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: 3 HOURS LATER
Workplace anomaly detected
{{name:evelyn}} reported concerns regarding new work outfits
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: {{name:evelyn}} a signalé des préoccupations concernant les nouvelles tenues de travail

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Repeated references to management decisions detected
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Références répétées aux décisions de la direction détectées

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Additional monitoring recommended to evaluate workplace influence patterns
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Surveillance supplémentaire recommandée pour évaluer les schémas d'influence au travail

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I don't like how much her work seems to be deciding for her.
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Je n'aime pas à quel point son travail semble décider à sa place.

HAK archived an image from a fitting session involving the new work outfits introduced by management
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: HAK a archivé une image d'une séance d'essayage impliquant les nouvelles tenues de travail introduites par la direction

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: EVENING
Outfit Trying
DAY 13
DAY 13
Thank you
And good luck tonight
Thank you 😊
Send me a message during your break
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Envoie-moi un message pendant ta pause

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I will
1 H LATER
I'm so good at picking the right outfit right ?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Je suis vraiment douée pour choisir la bonne tenue, non ?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I can understand that, but you also don't want to fall into the trap of avoiding work because it's hard
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Je comprends, mais tu ne veux pas non plus tomber dans le piège d'éviter le travail parce que c'est difficile

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: LATER, AFTER {{name:hailey}} BROUGHT FOOD TO YOUR ROOM
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: PLUS TARD, APRÈS QUE {{name:hailey}} AIT APPORTÉ DE LA NOURRITURE DANS TA CHAMBRE

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Everything went well with your professor?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Tout s'est bien passé avec ton professeur ?
Le prof a aussi envoyé un message

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He said my answer from earlier was closer than he expected
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Il a dit que ma réponse de tout à l'heure était plus proche que ce qu'il s'attendait

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Like someone finally understands where I get lost
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Comme si quelqu'un comprenait enfin où je me perds

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Don't rely on him too much
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ne compte pas trop sur lui

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But he already knows all the exam stuff
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Mais il connaît déjà tout le programme de l'examen

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And he explains things in a way that actually makes sense
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Et il explique les choses d'une manière qui a vraiment du sens

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He said I can come back tomorrow if I need the quiet
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Il a dit que je peux revenir demain si j'ai besoin de calme

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Anyway I am going to sleep before you start thinking too loudly
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Bref, je vais dormir avant que tu commences à penser trop fort
Bonne nuit, petit fauteur de troubles

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He's actually very nice when he doesn't talk about homework
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Il est en fait très sympa quand il ne parle pas de devoirs

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He said I can come back tomorrow if I want to revise somewhere quiet
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Il a dit que je peux revenir demain si je veux réviser quelque part au calme

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: A little weird that he offered that, but good that he did
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: C'est un peu bizarre qu'il ait proposé ça, mais c'est bien qu'il l'ait fait

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Yeah, but I don't know if I will go
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ouais, mais je ne sais pas si j'irai

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I'm not built for academic suffering
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Je ne suis pas faite pour souffrir académiquement

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I am just a tiny little victim 😔
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Je suis juste une petite victime 😔

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This is going to sound stupid
I felt like my manager was looking at me a bit weird today
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'avais l'impression que mon manager me regardait un peu bizarrement aujourd'hui.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was a really long day
I'm probably just tired and overthinking
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis probablement juste fatigué et en train de trop réfléchir.
Ne commence pas à imaginer des choses non plus.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But you don't have to worry about me
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mais tu n'as pas à t'inquiéter pour moi
Je suis vraiment fatigué ce soir.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to shower and go to bed
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je vais prendre une douche et aller au lit.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Can I get a goodnight pic?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puis-je avoir une photo de bonne nuit ?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I really don't have the energy
I'll make it up to you tomorrow
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je te le ferai oublier demain.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK: A new creator account has posted content that may match someone close to you
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK : Un nouveau compte créateur a posté du contenu qui pourrait correspondre à quelqu'un de proche de toi

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AlphaMana posted: New assistant ! A good one
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: AlphaMana a posté : Nouveau assistant ! Un bon !

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I barely had time to breathe
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je n'ai à peine eu le temps de respirer.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Just a lot of work all at once
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Juste beaucoup de travail d'un coup.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: New stuff, more responsibility, everything at the same time
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nouveaux trucs, plus de responsabilités, tout en même temps

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I have to stop by the gym first
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Je dois d'abord passer par la salle de sport

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'll grab it and come back
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Je vais le prendre et revenir

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You'll be back for dinner at least?
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Tu seras de retour pour le dîner au moins ?
Tu veux des frites ce soir ?

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Don't eat everything before I get home
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ne mange pas tout avant que je rentre

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Subject remains at gym longer than expected
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Le sujet reste à la salle de sport plus longtemps que prévu

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I was ready to laugh about the delay, and now I'm worried about what happened at the gym.
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: J'allais plaisanter sur le retard, et maintenant je m'inquiète de ce qui s'est passé à la salle.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: {{name:mason}} appears to be in an uncomfortable situation at the gym.
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: {{name:mason}} semble être dans une situation inconfortable à la salle de sport.

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I didn't come downstairs for nothing
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Je ne suis pas descendu pour rien

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'm surprised you even found the kitchen
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Je suis surpris que tu aies même trouvé la cuisine
Ouais, les frites ont l'air bonnes
Je ne peux pas pour l'instant

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I honestly did not expect that much
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Honnêtement, je ne m'attendais pas à autant

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Do you want to try again today?
Alright, I'll keep you updated when I find a good client
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: D'accord, je te tiendrai au courant quand je trouverai un bon client
Je vais préparer le petit déjeuner

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Come eat when you're done, okay?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Viens manger quand tu as fini, d'accord ?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I think yesterday helped a lot
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Je pense qu'hier a beaucoup aidé

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I feel much less stressed now
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Je me sens beaucoup moins stressée maintenant

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: And I have some good news

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: La sortie d'hier a été payée 300 $

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You're starting to look like part of the furniture
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: On dirait que tu fais partie du décor
{{name:evelyn}} a préparé le petit-déjeuner ce matin

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You should come eat with us
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tu devrais venir manger avec nous

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Even if you have to crawl all the way here 😭
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Même si tu dois ramper jusqu'ici 😭

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'll ask your private {{name:tutor}} to give you extra exercises today
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Je vais demander à ton {{name:tutor}} privé de te donner des exercices supplémentaires aujourd'hui

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That should keep your funny ideas out of my breakfast
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ça devrait éloigner tes idées farfelues de mon petit-déjeuner

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: The pancakes belong to me now
The leg is getting better every week
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: La jambe va mieux chaque semaine

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: When do you see the doctor again?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Quand est-ce que tu revois le médecin ?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Hopefully he'll finally get rid of the cast
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: J'espère qu'il va enfin se débarrasser du plâtre

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ce n'est pas mal, je te promets.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You saying that makes me stress more
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Le fait que tu dises ça me stresse encore plus.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I just thought a lot about where we are
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je viens de beaucoup réfléchir à l'endroit où nous sommes.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: About how much I trust you
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: À quel point je te fais confiance

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And about how I feel when I'm honest with myself
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et à propos de ce que je ressens quand je suis honnête avec moi-même
Mais sérieux ne veut pas dire négatif.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's actually more positive than anything
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est en fait plus positif que quoi que ce soit.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to talk about it properly tonight
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je veux en parler correctement ce soir.
Le cocon de couverture a-t-il fonctionné ?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not quickly before I start my day
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pas rapidement avant de commencer ma journée.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Just the two of us, when I can explain it right
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Juste nous deux, quand je peux bien l'expliquer
Tu es sûr que je ne devrais pas m'inquiéter ?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't want you carrying stress all day because of me
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je ne veux pas que tu portes du stress toute la journée à cause de moi.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I need to fix that
A sleepy mess, but you love me anyway right ?😌
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un désordre endormi, mais tu m'aimes quand même, n'est-ce pas ?😌

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You say that when I look half asleep
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu dis ça quand j'ai l'air à moitié endormi.
J'essaierai de ne pas trop réfléchir.
Je n'ai pas très bien dormi.
On se parle plus tard, beau ❤️

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I had too much in my head
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'avais trop de choses en tête.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: How does it feel getting up early just to suffer?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Comment ça fait de se lever tôt juste pour souffrir ?
Je ne comptais pas le faire

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Send me a photo of {{mason:him}} suffering first
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Envoie-moi d'abord une photo de {{mason:him}} en train de souffrir
C'est exactement ce que je voulais 😂

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'm giving {{mason:his}} phone back before {{mason:he}} starts crying
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Je rends {{mason:his|son|son}} téléphone avant {{mason:he|qu'il|qu'elle}} se mette à pleurer.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Sorry, I can't read that right now
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Désolée, je ne peux pas lire ça maintenant

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'm too busy imagining you suffering through your workout
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Je suis trop occupée à imaginer ta souffrance pendant l'entraînement

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: The idiot kept looking at it instead of focusing
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: L'idiot n'arrêtait pas de le regarder au lieu de se concentrer

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: How does it feel getting up early just to suffer?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Comment ça fait de se lever tôt juste pour souffrir ?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: {{mason:He}} needs more focus, but {{mason:he}}'s doing great
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: {{mason:He|Il|Elle}} doit se concentrer davantage, mais {{mason:he|il|elle}} s'en sort très bien.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Can you do me a favor?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Tu peux me rendre un service ?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Send me a photo of {{name:mason}} suffering during the session please
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Envoie-moi une photo de {{name:mason}} en train de souffrir pendant la séance, s'il te plaît

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Just to keep some memories of this moment
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Juste pour garder un souvenir de ce moment

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Sorry, I can't read that right now
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Désolée, je ne peux pas lire ça maintenant

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'm too busy imagining you suffering through your workout
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Je suis trop occupée à imaginer ta souffrance pendant l'entraînement
J'ai le téléphone de {{name:mason}} en ce moment

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I took it away because {{mason:he}} wasn't focusing on the session
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Je l'ai confisqué parce {{mason:he|qu'il|qu'elle}} ne se concentrait pas sur la séance.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: It has been a long time since I went to the cinema
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ça fait longtemps que je ne suis pas allée au cinéma

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I'll keep you updated with the place and the final details
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Je te tiendrai au courant du lieu et des détails finaux

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Try to enjoy it and have a good day
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Essaie d'en profiter et passe une bonne journée

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I have a new profile for you
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: J'ai un nouveau profil pour toi

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I just arrived at the place

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Et en fait, il est plutôt beau gosse aussi

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But I feel less comfortable with people looking at us
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Mais je me sens moins à l'aise avec les gens qui nous regardent

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Try to focus on the moment
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Essaie de te concentrer sur l'instant présent

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: If people are looking, they are probably just jealous
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Si les gens regardent, c'est probablement juste par jalousie

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: It reassures me to have you close, even if it is only through the phone
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ça me rassure de t'avoir près de moi, même si c'est juste par téléphone

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: If anything happens, you message me right away
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Si quoi que ce soit se passe, envoie-moi un message tout de suite

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I liked the movie, but I liked walking out with you even more.
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: J'ai aimé le film, mais j'ai encore plus aimé sortir avec toi.
Quelqu'un de plus jeune cette fois

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: He would like to take you on a movie date
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Il aimerait t'inviter à un rendez-vous cinéma

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I already feel like some subjects are getting easier
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: J'ai déjà l'impression que certaines matières deviennent plus faciles

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe Ethan knows what he's doing
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Peut-être qu'Ethan sait ce qu'il fait

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Or maybe it's because he's handsome
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ou peut-être que c'est parce qu'il est beau

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That's definitely not how education works
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ce n'est définitivement pas comme ça que l'éducation fonctionne

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Or I'll tell him to give you extra punishments
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ou je lui dirai de te donner des punitions supplémentaires

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I might need some extra punishments
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: J'aurais peut-être besoin de quelques punitions supplémentaires

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have something annoying to admit
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: J'ai quelque chose d'ennuyant à admettre

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm just taking every possibility into consideration 😇
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je prends juste toutes les possibilités en considération 😇
Et pourtant, tout le monde m'adore

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Can you do me a favor?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu peux me rendre un service ?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have a package waiting for pickup
Can you grab it for me?
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu peux le récupérer pour moi ?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Using your injured leg to get free labor 😭
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Utiliser ta jambe blessée pour obtenir du travail gratuit 😭

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: And I'll bring it over after my tutoring session
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Et je te l'apporterai après ma séance de tutorat

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He's supposed to arrive soon anyway
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Il est censé arriver bientôt de toute façon

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You owe me pancakes for this 😌
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu me dois des pancakes pour ça 😌
Je pense que ça fonctionne vraiment

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I understood a few things in class today that would've completely confused me last week
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: J'ai compris quelques trucs en cours aujourd'hui qui m'auraient complètement perdu la semaine dernière

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You fucking asshole, I'm going to make you pay for that photo
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Espèce de connard, je vais te faire payer pour cette photo

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: No
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Non

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: What
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Quoi

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Why
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Pourquoi

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: As your secretary, it's my duty to handle your appointments
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: En tant que ta secrétaire, c'est mon devoir de gérer tes rendez-vous
