story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I like spending time with you too
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: J'aime aussi passer du temps avec toi

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And I am even expanding my little goblin photo album with all your pictures
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Et j'agrandis même mon petit album photo de gobelin avec toutes tes photos

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Did you just call me a goblin?
I open my heart and this is my reward 😔
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: J'ouvre mon cœur et voilà ma récompense 😔
Tu continues d'envoyer des photos de toute façon

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Maybe because someone keeps asking for them 💅
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Peut-être parce que quelqu'un n'arrête pas de demander 💅

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: One more for the creepy goblin collection 😭
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Une de plus pour la collection de gobelins creepy 😭
Tout le monde attend en bas

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: So hurry up and drag your little larva body down here 😭
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Alors dépêche-toi et traîne ton petit corps de larve ici 😭

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You look way too proud of yourself
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Tu as l'air beaucoup trop fier de toi

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Because I survived classes AND cooked !
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Parce que j'ai survécu aux cours ET cuisiné !
Une journée suspectement productive pour toi

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It made everything feel more real
It felt really good having you here
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: C'était vraiment agréable de t'avoir ici.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because I don't want today to be a one time thing
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Parce que je ne veux pas que aujourd'hui soit un événement unique.
Tu es bien rentré chez toi ?
Et... merci pour tout à l'heure

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I really hope you liked it too
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'espère vraiment que ça t'a plu aussi.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Talking together about what I like before
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Parlons ensemble de ce que j'aimais avant.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And moving forward while making your partner feel good too
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Et avancer tout en faisant en sorte que ton partenaire se sente bien aussi.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That worked really, really well for me ❤️
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ça a vraiment, vraiment bien fonctionné pour moi ❤️

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That makes me very happy to hear
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Cela me rend très heureux d'entendre ça.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because I want more of that with you
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Parce que je veux plus de ça avec toi

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now I need to calm down a little before bed 😭
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Maintenant, je dois me calmer un peu avant de dormir 😭

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I already miss you a little
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Et tu me manques déjà un peu

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Did you have a good time?
And seeing you move more easily made me so happy
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Et te voir bouger plus facilement m'a rendu si heureux.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: The teasing between you and {{name:mason}} keeps getting more competitive.
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Les taquineries entre toi et {{name:mason}} deviennent de plus en plus compétitives.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Every game now feels like a personal challenge.
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Chaque jeu ressemble maintenant à un défi personnel.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'm starting to care more about being there with {{name:mason}} than winning.
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Être là avec {{name:mason}} commence à compter plus pour moi que gagner.
Ne me dis pas que tu te caches

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: You'll get a free lesson on how to exercise properly
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Tu auras une leçon gratuite sur comment bien t'exercer
Je vais surveiller ça de près
Je sais que tu le feras 😏
Tu commences déjà à avoir peur ? 😏

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Had to be clean before destroying you
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Fallait que je sois propre avant de te détruire

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.source: Repeated cardiac anomalies detected during today's private interactions
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.translation: Anomalies cardiaques répétées détectées lors des interactions privées d'aujourd'hui.
Exécution de la reconstruction de la trace émotionnelle...

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.source: Relevant moments have been archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.translation: Les moments pertinents ont été archivés dans les preuves HAK.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.source: The little moments with {{name:lena}} are staying with me more than I expected.
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.translation: Ces petits moments avec {{name:lena}} me restent en tête plus que prévu.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Elle ne fera plus jamais de bruit

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I mean she promised to be quieter
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Je veux dire, elle avait promis d'être plus silencieuse

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: For a second I was actually worried
Although {{name:hailey}} is making enough noise for the whole house right now 😅
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Bien que {{name:hailey}} fasse assez de bruit pour toute la maison en ce moment 😅

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Can you tell her to be a little quieter?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Peux-tu lui dire d'être un peu plus silencieuse ?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Otherwise I'll have to go upstairs and do it myself
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Sinon je vais devoir monter et le faire moi-même

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Study is killing me 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Les études me tuent 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He heard me talk about it whith my friends
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Il m'a entendu en parler avec mes amis

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Apparently I have to come revise with him after class instead
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Apparemment, je dois venir réviser avec lui après les cours à la place

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Seriously?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Sérieusement ?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Yes 😔
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Oui 😔

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But then he made a deal with me
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mais ensuite, il a fait un deal avec moi

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If I do well on the quiz tomorrow, he will personally take me shopping himself
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Si je réussis le quiz demain, il m'emmènera lui-même faire du shopping

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He said that?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Il a dit ça ?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: YES 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: OUI 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He said I need motivation
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Il a dit que j'avais besoin de motivation

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And that he heard shopping is apparently my natural habitat
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Et qu'il a entendu dire que le shopping est apparemment mon habitat naturel

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: My brain is swollen
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mon cerveau est en ébullition

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Which is rude but accurate 😔
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ce qui est rude mais vrai 😔

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Look at this face
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Regarde cette tête

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Does this look like someone built for revision suffering?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ça ressemble à quelqu'un qui n'est pas faite pour souffrir en révisant ?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Looks like someone trying to negotiate her way out of studying
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: On dirait quelqu'un qui essaie de négocier pour éviter d'étudier

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Correct 😌
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Exactement 😌

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But honestly the shopping promise is kind of motivating me
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mais honnêtement, la promesse de shopping me motive un peu

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I hate that it is working
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Je déteste que ça fonctionne

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Reward-based attention from an authority figure is strengthening emotional attachment patterns.
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: L'attention basée sur les récompenses d'une figure d'autorité renforce les schémas d'attachement émotionnel.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Ask why he wants to take her shopping
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Demande-lui pourquoi il veut l'emmener faire du shopping.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Focus on helping her survive the quiz
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Concentre-toi sur le fait de l'aider à survivre au quiz.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Probably illegal
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: C'est probablement illégal

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Why does he want to take you shopping himself?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Pourquoi il veut t'emmener faire du shopping lui-même ?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Because apparently stressed students need rewards
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Parce qu'apparemment, les étudiants stressés ont besoin de récompenses.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And because he thinks I work better when I have motivation
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Et parce qu'il pense que je travaille mieux quand j'ai de la motivation.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You are making this sound way more dramatic than it is 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tu rends ça beaucoup plus dramatique que ça ne l'est 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Survive the quiz first. Shopping after.
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Survis au quiz d'abord. Shopping après.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: See 😌
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tu vois 😌

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You and him are bullying me together now
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Toi et lui, vous me harcelez ensemble maintenant.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Huge morning today 😔
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Grosse matinée aujourd'hui 😔

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Fine
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: D'accord

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If I become the smartest girl alive, somebody defenetly owes me clothes 😌
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Si je deviens la fille la plus intelligente du monde, quelqu'un me doit définitivement des vêtements 😌

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Now let me survive this horrible morning first 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: D'abord, laisse-moi survivre à ce horrible matin 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Afternoon free though
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: L'après-midi est libre par contre

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Which means shopping should legally happen
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ce qui veut dire que le shopping devrait légalement avoir lieu

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That's not a good idea
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ce n'est pas une bonne idée

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: 15 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 15 MINUTES PLUS TARD

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That is exactly what my professor said 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: C'est exactement ce que mon prof a dit 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He literally told me I am not allowed to go shopping today
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Il m'a littéralement dit que je n'avais pas le droit d'aller faire du shopping aujourd'hui

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But I think it'll be fine 🙂
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mais je pense que ça ira bien 🙂
Ne commence pas à t'inquiéter déjà.
Difficile de ne pas le faire après hier.
Mais hier c'était juste le désordre.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't want every morning to feel like an interrogation
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je ne veux pas que chaque matin ressemble à un interrogatoire.
Je me soucie juste de toi

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I care about you too
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et je tiens à toi aussi

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I just need you to trust me a little
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai juste besoin que tu me fasses un peu confiance.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have to get ready now
I fell asleep fast after yesterday 😅
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je me suis endormi rapidement après hier 😅

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'll make sure you're the one getting dragged out of bed tomorrow
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Je vais m'assurer que c'est toi qui sera traîné hors du lit demain

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Keep talking and you'll be late for work
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Continue de parler et tu vas être en retard au travail

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: If you don't get up soon
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Si tu ne te lèves pas bientôt

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'll drag my cast all the way to your room just to wake you up 😌
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Je vais traîner mon plâtre jusqu'à ta chambre juste pour te réveiller 😌

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Hey, I was looking for you
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Hé, je te cherchais

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: And you took a photo of me? 😳
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Et tu as pris une photo de moi ? 😳

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Sorry, I didn't mean to make you uncomfortable
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Désolé, je ne voulais pas te mettre mal à l'aise
Tu avais juste l'air paisible
Et très belle

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Besides, you're right to take care of your body
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: En plus, tu as raison de prendre soin de ton corps
Merci

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That's sweet of you to say
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: C'est gentil de ta part de dire ça

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I just want to be in shape for tonight
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Je veux juste être en forme pour ce soir

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I did a little workout before getting ready
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Alors j'ai fait un petit entraînement avant de me préparer
Ça se comprend
Je ne pouvais pas te trouver nulle part

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Just don't push yourself too hard
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Mais ne te pousse pas trop, d'accord ?
Je ne le ferai pas, ne t'inquiète pas
À propos de la promenade

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: How about we do it tomorrow?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Et si on le faisait demain ?
Bien sûr, ça me va
Super

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I have to go get ready now
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Je dois y aller pour me préparer maintenant
D'accord, à plus tard !

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I wanted to ask if you wanted to walk a little with me
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Je voulais te demander si tu voulais marcher un peu avec moi
QUELQUES MINUTES PLUS TARD...

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I didn't think to look for you in the garden
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Je n'ai pas pensé à te chercher dans le jardin

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But I'm glad you started yoga again 🙂
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Mais je suis contente que tu aies recommencé le yoga 🙂
40 MINUTES PLUS TARD
Oh mon dieu
Je ne t'ai même pas vue

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Quiz survécu 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Which is good because I need it
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ce qui est bien parce que j'en ai besoin.
Mais bientôt shopping 😌

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: When I think about all the things I will be able to choose with professor money 💅
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Quand je pense à toutes les choses que je pourrai choisir avec l'argent du prof 💅

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Do not get your hopes up
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ne te fais pas trop d'illusions.
Je ne le fais pas.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I just want to be hopeful for once 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je veux juste être optimiste pour une fois 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have been so stressed about school that I have not allowed myself to be excited about anything else
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: J'ai été tellement stressée par l'école que je ne me suis pas permis d'être excitée par autre chose.
Envoie-moi un message quand tu pars.
Oui, papa.
Attends, non.
C'était correct.
Ça sonne horrible.
Ça l'est vraiment.
Je me supprime maintenant 😭
Je t'enverrai un message plus tard.
1 HEURE PLUS TARD

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Unexpected emotional variance detected during private revision session
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Variation émotionnelle inattendue détectée lors de la session de révision privée.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Behavioral analysis indicates discomfort but excitement from subject {{name:hailey}}
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: L'analyse comportementale indique un inconfort mais de l'excitation chez le sujet {{name:hailey}}.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Observed interaction pattern exceeds expected academic boundaries
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Le modèle d'interaction observé dépasse les limites académiques attendues.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Honnêtement ?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: As long as you're comfortable with it, I'm really happy to do this work with you
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Tant que tu es à l'aise avec ça, je suis vraiment heureuse de faire ce travail avec toi

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: How did it go?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Comment ça s'est passé ?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: That is really kind of you ❤️
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: C'est vraiment gentil de ta part ❤️

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Thank you
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Merci

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: But don't you find it strange?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Mais tu ne trouves pas ça étrange ?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Sending me to spend time with strangers and knowing everything that happens?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: M'envoyer passer du temps avec des inconnus et savoir tout ce qui se passe ?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: No
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Non

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Actually, I prefer it this way
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: En fait, je préfère comme ça

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I can keep an eye on everything and make sure you're safe
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Je peux garder un œil sur tout et m'assurer que tu es en sécurité

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And honestly, I feel like it brings us closer too
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Et honnêtement, je pense que ça nous rapproche aussi

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'm really happy to share all of this with you
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Je suis vraiment heureuse de partager tout ça avec toi

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: That touches me more than you think...
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ça me touche plus que tu ne le penses...

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: It was okay
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: C'était pas mal

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Which is why I want to be honest with you
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: C'est pourquoi je veux être honnête avec toi

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: He kissed me at the end of the date
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Il m'a embrassée à la fin du rendez-vous

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I didn't really know what to do
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Je ne savais pas trop quoi faire

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Then it started raining and I just ran home
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Puis il a commencé à pleuvoir et j'ai juste couru chez moi

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: That's why I was soaked when I got back
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: C'est pour ça que j'étais trempée en rentrant

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Are you okay?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Tu vas bien ?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Did he force you?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Est-ce qu'il t'a forcée ?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: No, not at all
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Non, pas du tout

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'm okay
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Je vais bien

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Then how do you feel about it?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Alors, qu'est-ce que tu en penses ?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: But it started raining, so I'm completely drenched
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Mais il a commencé à pleuvoir, donc je suis complètement mouillée

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Did you hate it?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Tu as détesté ça ?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Do you want me to warn him or put a note on his account?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Tu veux que je le prévienne ou que je mette une note sur son compte ?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: No...
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Non...

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I actually liked it
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: En fait, j'ai aimé ça

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: That's what makes me feel guilty
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: C'est ça qui me rend coupable

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Because of you
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: À cause de toi

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You don't have to feel guilty
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Tu n'as pas à te sentir coupable

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You're an adult
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Tu es une adulte

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You deserve to have your own life as a woman too
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Tu mérites d'avoir ta propre vie en tant que femme aussi

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Are you really sure it's okay? 🥺
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Tu es vraiment sûre que ça va ? 🥺

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Yes
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Oui

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'm sure
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Je suis sûre

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I promise
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Je te promets

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: That makes me feel relieved 😌
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ça me soulage 😌

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: It doesn't mean it will happen every time
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ça ne veut pas dire que ça arrivera à chaque fois

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: But I already feel less guilty about it
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Mais je me sens déjà moins coupable à ce sujet

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You're really sure it doesn't bother you?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Tu es vraiment sûre que ça ne te dérange pas ?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: No
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Non

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Actually, I want you to tell me whenever something like that happens
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: En fait, je veux que tu me dises chaque fois que quelque chose comme ça arrive

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I need to know because I have to charge the client extra when things go further than planned haha
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: J'ai besoin de le savoir parce que je dois facturer le client en plus quand les choses vont plus loin que prévu haha

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: So you really want me to tell you everything?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Donc tu veux vraiment que je te dise tout ?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Yes
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Oui

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: It's better that way
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: C'est mieux comme ça

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Alright ❤️
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: D'accord ❤️

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Then I'll tell you everything that happens from now on
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Alors je te raconterai tout ce qui se passe à partir de maintenant

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: DAY 14
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: JOUR 14

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: DAY 14
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: JOUR 14

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Sorry the rain ended things early. I still liked the walk more than I expected.
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Désolée que la pluie ait mis fin à la soirée. J'ai quand même aimé la promenade plus que je ne l'attendais.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Additional Noah date content unlocked.
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Contenu supplémentaire de rendez-vous avec Noah débloqué.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Go take a shower quickly
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Va prendre une douche rapidement.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I don't want you catching a cold
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Je ne veux pas que tu attrapes froid.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: What reward did you ask for this time?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Quelle récompense as-tu demandée cette fois ?
Tu sembles vraiment apprécier ces récompenses

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: If I'm going to suffer through quizzes, I deserve benefits
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Si je dois souffrir avec les quiz, je mérite des avantages

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: So how did it go with Ethan?
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Alors, ça s'est bien passé avec Ethan ?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That's not how studying usually works
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ce n'est pas comme ça que l'étude fonctionne habituellement
Et je réussis quand même mes quiz

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I'm putting a movie on downstairs
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Je mets un film en bas

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Hurry up and come watch it with me
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Dépêche-toi de venir le regarder avec moi

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: At the speed you move, it'll be over before you get down here 😭
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: À la vitesse à laquelle tu bouges, ça sera fini avant que tu arrives ici 😭

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I want to know if you're actually studying
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Je veux savoir si tu étudies vraiment

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Annoyingly enough, it's working very well
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: C'est agaçant, mais ça fonctionne très bien

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It made everything feel more real
It felt really good having you here
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'était vraiment agréable de t'avoir ici.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because I don't want today to be a one-time thing
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Parce que je ne veux pas que aujourd'hui soit un événement unique.
Tu es bien rentré chez toi ?
Et... merci pour tout à l'heure

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I really hope you liked it too
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'espère vraiment que ça t'a plu aussi.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Talking about your cuckold fantasy was... weird at first
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Parler de ta fantaisie de cocu était... étrange au début

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I hope you liked all the touching too
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et j'espère que tu as aimé tout le contact aussi.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially when you talked so close to my ear
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Surtout quand tu parlais si près de mon oreille

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That worked really, really well for me ❤️
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça a vraiment, vraiment bien fonctionné pour moi ❤️

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That makes me very happy to hear
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cela me rend très heureux d'entendre ça.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because I want more of that with you
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Parce que je veux plus de ça avec toi

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now I need to calm down a little before bed 😭
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Maintenant, je dois me calmer un peu avant de dormir 😭

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I already miss you a little
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et tu me manques déjà un peu.
Ne rends pas les choses pires 😌

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you have a good time?
And seeing you move more easily made me so happy
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et te voir bouger plus facilement m'a rendu si heureux.

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Tu es toujours en vie ?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: {{name:evelyn}} m'a dit que tu voulais utiliser sa salle de bain

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Even though you have one upstairs
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Alors que tu en as une à l'étage

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Tes jambes ont un peu de mal ?

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I just didn't feel like climbing the stairs
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Je n'avais juste pas envie de monter les escaliers

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Of course

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You survived twelve kilometers but the stairs defeated you

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: At least my legs hurt because I actually used them
story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Au moins mes jambes me font mal parce que je les ai vraiment utilisées

story/DAY13/nts/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Keep talking and tomorrow I'll find out how many kilometers it takes to make you crawl

story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Do not act like you have better plans
story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Ne fais pas semblant d'avoir de meilleurs plans.

story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I have good news and bad news
story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: J'ai de bonnes nouvelles et de mauvaises nouvelles.

story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I might, i have to train for a marathon
story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Je pourrais, je dois m'entraîner pour un marathon.

story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I hope it itches under your cast
story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: J'espère que ça démange sous ton plâtre.
Non, s'il te plaît, ne fais pas ça !

story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Patch notes wait for no one
story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Les notes de mise à jour n'attendent personne.

story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: No pain, no weird feeling, everything felt clean
story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Pas de douleur, pas de sensation étrange, tout semblait propre.

story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Yeah, I missed it more than I thought
story/DAY14/DAY14_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Ouais, ça m'a manqué plus que je ne le pensais.
Notre jeu a reçu une mise à jour

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: You should open your window more often
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Tu devrais ouvrir ta fenêtre plus souvent.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: It's not good staying locked in your room all day
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ce n'est pas bon de rester enfermé dans ta chambre toute la journée.
Même si c'est pour le travail.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I should probably air the room out more
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Je devrais probablement aérer la pièce plus souvent.
Au fait, comment va ta jambe ?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I feel like you've been moving around a lot lately
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: J'ai l'impression que tu bouges beaucoup ces derniers temps.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I'm worried you're going to hurt yourself
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Je crains que tu ne te fasses mal.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Honestly, it feels better every day
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Honnêtement, ça va mieux chaque jour.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: To see if the cast can come off soon
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Pour voir si le plâtre peut être enlevé bientôt.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: And to make you do some movement tests
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Et pour te faire faire quelques tests de mouvement.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I'm actually looking forward to it
Anyway, I should get ready for work
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: De toute façon, je devrais me préparer pour le travail.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I'll message you when I get some free time
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Je te message quand j'ai un peu de temps libre.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: And don't forget to drink water
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Et n'oublie pas de boire de l'eau.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Do you have clothes that need washing?
Yeah, I have a few things
I'll come upstairs and grab them
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Je vais monter et les prendre.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Tu voulais le deal de vêtements

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I fully intend to abuse it 💅
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Et j'ai bien l'intention d'en abuser 💅

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: If I do not return, tell the world I fought bravely
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Si je ne reviens pas, dis au monde que j'ai combattu bravement

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And that the cafeteria muffins were terrible
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Et que les muffins de la cafétéria étaient terribles

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I wrote it while emotionally unstable
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Je l'ai écrit en étant émotionnellement instable

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: See you after the academic war 🤍
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: On se voit après la guerre académique 🤍

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Today is the big test day
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Aujourd'hui, c'est le grand jour du test

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: We are about to find out if all this revision actually worked
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: On va bientôt découvrir si toute cette révision a vraiment porté ses fruits

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You know more than you think
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Tu sais plus que tu ne le penses

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Because if my brain betrays me now I am suing it, and you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Parce que si mon cerveau me trahit maintenant, je le poursuis en justice, et toi aussi

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Just focus on tomorrow's shopping reward
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Concentre-toi sur la récompense de shopping de demain

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Parce que maintenant je veux des détails
J'ai aussi fait de beaux rêves.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: But I had a hard time falling asleep first because I kept thinking about you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Mais j'ai eu du mal à m'endormir d'abord parce que je n'arrêtais pas de penser à toi.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You really suffer so much because of me
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu souffres vraiment tellement à cause de moi.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Can I get a picture of the girl ruining my sleep before she leaves for uni?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Puis-je avoir une photo de la fille qui ruine mon sommeil avant qu'elle ne parte à l'université ?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Now behave while I'm in class 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Maintenant, sois sage pendant que je suis en classe 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll talk to you at noon

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: J'ai fait de très beaux rêves ❤️

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: But maybe a little related to what happened at your place 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Mais peut-être un peu lié à ce qui s'est passé chez toi 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: You've been waiting all morning to see this body in action
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Tu attendais toute la matinée pour voir ce corps en action

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: I need to study proper technique
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Je dois étudier la bonne technique

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: That's what we're calling it now
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: C'est comme ça qu'on appelle ça maintenant

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: So that's why you texted me
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Alors c'est pour ça que tu m'as texté

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Are you ready for your punishment?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into French.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Hey, I'm starting to get hungry
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Hé, je commence à avoir faim.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: And you do not need to rush
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Et tu n'as pas besoin de te dépêcher.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I was just worried because you did not answer
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Je m'inquiétais juste parce que tu n'as pas répondu.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: That is very sweet of you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: C'est très gentil de ta part.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I will be upstairs in ten minutes with your lunch
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Je serai à l'étage dans dix minutes avec ton déjeuner

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Could you bring me something to eat if it does not bother you?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Peux-tu me rapporter quelque chose à manger si ça ne te dérange pas ?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I was worried a second ago. Now I'm struggling to find my words.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Il y a une seconde, j'étais inquiet. Maintenant, je cherche mes mots.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I just got out of the shower
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Je viens de sortir de la douche

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'll dry myself quickly and bring you something to eat
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Je vais me sécher rapidement et te rapporter quelque chose à manger

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I am proud of your non-empty page
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Je suis fière de ta page non vide

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: This is the face of a soldier between battles
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Voici le visage d'un soldat entre deux batailles

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Wow i'm starting to believe youre actually at war
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Wow, je commence à croire que tu es vraiment en guerre

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: But i am cute enough to survive
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Mais je suis assez mignonne pour survivre

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Go win the next round then
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Vas-y, gagne le prochain round alors

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I am going back to the front
If I fall, avenge me with tomorrow's shopping money 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Si je tombe, venge-moi avec l'argent des courses de demain 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: And then I have more tests 😭
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Et après, j'ai encore plus de tests 😭

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: How did the first ones go?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Comment se sont passés les premiers ?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Maybe my brain invented a new academic language
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Peut-être que mon cerveau a inventé un nouveau langage académique

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: But I did not leave the page blank at least 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Mais au moins, je n'ai pas laissé la page blanche 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: You say that like you don't enjoy watching the chaos
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Tu le dis comme si tu n'aimais pas regarder le chaos.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: I just hope I don't finish too late tonight
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: J'espère juste que je ne finirai pas trop tard ce soir.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: But I really want to talk whith you tonight ❤️
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Mais je veux vraiment parler avec toi ce soir ❤️

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Then as soon as you get home we will talk
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Alors dès que tu rentreras à la maison, nous parlerons.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: That gives me something nice to look forward to
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Cela me donne quelque chose de sympa à attendre.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Okay, I should get back before lunch break disappears
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: D'accord, je devrais revenir avant que la pause déjeuner ne disparaisse.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Good luck for the rest of the day
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Bonne chance pour le reste de la journée

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Don't forget to move your body and don't play to much game
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: N'oublie pas de bouger ton corps et ne joue pas trop au jeu.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Just long and a little boring
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Juste long et un peu ennuyeux

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: So basically a classic university morning 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Donc, en gros, un matin classique à l'université 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: I'm eating with my friends right now
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Je mange avec mes amis en ce moment.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: And {{name:aiden}} apparently found another group of girls to annoy
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Et {{name:aiden}} a apparemment trouvé un autre groupe de filles à embêter

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: We'll settle it on the game tonight
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: On le réglera dans le jeu ce soir

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe we should train somewhere else
If you can with your cast
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Si tu peux avec ton plâtre

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I've already seen people swimming with a cast
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: J'ai déjà vu des gens nager avec un plâtre

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: She's probably better than both of us
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Elle est probablement meilleure que nous deux

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: You were actually pretty impressive for once
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu étais en fait assez impressionnant cette fois-ci

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Try not to sound too surprised
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Essaie de ne pas avoir l'air trop surpris

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Don't let it get to your head
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Ne laisse pas ça te monter à la tête
Je finis le travail plus tôt aujourd'hui

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: If you've got a problem with me
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Si t'as un problème avec moi

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Then I'll come downstairs and help you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ensuite, je descendrai et je t'aiderai

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I can't let you do everything alone
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Je ne peux pas te laisser tout faire toute seule

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Would you like to continue the series?
You don't even need to ask
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Tu n'as même pas besoin de demander

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'm waiting for you on the couch 😌
I just finished brushing my teeth
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Je viens de finir de me brosser les dents
Interactions privées du soir répétées détectées

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Capture émotionnelle pertinente archivée dans les preuves HAK

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: So I'm not imagining how close we've become.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Alors je n'imagine pas ce rapprochement entre nous.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I actually enjoy what I'm doing
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: J'apprécie vraiment ce que je fais

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Did you already start making dinner?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Tu as déjà commencé à préparer le dîner ?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Je ne peux plus faire ça 😭

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I am really proud of you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Je suis vraiment fière de toi

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Later, after you brought food to {{name:hailey}} in her room
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Plus tard, après que tu aies apporté de la nourriture à {{name:hailey}} dans sa chambre

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I still cannot believe my private professor brought me food in bed 😭
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Je n'arrive toujours pas à croire que mon prof particulier m'a apporté à manger au lit 😭
Tu avais l'air à moitié morte

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: That is not an excuse to stare at me while I eat
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ce n'est pas une excuse pour me regarder pendant que je mange

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You took a picture of me 😭
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Tu as pris une photo de moi 😭

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You are literally a paparazzi pervert
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Tu es littéralement une paparazzi pervers

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The evidence shows a tired innocent girl being harassed in her natural habitat 😔
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Les preuves montrent une fille fatiguée et innocente harcelée dans son habitat naturel 😔

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You are lucky I am exhausted
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Tu as de la chance que je sois épuisée

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Otherwise I would destroy you verbally right now
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Sinon, je te détruirais verbalement là tout de suite

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Elevated heart rate spike detected during recent private interaction
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Fréquence cardiaque élevée détectée lors d'une interaction privée récente
Croisement des marqueurs visuels et émotionnels...

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Capture émotionnelle pertinente archivée dans les preuves HAK

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I keep looking forward to those moments with her, even when I have no clever line ready.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: J'ai toujours hâte de partager ces moments avec elle, même quand je n'ai aucune réplique maligne en tête.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Tomorrow I am sleeping for ten years
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Demain, je dors pendant dix ans

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You survived the whole day though
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Mais tu as survécu toute la journée

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I am taking a shower and collapsing into my bed after this
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Je vais prendre une douche et m'effondrer dans mon lit après ça

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But first I'm going to take a shower and eat something
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mais d'abord, je vais prendre une douche et manger quelque chose.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And yet you still like me
Keep it to yourself, of course
She knows exactly how to catch me off guard. Even now.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Elle sait exactement comment me prendre au dépourvu. Même maintenant.
Tout juste sorti de la douche
Tu frappes de plus en plus fort.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How am I supposed to stay calm now?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Comment suis-je censé rester calme maintenant ?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But maybe that's exactly what I was going for 🤍
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mais peut-être que c'est exactement ce que je visais 🤍

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now let me eat before I become dramatic
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Laisse-moi manger avant que je ne devienne dramatique.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But I expect another one later
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mais j'en attends un autre plus tard.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because now I'm fed, clean, comfy, and all yours for the rest of the evening 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Parce que maintenant je suis rassasié, propre, à l'aise, et tout à toi pour le reste de la soirée 😌
Je savais que ça te plairait.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then you're keeping me company all night
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Alors tu me tiens compagnie toute la nuit.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I just need to get into bed and warm up a little, then I'm all yours
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je dois juste me mettre au lit et me réchauffer un peu, puis je suis à toi.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And the day actually went better than I thought it would
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Et la journée s'est en fait mieux passée que je ne le pensais.
Je ne suis même pas si fatigué.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So I have the whole evening for you ❤️
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Alors j'ai toute la soirée pour toi ❤️

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now that's exactly what I wanted to hear
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: C'est exactement ce que je voulais entendre.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: The playful rivalry between you and {{name:mason}} keeps escalating, turning every game into another excuse to get closer.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: La rivalité amusante entre toi et {{name:mason}} ne fait qu'escalader, transformant chaque jeu en une excuse pour se rapprocher.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I knew you were a sore loser
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Je savais que tu étais un mauvais perdant

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: But jumping on me so I couldn't win?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Mais me sauter dessus pour que je ne gagne pas ?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Didn't look like you hated it that much 😉
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: On dirait pas que ça t'a déplu tant que ça 😉

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Can we pretend that never happened?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: On peut faire comme si ça ne s'était jamais passé ?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Go to bed before I smash this cast over your head
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Va te coucher avant que je ne te casse ce plâtre sur la tête

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'm going to be even stronger tonight 😏
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Je vais être encore plus forte ce soir 😏
Tu ferais mieux de ne pas

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I just got out of the shower
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Je viens de sortir de la douche

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: If you started without me, you're dead
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Si tu commences sans moi, t'es mort

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I wouldn't steal your only chance to win 😂
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Je ne volerais pas ta seule chance de gagner 😂

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: The teasing between you and {{name:mason}} is becoming more personal.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Les taquineries entre toi et {{name:mason}} deviennent de plus en plus personnelles.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Another game feels like an excuse to stay close, and I'm happy to take it.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Une autre partie ressemble à une excuse pour rester proches, et je la saisis volontiers.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And explore a little further together
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Et explorons un peu plus ensemble.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: By learning what the other person likes and what feels good to them ❤️
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: En apprenant ce que l'autre personne aime et ce qui lui fait du bien ❤️

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: That's exactly what I want too
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: C'est exactement ce que je veux aussi.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Us figuring it out together feels right
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Nous le découvrons ensemble, ça semble juste.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Because I want it to stay like that with you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Parce que je veux que ça reste comme ça avec toi

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Now you're making me think too much before sleep
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Maintenant, tu me fais trop réfléchir avant de dormir.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Then maybe I should make it worse
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Alors peut-être que je devrais l'aggraver.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And way too proud of yourself
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Et beaucoup trop fier de toi-même

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: You're making it very hard to act normal right now
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Tu rends très difficile de rester normal en ce moment.
Maintenant, fais-moi un compliment comme il se doit 🤍
Nous apprenons déjà ce qui fonctionne 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Because I want a lot more of this with you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Parce que je veux beaucoup plus de ça avec toi

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: You have no idea how happy that makes me
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Tu n'as aucune idée à quel point cela me rend heureux.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: I'm really happy we had that talk the other day
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Je suis vraiment content que nous ayons eu cette conversation l'autre jour.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Now I really have to sleep before I keep getting worse
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Maintenant, je dois vraiment dormir avant que ça ne s'aggrave.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And try not to haunt me with those pictures
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Et essaie de ne pas me hanter avec ces images.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: It feels really good when we're that honest with each other
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Ça fait vraiment du bien quand on est aussi honnêtes l'un envers l'autre.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: I feel so much better now that things are clearer between us
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Je me sens tellement mieux maintenant que les choses sont plus claires entre nous.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And I really can't wait for us to open up more and more
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Et j'ai vraiment hâte que nous nous ouvrions de plus en plus.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: And I'm sorry I let you make breakfast again
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Et je suis désolée de t'avoir laissé préparer le petit-déjeuner encore une fois
Ce n'est vraiment pas un problème

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'm happy to take care of you for once
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Je suis contente de prendre soin de toi pour une fois

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I don't even know what to say to that
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Je ne sais même pas quoi dire à ça

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Just come downstairs when you're ready
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Descends juste quand tu es prête

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: And before you ask, I'm fine
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Et avant que tu ne demandes, ça va
Ma jambe ne me fait pas mal aujourd'hui

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: So don't worry about me and get some rest
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Alors ne t'inquiète pas pour moi et repose-toi un peu

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Last night must have been exhausting
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: La nuit dernière devait être épuisante

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: More like he already decided I am not allowed
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Plutôt comme s'il avait déjà décidé que je n'avais pas le droit

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Do not make me analyze it before battle
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ne me fais pas analyser ça avant la bataille

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Professor voice and your voice are merging in my head
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: La voix du prof et la tienne se mélangent dans ma tête

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: See you after the first battle 🤍
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: On se voit après la première bataille 🤍

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That is definitely a soldier face
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: C'est clairement un visage de soldat

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Professor made me review until my soul left my body yesterday
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Le prof m'a fait réviser jusqu'à ce que mon âme quitte mon corps hier

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So if I fail, I am suing him
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Donc si j'échoue, je le poursuis en justice

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I still have a full day ahead
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai encore une journée entière devant moi.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I just want this year to be over already 😌
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je veux juste que cette année soit déjà terminée 😌

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I'll only have the job to focus on
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Alors je n'aurai plus que le travail sur lequel me concentrer.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One thing at a time sounds nice right now
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Une chose à la fois semble agréable en ce moment.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you later if I can
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je te texterai plus tard si je peux.
Je n'ai pas très bien dormi.
Mon cerveau ne voulait pas se taire.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: How are things with those idiots at the gym?
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Comment ça se passe avec ces idiots à la salle de sport ?
Fais juste attention à ne pas faire de bêtises

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You should follow your own advice
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Tu devrais suivre ton propre conseil

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I had a good time too
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Je me suis bien amusé aussi

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'm just getting used to work and the gym
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Je m'habitue juste au travail et à la salle de sport

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Je suis prête pour notre promenade 😊

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Did you put on something light for the heat?
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu as mis quelque chose de léger pour la chaleur ?

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I wore my favorite summer outfit
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: J'ai mis ma tenue d'été préférée

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: And I feel perfectly comfortable in it
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Et je me sens parfaitement à l'aise dedans

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Entre les batailles 😭

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He fixed my shirt because it was folded weird
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Il a corrigé ma chemise parce qu'elle était mal pliée

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Before you say anything, I did not notice
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Avant que tu dises quoi que ce soit, je n'avais pas remarqué
C'est assez personnel
Ça a duré deux secondes
Et j'avais le cerveau en mode examen

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: My soul left my body three hours ago 😭
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mon âme a quitté mon corps il y a trois heures 😭

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Anyway I still have one more test later
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: De toute façon, j'ai encore un test plus tard

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If I survive this week I deserve financial compensation 😌
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Si je survis cette semaine, je mérite une compensation financière 😌
Tu veux dire faire du shopping encore
Exactement 💅
J'ai écrit des trucs

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I am going back to the front
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je retourne au front

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If I fall, avenge me with tomorrow's shopping money 😌
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Si je tombe, venge-moi avec l'argent des courses de demain 😌
47 MINUTES PLUS TARD
Capture visuelle supplémentaire archivée

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Detected elevated comfort level during private interaction
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Niveau de confort élevé détecté lors de l'interaction privée

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Behavioral tension exceeds expected teacher-student revision baseline
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: La tension comportementale dépasse le seuil de révision attendu entre prof et élève.
Niveau de confiance augmenté.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: She's getting comfortable around him. I'm not sure how I feel about that.
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Elle est de plus en plus à l'aise avec lui. Je ne sais pas trop ce que j'en pense.
HAK//PREUVES

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK detected prolonged eye contact, reduced personal distance, and elevated emotional responsiveness during an academic interaction between {{name:hailey}} and her professor
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK a détecté un contact visuel prolongé, une distance personnelle réduite et une réactivité émotionnelle élevée lors d'une interaction académique entre {{name:hailey}} et son professeur
Familiarité inattendue

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Some of them may even be correct
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Certains d'entre eux sont peut-être même corrects
C'est super !

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Professor caught me outside the room
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Le prof m'a attrapée dehors
Il a demandé comment ça s'était passé

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I said I did not cry on the paper
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: J'ai dit que je n'avais pas pleuré sur le papier
Il a ri 😭

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Sounds like full support from him
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: On dirait qu'il me soutient à fond
Ouais 😌

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..source: I just hope I don't finish too late tonight
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..translation: J'espère juste que je ne finirai pas trop tard ce soir

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..source: But I really want to talk with you tonight
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..translation: Mais j'ai vraiment envie de parler avec toi ce soir

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..source: Then as soon as you get home, we will talk
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..translation: Alors dès que tu rentres chez toi, on parlera

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..source: That gives me something nice to look forward to
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..translation: Ça me donne quelque chose de sympa à attendre

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..source: Okay, I should get back before lunch break disappears
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..translation: Ok, je devrais retourner avant que la pause déjeuner ne disparaisse

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..source: Good luck for the rest of the day
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..translation: Bonne chance pour le reste de la journée

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..source: Don't forget to move your body and don't play too many games
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..translation: N'oublie pas de bouger un peu et ne joue pas trop aux jeux

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..source: Just long and a little boring
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..translation: Juste long et un peu ennuyeux

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..source: So basically a classic university morning 😌
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..translation: Donc, en gros, un matin classique à l'université 😌

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..source: I'm eating with my friends right now
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..translation: Je mange avec mes amis en ce moment.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..source: And {{name:aiden}} just sat at our table
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..translation: Et {{name:aiden}} vient de s'asseoir à notre table
Il est en train d'être agaçant

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..source: He says I should send you something
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..translation: Il dit que je devrais t'envoyer quelque chose

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..source: And he's smiling like an idiot right now
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_NTR..translation: Et il sourit comme un idiot en ce moment
Tu as vraiment l'air bien pourtant

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I don't remember seeing your name on the box
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Je ne me souviens pas avoir vu ton nom sur la boîte

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Because you threw it away with the evidence
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Parce que tu l'as jetée avec les preuves

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Say that again and I'll eat your dessert too
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Dis ça encore et je mangerai aussi ton dessert

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: That's exactly what a guilty person would say
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: C'est exactement ce qu'une personne coupable dirait

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I knew you were the one who took the last slice
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Je savais que c'était toi qui avais pris la dernière part

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You broke into my room just to take a picture?
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Tu es entrée dans ma chambre juste pour prendre une photo ?

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You're lucky I didn't throw the slice at you
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: T'as de la chance que je ne t'ai pas lancé la part

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You would've wasted perfectly good food
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Tu aurais gâché de la bonne nourriture

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Thanks for coming with me today 😊

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Il a juste discuté un peu avec moi

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Sounds like you had a good afternoon
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: On dirait que tu as passé un bon après-midi

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Proof of emotional and academic damage
