Ethan a dit que je m'étais encore améliorée
Je n'ai pas gagné cette fois😭
Tu as enfin eu ta punition !

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: De retour à la maison plus tôt que prévu 😌

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But first I'm going to take a shower and eat something
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mais d'abord, je vais prendre une douche et manger quelque chose.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And yet you still like me
Keep it to yourself, of course

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tout juste sorti de la douche
Tu frappes de plus en plus fort.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How am I supposed to stay calm now?
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Comment suis-je censé rester calme maintenant ?

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But maybe that's exactly what I was going for 🤍
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mais peut-être que c'est exactement ce que je visais 🤍

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now let me eat before I become dramatic
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Laisse-moi manger avant que je ne devienne dramatique.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I expect another one later
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mais j'en attends un autre plus tard.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And the day actually went better than I thought it would
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et la journée s'est en fait mieux passée que je ne le pensais.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because now I'm fed, clean, comfy, and all yours for the rest of the evening 😌
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Parce que maintenant je suis rassasié, propre, à l'aise, et tout à toi pour le reste de la soirée 😌
Je savais que ça te plairait.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then you're keeping me company all night
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alors tu me tiens compagnie toute la nuit

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just need to get into bed and warm up a little, then I'm all yours
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je dois juste me mettre au lit et me réchauffer un peu, puis je suis à toi.
Je ne suis même pas si fatigué.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I have the whole evening for you ❤️
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alors j'ai toute la soirée pour toi ❤️

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now that's exactly what I wanted to hear
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Maintenant, c'est exactement ce que je voulais entendre.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: It's like the idea of sharing you is exciting to me
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: C'est comme si l'idée de te partager m'excitait.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Thinking about you taking pleasure with another man
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Penser à toi prenant du plaisir avec un autre homme
Ou flirter avec un autre gars

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: And the idea of someone else seeing all of you
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Et l'idée que quelqu'un d'autre puisse te voir entièrement...

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Having you for himself for a moment
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Avoir un moment rien que pour lui

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: All of that is extremely exciting to me
I think I'm starting to understand
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Je pense que je commence à comprendre

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: So when you say someone else seeing all of me
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Alors quand tu dis que quelqu'un d'autre voit tout de moi

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: If someone else saw me like that…
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Si quelqu'un d'autre me voyait comme ça...

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: What would that do to you?
It would excite me a lot
And the idea of another man seeing you like that does something to me
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Et l'idée qu'un autre homme te voie comme ça me fait quelque chose.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: That's what I wanted to know 😳
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: C'est ce que je voulais savoir 😳

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Now imagine I send something like that to someone else
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Maintenant imagine que j'envoie quelque chose comme ça à quelqu'un d'autre.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: I think I'd want to know, and I'd want to have it too
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Je pense que je voudrais savoir, et je voudrais l'avoir aussi.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: I think I'd want to know, but not receive it myself
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Je pense que je voudrais savoir, mais ne pas le recevoir moi-même.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: I don't think I'd want to know
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Je ne pense pas que je voudrais savoir

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: I've been thinking a lot about what you told me
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: J'ai beaucoup réfléchi à ce que tu m'as dit.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: So you'd want to share that moment with me?
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Alors tu voudrais partager ce moment avec moi ?

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Maybe not knowing would make it stronger
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Peut-être que ne pas savoir le rendrait plus fort.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: So the mystery would be part of it?
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Donc le mystère en ferait partie ?

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: You're really trying to understand this, huh
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Tu essaies vraiment de comprendre ça, hein ?

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: And maybe I like the way you react 😌
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Et peut-être que j'aime la façon dont tu réagis 😌
À propos de ton truc de cocu

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: But I feel safe doing this with you
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Mais je me sens en sécurité de faire cela avec toi.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Now I really need to stop before I go too far 😭
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Maintenant, je dois vraiment m'arrêter avant d'aller trop loin 😭

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Yeah... same here, it's getting harder to keep it together
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Ouais... moi aussi, c'est de plus en plus difficile de rester calme.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Be ready for next time then 😏
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Sois prêt pour la prochaine fois alors 😏

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: I'm trying to understand how it feels for you
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: J'essaie de comprendre ce que tu ressens.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Like… what exactly makes it exciting in your head
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Comme... qu'est-ce qui le rend exactement excitant dans ta tête ?

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: If you try to act tough and mess it up right away I will judge you loudly
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Si tu essaies de faire le dur et que tu te plantes tout de suite, je te jugerai bruyamment.

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Only one week of classes left
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Il ne reste qu'une semaine de cours.

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: What are you planning to do
Any news on when that cast comes off?
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Du nouveau sur quand on t'enlève ce plâtre ?

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: And drag you with me once your leg is ready
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Et je te traînerai avec moi une fois que ta jambe sera prête.

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: That's suppose to be a good thing?
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: C'est censé être une bonne chose ?

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: The doctor is checking my leg today, so I should know more after that
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Le médecin examine ma jambe aujourd'hui, donc j'en saurai plus après
Tu crois que c'est pour aujourd'hui ?

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Your leg has been in there long enough
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Ta jambe est enfermée là-dedans depuis assez longtemps

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I hope so, but I'm waiting to hear what he says
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: J'espère, mais j'attends de voir ce qu'il dit

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Even if it comes off, take it slow
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Même s'il te l'enlève, vas-y doucement

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: No celebrating with a sprint down the stairs
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Ne fête pas ça en dévalant les escaliers

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I'll ask him what I can do before I try anything
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Je lui demanderai ce que je peux faire avant de tenter quoi que ce soit

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Bonjour 😊

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: But I think I got enough rest
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Mais je pense que j'ai assez reposé
C'est bien

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: By the way, I sent you some money this morning
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Au fait, je t'ai envoyé de l'argent ce matin

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: For groceries, bills and everything else
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Pour les courses, les factures et tout le reste
Vraiment ?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I really don't know how to thank you
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Je ne sais vraiment pas comment te remercier

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: You already do enough for me
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Tu fais déjà assez pour moi
Tu as déjà fait tant de choses

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: You deserve to rest and enjoy yourself a little
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Tu mérites de te reposer et de profiter un peu

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: And honestly, I'm happy I get to spend so much time with you lately
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Et honnêtement, je suis contente de passer autant de temps avec toi ces derniers temps
Comment te sens-tu aujourd'hui ?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: It feels like we've gotten a lot closer
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: On dirait qu'on s'est beaucoup rapprochés
Je suis contente aussi

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I like spending more time with you
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: J'aime passer plus de temps avec toi
Plus que je ne m'y attendais, en fait 😌
Quoi qu'il en soit, n'oublie pas

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: The doctor is coming after work today
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Le médecin vient après le travail aujourd'hui
Alors prépare-toi pour ça
Ça devrait aller

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Actually, I wanted to ask you something
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: En fait, je voulais te demander quelque chose

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Would it be easier if I kept some food in my room for lunch?
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ce serait plus facile si je gardais de la nourriture dans ma chambre pour le déjeuner ?
Tu n'es pas trop fatigué ?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: That way I wouldn't have to bother you every day
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Comme ça, je ne te dérangerais pas tous les jours
Tu ne me déranges pas
Pas du tout

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I actually like taking care of you
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: J'aime en fait prendre soin de toi

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: So whenever you're hungry, just tell me
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Alors quand tu as faim, dis-le moi

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: And I'll bring you a hot meal
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Et je t'apporterai un repas chaud
Merci, {{name:evelyn}}

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I'll talk to you later then
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Je te parle plus tard alors
Bonne chance avec le travail 😊

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: We went to bed pretty late yesterday
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: On s'est couché assez tard hier
Je vais bien
J'ai très bien dormi en fait
Et toi ?
Tu as bien dormi ?
J'ai bien dormi

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I woke up a few times during the night
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Je me suis réveillé quelques fois pendant la nuit

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: J'ai survécu au jour de l'examen
Mon corps héroïque a besoin de récupération

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You cannot just skip because you are tired
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Tu ne peux pas juste zapper parce que tu es fatiguée

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I can if I pay the tutor tax
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Je peux si je paie la taxe du tuteur

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You earned a bit of rest
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Tu as bien mérité un peu de repos

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I knew you were secretly reasonable 💅
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Je savais que tu étais secrètement raisonnable 💅

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: The court has ruled in my favor 😌
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Le tribunal a statué en ma faveur 😌

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Besides, I need to be in top condition for shopping this afternoon
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: De plus, je dois être en pleine forme pour le shopping cet après-midi

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Of course that is your priority
I am still in bed and i don't plan on leaving
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Je suis toujours au lit et je ne compte pas en sortir

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And my bed is also holding me hostage
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Et mon lit me garde aussi en otage
Non, tu ne fais pas ça

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: So what are you doing today?
And I want to use that time to go shopping for our date tomorrow 😌
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Et je veux profiter de ce temps pour faire du shopping pour notre rendez-vous de demain 😌
Tu ferais mieux de me tenir au courant.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll send you the outfits so you can tell me which one you like most ❤️
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je vais t'envoyer les tenues pour que tu puisses me dire laquelle tu préfères le plus ❤️

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You in different outfits sounds dangerous already
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Toi dans des tenues différentes, ça sonne déjà dangereux.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then I'll make sure to send you the hardest choices
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Alors je m'assurerai de t'envoyer les choix les plus difficiles.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I need to thank you again for last night
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je dois te remercier encore pour hier soir.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And for spoiling me that much
You spoil me too, you know
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu me gâte trop, tu sais.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: That's exactly how it should be
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: C'est exactement comme ça que ça devrait être.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Still sore in a few places
Try not to complain too much
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Essaie de ne pas trop te plaindre
Honnêtement, faire des étirements ça a l'air bien

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: But I might get the cast off soon
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Mais je vais peut-être bientôt pouvoir enlever le plâtre

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: After that I'll be able to move properly again
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Après ça, je pourrai bouger correctement à nouveau
Tu as préparé ton maillot de bain ?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Unlike you, I can get ready without turning it into a medical operation
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Contrairement à toi, je peux me préparer sans que ça devienne une opération médicale

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: It's not exactly easy to put on with the cast
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Ce n'est pas vraiment facile à mettre avec le plâtre

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: So the cast is now losing against clothes too
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Donc le plâtre perd maintenant contre les vêtements aussi

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Let's go before you need a break from getting dressed
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Allons-y avant que tu aies besoin d'une pause pour t'habiller

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Everything seems to be healing correctly

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Le médecin a enlevé le plâtre

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: But he also made me do a lot of movements
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Mais il m'a aussi fait faire beaucoup de mouvements

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: And now it's starting to hurt a little
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Et maintenant ça commence à faire un peu mal
Tu as besoin de quelque chose ?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Could you bring me some ice?
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Tu pourrais m'apporter de la glace ?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I think I'm just going to let it rest for an hour
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Je pense que je vais juste le laisser se reposer pendant une heure

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Just let me know if you need anything
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Fais-moi juste savoir si tu as besoin de quoi que ce soit

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: He's about to come up and examine you
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Il va bientôt monter pour t'examiner

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Bien sûr que tu n'as pas oublié

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Let's start with the school outfits

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ronde des tenues de jour maintenant 💅

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You officially influenced my wardrobe now
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Tu as officiellement influencé ma garde-robe maintenant

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: If I look too good later, that is your fault 💅
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Si je suis trop belle plus tard, c'est de ta faute 💅

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I will keep shopping a little
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Je vais continuer à faire du shopping un peu
Le champ de bataille est magnifique 😌

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Mon boss vient de m'envoyer un message

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I meant settling it by fighting
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Je voulais dire qu'on règle ça en se battant

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: You can't hit someone who's already injured
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu ne peux pas frapper quelqu'un qui est déjà blessé
D'accord
Tu as de la chance

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I'll kill you on the game instead
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Je vais te battre dans le jeu à la place

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Try not to cry when you lose
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Essaie de ne pas pleurer quand tu perds
Je ne travaille pas aujourd'hui
Et pourquoi est-ce que ça m'intéresserait ?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Because now you have more time to annoy me
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Parce qu maintenant tu as plus de temps pour m'embêter
T'es chanceux
Au fait

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I've never seen someone so stiff
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Je n'ai jamais vu quelqu'un d'aussi raide

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Even with a cast, I think I did better
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Même avec un plâtre, je pense que j'ai fait mieux
Tu as à peine bougé
Ce n'est pas de la flexibilité, c'est de la triche
Au fait

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Turns out jump rope wasn't your only weakness
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: On dirait que la corde à sauter n'était pas ta seule faiblesse
Tu ne sais pas plonger non plus
Je sais plonger

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I just chose not to look good doing it
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: J'ai juste choisi de ne pas avoir l'air bien en le faisant
Je finis ma nourriture
Ensuite, on règle ça
Bon

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I'll wait for you on the game
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Je t'attendrai sur le jeu

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'm just a little stuck in the shower
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Je suis juste un peu coincé dans la douche
Heureusement, mon téléphone était à proximité

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: So you're telling me you're trapped in the shower? 😄
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Donc tu es en train de me dire que tu es coincé dans la douche ? 😄

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: And you're still naked as a worm?
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Et tu es toujours nu comme un ver ?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Significant emotional tension detected during recent private interaction
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Tension émotionnelle significative détectée lors de l'interaction privée récente

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Elevated heartbeat and embarrassment markers recorded
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Fréquence cardiaque élevée et marqueurs d'embarras enregistrés

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Capture émotionnelle pertinente archivée dans les preuves HAK

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'm not the only one feeling this. That makes it harder to ignore.
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Je ne suis pas le seul à ressentir ça. Ça devient plus difficile à ignorer.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: And sorry about the awkward situation
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Et désolé pour la situation gênante

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: It's not the first naked man I've ever seen
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ce n'est pas le premier homme nu que je vois

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: That somehow doesn't make me feel less embarrassed
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ça ne m'aide pas à me sentir moins gênée
Je ne m'attendais pas à... ça
Quoi qu'il en soit, le dîner est presque prêt

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'll bring you something to eat soon
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Je vais te ramener quelque chose à manger bientôt

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'll come down a little later for dinner
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Je descendrai un peu plus tard pour le dîner

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Are you sure everything is okay?
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Tu es sûre que tout va bien ?
Dis-lui que tu as besoin d'aide

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: But tell me if you need anything
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Mais dis-moi si tu as besoin de quoi que ce soit

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'm bringing you some ice for your leg
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Je t'apporte de la glace pour ta jambe

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: You should rest as much as possible tonight
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Tu devrais te reposer autant que possible ce soir

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: It will help your leg recover properly
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ça aidera ta jambe à bien récupérer

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: JOUR 15 — Après avoir examiné ta jambe, le médecin a retiré ton plâtre. Tu peux bouger plus librement, mais ta jambe a encore besoin de repos.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source:
Hey.

You've reached the end of the available content for this character for now.

Thank you for playing iNTeRcepted.

If you want to support the project, get new episodes, and access exclusive content, you can subscribe to my Patreon.

Your support genuinely helps me keep building this game.

See you in the next chapter.
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation:
Salut.

Tu as atteint la fin du contenu disponible pour ce personnage pour le moment.

Merci de jouer à iNTeRcepted.

Si tu veux soutenir le projet, obtenir de nouveaux épisodes et accéder à du contenu exclusif, tu peux t'abonner à mon Patreon.

Ton soutien m'aide vraiment à continuer de construire ce jeu.

À la prochaine chapitre.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I tried to take a shower
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: J'ai essayé de prendre une douche

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: But I can't really move my leg properly right now
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Mais je ne peux pas vraiment bouger ma jambe correctement en ce moment

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I think I need some help
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Je pense que j'ai besoin d'aide

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I already gave you emotional honesty
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Je t'ai déjà donné de l'honnêteté émotionnelle

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: But I still have one surprise for you
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Mais j'ai encore une surprise pour toi

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I bought a few extra little things while shopping
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: J'ai acheté quelques petites choses en plus en faisant du shopping
Strictement pour la recherche de tenues scientifiques 💅

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And I am happy with this week
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Et je suis contente de cette semaine

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: So that was the surprise. She looks far too pleased with herself.
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Alors, c'était ça, la surprise. Elle a l'air bien trop contente d'elle.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: So that was the surprise. She looks far too pleased with herself.
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Alors, c'était ça, la surprise. Elle a l'air bien trop contente d'elle.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Even with all the revision torture
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Même avec toute cette torture de révisions

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: So that was the surprise. She looks far too pleased with herself.
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Alors, c'était ça, la surprise. Elle a l'air bien trop contente d'elle.
Ça veut dire que la surprise a fonctionné

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Now I want to see every color
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Maintenant, je veux voir toutes les couleurs

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: One color and suddenly you want the whole collection
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Une couleur et soudain tu veux toute la collection
Je fais juste preuve de rigueur
C'est très académique de ta part 💅

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: JOUR 15 — Après avoir examiné ta jambe, le médecin a retiré ton plâtre. Tu peux bouger plus librement, mais ta jambe a encore besoin de repos.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And I kind of liked spending that time with you
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Et j'ai un peu aimé passer ce temps avec toi

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I came here straight after class 😮‍💨
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je suis venu ici directement après les cours 😮‍💨

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So now you're officially on outfit duty
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Alors maintenant, tu es officiellement en charge de la tenue

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I think that's my favorite on you ❤️
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je pense que c'est mon préféré sur toi ❤️

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a feeling you'd like that one ❤️
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'avais le sentiment que tu aimerais celui-là ❤️

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Don't panic but I may have gone a little further 👀
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ne panique pas mais il se peut que je sois allé un peu plus loin 👀

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Well I need to be completely prepared, right? 😌
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eh bien, je dois être complètement préparé, n'est-ce pas ? 😌

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You can't just surprise me like that 😭
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu ne peux pas me surprendre comme ça 😭

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And no, I was not prepared for this 😭
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Et non, je n'étais pas préparé à ça 😭

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because I'm about to start trying things on and you need to be ready to help me 🤍
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Parce que je vais commencer à essayer des choses et tu dois être prêt à m'aider 🤍

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You have to be ready for anything with me 🤍
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu dois être prêt pour n'importe quoi avec moi 🤍

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was waiting for a proper compliment 🤍
You're beautiful, sexy, and a little devil 😌
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu es belle, sexy, et un petit diable 😌

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay, I'll text you again once I'm back home 🤍
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: D'accord, je te retextoterai une fois que je serai de retour chez moi 🤍

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Get home safe, love you little devil ❤️
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Rentre bien, je t'aime petit diable ❤️

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: JOUR 15 — Après avoir examiné ta jambe, le médecin a retiré ton plâtre. Tu peux bouger plus librement, mais ta jambe a encore besoin de repos.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: This is a lot of pressure 😭

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Yo hurry up and get out of the shower already
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Allez, dépêche-toi de sortir de la douche !

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: 1 HOUR LATER
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 1 HEURE PLUS TARD

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Finally won baby. And from now on I’m gonna be the only winner
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Enfin gagné, bébé ! Et à partir de maintenant, je serai la seule gagnante.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: You’re dreaming
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Tu rêves

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: You sure about the dare you asked for
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: T'es sûr du défi que tu as demandé ?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: You scared ? If you’re that scared you can chicken out
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: T'as peur ? Si t'as vraiment peur, tu peux te dégonfler.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: You asked for it
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Tu l'as demandé.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Oh okay
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Oh d'accord

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: So not so small huh
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Pas si petit que ça, hein ?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It stings that she kept asking for my opinion while his was the one that counted.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ça fait mal qu'elle ait continué à demander mon avis alors que seul le sien comptait.
Écart dans la chronologie des achats

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived a visual fragment from the shopping session. Subject posture and proximity markers suggest emotional tension inconsistent with normal shopping assistance
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK a archivé un fragment visuel de la session de shopping. La posture et les marqueurs de proximité du sujet suggèrent une tension émotionnelle incohérente avec une assistance normale aux achats

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recovered an unsent changing-room image from the shopping session metadata.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK a récupéré une image non envoyée de la cabine d'essayage à partir des métadonnées de la session de shopping.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recovered a second unsent changing-room image from the same store session.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK a récupéré une deuxième image non envoyée de la cabine d'essayage de la même session en magasin.
Deuxième image non envoyée de la cabine d'essayage

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Don't worry, I will be careful
And professor is a good guy
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Et le prof est un bon gars

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Some of us are actually competent
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Certains d'entre nous sont vraiment compétents

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll remember that when you're asking me for favors
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Je m'en souviendrai quand tu me demanderas des faveurs

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Do we let the front door unlocked tonight?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: On laisse la porte d'entrée déverrouillée ce soir ?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Otherwise I'll just climb through your window
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Sinon, je vais juste passer par ta fenêtre

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Your leftovers saved my lunch today
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Tes restes ont sauvé mon déjeuner aujourd'hui

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: They even talked to me about a promotion
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ils m'ont même parlé d'une promotion

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I might not even get a break
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Je ne vais même pas avoir de pause
Essaie d'en prendre une quand même

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: But if you really can't, then at least be careful and take care of yourself
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Mais si tu ne peux vraiment pas, fais au moins attention et prends soin de toi
Événement à forte réponse émotionnelle détecté

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Alcohol exposure and elevated excitement levels observed
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Exposition à l'alcool et niveaux d'excitation élevés observés

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Multiple interaction markers exceeded expected thresholds
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Plusieurs marqueurs d'interaction ont dépassé les seuils attendus

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I hope she's all right. Those numbers don't tell me what she actually wants.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: J'espère qu'elle va bien. Ces chiffres ne me disent pas ce qu'elle veut vraiment.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: HAK archived footage from a high-energy shift showing unusually elevated emotional engagement during service
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Séquences archivées HAK d'un shift énergique montrant un engagement émotionnel exceptionnel pendant le service
Elle commence enfin à le ressentir

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Everything is ready in the kitchen if you need anything
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Tout est prêt dans la cuisine si tu as besoin de quoi que ce soit

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: JOUR 15 — Après avoir examiné ta jambe, le médecin a retiré ton plâtre. Tu peux bouger plus librement, mais ta jambe a encore besoin de repos.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source:
Hey.

You've reached the end of the available content for this character for now.

Thank you for playing iNTeRcepted.

If you want to support the project, get new episodes, and access exclusive content, you can subscribe to my Patreon.

Your support genuinely helps me keep building this game.

See you in the next chapter.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation:
Salut.

Tu as atteint la fin du contenu disponible pour ce personnage pour le moment.

Merci de jouer à iNTeRcepted.

Si tu veux soutenir le projet, obtenir de nouveaux épisodes et accéder à du contenu exclusif, tu peux t'abonner à mon Patreon.

Ton soutien m'aide vraiment à continuer de construire ce jeu.

À la prochaine chapitre.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Thank you for still taking care of me
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Merci de continuer à prendre soin de moi

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You really don't have to do all this
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Tu n'as vraiment pas besoin de faire tout ça

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I just want to take care of the people around me
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Je veux juste prendre soin des gens autour de moi

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: But make sure you take care of yourself too
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Mais assure-toi de prendre soin de toi aussi

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Remember, tonight is going to be really busy
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Rappelle-toi, ce soir va être vraiment chargé

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I wanted to thank you both
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Je voulais vous remercier toutes les deux

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You don't have to thank me
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Tu n'as pas besoin de me remercier

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I know that I have been a mess this week
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Je sais que j'ai été un vrai désastre cette semaine

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And I feel bad about it
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Et je me sens mal à ce sujet

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You don't have to feel bad about that
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Tu n'as pas à te sentir mal pour ça
Je sais, mais je le fais

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Shopping session timeline contains unresolved gaps
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: La chronologie de la session shopping contient des lacunes non résolues

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Emotional stress pattern suggests a possible undisclosed event
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Le schéma de stress émotionnel suggère un événement non divulgué possible

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Review the previously archived shopping evidence
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Consultez les preuves de la séance de shopping déjà archivées

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Her guilt makes me anxious, but I still don't know what she hasn't told me.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Sa culpabilité m'inquiète, mais je ne sais toujours pas ce qu'elle ne m'a pas dit.
Écart dans la chronologie des achats

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: HAK archived a visual fragment from the shopping session. Subject posture and proximity markers suggest emotional tension inconsistent with normal shopping assistance
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: HAK a archivé un fragment visuel de la session de shopping. La posture et les marqueurs de proximité du sujet suggèrent une tension émotionnelle incohérente avec une assistance normale aux achats
Ne t'inquiète pas, ce n'est rien de grave

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Anyway, I just wanted to say thank you
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: De toute façon, je voulais juste dire merci

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And tomorrow I need to see professor
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Et demain, je dois voir le prof

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He said I can come by
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Il a dit que je pouvais passer

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Just to return a book and talk about the next exam plan
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Juste pour rendre un livre et parler du plan de l'examen
Je sais ce que ça a l'air
Mais c'est juste lié au travail

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I am fine, you're the one making it weird
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Je vais bien, c'est toi qui rends ça bizarre

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I have to be up early tomorrow
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Je dois me lever tôt demain

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: JOUR 15 — Après avoir examiné ta jambe, le médecin a retiré ton plâtre. Tu peux bouger plus librement, mais ta jambe a encore besoin de repos.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Are you sure everything is okay?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Tu es sûre que tout va bien ?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: My professor helped a lot too
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Mon prof m'a beaucoup aidée aussi

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.source: New AlphaMana activity aligns with previous captures
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.translation: La nouvelle activité AlphaMana s'aligne avec les captures précédentes.
Exécution de la corrélation des preuves retardées...

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.source: Relevant capture has been archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.translation: La capture pertinente a été archivée dans les preuves HAK.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to worry about me
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu n'as pas à t'inquiéter pour moi.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The doctor took the cast off today. I still need to take it easy
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Le docteur a enlevé le plâtre aujourd'hui. Je dois encore y aller doucement
AlphaMana a posté : Je n'ai pas pu résister
Tu as eu une longue journée

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you sure your manager is treating you well?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Es-tu sûr que ton manager te traite bien ?
Tu devrais te reposer ce soir.
Ça ne le ressent pas comme ça.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What is that supposed to mean?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Qu'est-ce que ça est censé vouloir dire ?
Tu ne me fais pas confiance ?
Ce n'est pas ce que j'ai dit

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm already having a bad day
I don't need this right now
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je n'ai pas besoin de ça en ce moment.
Je pensais que tu me faisais confiance.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then believe me when I say things are fine
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alors crois-moi quand je dis que tout va bien

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I feel like everything just keeps piling up
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai l'impression que tout s'accumule sans cesse.
Je suis juste inquiet pour toi.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And thank you, that means a lot

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mais s'il te plaît, fais-moi confiance.
Bien sûr que nous le sommes.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: JOUR 15 — Après avoir examiné ta jambe, le médecin a retiré ton plâtre. Tu peux bouger plus librement, mais ta jambe a encore besoin de repos.
Trop de choses à la fois encore

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'll leave the back door unlocked for you
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Je laisserai la porte de derrière déverrouillée pour toi

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Have fun with your imaginary friends
They're still more believable than yours
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ils sont encore plus crédibles que les tiens

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: {{name:mason}} is being kissed by an unidentified gym contact
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: {{name:mason}} est embrassé par un contact non identifié à la salle de sport

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: That alert stings, but it doesn't tell me what {{name:mason}} wanted.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Cette alerte fait mal, mais elle ne me dit pas ce que {{name:mason}} voulait.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: {{name:mason}} is seen being kissed during the late-night meeting after leaving the gym.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: {{name:mason}} est vu en train d'être embrassé lors de la réunion de nuit après avoir quitté la salle de sport.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: JOUR 15 — Après avoir examiné ta jambe, le médecin a retiré ton plâtre. Tu peux bouger plus librement, mais ta jambe a encore besoin de repos.

Hey.

You've reached the end of the available content for this character for now.

Thank you for playing iNTeRcepted.

Salut.

Tu as atteint la fin du contenu disponible pour ce personnage pour le moment.

Merci d'avoir joué à iNTeRcepted.

Si tu veux soutenir le projet, obtenir de nouveaux épisodes et accéder à du contenu exclusif, tu peux t'abonner à mon Patreon.

Ton soutien m'aide vraiment à continuer de construire ce jeu.

À la prochaine chapitre.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Use it if you come home late
I put oil on my windowsill
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: J'ai mis de l'huile sur mon rebord de fenêtre

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: So don't even think about climbing through the window
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Alors ne pense même pas à passer par la fenêtre

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You're going to break my neck before the gym idiots ever get the chance
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Tu vas me casser le cou avant que ces idiots de la salle de sport aient la chance de le faire

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Then use the door like a normal person
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Alors utilise la porte comme une personne normale

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Hey, how are you feeling this morning?😊
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Salut, comment tu te sens ce matin ?😊

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: We can do one last client today if you want
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: On peut faire un dernier client aujourd'hui si tu veux

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: And after that, we take the weekend to rest together
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Et après ça, on prend le week-end pour se reposer ensemble

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Then keep me updated when you find the client
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Tiens-moi au courant quand tu trouves le client

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: And how things go with the doctor
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Et comment ça se passe avec le docteur

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: You have your doctor's appointment today, right?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Tu as ton rendez-vous chez le docteur aujourd'hui, non ?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: To see if they can remove the cast
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Pour voir s'ils peuvent enlever le plâtre

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Do you want me to stay with you today?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Tu veux que je reste avec toi aujourd'hui ?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I can cancel everything if you need me
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Je peux annuler tout si tu as besoin de moi

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mon cerveau veut de la liberté

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You still have a session with Ethan later
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tu as encore une session avec Ethan plus tard
Alors ce n'est plus vraiment étudier
Ce n'est pas comme ça que ça marche les sessions

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: It is if I decide it is
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: C'est le cas si je décide que c'est le cas

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You still need to stay serious until the exam is done
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tu dois rester sérieuse jusqu'à ce que l'examen soit fini
Et la session avec Ethan après ça

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I revised so much these last few days
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: J'ai révisé tellement ces derniers jours

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So I think it's going to be okay
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Donc je pense que ça va aller

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I just can't wait for it to be over
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: J'ai juste hâte que ce soit fini

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And the pictures I sent you 😳
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et les photos que je t'ai envoyées 😳

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That didn't help me sleep either
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça ne m'a pas aidé à dormir non plus.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: At least I'm not the only one suffering
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Au moins, je ne suis pas le seul à souffrir.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm really happy with how things are evolving between us
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je suis vraiment heureux(se) de la façon dont les choses évoluent entre nous.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I feel like we're getting closer
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je sens que nous nous rapprochons.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And also exploring something new at the same time
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et aussi explorer quelque chose de nouveau en même temps

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to learn more about it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je veux en savoir plus à ce sujet.
À propos de ce que tu ressens

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: About how far we can go with it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: À quelle distance nous pouvons aller avec ça

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We can take it step by step
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nous pouvons y aller étape par étape.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But I keep thinking about something…
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mais je n'arrête pas de penser à quelque chose...

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What the next step even is

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Nous sommes dans un restaurant très chic

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: He is paying for everything, and he is being incredibly kind
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Il paie tout, et il est incroyablement gentil

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I am honestly having a wonderful time
I'm really glad to hear that
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Je suis vraiment contente d'entendre ça

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Dinner felt special. You were kind, elegant, and exactly who I wanted there.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Le dîner était spécial. Tu étais gentille, élégante, et exactement qui je voulais là.
Contenu du dîner avec Lucas débloqué.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But honestly I'm mostly relieved that it's over
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Mais honnêtement, je suis surtout soulagée que ce soit fini

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: For once I actually feel proud of myself 😊
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Pour une fois, je suis vraiment fière de moi 😊

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: All those hours of studying finally paid off 😌
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Toutes ces heures d'étude ont enfin porté leurs fruits 😌

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Even if I complained the whole time
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Même si je me suis plainte tout le temps
{{name:hailey}} a récompensé Ethan avec un bisou

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: No signs of hesitation detected during the exchange
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Aucun signe d'hésitation détecté pendant l'échange
Estimation de la confiance dans la relation augmentée

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: A kiss makes this feel different from helping her study, and I'm not as detached as I sound.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Un baiser, c'est autre chose que l'aider à réviser, et je ne suis pas aussi détaché que j'en ai l'air.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: HAK archived visual evidence of {{name:hailey}} rewarding Ethan with a kiss following a successful tutoring session
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: HAK a archivé des preuves visuelles de {{name:hailey}} récompensant Ethan par un baiser après une séance de tutorat réussie

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Wow you're really sending me that ??
Well it's a reward for you too 😌
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Eh bien, c'est une récompense pour toi aussi 😌
Comment ça peut être une récompense ?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You don't let any opportunity slip by!
Now I just have to wait for the results 😩
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Maintenant, je dois juste attendre les résultats 😩

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: We talked about the exam for a while
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: On a parlé de l'examen pendant un moment

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But maybe it won't be that bad, if I fail at least I will get punished 😌
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Mais peut-être que ce ne sera pas si mal, si je rate, au moins je serai punie 😌

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It's supposed to be a bad thing!
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: C'est censé être une mauvaise chose !

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: JOUR 15 — Après avoir examiné ta jambe, le médecin a retiré ton plâtre. Tu peux bouger plus librement, mais ta jambe a encore besoin de repos.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Ethan thinks I did better than I think I did
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ethan pense que j'ai mieux réussi que ce que je pense

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I'm still overthinking a few questions
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Je réfléchis encore à quelques questions

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Everyone does that after an exam
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Tout le monde fait ça après un examen

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis vraiment heureux à ce sujet

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now I need to calm down again before bed 😭
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Maintenant, je dois me calmer à nouveau avant de dormir 😭

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Should I make it worse before bed? 😏
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Devrais-je aggraver les choses avant d'aller au lit ? 😏

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You really want to kill me
But keeping you awake… I'm guilty 😌
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mais te garder éveillé… J'ai des remords 😌

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: JOUR 15 — Après avoir examiné ta jambe, le médecin a retiré ton plâtre. Tu peux bouger plus librement, mais ta jambe a encore besoin de repos.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The doctor removed the cast today
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Le médecin a retiré le plâtre aujourd'hui
Je suis tellement heureux pour toi

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay I need a shower now
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord, j'ai besoin d'une douche maintenant.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you want me to send it to someone else instead?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu veux que je l'envoie à quelqu'un d'autre à la place ?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Trying to understand what you like
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Essayer de comprendre ce que tu aimes

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I want to see how you react
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et je veux voir comment tu réagis
Cette journée a semblé si longue

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: If I was going to do something like that…
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Si j'allais faire quelque chose comme ça...

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Who would you want it to be with?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Avec qui voudrais-tu que ce soit ?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Like… who would you want me to send it to?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Comme... à qui voudrais-tu que je l'envoie ?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Probably someone I don't really know
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Probablement quelqu'un que je ne connais pas vraiment.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I think the idea of a stranger makes it intense
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je pense que l'idée d'un étranger rend cela intense.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And maybe safer, for the private part
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et peut-être plus sûr, pour la partie privée.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But you're not afraid he'll try to steal me?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mais tu n'as pas peur qu'il essaie de me voler ?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: then, why not, if we find the right person
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: alors, pourquoi pas, si nous trouvons la bonne personne

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I kinda… already thought about it…
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'y ai un peu… déjà pensé…

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Too many classes, too many people 😭
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Trop de cours, trop de gens 😭
Parce que tu le connais déjà ?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And we don't even know if he would agree
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et nous ne savons même pas s'il serait d'accord.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We both know he's a real charmer
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nous savons tous les deux qu'il est un vrai charmeur.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And he always looks at you like that
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et il te regarde toujours comme ça.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I see him, he doesn't hide it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je le vois, il ne le cache pas.
Ça ne te rend pas fou ?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little… but more like jealous… and excited
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un peu… mais plutôt jaloux… et excité

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And proud that my girlfriend is that beautiful
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et fier que ma copine soit si belle

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wow… that's really sweet… and hot
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wow… c'est vraiment mignon… et sexy

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We did say we would explore this
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nous avons dit que nous explorerions cela.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why not with someone I trust?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pourquoi pas avec quelqu'un en qui j'ai confiance ?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But you're not afraid he'll try to steal me?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mais tu n'as pas peur qu'il essaie de me voler ?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: So, you didn't drown?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Alors, tu ne t'es pas noyé ?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You sent me to a pool in that swimsuit with your best friend knowing I can barely swim
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Tu m'as envoyée à la piscine dans ce maillot avec ta meilleure amie en sachant que je sais à peine nager

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You're about as innocent as a serial killer holding the knife
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: T'es aussi innocent qu'un tueur en série avec un couteau.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: And {{name:aiden}} have the best tan of the year, unlike me
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Et {{name:aiden}} a le meilleur bronzage de l'année, contrairement à moi

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'm as white as a ghost compared to him
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Je suis aussi blanche qu'un fantôme à côté de lui

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: That's for sure
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: C'est sûr

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'm sure you had a good time at the pool anyway
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Je suis sûre que tu t'es bien amusé à la piscine de toute façon.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I didn't say that
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Je n'ai pas dit ça.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: But you're not denying it either
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mais tu ne le nies pas non plus.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Shut up
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Tais-toi

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Sounds like my best friend is growing on you
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: On dirait que ma meilleure amie te plaît de plus en plus

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I found your old swimsuit by the way
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: J'ai trouvé ton vieux maillot, au fait.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: This is only the beginning of the war
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ce n'est que le début de la guerre.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: With pleasure
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Avec plaisir

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Sincerely, your secretary
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Sincèrement, ta secrétaire

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Too bad
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Dommage

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: 25 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 25 MINUTES PLUS TARD

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Unusual physical proximity detected in the swimming pool
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Proximité physique inhabituelle détectée dans la piscine.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Mason relied heavily on {{name:aiden}} during the session
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mason a beaucoup compté sur {{name:aiden}} pendant la séance

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: An intense interaction occurred between Mason and his coach
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Une interaction intense a eu lieu entre Mason et son coach.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I want {{name:mason}} to feel free to choose, even while I'm figuring out where that leaves me.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Je veux que {{name:mason}} puisse choisir librement, même si j'essaie encore de savoir quelle place ça me laisse.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'm completely innocent
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Je suis complètement innocente.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: JOUR 15 — Après avoir examiné ta jambe, le médecin a retiré ton plâtre. Tu peux bouger plus librement, mais ta jambe a encore besoin de repos.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: ( CONTINUE )
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: ( CONTINUER )

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source:
Hey.

You've reached the end of the available content for this character for now.

Thank you for playing iNTeRcepted.

If you want to support the project, get new episodes, and access exclusive content, you can subscribe to my Patreon.

Your support genuinely helps me keep building this game.

See you in the next chapter.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation:
Salut.

Tu as atteint la fin du contenu disponible pour ce personnage pour le moment.

Merci de jouer à iNTeRcepted.

Si tu veux soutenir le projet, obtenir de nouveaux épisodes et accéder à du contenu exclusif, tu peux t'abonner à mon Patreon.

Ton soutien m'aide vraiment à continuer de construire ce jeu.

À la prochaine chapitre.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: DEVELOPER
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: DÉVELOPPEUR

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Points HAK suffisants accumulés
Nouvelle compétence disponible : Transcription en direct

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Capture les conversations qui se déroulent ailleurs en surveillant les personnes d'intérêt
HAK//COMPÉTENCE DISPONIBLE
Peut-être que je vais le faire

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: If I feel like drawing a bit of attention
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Si j'ai envie d'attirer un peu l'attention

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Don’t get used to being right
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ne t'habitue pas à avoir raison
C'est une habitude dangereuse
Bref
Bonjour ! ☀️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I’ve been thinking about last night
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: J'ai pensé à hier soir
Plus que je ne le voulais
Quelle partie ?
Tu sais de quelle partie je parle
La photo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I keep wondering what you actually thought when you received it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Je me demande toujours ce que tu as vraiment pensé quand tu l'as reçue

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I thought about it more than I should have
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: J'y ai pensé plus que je n'aurais dû
Tu étais belle dessus

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: That’s more honest than I expected
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: C'est plus honnête que je ne m'y attendais

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I tried the outfit you chose for me again this morning
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: J'ai réessayé la tenue que tu as choisie pour moi ce matin

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I don’t know if that makes it better or worse
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Je ne sais pas si ça rend les choses meilleures ou pires
C'est tout ?
Tu fais encore attention

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I keep telling myself it was just a stupid late-night decision
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Je me dis sans cesse que c'était juste une décision stupide de fin de soirée

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: But I didn’t exactly regret sending it either
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Mais je ne regrettais pas vraiment de l'avoir envoyée non plus

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: That’s the part that bothers me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: C'est ça qui me dérange

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I still can’t decide if I should thank you or be slightly annoyed
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Et je ne sais toujours pas si je dois te remercier ou être un peu agacée 😏
Pourquoi ça te dérange ?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Because it means I wanted you to see me like that
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Parce que ça veut dire que je voulais que tu me voies comme ça

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I don’t usually do things like that without overthinking for days
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Et je ne fais généralement pas ce genre de choses sans réfléchir pendant des jours
Ça s'est juste... passé
Je ne me plains pas du tout
Je sais

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: That’s also part of the problem
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: C'est aussi une partie du problème

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You’re being very calm about something that still feels a bit dangerous to me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Tu restes très calme sur quelque chose qui me semble encore un peu dangereux
Je ne suis pas si calme non plus
Et dangereux comment ?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: It looks better than I expected
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Elle est mieux que ce à quoi je m'attendais

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: We’re living in the same house
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: On vit dans la même maison

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: If things start changing, they change fast
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Si les choses commencent à changer, ça change vite

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I’m not sure I’m ready for that yet
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Et je ne suis pas sûre d'être prête pour ça encore

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: We don’t have to rush anything
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: On n'a pas besoin de se précipiter
C'est une réponse correcte
J'avais besoin d'entendre ça

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Okay, I’m going to get ready before I keep talking myself into a corner
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ok, je vais me préparer avant de continuer à me mettre dans une impasse
On se parle plus tard ?
Bien sûr
Je suis contente que ça te plaise 😊
Tu devrais la porter aujourd'hui

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Told you I had decent taste
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Je t'avais dit que j'avais bon goût !

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Don’t sound so pleased with yourself
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ne sois pas si fier de toi
Ce n'est qu'une tenue

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Sufficient HAK points accumulated
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Points HAK suffisants accumulés
