story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je pense que tu l'as bien mérité

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going to remember you said that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je vais me souvenir que tu as dit ça

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Two subjects standing together beside the desk
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Deux sujets se tenant ensemble à côté du bureau

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Capture visuelle archivée

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They're standing so close. I keep telling myself it's work, but seeing them together like that makes my stomach tighten.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ils sont si près l'un de l'autre. Je me répète que c'est pour le travail, mais les voir ensemble comme ça me noue l'estomac.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVIS

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too Close
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Trop près

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You seem more comfortable in here now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu sembles plus à l'aise ici maintenant

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I knew it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je le savais

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: With the work? A little
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Avec le travail ? Un peu

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That wasn't exactly what I meant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ce n'était pas exactement ce que je voulais dire

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then maybe you should be more specific
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alors peut-être que tu devrais être plus précis

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The first few days you stood by the door whenever you brought something in
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Les premiers jours, tu restais près de la porte chaque fois que tu apportais quelque chose

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because you always looked busy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Parce que tu avais toujours l'air occupé

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et maintenant ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I know half the time you're just looking at the same numbers I am
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Maintenant, je sais que la moitié du temps, tu regardes juste les mêmes chiffres que moi

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So I'm less intimidating
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Donc je suis moins intimidante

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't say you were intimidating
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je n'ai pas dit que tu étais intimidant

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You just didn't want to come any closer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu ne voulais juste pas t'approcher

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I sat down before you could sense a disturbance
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je me suis assis avant que tu ne ressentes une perturbation

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know, you notice a lot for someone with so much work to do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu sais, tu remarques beaucoup de choses pour quelqu'un qui a tant de travail

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some things are hard not to notice
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Certaines choses sont difficiles à ne pas remarquer

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're doing it again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu le fais encore

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Doing what?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Faire quoi ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Looking at me instead of the screen
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me regarder au lieu de l'écran

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've finished explaining the spreadsheet
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu as fini d'expliquer le tableau.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That isn't an answer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça, ce n'est pas une réponse.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It wasn't meant to be
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ce n'était pas le but.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really don't make this easy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu ne rends vraiment pas ça facile.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Make what easy?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Rendre quoi facile ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too late, I felt it 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Trop tard, je l'ai ressenti 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keeping a straight face when I'm supposed to be working
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Garder un visage impassible alors que je suis censée travailler.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little later, after the paperwork is finished...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un peu plus tard, après avoir fini la paperasse...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Are we still on for tomorrow?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: On est toujours d'accord pour demain ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The drink?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Le verre ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, the drink
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui, le verre.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I said I'd come, didn't I?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai dit que je viendrais, non ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You also said you might be tired after work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu as aussi dit que tu pourrais être fatigué après le boulot.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I probably will be. I can still sit down somewhere that isn't this chair
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je le serai probablement. Je peux toujours m'asseoir quelque part qui n'est pas cette chaise.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There's a place a couple of streets over. Around seven?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il y a un endroit à quelques rues d'ici. Vers sept heures ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seven should be fine
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sept heures, ça devrait aller.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously though, is it hurting or just awkward?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sérieusement, ça fait mal ou c'est juste gênant ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It was the smart thing to do
Even if it means more work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Même si ça veut dire plus de boulot
Bien sûr que je vais le faire

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He’s going to help me deeply this time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Il va vraiment m'aider cette fois.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Thanks for checking on me earlier
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Merci d'avoir pris de mes nouvelles tout à l'heure.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I kind of have to take the exams after all
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Je crois que je vais devoir passer les exams après tout.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He made it pretty clear I won’t get the diploma otherwise
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Il a été assez clair que je n'aurai pas le diplôme sinon.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Okay… but you said you maybe had a solution?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: D'accord... mais tu as dit que tu avais peut-être une solution ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I’m going to have to spend more time with him for the exams
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Je vais devoir passer plus de temps avec lui pour les exams.
Des sessions supplémentaires, ce genre de trucs

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That’s good actually. I’m glad you changed your mind
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: C'est bien en fait. Je suis content que tu aies changé d'avis.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm home and attempting dinner before our very serious film night
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Salut ❤️ Je suis rentrée et j'essaie de préparer le dîner avant notre soirée film très sérieuse

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We don't need to discuss him
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: On n'a pas besoin d'en parler

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He wasn't even in the second half
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il n'était même pas dans la deuxième moitié

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was working with the information available at the time 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je travaillais avec les infos disponibles à ce moment-là 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were very confident
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu étais très sûr de toi

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I trusted the scarf too much
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai trop fait confiance à l'écharpe

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A mistake any great detective could make
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Une erreur que n'importe quel grand détective pourrait faire

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stop laughing, at least the film was as bad as I promised
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Arrête de rire, au moins le film était aussi mauvais que je l'avais promis

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You did deliver on that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as tenu ta promesse là-dessus

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was nicer watching it with you, though
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'était plus sympa de le regarder avec toi, quand même

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even with my commentary?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Même avec mes commentaires ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Future You always finds something to complain about
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Le Toi du futur trouve toujours quelque chose à redire

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially with your commentary ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Surtout avec tes commentaires ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I missed this, just talking about something silly with you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça m'a manqué, juste parler de quelque chose de bête avec toi

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Moi aussi

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We should do it again, but you pick the next one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: On devrait le refaire, mais c'est toi qui choisis le prochain

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can't blame me for your detective career ending tonight
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu ne peux pas me blâmer pour la fin de ta carrière de détective ce soir

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm retiring undefeated, thank you 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je prends ma retraite invaincue, merci 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not what happened
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ce n'est pas ce qui s'est passé

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the story I'm sticking to
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est l'histoire à laquelle je m'accroche

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to bed before you talk me into watching a better one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je vais me coucher avant que tu ne me convainques de regarder un meilleur film

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sleep well
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dors bien

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only when Present Me leaves her washing up 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Seulement quand le Moi présent laisse sa vaisselle 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too handsome ❤️ I'm glad today was a little easier for your leg
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Toi aussi, beau gosse ❤️ Je suis contente qu'aujourd'hui ait été un peu plus facile pour ta jambe

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Moi aussi

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je t'aime

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you too ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je t'aime aussi ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bonne nuit ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bonne nuit

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How much have you created so far?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Combien as-tu créé jusqu'à présent ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: One pan, one bowl, one spoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Une poêle, un bol, une cuillère

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And a second spoon because I put the first one somewhere stupid
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et une deuxième cuillère parce que j'ai mis la première quelque part de stupide

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Impressive efficiency
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Efficacité impressionnante

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'll be laughing less when you see my masterpiece
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu riras moins quand tu verras mon chef-d'œuvre

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There, actual food and not a fire in sight
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voilà, de la vraie nourriture et pas de feu en vue

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks good
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça a l'air bon

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Attempting doesn't sound promising
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Essayer, ça ne sonne pas très prometteur

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It tastes good too, I'm almost suspicious 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est bon aussi, je suis presque suspicieuse 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did the second spoon contribute?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Qu'est-ce que la deuxième cuillère a apporté ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Moral support
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un soutien moral

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll remember that next time I'm cooking
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je m'en souviendrai la prochaine fois que je cuisine

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you eaten properly tonight?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as bien mangé ce soir ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I've eaten and I'm settled on the sofa
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ouais, j'ai mangé et je suis bien installé sur le canapé

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good ❤️ I'll catch up once I've put the rest away
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien ❤️ Je te rejoins une fois que j'ai rangé le reste

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Meal prep now? You really have changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Préparation de repas maintenant ? Tu as vraiment changé

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't get used to it, I'm only doing this because I'm going out tomorrow
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ne t'habitue pas, je fais ça juste parce que je sors demain

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, I meant to tell you about that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oh, je voulais te parler de ça

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I nearly put the empty pan on and left the pasta in the cupboard
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai failli mettre la poêle vide sur le feu et laisser les pâtes dans le placard

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: With the coworker you mentioned the other night?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Avec le collègue dont tu as parlé l'autre soir ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ouais

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My manager, actually
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mon manager, en fait

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your manager?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ton manager ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, we talked about it again today
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ouais, on en a reparlé aujourd'hui

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said coworker before
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as dit collègue avant

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je l'ai fait

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I should've been clearer about who I meant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'aurais dû être plus claire sur qui je voulais dire

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is anybody else going?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Est-ce que quelqu'un d'autre y va ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, just us
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non, juste nous.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So we're having a strong start 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Donc on commence fort 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Right
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est vrai

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's just a drink after work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est juste un verre après le boulot.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Where?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Où ça ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's a bar a couple of streets from the office
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il y a un bar à quelques rues du bureau.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around seven, so I'll go straight from work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vers sept heures, donc je vais y aller directement après le boulot.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you want to go?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et tu veux y aller ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ouais, j'en ai envie.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've spent most of the week going from class to work to home
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai passé la plupart de ma semaine à enchaîner cours, boulot et maison.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like to do something that isn't one of those three things
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'aimerais faire quelque chose qui ne soit pas l'une de ces trois choses.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I get wanting to go out
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je comprends que tu aies envie de sortir.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe start with the water
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Peut-être commencer par l'eau

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Going out alone with your manager is a bit different from what I pictured
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sortir seule avec ton manager, c'est un peu différent de ce que j'imaginais.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know how it sounds
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je sais ce que ça peut sembler.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially after what you said about him looking at you differently
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Surtout après ce que tu as dit sur son regard différent.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I probably shouldn't have made such a thing of that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je n'aurais probablement pas dû en faire tout un plat.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You told me because it bothered you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu m'en as parlé parce que ça te dérangeait.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It surprised me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça m'a surpris.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I don't feel uncomfortable around him
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mais je ne me sens pas mal à l'aise avec lui.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he know you're with someone?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il sait que tu es avec quelqu'un ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, he knows
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui, il le sait.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want to turn this into an argument
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne veux pas que ça devienne une dispute.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have water, I'm not completely lost
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai de l'eau, je ne suis pas complètement perdue

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me neither
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Moi non plus.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just don't want to find out I've only been hearing half the story
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne veux juste pas découvrir que je n'entends que la moitié de l'histoire.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je sais

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's why I'm telling you where we're going and who it's with
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est pour ça que je te dis où on va et avec qui.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je te texte quand j'arrive.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And when you're home?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et quand tu es chez toi ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien sûr

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do want to spend time with you too, you know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je veux aussi passer du temps avec toi, tu sais.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What's for dinner?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est quoi pour le dîner ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I miss seeing you instead of just waiting for messages
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je sais. Tu me manques, je préfère te voir plutôt que d'attendre des messages.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I miss you too ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu me manques aussi ❤️.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me check when I finish over the next few days and we'll work something out
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Laisse-moi vérifier quand je finis ces prochains jours et on s'organise.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'aimerais bien.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Moi aussi

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I don't want our whole evening to disappear while I'm standing next to a pan
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et je ne veux pas que notre soirée disparaisse pendant que je suis à côté d'une poêle.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to change and get comfortable, then I'm yours for this awful film
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je vais me changer et être à l'aise, ensuite je suis à toi pour ce film horrible.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll get it ready
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je m'en occupe.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little later...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un peu plus tard...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, I've put the leftovers away and changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord, j'ai rangé les restes et je me suis changée.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Pasta, tomato sauce and whatever cheese survived the week
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Des pâtes, de la sauce tomate et le fromage qui a survécu à la semaine

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No work clothes, no dishes in front of me, no numbers
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pas de vêtements de travail, pas de vaisselle devant moi, pas de chiffres.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you find the first spoon?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as trouvé la première cuillère ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was in the bowl the entire time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Elle était dans le bol tout ce temps.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course it was
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien sûr que c'était le cas

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm trusting you with that information, be kind 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je te fais confiance avec cette info, sois sympa 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've even claimed the good end of the sofa
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai même pris le bon bout du canapé

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's where I'd want to be right now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est là où j'aimerais être en ce moment

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There'd be room for you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il y aurait de la place pour toi

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've taken up half the sofa with that blanket
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as pris la moitié du canapé avec cette couverture

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A classic
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un classique

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd share the blanket, not the good cushion 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je partagerais la couverture, pas le bon coussin 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A generous offer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Une offre généreuse

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'd take it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu prendrais ça

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I would
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ouais, je le ferais

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Soon ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bientôt ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you at the beginning of the film?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu es au début du film ?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Paused at the first frame
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mis sur pause au premier cadre

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, three, two, one... play
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord, trois, deux, un... go

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the film...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Après le film...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So, about the man with the red scarf
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alors, à propos de l'homme avec l'écharpe rouge

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm making enough for tomorrow too, so Future Me can't complain
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je fais assez pour demain aussi, comme ça le Moi du futur ne pourra pas se plaindre

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Nouvelle compétence disponible : Transcription en direct

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Capture les conversations qui se déroulent ailleurs en surveillant les personnes d'intérêt

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm still stressed enough without your commentary
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Je suis déjà assez stressé sans tes commentaires

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Yesterday you were sending me certain pictures
And today you're waiting for grades like a responsible student
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Et aujourd'hui, tu attends tes notes comme un étudiant responsable

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'll text you when I get the results
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Je te texterai quand j'aurai les résultats

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I should get my grades today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Je devrais recevoir mes notes aujourd'hui

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Having a private tutor who knows people has its advantages 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Avoir un tuteur privé qui connaît des gens, ça a ses avantages 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But not as much as before

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 First morning without the cast, how does it feel?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Salut 😊 Première matinée sans le plâtre, ça fait quoi ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I walked straight into it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et je suis tombée en plein dans le panneau

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you for making this possible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Merci d'avoir rendu ça possible

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're welcome, unfortunately 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: De rien, malheureusement 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But seriously, are you comfortable?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mais sérieusement, tu es à l'aise ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Mostly. It still feels stiff when I get up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: La plupart du temps. C'est encore raide quand je me lève

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not exactly ready to sprint down the street
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pas vraiment prêt à sprinter dans la rue

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, because I wasn't going to chase you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bien, parce que je n'allais pas te courir après

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not even a little?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pas même un peu ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd walk after you with a very disappointed expression
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je marcherais après toi avec une expression très déçue

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, this is the face you'd be getting
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Attends, voilà la tête que je te ferais

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Strange actually
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est bizarre en fait

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Terrifying
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Terrifiant

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It works on you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça marche sur toi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It really does
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça marche, oui

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm just happy it's finally off ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je suis juste contente que le plâtre soit enfin enlevé ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When I saw your message yesterday, I wanted to come over and hug you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quand j'ai vu ton message hier, j'avais envie de venir te faire un câlin

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That offer still available?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cette offre est toujours valable ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Obviously
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Évidemment

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Although I also want an afternoon with you where neither of us spends half of it asking about your leg
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mais j'aimerais aussi un après-midi avec toi où aucun de nous ne passe la moitié à demander pour ta jambe

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We could find a small café somewhere, when I'm up to it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: On pourrait trouver un petit café quelque part, quand je me sentirai prête

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I woke up and moved the blanket like I still had to make room for it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je me suis réveillé et j'ai bougé la couverture comme si je devais encore faire de la place pour lui

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça me plairait

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I miss sitting across from you and stealing something off your plate
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça me manque de m'asseoir en face de toi et de piquer quelque chose dans ton assiette

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Beautiful. That's what you miss about me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Magnifique. C'est donc ça qui te manque chez moi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Among other things
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Parmi d'autres choses

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But mostly your terrible habit of ordering something nicer than mine
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mais surtout ta terrible habitude de commander quelque chose de meilleur que mon plat

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You always say you're not hungry
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu dis toujours que tu n'as pas faim

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not hungry until your food arrives
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je n'ai pas faim tant que ta nourriture n'arrive pas

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Completely different situation 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Situation complètement différente 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Speaking of food, have you had breakfast?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: En parlant de nourriture, tu as pris le petit-déjeuner ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Coffee
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Café

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You got attached to it 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu t'y es attaché 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's a drink
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est une boisson

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look who's suddenly responsible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Regarde qui devient soudainement responsable

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I learned from a very strict woman
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai appris d'une femme très stricte

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She sounds lovely
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Elle a l'air adorable

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Annoying. Very pretty though
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Agaçante. Mais très jolie

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That saved you ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça t'a sauvé ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, I'll prove I'm eating
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Attends, je vais prouver que je mange

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2 MINUTES PLUS TARD

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Toast, coffee, and a woman who is definitely going to be late if she keeps texting you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Des tartines, du café, et une femme qui va forcément être en retard si elle continue à t'envoyer des messages

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We spent a lot of time together
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: On a passé beaucoup de temps ensemble

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu es magnifique

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were supposed to notice the toast
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu étais censé remarquer le pain grillé

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I noticed both
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai remarqué les deux

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll allow it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je l'accepte

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes all day?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Des cours toute la journée ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: This morning, then some work with my group after lunch
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ce matin, puis un peu de travail avec mon groupe après le déjeuner

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We spent twenty minutes yesterday deciding who was supposed to send a document everyone already had
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: On a passé vingt minutes hier à décider qui devait envoyer un document que tout le monde avait déjà

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Promising start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un bon début

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly. I'm bringing snacks and lowering my expectations
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Exactement. J'apporte des snacks et je baisse mes attentes

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sounds like you're the only one prepared
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: On dirait que tu es le seul préparé

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Should I be jealous?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je devrais être jalouse ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Emotionally, absolutely not
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Émotionnellement, pas du tout

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I haven't forgotten what we talked about last night
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et je n'ai pas oublié de quoi on a parlé hier soir

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to think about the first step properly, not while I'm trying to find my other shoe
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je veux réfléchir sérieusement au premier pas, pas pendant que je cherche mon autre chaussure

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd hate to compete with the shoe
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je détesterais devoir rivaliser avec la chaussure

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's currently winning
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pour l'instant, c'est elle qui gagne

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2 MINUTES PLUS TARD

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Found it. Both shoes are on, so now I have no excuse
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je l'ai trouvée. J'ai mis mes deux chaussures, donc maintenant je n'ai plus d'excuse.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One last picture before I leave, since you can't be here to distract me in person
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Une dernière photo avant de partir, puisque tu peux pas être là pour me distraire en personne.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're making it very hard to encourage you to leave
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu rends vraiment difficile de t'encourager à partir.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was a very supportive relationship
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'était une relation qui m'apportait beaucoup de soutien

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're supposed to wish me luck, not make me miss you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu es censé me souhaiter bonne chance, pas faire en sorte que tu me manques encore plus.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can do both
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je peux faire les deux.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you can ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je sais que tu peux ❤️.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Text me when you have a quiet moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Envoie-moi un message quand tu as un moment tranquille.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je le ferai ❤️.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And keep some room in your schedule for that hug
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et garde un peu de place dans ton emploi du temps pour ce câlin.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll cancel my appointment with the sofa
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je vais annuler mon rendez-vous avec le canapé.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Tell it I'm sorry 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dis-lui que je suis désolée 😌.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Oh my god
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oh mon dieu

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've been saving that one since yesterday, haven't you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as gardé celle-là depuis hier, pas vrai ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Since the doctor took it off
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Depuis que le médecin l'a enlevé

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ma petite élève a vraiment étudié

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You also got some very interesting rewards along the way
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu as aussi eu des récompenses très intéressantes en chemin
On appelle ça de la motivation 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I passed the most important exam
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: J'ai réussi l'examen le plus important

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So technically I don't really need to keep studying that hard
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Donc techniquement, je n'ai pas vraiment besoin de continuer à étudier aussi dur

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You should still pass the remaining exams to be safe. Keeping Ethan a bit longer is a win-win.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu devrais quand même réussir les autres examens pour être en sécurité. Garder Ethan un peu plus longtemps, c'est gagnant-gagnant.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You worked hard enough. Maybe it's time to do something other than books for a while.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu as assez travaillé. Peut-être qu'il est temps de faire autre chose que des livres pendant un moment.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Is it really about the exams...
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: C'est vraiment à propos des examens...

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Or is it you who wants me to keep seeing Ethan? 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ou c'est toi qui veux que je continue à voir Ethan ? 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm just thinking about your diploma
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je pense juste à ton diplôme
Comme c'est noble de ta part

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I can be a good person sometimes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je peux être une bonne personne parfois

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But when I am, I'm right
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mais quand je le suis, j'ai raison

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'll keep Ethan for the next exams
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je vais garder Ethan pour les prochains examens

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You are the one who will be happy
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: C'est toi qui va être contente
Quelque chose d'autre que des livres ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You've been stuck studying for weeks
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu es coincée à étudier depuis des semaines

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Moving a bit wouldn't kill you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Bouger un peu ne te ferait pas de mal

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Especially if you want to keep your body in shape for the summer
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Surtout si tu veux garder ton corps en forme pour l'été

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Be careful, I may be small but I can still kick your ass 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Fais attention, je suis peut-être petite mais je peux toujours te botter les fesses 😌
Tu n'as pas tort en fait

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I do feel like I need to move again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: J'ai vraiment l'impression qu'il faut que je bouge à nouveau
Je vais envoyer un message à {{name:aiden}}
Ne fais pas cette tête satisfaite 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey, I finally have time to eat without someone asking me about our group project 😮‍💨
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hé, j'ai enfin le temps de manger sans qu'on me pose de questions sur notre projet de groupe 😮‍💨

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It certainly had more information available
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: En tout cas, on en apprenait davantage sur elle.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Harsh
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dur

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Accurate 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Réaliste 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But it did help me work out something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mais ça m'a aidée à comprendre quelque chose.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to be able to talk to someone normally first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je veux d'abord pouvoir parler normalement à quelqu'un

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to pick a person just because we're excited about trying something new
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne veux pas choisir une personne juste parce qu'on est excités à l'idée d'essayer quelque chose de nouveau

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want you doing that either
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne veux pas que tu fasses ça non plus

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I want him to know I'm in a relationship
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et je veux qu'il sache que je suis en couple

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to get halfway through a conversation and feel like I've hidden the important part
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne veux pas être à mi-chemin d'une conversation et avoir l'impression d'avoir caché la partie importante

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Agreed
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not sure how to write that without making my profile sound like a very serious announcement
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne sais pas trop comment écrire ça sans que mon profil ait l'air d'une annonce très sérieuse

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Start with hello. Probably leave out a formal introduction from your boyfriend
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Commence par dire bonjour. Évite probablement une introduction formelle de ton petit ami

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You mean you haven't prepared one?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu veux dire que tu n'en as pas préparé un ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I could include references
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je pourrais inclure des références

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Absolutely not 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Surtout pas 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like you to read what I write, though
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'aimerais que tu lises ce que j'écris, quand même

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not to choose someone for me. Just because this is new and I'd rather not feel alone doing it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pas pour choisir quelqu'un pour moi. Juste parce que c'est nouveau et je préfère ne pas me sentir seule à le faire

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien sûr

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And when I said someone we don't know might be simpler, I didn't mean you have to trust the first person who answers
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et quand j'ai dit qu'une personne qu'on ne connaît pas pourrait être plus simple, je ne voulais pas dire que tu dois faire confiance à la première personne qui répond

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je sais

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You found somewhere sunny
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu as trouvé un endroit ensoleillé.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Less awkward around our friends doesn't automatically mean I'll feel comfortable with him
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Être moins mal à l'aise devant nos amis ne veut pas dire que je me sentirai à l'aise avec lui

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Exactement

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So tonight I'll write something and choose a normal photo
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Donc ce soir, je vais écrire quelque chose et choisir une photo normale

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow I can decide whether I'm happy to put it up and start a conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Demain, je verrai si j'ai envie de le publier et d'entamer une conversation.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds like an actual plan
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça a l'air d'un vrai plan

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A slightly nervous plan, but yes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un projet qui me rend un peu nerveuse, mais oui

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's allowed
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est permis

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I also reserve the right to complain to you about terrible profiles
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je me réserve aussi le droit de me plaindre auprès de toi des profils terribles

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That part was never in doubt
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cette partie n'a jamais été en doute

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, and my lunch hasn't asked a single question about the presentation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui, et mon déjeuner n'a posé aucune question sur la présentation

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought the difficult part would be admitting I was curious
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je pensais que la partie difficile serait d'admettre que j'étais curieuse

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I'm thinking about how to start a conversation without sounding completely unlike myself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Maintenant, je pense à comment commencer une conversation sans avoir l'air complètement différente de moi-même

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't need to suddenly become some incredibly confident person
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu n'as pas besoin de devenir soudainement une personne incroyablement confiante

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because I still rehearse phone calls before ordering food
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien, parce que je répète encore mes appels avant de commander à manger

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And then tell me to call instead
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et après, tu me dis d'appeler à ta place

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because you love me 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Parce que tu m'aimes 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Unfortunately for my phone bill
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Malheureusement pour ma facture de téléphone

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I do want to try this
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je veux vraiment essayer ça

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just want the first step to feel like something I chose, not something I rushed into because we had a good conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je veux juste que le premier pas ressemble à un choix, pas à quelque chose que j'ai fait à la hâte parce qu'on a eu une bonne conversation

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Excellent company
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Excellente compagnie

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we start there
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alors on commence par là

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go back. They've found another reason to discuss the slides
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je dois retourner. Ils ont trouvé une autre raison de discuter des diapositives

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Stay strong
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Reste forte

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm taking the rest of my lunch with me. It's the only thing I trust right now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je prends le reste de mon déjeuner avec moi. C'est la seule chose en qui j'ai confiance en ce moment

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're invited next time. Provided you bring your own fries
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu es invité la prochaine fois. À condition que tu apportes tes propres frites

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've been thinking about yesterday
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai pensé à hier

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Mostly about what I'd actually feel comfortable doing first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Surtout à ce que je me sentirais vraiment à l'aise de faire en premier

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did you get anywhere?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et tu as avancé ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. A little further than just sitting there wondering what you would like
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ouais. Un peu plus loin que juste rester là à me demander ce que tu aimerais

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you escape?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu t'es échappée ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You mentioning {{name:aiden}} has made very ordinary things feel less ordinary
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Le fait que tu mentionnes {{name:aiden}} a rendu des choses très ordinaires moins ordinaires

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What things?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quelles choses ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He asked if I had the notes from our last class
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il a demandé si j'avais les notes de notre dernier cours

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Normally I would just send them
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Normalement, je les aurais juste envoyées

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Today I stared at the message for a stupid amount of time before remembering he was literally asking for class notes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aujourd'hui, j'ai fixé le message pendant un temps ridicule avant de me rappeler qu'il demandait simplement des notes de cours.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please tell me you didn't send him a mysterious reply
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dis-moi que tu ne lui as pas envoyé une réponse mystérieuse

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Temporarily
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Temporairement.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He got the notes. Very exciting development
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il a eu les notes. Développement très excitant

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Slow down, you're getting ahead of yourself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ralentis, tu t'emballes

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shut up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tais-toi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But that's the thing. He's already part of my normal life
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mais c'est ça le truc. Il fait déjà partie de ma vie normale

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: If we talk about this and it feels strange afterward, I'll still see him around campus
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Si on en parle et que ça semble étrange après, je le verrai toujours sur le campus

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. I hadn't really thought about the next ordinary lunch together
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ouais. Je n'avais pas vraiment pensé au prochain déjeuner ordinaire ensemble

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Moi, si.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't think that means we shouldn't talk to him
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne pense pas que ça veuille dire qu'on ne devrait pas lui parler

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just don't want to treat it like asking him to join us for a game
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne veux juste pas que ça ressemble à lui demander de se joindre à nous pour un jeu

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I understand
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je comprends

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I said I needed lunch and someone asked if we could discuss the slides while I ate
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai dit que j'avais besoin de déjeuner et quelqu'un a demandé si on pouvait discuter des diapositives pendant que je mangeais.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How would you want to bring it up?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Comment tu voudrais en parler ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Alone, for a start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: En tête-à-tête, pour commencer.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd rather have a slightly awkward conversation than try to explain something personal with my friends listening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je préfère avoir une conversation un peu gênante plutôt que d'essayer d'expliquer quelque chose de personnel avec mes amis à l'écoute

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And probably offering advice nobody asked for
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et qu'ils me donnent sûrement des conseils que personne n'a demandés.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Exactement

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Attends

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's coming over. I'll text you when I get a moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il arrive. Je te texte quand j'ai un moment

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: UN MOMENT PLUS TARD

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is anyone sitting here?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quelqu'un est assis ici ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Depends. Are you here to steal my lunch?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça dépend. Tu es là pour voler mon déjeuner ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you throw the slides at them?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu leur as lancé les diapositives ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Someone joins the table
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quelqu'un rejoint la table

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation in progress
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Conversation en cours

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVIS

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An Unexpected Seat
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Une place inattendue

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was going to ask about the notes, but now that you've mentioned lunch...
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'allais te parler des notes, mais maintenant que tu parles de déjeuner...

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You got the notes. That's your gift for today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu as les notes. C'est ton cadeau du jour

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Generous as always
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Généreuse comme toujours.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You okay? You looked miles away earlier
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça va ? Tu avais l'air dans la lune tout à l'heure

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. Just thinking about something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ouais. Je pensais juste à quelque chose

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something I can help with?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un truc pour lequel je peux t'aider ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe. I'd rather talk about it when it's quieter
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Peut-être. Je préfère en parler quand c'est plus calme

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation continues
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: La conversation continue

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Attention directed towards the other speaker
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Attention dirigée vers l'autre intervenant

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVIS

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I considered it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'y ai pensé.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something to Say
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quelque chose à dire

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Oh. Okay
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oh. D'accord

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't look so worried, it's nothing bad
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ne t'inquiète pas, ce n'est rien de grave

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't worried until you said that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne m'inquiétais pas jusqu'à ce que tu dises ça

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Great, now I've made it sound dramatic
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Super, maintenant j'ai l'air dramatique

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can tell me when you're ready. I was only coming over to say thanks
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu peux me le dire quand tu seras prête. Je venais juste te remercier.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For the notes?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pour les notes ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For saving me from admitting I hadn't written any of that down
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pour m'avoir sauvé de l'admettre que je n'avais rien écrit

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There he is. I was wondering why you were being so nice
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Le voilà. Je me demandais pourquoi tu étais si gentil

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can be nice without wanting something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je peux être sympa sans rien vouloir

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But I found a table outside instead, so I'm choosing personal growth
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mais j'ai trouvé une table dehors à la place, alors je choisis la maturité.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then take your hand away from my fries
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alors retire ta main de mes frites

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair point
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu marques un point.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Playful exchange at the table
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Échange taquin à la table

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shared laughter
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Rires partagés

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like knowing she's laughing, even if I'm still getting used to the thought of them together.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'aime savoir qu'elle rit, même si je m'habitue encore à l'idée de les voir ensemble.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVIS

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Lunch Negotiations
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Négociations de déjeuner

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: 20 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 20 MINUTES PLUS TARD

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, I have my phone to myself again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord, j'ai à nouveau mon téléphone pour moi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything okay?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tout va bien ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. We just had a normal conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui. On a juste eu une conversation normale

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I nearly brought it up, but there were people sitting right next to us
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai failli en parler, mais il y avait des gens juste à côté de nous

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He knows I want to talk about something. Not what it is
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il sait que je veux parler de quelque chose. Pas de quoi il s'agit

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Proud of you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fier de toi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How did that feel?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Qu'est-ce que tu as ressenti ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Less terrifying than I expected
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Moins terrifiant que je ne le pensais

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Although he did try to steal my lunch, so I couldn't take him too seriously
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: En même temps, il a essayé de me voler mon déjeuner, alors je ne pouvais pas le prendre trop au sérieux.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds familiar
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça me dit quelque chose

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow I'll find a quieter moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Demain, je trouverai un moment plus calme

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to see whether we can actually talk about it before deciding anything else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je veux voir si on peut vraiment en parler avant de décider quoi que ce soit d'autre

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay. Tell me how you're feeling tonight
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord. Dis-moi comment tu te sens ce soir

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui, je te le dirai

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Merci 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I downloaded an app during my break
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai téléchargé une appli pendant ma pause

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You did?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vraiment ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Just to see what it was like. I haven't put a profile up or messaged anyone
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Juste pour voir à quoi ça ressemblait. Je n'ai pas mis de profil ni envoyé de message à qui que ce soit

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hang on, I'm trying to remember how to get back to the profile screen
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Attends, j'essaie de me souvenir comment revenir à l'écran de profil

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: UN MOMENT PLUS TARD

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, found it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord, je l'ai trouvé

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was less intimidating when I stopped treating every man on the screen like some enormous life decision
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'était moins intimidant quand j'ai arrêté de considérer chaque homme à l'écran comme une énorme décision de vie

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Any interesting discoveries?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Des découvertes intéressantes ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One man had six pictures of himself next to the same car
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un homme avait six photos de lui à côté de la même voiture

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe the car has a good personality
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Peut-être que la voiture a une bonne personnalité

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here's my very exclusive lunch spot
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Voici mon coin déjeuner très select.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: But I'm warning you right now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Mais je te préviens tout de suite

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: Even if she's family, she's getting the exact same treatment as everyone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Même si c'est de la famille, elle aura le même traitement que tout le monde

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: She needs someone to put her in her place
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Elle a besoin de quelqu'un pour la remettre à sa place

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: And while we're talking about people who need to get serious…
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Et pendant qu'on parle des gens qui doivent se mettre au sérieux…

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: Your leg still isn't gonna fix itself if you keep being lazy
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Ta jambe ne va pas se réparer toute seule si tu restes paresseux

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: The doctor only took my cast off yesterday, remember?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Le médecin ne m’a retiré le plâtre qu’hier, tu te souviens ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: Just don't come crying when the real sessions start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Ne viens pas pleurer quand les vraies séances commenceront

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: She wants to join the training sessions
