story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Elle veut rejoindre les séances d'entraînement

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: I might have given her a little push

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Bien sûr que tu l'as fait 😂

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey 😊 Did your grand expedition away from the sofa happen, or did the console win?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Salut 😊 Ta grande expédition loin du canapé a-t-elle eu lieu, ou la console a-t-elle gagné ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Probably not immediately
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Probablement pas tout de suite.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's partly why I want to talk face to face. I can tell him to stop making jokes if I need to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est en partie pour ça que je veux parler en face à face. Je peux lui dire d'arrêter de faire des blagues si besoin.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please don't tell him how quickly I said his name
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: S'il te plaît, ne lui dis pas à quelle vitesse j'ai dit son nom.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You mean immediately?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu veux dire tout de suite ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds worse when you say it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça sonne pire quand tu le dis.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can leave that detail out 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je peux laisser ce détail de côté 😌.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to show him our messages either. I can explain the situation myself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne vais pas lui montrer nos messages non plus. Je peux expliquer la situation moi-même.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Merci

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then we'll see how he feels. I'm not inviting him anywhere before we've even managed that conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ensuite, on verra comment il se sent. Je ne l'invite nulle part avant qu'on ait réussi cette conversation.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me know how you're doing when you get a chance
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fais-moi savoir comment tu vas quand tu as un moment.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I got home, made dinner, and realized I'd cooked enough pasta for a family of six
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puis je suis rentré, j'ai préparé le dîner, et j'ai réalisé que j'avais cuisiné assez de pâtes pour une famille de six

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je le ferai ❤️.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wrote a short introduction earlier. Want to read it?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai écrit une courte introduction plus tôt. Tu veux la lire ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Send it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Envoie-la

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm in a relationship, and my partner knows I'm here. I'd like to get to know someone, starting with a conversation and maybe a coffee
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis en couple, et mon partenaire sait que je suis ici. J'aimerais faire connaissance avec quelqu'un, en commençant par une conversation et peut-être un café.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That says what you mean
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça dit ce que tu veux dire.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't sound too formal?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça ne sonne pas trop formel ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little. Add something about yourself that isn't about us
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un peu. Ajoute quelque chose sur toi qui ne concerne pas notre couple.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Like my impressive ability to cook six portions of pasta by accident?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu aimes ma capacité impressionnante à cuisiner six portions de pâtes par accident ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's tomorrow sorted
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est réglé pour demain

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honestly, yes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Honnêtement, oui

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like quiet cafés, terrible films, and apparently cooking for people who don't exist
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'aime les cafés tranquilles, les mauvais films et, apparemment, cuisiner pour des gens qui n'existent pas.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds much more like you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça te ressemble beaucoup plus

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're included in the pasta, don't worry 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ta part de pâtes est prévue aussi, ne t’inquiète pas 😌.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, I want to try taking one now while the light's nice
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Attends, je veux essayer d'en prendre une maintenant, tant que la lumière est belle.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll try to give you a completely unbiased opinion
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je vais essayer de te donner un avis complètement impartial.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That would be a first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ce serait une première.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 2 MINUTES PLUS TARD

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, this one actually looks like me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord, celui-là me ressemble vraiment

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And possibly the rest of my life
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et peut-être le reste de ma vie

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the expression I get when you tell me you've only stolen one fry
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est l'expression que j'ai quand tu me dis que tu n'as volé qu'une frite

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I look innocent because I am
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai l'air innocente parce que je le suis

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The photo is excellent. The legal defense needs work
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La photo est excellente. La défense légale a besoin de travail

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm keeping the photo then 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je garde la photo alors 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll use that one and read the introduction again tomorrow before I put anything up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je vais utiliser celle-là et relire l'introduction demain avant de mettre quoi que ce soit

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I can see if there's someone I actually want to talk to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alors je pourrai voir s'il y a quelqu'un avec qui j'ai vraiment envie de parler

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you don't owe anyone a conversation just because they message you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et tu ne dois rien à personne juste parce qu'ils t'envoient un message

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm curious, not accepting applications from the entire internet
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je sais. Je suis curieuse, je n'accepte pas les candidatures de tout Internet

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now that's a good profile title
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça, c'est un bon titre de profil

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're not helping anymore
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu n'aides plus du tout

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could bring some next time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu pourrais en apporter la prochaine fois

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm nervous about tomorrow
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis nerveuse pour demain

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I like that it's a small thing I actually want to do, rather than some huge leap I'm trying to be ready for
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mais j'aime que ce soit une petite chose que j'ai vraiment envie de faire, plutôt qu'un grand saut pour lequel j'essaie d'être prête

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can tell me if it turns out to feel different than you expected
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu peux me dire si ça te fait sentir différemment de ce que tu attendais

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Toi aussi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want you pretending you're fine just because you were the one who brought it up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne veux pas que tu fasses semblant d'aller bien juste parce que c'est toi qui en as parlé

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I won't
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne le ferai pas

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now, very important question
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alors, question très importante

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Look at you solving my problems
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Regarde-toi, tu résous mes problèmes

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm listening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'écoute

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: When I bring you pasta, are we watching something decent, or are you making me watch another film where nobody turns a light on?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quand je t'apporte des pâtes, on regarde quelque chose de bien, ou tu me fais regarder un autre film où personne n'allume la lumière ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's atmosphere
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est l'atmosphère

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's two hours of me asking who's standing in the doorway
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est deux heures à me demander qui se tient dans l'embrasure de la porte

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can pick this time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu peux choisir cette fois

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Really?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vraiment ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. But I reserve the right to complain
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui. Mais je me réserve le droit de me plaindre

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd be worried if you didn't
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je m'inquiéterais si tu ne le faisais pas

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want that afternoon with you, you know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je veux cet après-midi avec toi, tu sais

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not to have another serious discussion. Just to eat too much and sit next to you for a while
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pas pour avoir une autre discussion sérieuse. Juste pour trop manger et rester à côté de toi un moment

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, let me get comfortable before you distract me again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Attends, laisse-moi me mettre à l'aise avant que tu ne me distraies encore

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want that too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Moi aussi, je veux ça

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then don't forget. I'm still claiming my spot on the sofa
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alors n'oublie pas. Je garde toujours ma place sur le canapé

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's yours
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est à toi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hang on, I'm moving from the sofa to bed before I fall asleep here
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Attends, je passe du canapé au lit avant de m'endormir ici

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 5 MINUTES PLUS TARD

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. I'm saving you the other pillow
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voilà. Je te garde l'autre oreiller

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're really not helping with how much I miss you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu n'aides vraiment pas avec à quel point tu me manques

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then come and claim it when you can
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alors viens le prendre quand tu peux

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je le ferai ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 5 MINUTES PLUS TARD

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bonne nuit, beau ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night. Save me some pasta
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bonne nuit. Garde-moi des pâtes

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is enough pasta to outlive both of us. Go to sleep 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il y a assez de pâtes pour nous deux. Va dormir 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Hair still damp, but I'm not moving again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voilà. Cheveux encore humides, mais je ne bouge plus

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look like you're about to fall asleep
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: On dirait que tu es sur le point de t'endormir

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I made it to the kitchen and back several times
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis allé à la cuisine et revenu plusieurs fois

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not. I've only just sat down
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pas du tout. Je viens juste de m'asseoir

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's usually how it starts
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est généralement comme ça que ça commence

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very funny
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Très drôle

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is something I wanted to check before tomorrow, actually
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il y a quelque chose que je voulais vérifier avant demain, en fait

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go ahead
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vas-y.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The other night, when I asked what you'd want to know if I sent a picture to someone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: L'autre soir, quand j'ai demandé ce que tu voudrais savoir si j'envoyais une photo à quelqu'un d'autre

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember your answer. I just don't want to assume it covers everything we might do
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je me souviens de ta réponse. Je ne veux juste pas supposer que ça couvre tout ce qu'on pourrait faire

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's fair
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est compréhensible

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An experienced traveler
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un voyageur expérimenté

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd want to know, and receive the picture too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as dit que tu voudrais savoir, et recevoir la photo aussi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. I like the idea of being included in what you choose to share
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ouais. J'aime l'idée d'être inclus dans ce que tu choisis de partager

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. But if I'm out talking to someone, I won't necessarily be looking at my phone the whole time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord. Mais si je suis dehors à parler à quelqu'un, je ne vais pas forcément regarder mon téléphone tout le temps

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not asking you to give me updates every five minutes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne te demande pas de me donner des nouvelles toutes les cinq minutes

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like to see the picture if that's something you decide to share. A conversation is different
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'aimerais voir la photo si c'est quelque chose que tu décides de partager. Une conversation, c'est différent

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I don't want you waiting for a message and thinking something's wrong because I'm not typing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. Je ne veux pas que tu attendes un message en pensant qu'il y a un problème parce que je ne t'écris pas

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell me when you're free, then we can actually talk
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dis-moi quand tu es libre, comme ça on pourra vraiment discuter.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There was also a little time outside
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il y a aussi eu un peu de temps dehors

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that better
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je préfère ça.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And don't get too excited about the pictures yet. I haven't even had the first conversation 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et ne t'excite pas trop pour les photos. Je n'ai même pas encore eu la première conversation 😌.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm being very patient
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je fais preuve de beaucoup de patience.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're doing a convincing impression of it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu fais bien semblant, en tout cas

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd want to know, but wouldn't necessarily want the picture yourself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as dit que tu voulais savoir, mais que tu ne voulais pas forcément la photo toi-même.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. That still fits
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ouais. Ça me convient toujours

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want to hear about it from you. I don't need you collecting things to show me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je veux l'entendre de ta part. Je n'ai pas besoin que tu collectionnes des trucs à me montrer.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's a relief, honestly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est un soulagement, honnêtement.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I sat down before I started regretting my ambition
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puis je me suis assis avant de commencer à regretter mon ambition

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather tell you how something felt than worry about proving it happened
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je préfère te raconter ce que j'ai ressenti plutôt que de me soucier de prouver que c'est arrivé

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not checking your homework
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne vais pas vérifier tes devoirs.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I've had enough of that today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. J'en ai eu assez pour aujourd'hui

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if you're busy, we can talk afterward
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et si tu es occupée, on peut en parler après

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. I'll tell you when I've got a moment, rather than trying to keep up a second conversation on my phone
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord. Je te dirai quand j'ai un moment, plutôt que d'essayer de gérer une deuxième conversation sur mon téléphone.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Exactement

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You still get my ordinary pictures, by the way. You're not escaping my face that easily 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu reçois toujours mes photos normales, au fait. Tu ne peux pas échapper à ma tête si facilement 😌.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't planning to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne prévoyais pas de le faire.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That actually sounds sensible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça a l'air sensé en fait

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you might not want to know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as dit que tu ne voulais peut-être pas savoir.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you mean not knowing about each individual thing, or not having updates while it's happening?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu voulais dire ne pas savoir pour chaque chose individuelle, ou ne pas avoir de nouvelles pendant que ça se passe ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hadn't really separated those in my head
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je n'avais pas vraiment séparé ça dans ma tête.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's why I'm asking
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est pourquoi je demande.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can understand leaving room for a surprise. I just don't want us to mean two different things without realizing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je comprends l'idée de garder une part de surprise. Je ne veux juste pas qu'on parle de deux choses différentes sans s'en rendre compte.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let's agree on the limits, but leave some things as a surprise
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord pour définir les limites, mais gardons certaines choses en surprise.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather have no updates during it, then talk afterward
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je préfère ne pas avoir de nouvelles pendant, et en parler après.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather agree on what we're trying first, then leave room for you not to tell me about every little thing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je préfère qu'on se mette d'accord sur ce qu'on essaie d'abord, puis laisser de la place pour que tu ne me racontes pas chaque petit détail.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. A surprise within what we've actually talked about, not me guessing how far that answer goes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord. Une surprise dans les limites de ce dont on a parlé, sans que j'aie à deviner jusqu'où va ta réponse.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Exactement

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You sound surprised
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as l'air surpris

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For now, we're only talking about making contact and seeing whether a first date feels right
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pour l'instant, on parle juste de prendre contact et de voir si on a envie d'un premier rendez-vous.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm not treating this like we've already agreed to everything else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je sais. Je ne considère pas ça comme si on avait déjà tout convenu.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if something feels wrong, I'm telling you. I'm not keeping that to myself to preserve the mystery
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et si quelque chose ne va pas, je te le dirai. Je ne vais pas garder ça pour moi pour préserver le mystère.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. Same for me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien sûr. C'est pareil pour moi.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. That makes more sense to me now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord. Ça a plus de sens pour moi maintenant.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I think I'd rather not follow everything while it's happening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je pense que je préfère ne pas suivre tout pendant que ça se passe.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But afterward, I would like to hear how it went and how you felt
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mais après, j'aimerais savoir comment ça s'est passé et ce que tu as ressenti.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I put my phone away, have the conversation, and we talk when I'm free
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Donc je mets mon téléphone de côté, j'ai la conversation, et on en parle quand je suis libre.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm trying not to ruin the moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'essaie de ne pas gâcher le moment

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. That sounds closer to what I meant
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ouais. Ça ressemble plus à ce que je voulais dire.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. I can do that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord. Je peux faire ça.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if I need to talk to you sooner, I'm still going to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et si j'ai besoin de te parler plus tôt, je le ferai quand même.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Obviously. You don't have to stick to some plan when you need me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Évidemment. Tu n'as pas à suivre un plan quand tu as besoin de moi.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad we talked about that now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis contente qu'on ait parlé de ça maintenant.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I kept imagining myself looking at my phone, wondering whether I was supposed to be sending you something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je m'imaginais en train de regarder mon téléphone, me demandant si je devais t'envoyer quelque chose.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want you worrying about that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne veux pas que tu t'inquiètes pour ça.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Comment s'est passé le reste de ta journée ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. It's easier now we've actually said it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je sais. C'est plus facile maintenant qu'on l'a vraiment dit.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So what do you want to do tomorrow?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alors, tu veux faire quoi demain ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll ask {{name:aiden}} if we can talk for a few minutes after class
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je vais demander à {{name:aiden}} si on peut parler quelques minutes après le cours.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want to explain that we've been discussing the idea of me going on a date with someone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je veux expliquer qu'on a discuté de l'idée que je sorte avec quelqu'un d'autre.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And that he's someone I'd consider having that conversation with
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et que c'est quelqu'un avec qui je considérerais avoir cette conversation.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You think he'll believe you're serious?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu penses qu'il va croire que tu es sérieux ?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We finished our part of the project, so I can finally stop thinking about it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: On a fini notre partie du projet, donc je peux enfin arrêter d'y penser

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You’re really trying to keep me busy
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Tu essaies vraiment de me garder occupée.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I just didn’t expect you to suggest something like that after last night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Je ne m'attendais pas à ce que tu proposes ça après la nuit dernière.
Mais c'est toi qui portes les sacs.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Don’t take too long or I’ll start without you and buy only junk food
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ne mets pas trop de temps, sinon je commencerai sans toi et j'achèterai que des cochonneries.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’ve been staring at the same page for twenty minutes
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Je fixe la même page depuis vingt minutes.
Tu veux faire quelque chose plus tard ?
On pourrait faire des tacos ce soir.
Shopping + tacos maison. Ça te dit ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You’re offering to cook with me?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Tu proposes de cuisiner avec moi ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Morning ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Bonjour ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: She has a permanent invitation
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Elle a une invitation permanente

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Good. Keep that in mind 🤍
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Bien. Garde ça en tête 🤍

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: How's your leg after yesterday?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Comment va ta jambe après hier ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A bit stiff when I got up, but better after moving around a little
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Un peu raide quand je me suis levé, mais mieux après avoir bougé un peu

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm glad we stopped when we did
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je suis content qu'on se soit arrêté quand on l'a fait

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Me too. I'll take it easy this morning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Moi aussi. Je vais y aller doucement ce matin

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What are you planning?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Qu'est-ce que tu prévois ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A few things around the house this morning, then probably some games later
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Quelques trucs à la maison ce matin, puis probablement des jeux plus tard

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What about you?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Et toi ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm spending the afternoon with my family
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je passe l'après-midi avec ma famille

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I reached for my bag and remembered where it was
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: J'ai tendu la main vers mon sac et je me suis rappelé où il était

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Lunch first. Then apparently we're playing cards
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: D'abord le déjeuner. Ensuite, apparemment, on joue aux cartes

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Apparently?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Apparemment ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I was informed. My participation wasn't optional 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: J'ai été informée. Ma participation n'était pas optionnelle 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Try to come back with your dignity intact
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Essaie de revenir avec ta dignité intacte

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll aim higher. I'm going to win
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je viserai plus haut. Je vais gagner

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: That's the spirit
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: C'est l'esprit

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And then I'll graciously allow them to admire me
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Et ensuite, je leur permettrai gracieusement de m'admirer

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Very gracious
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Très gracieux

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Exactly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Exactement

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay, I need to get ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: D'accord, je dois me préparer

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: It's still beside the sofa
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Il est toujours à côté du canapé

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Keep my bag safe. I'll collect it when I see you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Garde mon sac en sécurité. Je le récupérerai quand je te verrai

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Of course. Have a good time today ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Bien sûr. Amuse-toi bien aujourd'hui ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You too love
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Toi aussi, mon amour

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: At least one of us got to stay at your place last night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Au moins, l'un de nous a pu rester chez toi hier soir

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Your bag was very quiet company
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ton sac était une compagnie très silencieuse

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then don't get too attached to it 😌
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Alors ne t'y attache pas trop 😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Too late. We've already had breakfast
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Trop tard. Nous avons déjà pris le petit déjeuner

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Without me? Rude
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Sans moi ? C'est impoli

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Here's the person you should have invited instead
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Voici la personne que tu aurais dû inviter à la place

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Okay come help me in the kitchen
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: D'accord, viens m'aider dans la cuisine.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You’re not allowed to just supervise
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Tu n'as pas le droit de juste superviser.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: A while later, after cooking in the kitchen
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Un moment plus tard, après avoir cuisiné dans la cuisine.
Tu es en fait pas mal en train de couper.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m still the one in charge of the seasoning
You’re also the one making the biggest mess
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: C'est toi qui mets le plus de bazar.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And I only bought three unnecessary things
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Et je n'ai acheté que trois choses inutiles.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Did you just take a picture of me?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Tu viens de me prendre en photo ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: While I have sauce on my face?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Alors que j'ai de la sauce sur le visage ?
Preuve de quoi ? De ma souffrance ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You’re not allowed to say that while I’m covered in taco seasoning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Tu n'as pas le droit de dire ça alors que je suis couverte d'épices à tacos.
Faire quelque chose de normal ensemble.
Après hier, ça fait... du bien.
Tu as failli en acheter une quatrième.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Don’t get used to me being this calm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ne t'habitue pas à me voir aussi calme.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m only like this because the tacos are almost ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Je suis comme ça juste parce que les tacos sont presque prêts.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Now stop talking and help me finish plating
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Maintenant, arrête de parler et aide-moi à finir de dresser.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The cookies were looking at me weird
I’m giving us both a solid 8/10
I’m saving the 10 for when we don’t almost set off the smoke alarm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Je garde le 10 pour quand on ne faillit pas déclencher l'alarme incendie.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You mean when you don’t almost set off the smoke alarm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Tu veux dire quand tu ne faillis pas déclencher l'alarme incendie.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Anyway… I’m going to clean up and then crash
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Bref… Je vais ranger et ensuite je vais m'écrouler

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m exhausted in the best way
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Je suis épuisée, mais dans le bon sens

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: It helped more than I expected
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ça m'a aidée plus que je ne l'aurais pensé
Ne dis pas ça trop vite

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I might start requesting weekly taco nights
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Je pourrais commencer à demander des soirées tacos chaque semaine

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Anyway… I’m going to clean up and then crash
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Bref… Je vais ranger et ensuite je vais m'écrouler

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Proof I carried at least one bag
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Preuve que j'ai porté au moins un sac.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Mise à jour : le déjeuner était super

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Say hello to your mom for me
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Dis bonjour à ta mère pour moi

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: She sends you a kiss back 😘
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Elle t'envoie un bisou en retour 😘
Aide-moi
Que se passe-t-il ?
J'ai presque fini mes cartes

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: But every time I look pleased, someone makes me draw more
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Mais chaque fois que j'ai l'air contente, quelqu'un me fait tirer plus
Alors arrête d'avoir l'air contente

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Act like your hand is terrible
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Fais comme si ta main était terrible
C'est ton conseil brillant ?
Laisse-les te sous-estimer
Les cartes sont un désastre

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Fine. I'm trusting you with my reputation
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: D'accord. Je te confie ma réputation
QUELQUES MINUTES PLUS TARD
J'ai encore perdu

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you keep a straight face?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: As-tu gardé un visage impassible ?
Pendant environ dix secondes

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then someone asked why I looked like I was hiding a crime
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Puis quelqu'un a demandé pourquoi j'avais l'air de cacher un crime
Donc le bluff a besoin de travail

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I think I need a new adviser
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Je pense que j'ai besoin d'un nouveau conseiller

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Harsh. I was working with limited information
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Dur. Je travaillais avec des informations limitées

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: They asked who I kept texting
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ils ont demandé qui je continuais à texter
Déjà ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you tell them you were receiving expert assistance?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Tu leur as dit que tu recevais une aide experte ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I said my boyfriend was helping me lose
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: J'ai dit que mon petit ami m'aidait à perdre
Ça fait mal
Seulement parce que c'est vrai 😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You should give them a chance to miss you. Take a break
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Tu devrais leur donner une chance de te manquer. Fais une pause

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I have. I'm getting another slice of cake
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: J'ai fait. Je prends une autre part de gâteau

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At least I'm winning at dessert
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Au moins, je gagne au dessert
Une belle remontée

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll be home later this afternoon
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Je serai à la maison plus tard cet après-midi
Tu es libre ce soir ?
J'ai perdu deux fois
Ouais. Pourquoi ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I have an idea. I'll tell you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: J'ai une idée. Je te dirai quand je serai à la maison ❤️
Maintenant, je suis curieuse

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Let me finish my very important cake first
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Bien. Laisse-moi d'abord finir mon gâteau très important

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Everyone suddenly becomes very competitive when I'm about to win
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Tout le monde devient soudain très compétitif quand je suis sur le point de gagner
Y compris toi ?
C'est différent

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Look at the face of someone being treated unfairly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Regarde la tête de quelqu'un qui est traité injustement

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You look like you're planning revenge
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: On dirait que tu prépares ta vengeance

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATE EVENING — You are back home and have a quiet moment to yourself.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: FIN DE SOIRÉE — Tu es de retour chez toi et tu as un moment de tranquillité.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Really?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vraiment ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. I'd love to play with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ouais. J'adorerais jouer avec toi

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You always sound like you're having fun
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: On dirait toujours que tu t'amuses

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought I'd like to try it with you instead of just hearing about it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je pensais que j'aimerais essayer avec toi au lieu de juste en entendre parler

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then let's find something we can both enjoy
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Alors trouvons quelque chose qu'on peut apprécier tous les deux

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What about that racing game you mentioned?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Que dirais-tu de ce jeu de course dont tu as parlé ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That would work. We can do a private race
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ça marcherait. On peut faire une course privée

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. But you have to explain the controls first
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: D'accord. Mais tu dois d'abord expliquer les contrôles

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Deal. I'll send you an invite once you're ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Marché conclu. Je t'enverrai une invitation quand tu seras prête

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A LITTLE LATER — You both launch the racing game. Before starting, you explain the controls and let {{name:lena}} try a practice lap.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: UN PEU PLUS TARD — Vous lancez tous les deux le jeu de course. Avant de commencer, tu expliques les contrôles et laisses {{name:lena}} essayer un tour d'essai.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm home
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je suis à la maison

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Ready. Please appreciate my concentration
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Prête. Apprécie ma concentration, s'il te plaît

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very professional. How's the practice lap going?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Très professionnel. Comment se passe le tour d'essai ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've met the same wall three times
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'ai rencontré le même mur trois fois

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Brake before the corner, then turn
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Freine avant le virage, puis tourne

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're trying to do both at full speed
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu essaies de faire les deux à pleine vitesse

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought speed was the point
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je pensais que la vitesse était le but

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Staying on the road helps too
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Rester sur la route aide aussi

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. One more practice lap
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: D'accord. Un tour d'essai de plus

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER THE FIRST RACE
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: APRÈS LA PREMIÈRE COURSE

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I have a very serious question
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Et j'ai une question très sérieuse

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You finished so far ahead of me 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu as fini tellement loin devant moi 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've played it a lot more. Don't compare your first race to that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je l'ai beaucoup plus joué. Ne compare pas ta première course à ça

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I also got stuck facing the wrong way
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je me suis aussi retrouvée coincée dans le mauvais sens

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But you got around the last corner cleanly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mais tu as bien passé le dernier virage

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's the one you kept hitting in practice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: C'est celui que tu frappais sans cesse pendant l'essai

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did notice that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'ai remarqué ça

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: See? You're already getting the timing
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu vois ? Tu commences déjà à maîtriser le timing

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Again
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: D'accord. Encore une fois

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Same track?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Même circuit ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. I have unfinished business with it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Oui. J'ai des comptes à régler avec ce circuit

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm listening
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'écoute

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER THE SECOND RACE — {{name:lena}} still finishes behind you, but completes the track with fewer crashes.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: APRÈS LA DEUXIÈME COURSE — {{name:lena}} termine toujours derrière toi, mais finit le circuit avec moins de crash.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Still lost
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Toujours perdu

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Check your time, though
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vérifie ton temps, quand même

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You finished much faster than the first race
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu as fini beaucoup plus vite que lors de la première course

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I only spun around twice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Et je n'ai fait que deux tours sur moi-même

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Exactly. You remembered to slow down before the sharp corners
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Exactement. Tu as pensé à ralentir avant les virages serrés

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was repeating your instructions in my head
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je répétais tes instructions dans ma tête

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: They worked. That was a much better lap
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ça a marché. C'était un tour bien meilleur

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're being nice because I'm your girlfriend
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu es gentil parce que je suis ta copine

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd tell you if you hadn't improved
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je te le dirais si tu n'avais pas progressé

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Would you play something with me tonight?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu voudrais jouer à quelque chose avec moi ce soir ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The faster lap is because you drove better
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Le tour plus rapide, c'est parce que tu as mieux conduit

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay, that's a good answer ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: D'accord, c'est une bonne réponse ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Want to stop or try a different track?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu veux t'arrêter ou essayer un autre circuit ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One more on this one
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Encore un sur celui-ci

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I want to see if I can do it without crashing at all
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je veux voir si je peux le faire sans crash du tout

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER ONE LAST RACE
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: APRÈS UNE DERNIÈRE COURSE

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I nearly had it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'étais presque là

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You only clipped the barrier at the end
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu as juste frôlé la barrière à la fin

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because I got excited and forgot to brake
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Parce que je me suis excitée et j'ai oublié de freiner

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Your first half was really good. Keep doing that and the rest will follow
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ta première moitié était vraiment bonne. Continue comme ça et le reste suivra

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. You're asking ME to play?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Attends. Tu me demandes à MOI de jouer ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I want a rematch another night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je veux un match revanche une autre nuit

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd be very happy with that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je serais très contente avec ça

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're still smiling about me asking, aren't you?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu souris encore parce que je demande, n'est-ce pas ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A little
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Un peu

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I like getting to share this with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'aime partager ça avec toi

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. Even if you're annoyingly difficult to catch
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Moi aussi. Même si tu es agaçamment difficile à rattraper

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now you understand why I always want one more round
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Maintenant tu comprends pourquoi je veux toujours un tour de plus

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Unfortunately, yes 😌
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Malheureusement, oui 😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Did you play games like this when you were little?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu jouais à des jeux comme ça quand tu étais petit(e) ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. I'd lean sideways with the controller like that would help me turn
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ouais. Je me penchais sur le côté avec la manette comme si ça m'aiderait à tourner

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Oui 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did that tonight 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'ai fait ça ce soir 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then you have excellent instincts
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Alors tu as d'excellents instincts

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Apparently everyone except the car understood what I wanted
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Apparemment, tout le monde sauf la voiture a compris ce que je voulais

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: We'll work on getting the car involved next time
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: On va travailler pour que la voiture soit impliquée la prochaine fois

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for being patient with me tonight
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Merci d'avoir été patient avec moi ce soir

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a good time. You don't have to win for me to enjoy playing with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'ai passé un bon moment. Tu n'as pas besoin de gagner pour que je prenne plaisir à jouer avec toi

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had fun too ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Moi aussi, j'ai bien rigolé ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Getting ready for tomorrow, then bed
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: D'accord. Je me prépare pour demain, puis au lit

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love. Thanks for asking me to play
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bonne nuit, mon amour. Merci de m'avoir demandé de jouer

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight ❤️ We'll do it again
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bonne nuit ❤️ On recommencera

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Why are you so surprised?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Pourquoi es-tu si surprise ?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You never suggest it. It's usually me telling you about my games
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu ne le proposes jamais. C'est généralement moi qui te parle de mes jeux

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm really happy you asked, actually
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je suis vraiment contente que tu aies demandé, en fait

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Morning
No
Today I’ve got the whole day free
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Aujourd'hui, j'ai toute la journée de libre.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Miraculously
Want to come shopping with me then?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tu veux venir faire du shopping avec moi alors ?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Shopping?
I need new pants. The doctor took my cast off two days ago, so I can finally wear pants that fit properly again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: J’ai besoin de nouveaux pantalons. Le médecin m’a retiré le plâtre il y a deux jours, alors je peux enfin remettre des pantalons à ma taille.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Oh damn, finally
Yes, with pleasure
I’ve been waiting for an excuse to leave the house without academic guilt
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: J'attendais une excuse pour sortir de la maison sans culpabilité académique.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You up?
Give me thirty minutes to look less like a disaster
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Donne-moi trente minutes pour avoir l'air moins désastreux.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Take your time
Don’t start without me 😌
Yeah. How are you feeling today?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ouais. Tu te sens comment aujourd'hui ?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Better than yesterday
Still a bit tired but my brain isn’t completely soup anymore
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Encore un peu fatiguée mais mon cerveau n'est plus complètement en bouillie

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Good. When are you seeing your professor again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Bien. C'est quand que tu revois ton prof ?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Probably one day out of two
Sometimes every day if he thinks I need it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Parfois tous les jours s'il pense que j'en ai besoin.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He’s taking this whole “extra sessions” thing pretty seriously
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Il prend vraiment au sérieux ce truc des "sessions supplémentaires".

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Today too?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've decided we never watched that film and my reputation is still intact
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Salut ❤️ J'ai décidé qu'on n'a jamais regardé ce film et que ma réputation est toujours intacte

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, then it wasn't just me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bien, alors ce n'était pas que moi

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What about you? Better night?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et toi ? Une meilleure nuit ?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better, and I got up and made breakfast before checking my phone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Beaucoup mieux, et je me suis levé et j'ai préparé le petit-déjeuner avant de vérifier mon téléphone

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Without leaving a trail of things you'd dropped?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sans laisser une traînée de choses que tu aurais laissées tomber ?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One spoon, but I picked it up
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Une cuillère, mais je l'ai ramassée

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm proud of your very ambitious morning ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je suis fière de ton matin très ambitieux ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've also put both shoes on
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai aussi mis mes deux chaussures

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sitting down?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu es assise ?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sitting down
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Assise

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: See, you can be taught 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu vois, on peut t'apprendre 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning to you too, detective
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bonjour à toi aussi, détective

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How's your breakfast going?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Comment se passe ton petit-déjeuner ?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's fine, packing my bag is the problem
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça va, le problème c'est de faire mon sac

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm taking last night's pasta so I don't get robbed by another sandwich
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je prends les pâtes d'hier soir pour ne pas me faire voler par un autre sandwich

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Future You finally got something out of that dinner
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Toi du futur a enfin tiré quelque chose de ce dîner

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She got food and an extremely full bag
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Elle a eu de la nourriture et un sac extrêmement plein

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Put the food at the top
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mets la nourriture en haut

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I have to carry the book
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Alors je dois porter le livre

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Carry the book
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Porte le livre

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You make everything sound so easy when you're not the one trying to close this zip 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu fais tout sembler si facile quand ce n'est pas toi qui essaies de fermer cette fermeture 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could leave something at home
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu pourrais laisser quelque chose à la maison

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't start, I haven't even had breakfast yet 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ne commence pas, je n'ai même pas encore pris mon petit déjeuner 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need all of it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'en ai besoin de tout

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Including whatever's been sitting at the bottom for three weeks?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Y compris ce qui traîne au fond depuis trois semaines ?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You don't know what's at the bottom
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu ne sais pas ce qu'il y a au fond

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Do you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu sais ?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's not the point
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ce n'est pas le but

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, I think I've got it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Attends, je pense que j'ai compris

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Please appreciate that I'm dressed and ready before the last possible minute
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: S'il te plaît, apprécie que je suis habillée et prête avant la dernière minute possible

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look really good ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu es vraiment belle ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome 😊
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Merci beau 😊

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Would a red scarf make you feel better?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Une écharpe rouge te ferait-elle sentir mieux ?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The bag looks like it's about to lose a fight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Le sac a l'air d'être sur le point de perdre un combat

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Compliment the girl, not the luggage
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Complimente la fille, pas les bagages

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The girl is lovely. The luggage has my sympathy
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: La fille est charmante. Les bagages ont ma sympathie

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Beaucoup mieux 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes this morning again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Des cours encore ce matin ?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, then straight to work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ouais, puis direction le boulot

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to get everything finished without staring at the clock for the last hour
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'aimerais finir tout sans regarder l'horloge pendant la dernière heure

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A reasonable goal
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un objectif raisonnable

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What are you doing with your day?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu fais quoi de ta journée ?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Going to clear out that kitchen cupboard I've been avoiding
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je vais vider ce placard de cuisine que j'évite

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will hide your remote the next time I come over
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je cacherai ta télécommande la prochaine fois que je viendrai

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The one where things fall on you when you open it?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Celle où des trucs tombent sur toi quand tu l'ouvres ?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I prefer to think of it as a surprise feature
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je préfère le voir comme une fonctionnalité surprise

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could also just put fewer things in it 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu pourrais aussi juste mettre moins de choses dedans 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm making space for the good coffee mugs
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je fais de la place pour les bonnes tasses à café

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Important, I don't want our first proper coffee together to come out of a measuring jug
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est important, je ne veux pas que notre premier vrai café ensemble sorte d'une carafe à mesurer

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've ruined my entire presentation
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as ruiné toute ma présentation

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Save the effort for the coffee, I won't judge the mug too much ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Garde tes efforts pour le café, je ne jugerai pas trop la tasse ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather take you out for one soon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je préfère t'emmener en prendre un bientôt

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça me plairait

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: All right, I need to leave before being early turns into missing the bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: D'accord, je dois partir avant que d'être en avance ne se transforme en rater le bus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like a confession
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça ressemble à une confession

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I probably won't be on my phone much this afternoon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je ne serai probablement pas beaucoup sur mon téléphone cet après-midi

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't forget your lunch after all that effort
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: N'oublie pas ton déjeuner après tous ces efforts

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's already digging into my side, I couldn't forget it if I tried 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça me rentre déjà dans le flanc, je ne pourrais pas l'oublier même si j'essayais 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get to the bar tonight, like I said
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je te texterai quand j'arriverai au bar ce soir, comme je l'ai dit

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, have a good day
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: D'accord, passe une bonne journée

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too handsome ❤️ Love you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Toi aussi, beau gosse ❤️ Je t'aime

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je t'aime aussi

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It sounds like a warning 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça ressemble à un avertissement 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep well at least?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as bien dormi au moins ?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, once I stopped trying to work out how the actual ending made sense
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ouais, une fois que j'ai arrêté d'essayer de comprendre comment la fin avait du sens

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It didn't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça ne l'a pas fait

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: The second one looks less tragic
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Le deuxième a l'air moins tragique.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Thanks for the vote of confidence
I saw something quite nice near the entrance
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: J'ai vu quelque chose de sympa près de l'entrée
Je vais essayer encore une fois.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m still buying this one though
We can go pay and get food after
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: On peut aller payer et prendre à manger après.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ We're at the bar, and I've finally sat down somewhere that isn't an office chair
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Salut ❤️ On est au bar, et je me suis enfin assise quelque part qui n'est pas une chaise de bureau

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can keep mocking my recommendations, but you seem to like this one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu peux continuer à te moquer de mes recommandations, mais tu as l'air d'aimer celle-ci

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do like it here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'aime bien ici

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: See, that wasn't difficult
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu vois, ce n'était pas si difficile

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're going to be unbearable about this all night, aren't you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu vas être insupportable à ce sujet toute la nuit, n'est-ce pas ?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only until you stop acting surprised that I have good taste
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Seulement jusqu'à ce que tu arrêtes de faire semblant d'être surprise que j'ai bon goût

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not giving you that one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne te laisse pas celle-là

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu n'es pas obligée

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? What do you actually do when you're not in that office?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et toi ? Tu fais quoi quand tu n'es pas dans ce bureau ?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go out, find somewhere good to eat, drive somewhere when I have a free day
