story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll talk to him properly after class, before I give myself another excuse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je lui parlerai sérieusement après le cours, avant de me trouver une autre excuse.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You sound much too pleased about this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as l'air bien trop content de ça

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I published the profile
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai publié le profil.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Already?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Déjà ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Before I could rewrite the introduction for the sixth time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Avant que je puisse réécrire l'introduction pour la sixième fois.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The photo from last night, the bit about being in a relationship, and my very attractive pasta problem
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: La photo d'hier soir, le passage sur le fait d'être en couple, et mon problème de pâtes très attirant.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A strong introduction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Une bonne introduction

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I added that I mean a real coffee in a real café, not someone inviting himself to my place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai précisé que je parle d'un vrai café dans un vrai café, pas de quelqu'un qui s'invite chez moi.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça te ressemble bien !

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I put the phone face down afterward like it might start giving me instructions
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ensuite, j’ai posé le téléphone écran vers le bas, comme s’il allait se mettre à me donner des instructions.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You know you don't have to answer anything during class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu sais que tu n'es pas obligé de répondre pendant le cours.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I do, and I'm leaving it alone until my break
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je sais, et je vais le laisser de côté jusqu'à ma pause.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Mostly because I don't want my first reply to contain a sentence from today's lecture
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Surtout parce que je ne veux pas que ma première réponse contienne une phrase du cours d'aujourd'hui.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Depends on the lecture
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça dépend du cours.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No man deserves my notes on research methods as an introduction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aucun homme ne mérite mes notes sur les méthodes de recherche comme introduction.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You might find someone with very specific interests
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu pourrais trouver quelqu'un avec des intérêts très spécifiques.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I already have one of those 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'en ai déjà un de ceux-là 😌.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Fair enough
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça se tient.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It feels strange that it's actually there now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est bizarre que ce soit vraiment là maintenant.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But I'm glad I pressed the button instead of spending another day adjusting commas
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mais je suis contente d'avoir appuyé sur le bouton au lieu de passer une autre journée à ajuster des virgules.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I see the problem
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je vois le problème.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What time do you finish?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: À quelle heure tu finis ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Around lunch, unless someone discovers a question just as we're leaving
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vers l'heure du déjeuner, à moins que quelqu'un ne découvre une question juste au moment où on part.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I have a book to return before the library starts sending me threateningly polite emails
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et j'ai un livre à rendre avant que la bibliothèque ne commence à m'envoyer des e-mails poliment menaçants.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A busy day of facing your enemies
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Une journée bien remplie à affronter tes ennemis.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You, university, the library
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Toi, l'université, la bibliothèque.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm on the list?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je suis sur la liste ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You made me miss you while I was trying to get dressed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as fait en sorte que tu me manques pendant que j'essayais de m'habiller.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're welcome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: De rien

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That wasn't a thank you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ce n'était pas un merci

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I put your pasta in a separate container, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Au fait, j'ai mis tes pâtes dans un récipient séparé

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Finally
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Enfin.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So now I have a very practical reason to come over soon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Donc maintenant, j'ai une raison très pratique de venir bientôt

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You already have several very impractical ones
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as déjà plusieurs raisons qui n'ont rien de pratique.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Those are my favorites ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ce sont mes préférées ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, leaving now before I start another conversation with you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bon, je pars maintenant avant de commencer une autre conversation avec toi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good luck today
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bonne chance aujourd'hui

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, handsome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Merci, beau gosse

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And have some breakfast that didn't come out of a packet next to the console
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et prends un petit déjeuner qui ne sort pas d'un paquet à côté de la console

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've narrowed down my options considerably
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as considérablement réduit mes options

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You still look beautiful, which weakens your case against me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu es toujours aussi belle, ce qui affaiblit ton accusation contre moi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You still have a crush on him, don't you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu as toujours un faible pour lui, n'est-ce pas ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm ready, let's go before you say something even worse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je suis prête, allons-y avant que tu dises quelque chose de pire

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: We're going to be late for {{name:aiden}}
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: On va être en retard pour {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You're not going to a party
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu ne vas pas à une fête

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I know… but I still want to look good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je sais… mais je veux quand même avoir l'air bien

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But with that outfit he's only going to be looking at your ass the whole time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mais avec cette tenue, il va juste regarder ton derrière tout le temps

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I still can't believe you're continuing after the main exam
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je n'arrive toujours pas à croire que tu continues après l'examen principal

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have a really good supervisor
Or rather… really good punishments and rewards 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ou plutôt… de super punitions et récompenses 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You still have to actually study though
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mais tu dois quand même vraiment étudier

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It's hard to focus when you do that…
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: C'est dur de se concentrer quand tu fais ça…
Intégrité de la session d'étude compromise

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So the reward came before the work this time, and my feelings about that are harder to joke away.
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Alors cette fois, la récompense est arrivée avant le travail, et mes sentiments à ce sujet sont plus difficiles à cacher derrière des blagues.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived evidence of physical reward during study session
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK a archivé des preuves de récompense physique pendant la session d'étude

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'll do my best to make sure you get the best grade possible then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je vais faire de mon mieux pour que tu aies la meilleure note possible alors
Je suis sûr que c'était le cas

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Ethan is coming to pick me up
Why doesn't he just come to the house?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Pourquoi il ne vient pas directement à la maison ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: We're more comfortable at his place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: On est plus à l'aise chez lui

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 Classes are over, I returned the library book, and I've stolen a sunny spot on the steps
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Salut 😊 Les cours sont finis, j'ai rendu le livre à la bibliothèque, et j'ai volé un coin ensoleillé sur les marches

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because if we're going to try something like this, I'd rather it was with someone we trust
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Parce que si on va essayer quelque chose comme ça, je préfère que ce soit avec quelqu'un en qui on a confiance.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Both of you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tous les deux ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. He trusts you, and so do I
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui. Il te fait confiance, et moi aussi.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know you can joke about absolutely anything, but I also know I can tell you when something matters
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je sais que tu peux rigoler sur n'importe quoi, mais je sais aussi que je peux te dire quand quelque chose est important.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Oh
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oh

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was that the part that finally shut you up?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'était la partie qui t'a enfin fait taire ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For a second, yeah
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pour une seconde, ouais.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That actually means a lot. I didn't expect that part either
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça compte vraiment pour moi. Je ne m'attendais pas à ça non plus.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't look so surprised. I do occasionally say nice things about you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ne fais pas cette tête. Je dis parfois des choses gentilles sur toi.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not usually without calling me an idiot immediately afterward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pas sans m'appeler idiot juste après, en général.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How did the morning go?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Comment s'est passée ta matinée ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can still do that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je peux toujours faire ça.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There she is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: La voilà.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm touched. I am. It's just also really strange knowing my friend is okay with me taking his girlfriend on a date
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je suis touché. Vraiment. C'est juste un peu bizarre de savoir que mon ami est d'accord pour que je sorte avec sa copine.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can be touched and find it strange. I'm managing curious and embarrassed at the same time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu peux être touché et trouver ça bizarre. Moi, je jongle entre la curiosité et la gêne.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I noticed the embarrassed part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai remarqué la partie gênée.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course you did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien sûr que tu l'as remarqué.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've spent five minutes avoiding my eyes after walking over here to ask me out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu as passé cinq minutes à éviter mon regard après être venue me proposer un rendez-vous.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was hoping you wouldn't point that out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'espérais que tu ne le soulignerais pas.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You didn't choose me for my ability to stay quiet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu ne m'as pas choisi pour ma capacité à rester silencieux.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Clearly that was an oversight
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'était clairement une erreur.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fine once I actually started listening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça allait une fois que j'ai vraiment commencé à écouter

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But you do want this? Not just because he likes the idea?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mais tu veux vraiment ça ? Pas juste parce qu'il aime l'idée ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wouldn't have come over here if I only wanted to make him happy
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne serais pas venu ici juste pour le rendre heureux.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like being around you. I'm curious about what it would feel like if we stopped pretending all the flirting was just a joke
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'aime être avec toi. Je me demande ce que ça ferait si on arrêtait de faire semblant que tous ces flirts n'étaient qu'une blague.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've noticed, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu as remarqué, alors.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're not nearly as subtle as you think
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu es loin d'être aussi subtil que tu le penses.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was trying to be charming
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'essayais d'être charmant.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sometimes it works. Don't make me regret admitting that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Parfois ça marche. Ne me fais pas regretter de l'admettre.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making it very difficult to act casual about this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Avec ce que tu me dis, c'est dur de faire comme si de rien n'était.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You haven't been casual since I said the first sentence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu n'as pas l'air détendu depuis ma première phrase.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair. And yes, I'd like to take you for a coffee
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord. Et oui, j'aimerais t'inviter à prendre un café.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Although I wrote the date in the wrong place three times before I noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Même si j’ai écrit la date au mauvais endroit trois fois avant de m’en rendre compte

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're sure?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu es sûr ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Surprised, not uninterested. There's a difference
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Surpris, pas désintéressé. Il y a une différence.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because for a moment you looked like you were trying to find the exit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien, parce que pendant un moment, on aurait dit que tu cherchais la sortie.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was trying to think of something less embarrassing than asking you to repeat the whole thing a third time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'essayais de penser à quelque chose de moins embarrassant que de te demander de répéter tout ça une troisième fois.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I appreciate the effort
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'apprécie l'effort.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like you. An awkward conversation hasn't suddenly made that difficult to admit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu me plais. Une conversation gênante ne rend pas soudain ça difficile à avouer.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some of us needed a little longer
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Certains d'entre nous ont eu besoin d'un peu plus de temps.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai remarqué.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And before you start feeling too pleased with yourself, I'm asking about a first date. Nothing beyond that is decided
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et avant que tu ne commences à te sentir trop fier de toi, je parle d'un premier rendez-vous. Rien de plus n'est décidé.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. A coffee, then we see how it feels
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je sais. Un café, et ensuite on voit comment ça se passe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A distracted student? Doesn't sound like you at all
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Une étudiante distraite ? Ça ne te ressemble pas du tout

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Even if it feels weird?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Même si ça fait bizarre ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then it feels weird. I'm still going to complain about the coffee and steal your fries next week
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alors ça fait bizarre. Je vais quand même me plaindre du café et te piquer tes frites la semaine prochaine.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Ideally without telling the entire table why we went out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Idéalement sans dire à toute la table pourquoi on est sortis.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course. I'm teasing you, not announcing it to everyone
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien sûr. Je te taquine, je ne l'annonce pas à tout le monde.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Or making him regret being honest with me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ou à lui faire regretter d'avoir été honnête avec moi.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I might need a second not to grin next time I see him, but I'm not going to make him feel bad about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je sais. Je vais peut-être avoir besoin d'une seconde pour ne pas sourire la prochaine fois que je le vois, mais je ne vais pas le faire se sentir mal.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really won't?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu ne vas vraiment pas le faire ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He trusts me. You've just told me you do too. I'm not going to be an idiot about that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il me fait confiance. Tu viens de me dire que tu me fais aussi confiance. Je ne vais pas être idiot là-dessus.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only about everything else?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Seulement à propos de tout le reste ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Let's not expect miracles
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ne nous attendons pas à des miracles.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm choosing to ignore that 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je choisis d'ignorer ça 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you. Seriously
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Merci. Sérieusement.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're welcome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: De rien.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Coffee tomorrow? There's that place near the campus with the mismatched chairs
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un café demain ? Il y a ce café près du campus avec les chaises dépareillées.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The one where you complained the cups were too small?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Celui où tu as dit que les tasses étaient trop petites ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They were too small
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Elles étaient trop petites.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This is already sounding like our normal conversations
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça commence déjà à ressembler à nos conversations habituelles.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying to ease you in
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'essaie de te mettre à l'aise.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow could work
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Demain, ça pourrait marcher.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Want to decide the time later? I need to check when my last class finishes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: On fixe l'heure plus tard ? Je dois vérifier à quelle heure finit mon dernier cours.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, message me when you know
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui, envoie-moi un message quand tu sauras.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I might be a little awkward at first
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et je serai peut-être un peu maladroite au début.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I'll give you something to complain about
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alors je te donnerai de quoi te plaindre.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You do that without trying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu fais ça sans même essayer.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See? We have a system
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu vois ? On a trouvé notre méthode.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: À demain

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: À demain

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: 25 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 25 MINUTES PLUS TARD

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked, and he said he'd like to get a coffee with me tomorrow 😊
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: On a parlé, et il a dit qu'il aimerait prendre un café avec moi demain 😊

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How are you feeling?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Comment tu te sens ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Like I've been holding my shoulders up around my ears since breakfast and only just noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Comme si j’avais les épaules remontées jusqu’aux oreilles depuis le petit déjeuner et que je venais seulement de m’en rendre compte.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can put them down now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu peux les baisser maintenant.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'essaie

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He knows we discussed him together, and that this isn't something I'm hiding from you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il sait qu'on a parlé de lui ensemble, et que ce n'est pas quelque chose que je te cache

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We've only agreed on a coffee, nothing beyond that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: On a juste convenu d'un café, rien de plus

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did talking to him feel all right?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et parler avec lui, ça s'est bien passé ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I left my phone in my bag until we'd finished, like we said
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai laissé mon téléphone dans mon sac jusqu'à ce qu'on ait fini, comme on a dit

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He understands that you know, and we agreed on a coffee without making promises about anything else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il comprend que tu sais, et on a convenu d'un café sans faire de promesses sur autre chose

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you could actually concentrate on the conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je suis content que tu aies pu vraiment te concentrer sur la conversation.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Me too, I already had enough happening inside my head
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Moi aussi, j'avais déjà assez de choses qui se passaient dans ma tête

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping the small details to myself, like we said
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je garde les petits détails pour moi, comme on a dit

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But the important part is good, and he understands that you know
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mais la partie importante est bonne, et il comprend que tu sais

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Just a coffee tomorrow, nothing we've decided beyond that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Juste un café demain, on n'a rien décidé de plus.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then tell me how you're feeling rather than giving me the whole conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alors dis-moi comment tu te sens plutôt que de me raconter toute la conversation

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Relieved, and a little pleased with myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Soulagée, et un peu fière de moi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought I'd feel like I was borrowing somebody else's confidence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je pensais que j'allais avoir l'impression d'emprunter la confiance de quelqu'un d'autre

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But once I'd said the awkward part, I was still just me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mais une fois que j'ai dit la partie gênante, j'étais toujours moi-même

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's the person he knows
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est la personne qu'il connaît

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, I think I needed to remember that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ouais, je pense que j'avais besoin de me rappeler ça

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And there was a moment when I realized I actually wanted him to say yes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et il y a eu un moment où j'ai réalisé que je voulais vraiment qu'il dise oui

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How did that feel?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Qu'est-ce que tu as ressenti ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: More personal than when we were just talking about the idea
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Plus personnel que quand on parlait juste de l'idée

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not bad, just enough to make me lose my next sentence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Rien de désagréable, juste assez pour me faire oublier ce que j'allais dire.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:aiden}} is by the courtyard gate
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:aiden}} est près de la porte de la cour

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did the library forgive you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: La bibliothèque t'a pardonné ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You, lost for words? I'm trying very hard not to look too pleased about that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Toi, à court de mots ? Je fais de gros efforts pour ne pas avoir l'air trop content.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Absolutely not, you'd have made a face and I'd have started laughing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Absolument pas, tu aurais fait une grimace et j'aurais commencé à rire

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here, this is the version that has recovered slightly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tiens, c'est la version qui s'est légèrement rétablie

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a very good smile
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est un très beau sourire

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, I can't quite get rid of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je sais, je n'arrive pas à m'en débarrasser

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu n'es pas obligé(e)

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making me do it again ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu me fais encore sourire ❤️.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He'll let me know his schedule later, then we'll pick a time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il me fera savoir son emploi du temps plus tard, ensuite on choisira un moment

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tell me tonight when you're settled
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dis-moi ce soir quand tu es installé

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I told him I'd be there in a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je lui ai dit que j'arriverais dans une minute

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will, I need to go get something to eat first
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je le ferai, mais d'abord je dois aller chercher quelque chose à manger.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've had a few messages on the app
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai reçu quelques messages sur l'appli

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anything you feel like answering?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il y en a auxquels tu as envie de répondre ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One or two, yes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un ou deux, oui

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going to sit somewhere with a drink and actually read them instead of opening everything between doors
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je vais m'asseoir quelque part avec un verre et les lire vraiment au lieu d'ouvrir tout entre les portes

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Probably more comfortable than standing in the library exit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Probablement plus confortable que de rester debout à la sortie de la bibliothèque.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Much less likely to get me politely removed, too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Beaucoup moins probable que je me fasse gentiment éjecter, aussi.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you once I've had a chance to talk properly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je t'enverrai un message dès que j'aurai eu l'occasion de parler correctement.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Are you still happy to talk to him?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu es toujours contente de lui parler ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord ❤️.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: 50 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 50 MINUTES PLUS TARD

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've finished my drink and somehow found a person I wanted to keep talking to
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai fini ma boisson et j'ai trouvé quelqu'un avec qui je voulais continuer à parler.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds promising
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça a l'air prometteur.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was not the man who asked whether I was actually single
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ce n'était pas l'homme qui a demandé si j'étais vraiment célibataire.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I pointed him back to the first sentence of my profile and left that conversation there
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je l'ai renvoyé à la première phrase de mon profil et j'en suis restée là.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An efficient reading comprehension test
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un test de compréhension de lecture efficace.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very efficient
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Très efficace.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But the other conversation was nice
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mais l'autre conversation était sympa.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He actually read what I'd written, including the part about you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il a vraiment lu ce que j'avais écrit, y compris la partie te concernant.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, I just need to stop trying to decide how the whole conversation will go before it starts
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui, je dois juste arrêter d'essayer de décider comment va se passer toute la conversation avant qu'elle ne commence

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did that make it awkward?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça a rendu les choses awkward?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He asked if this was something we'd agreed on, I said yes, and he didn't keep trying to turn it into a secret
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il a demandé si c'était quelque chose sur lequel nous étions d'accord, j'ai dit oui, et il n'a pas continué à essayer d'en faire un secret.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we got to have an ordinary conversation, which was the part I wanted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ensuite, nous avons pu avoir une conversation ordinaire, ce que je voulais.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What made you answer him?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Qu'est-ce qui t'a poussée à lui répondre ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One of his pictures was a very burnt pizza with an apology underneath it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Une de ses photos était une pizza très brûlée avec des excuses en dessous.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So you chose him for his cooking
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Donc tu l'as choisi pour sa cuisine.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I chose him because it made me laugh, which seemed like a reasonable place to start
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je l'ai choisi parce que ça m'a fait rire, ce qui semblait être un bon point de départ.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: His first message asked whether the imaginary people I cook for ever helped with the washing up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Son premier message demandait si les gens imaginaires pour qui je cuisine aidaient un jour à faire la vaisselle.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Better than asking whether you're single
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mieux que de demander si tu es célibataire

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One sentence at a time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Une phrase à la fois

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A significant improvement
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Une amélioration significative

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I told him they were terrible guests and he said his only dinner guest had once brought a fire extinguisher as a joke
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je lui ai dit qu'ils étaient de mauvais invités et il a dit que son seul invité au dîner avait une fois apporté un extincteur en blague

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because of the pizza?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: À cause de la pizza ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently there were several attempts before the pizza in the photo
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Apparemment, il y a eu plusieurs tentatives avant la pizza sur la photo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can't decide if the persistence is admirable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne sais pas si la persistance est admirable

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to let him cook for you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu n'es pas obligée de le laisser cuisiner pour toi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I mentioned that and he immediately suggested somewhere with actual staff 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'en ai parlé et il a tout de suite suggéré un endroit avec du personnel 😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds sensible of him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça a l'air sensé de sa part

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's twenty-six, works across town, and isn't part of our university circle
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il a vingt-six ans, travaille de l'autre côté de la ville et ne fait pas partie de notre cercle universitaire

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't know him yet, obviously, but I liked that he could talk without trying to impress me every other sentence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne le connais pas encore, évidemment, mais j'ai aimé qu'il puisse parler sans essayer de m'impressionner à chaque phrase

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's annoyingly sensible
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est agaçamment sensé

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you feel comfortable talking to him?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu te sens à l'aise de lui parler ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So far, yes, and he made me laugh without trying too hard
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pour l'instant, oui, et il m'a fait rire sans trop forcer

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping some of the little details for myself, but this is someone new, not anybody from our friends
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je garde quelques petits détails pour moi, mais c'est quelqu'un de nouveau, pas un de nos amis

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's enough for now, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est suffisant pour l'instant, alors

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I also liked that I could take a few minutes to answer without him asking where I'd disappeared to
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai aussi aimé que je puisse prendre quelques minutes pour répondre sans qu'il demande où j'avais disparu

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not making your phone feel like homework is a good start
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ne pas faire de ton téléphone un devoir, c'est un bon début

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Exactement

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm putting my phone away now, otherwise I'll keep talking to you instead
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je range mon téléphone maintenant, sinon je vais continuer à te parler

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: By the time we stopped, we were talking about getting a coffee tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Au moment où nous nous sommes arrêtés, nous parlions d'aller prendre un café demain

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Already picked somewhere?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu as déjà choisi un endroit ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I suggested the café near the main shopping street, the one with the big windows
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai suggéré le café près de la rue commerçante principale, celui avec les grandes fenêtres

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Somewhere I know, in the afternoon, and just a drink to see whether we get along in person
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un endroit que je connais, l'après-midi, juste un verre pour voir si on s'entend bien en vrai

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Does that feel like something you want to do?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça te dit de faire ça ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I caught myself typing the suggestion before he asked, actually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je me suis surprise à taper la suggestion avant qu'il ne demande, en fait

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Which surprised me more than getting messages in the first place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça m'a plus surprise que de recevoir des messages au départ

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You sound happy about that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: On dirait que ça te rend heureux

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je le suis

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Go on. I'll be here later ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vas-y. Je serai là plus tard ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't go looking for someone to tick a box, I had a conversation I enjoyed and wanted another one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne cherchais pas juste à cocher une case, j'ai eu une conversation que j'ai aimée et je voulais en avoir une autre

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds more like you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça te ressemble plus

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It felt like me, too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je me suis aussi sentie moi-même.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And it helped not trying to keep you updated at the same time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et ça m'a aidée de ne pas essayer de te tenir au courant en même temps

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I can actually talk to you instead of bouncing between two conversations
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Maintenant, je peux vraiment te parler au lieu de jongler entre deux conversations

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I prefer that to getting half a sentence from each
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je préfère ça à recevoir une demi phrase de chacun

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Merci

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anyway, this is your girlfriend after successfully sending a normal message without rewriting it twenty times
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bref, voici ta copine après avoir réussi à envoyer un message normal sans le réécrire vingt fois

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look pleased with yourself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu as l'air fière de toi.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am, and I'm allowing myself five minutes of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je le suis, et je m'accorde cinq minutes pour en profiter.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can have more than five
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu peux t'en accorder plus de cinq.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dangerous, I might become unbearable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est dangereux, je pourrais devenir insupportable

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll take the risk
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je prends le risque

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This photo is for you, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cette photo est pour toi, au fait

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not giving anyone else the version of me celebrating a very small victory 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne vais pas montrer à quelqu'un d'autre la version de moi qui célèbre une toute petite victoire 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll treasure the exclusive
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je vais garder précieusement cette exclusivité

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: QUELQUES MINUTES PLUS TARD

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll confirm the time later when I know whether tomorrow's group meeting is staying in the morning
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je te confirmerai l'heure plus tard quand je saurai si la réunion de groupe de demain reste le matin

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tell me tonight
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dis-moi ce soir

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je le ferai ❤️.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't forget that you have a boyfriend who also enjoys conversations unrelated to university
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: N'oublie pas que tu as un petit ami qui aime aussi parler d'autre chose que de l'université

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I haven't forgotten you for a second
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne t'ai pas oublié une seconde

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But tell me one ordinary thing from your day before I go
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mais dis-moi une chose ordinaire de ta journée avant que je parte

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I opened a game to do one thing and spent half an hour changing the controls
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai lancé un jeu pour faire une seule chose et j'ai passé une demi-heure à modifier les commandes

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That is painfully believable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est douloureusement crédible

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was beginning to think you'd escaped through another exit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je commençais à penser que tu t'étais échappé par une autre sortie

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The woman at the desk didn't even look at me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: La femme au bureau ne m'a même pas regardée

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then changed them back because I preferred the old ones
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puis j'ai remis les anciennes parce que je les préférais

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you, that has made me feel much more productive
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Merci, ça m'a fait me sentir beaucoup plus productif

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Happy to help
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Content d'aider

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Text me later, I want to know if you ever actually play it ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Envoie-moi un message plus tard, je veux savoir si tu y joues vraiment un jour ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I nearly did, but I have a reputation for being reliable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai failli le faire, mais j'ai la réputation d'être fiable

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Since when?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Depuis quand ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making an excellent first impression
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu fais une excellente première impression

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: First impression? I thought I was well past that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Première impression ? Je pensais être bien au-delà de ça

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come on, let's walk a little
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allez, marchons un peu

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Two subjects enter the courtyard
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Deux sujets entrent dans la cour

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation continues
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: La conversation continue

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can give her room to choose without pretending that I feel nothing.
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je peux lui laisser la liberté de choisir sans faire semblant de ne rien ressentir.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVIS

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Away from the Crowd
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Loin de la foule

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right, now you actually are making me curious
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord, maintenant tu me rends vraiment curieuse

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You remember what I said yesterday? About wanting to talk somewhere quieter
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu te souviens de ce que j’ai dit hier ? Que je voulais parler dans un endroit plus calme

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, and I have been very mature about not asking you twelve times
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ouais, et j'ai été super mature en ne te le demandant pas douze fois.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I prepared an apology for a machine that just beeped
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'avais préparé des excuses pour une machine qui a simplement fait bip.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I appreciate the effort
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'apprécie l'effort.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is this a good place?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est un bon endroit ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, let's sit for a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ouais, assieds-toi une minute.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're doing that thing with the strap on your bag
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu fais ce truc avec la sangle de ton sac.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What thing?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quel truc ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Twisting it around your fingers
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu l'enroules autour de tes doigts.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I hadn't noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je n'avais pas remarqué.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to make whatever this is sound perfect
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu n'as pas besoin de rendre ça parfait.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a dangerous amount of kindness from you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C’est dangereusement gentil de ta part

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm saving the jokes until I know what we're talking about
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je garde mes blagues pour quand je saurai de quoi on parle.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A very moving exchange
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un échange très émouvant

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:player}} and I have been talking about me going on a date with someone else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:player}} et moi, on a parlé de l'idée que j'aie un rendez-vous avec quelqu'un d'autre

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait, what the fuck?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Attends, c'est quoi ce bordel ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little quieter, please
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un peu plus calme, s'il te plaît.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry, but... {{name:player}} wants you to go on a date with another guy?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pardon, mais... {{name:player}} veut que tu aies un rendez-vous avec un autre mec ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. We've been talking about it for a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui. On en parle depuis un moment

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Why? Did something happen between you two?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pourquoi ? Il s'est passé quelque chose entre vous deux ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, we're happy together. It's not about breaking up or finding someone to replace him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non, on est heureux ensemble. Ce n'est pas une question de rupture ou de trouver quelqu'un pour le remplacer.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I'm definitely missing something, because I'd be wondering why my girlfriend wanted to date somebody else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alors quelque chose m'échappe clairement, parce que je me demanderais pourquoi ma copine veut sortir avec quelqu'un d'autre

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He was the one who brought it up. He likes the idea of me being with someone else, with us deciding together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est lui qui en a parlé. Il aime l'idée que je sois avec quelqu'un d'autre, qu'on décide ensemble.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I think we both grew as people
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je pense qu'on a tous les deux grandi en tant que personnes

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He brought it up?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il en a parlé ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. And after talking about it, I realized I was curious too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui. Et après en avoir parlé, je me suis rendu compte que j'étais curieuse aussi.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're serious? This isn't you two trying to see what I'll say?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu es sérieux ? Ce n'est pas un test pour voir ce que je vais dire ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do I look like I'm having fun explaining this?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: On dirait que je m'amuse à expliquer ça ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry. I'm not laughing at you, I just really wasn't ready for that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Désolé. Je ne me moque pas de toi, je n'étais vraiment pas prête pour ça.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Neither was I when he first told me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Moi non plus, quand il me l'a dit pour la première fois.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right, but why are you telling me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord, mais pourquoi tu me le dis ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because I wanted to ask how you'd feel about being that person
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Parce que je voulais te demander comment tu te sentirais à l'idée d'être cette personne.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Me? Wait, you mean you want to go on a date with me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Moi ? Attends, tu veux dire que tu veux sortir avec moi ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, the man standing behind you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non, l'homme derrière toi.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anyway, this is where I'm hiding for five minutes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: De toute façon, c'est ici que je me cache pendant cinq minutes

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't do that, I'm still trying to catch up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ne fais pas ça, j'essaie encore de comprendre

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, you. That's why I asked you to meet me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui, toi. C'est pour ça que je t'ai demandé de me retrouver

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Holy shit. And he knows it's me? Not just some guy he doesn't know?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Putain. Et il sait que c'est moi ? Pas juste un type qu'il ne connaît pas ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about you specifically, so this isn't something I'm bringing up behind his back
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: On a parlé de toi précisément, alors je ne fais pas ça dans son dos

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So he knows you're here right now, asking me this?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Donc il sait que tu es ici en ce moment, en train de me le demander ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. He knew I was going to talk to you after class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui. Il savait que j'allais te parler après le cours

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought you wanted advice about something. I wasn't expecting to be part of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je pensais que tu voulais des conseils sur quelque chose. Je ne m'attendais pas à faire partie de ça.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now you understand why I spent all morning working out how to say it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Maintenant tu comprends pourquoi j'ai passé toute la matinée à réfléchir à comment le dire.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I kept expecting him to tell me to stop flirting with you. This is a very different conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je m'attendais à ce qu'il me dise d'arrêter de flirter avec toi. C'est une conversation très différente.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could at least pretend to be less proud of yourself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu pourrais au moins faire semblant d'être un peu moins fier de toi.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not even at proud yet. I'm still trying to believe you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne suis même pas encore fier. J'essaie encore de te croire.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:player}} has been keeping a few surprises to himself, hasn't he?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:player}} nous cachait quelques surprises, hein ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently. I had exactly the same look on my face when we first talked about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Apparemment. J'avais exactement la même expression sur le visage quand on en a parlé pour la première fois.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Poor guy. He finally tells you what's on his mind and now we're sitting here comparing our reactions
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pauvre gars. Il te dit enfin ce qu'il pense et maintenant on est là à comparer nos réactions.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're the one staring at me like I asked you to help me rob a bank
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est toi qui me regarde comme si je t'avais demandé de m'aider à braquer une banque.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd have understood the bank faster
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'aurais compris le braquage plus vite.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That doesn't surprise me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça ne me surprend pas.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously though, I never thought I'd hear this kind of proposal from you two
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sérieusement, je ne pensais jamais entendre ce genre de proposition de votre part.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. We like discovering new things together, but this one took a bit more talking
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je sais. On aime découvrir de nouvelles choses ensemble, mais celle-ci a nécessité un peu plus de discussion.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I would hope so
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'espère bien.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look like you're enjoying the silence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: On dirait que tu apprécies le silence

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At first I wasn't sure what I thought. Then we talked more, and I found myself wanting to see how it could feel
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Au début, je ne savais pas trop quoi en penser. Puis on en a davantage parlé, et j'ai eu envie de découvrir ce que ça pouvait faire.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And that's where I came in?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et c'est là que j'interviens ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Eventually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça a fini par venir.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Whose idea was that?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'était l'idée de qui ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about you. You're not getting the whole conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: On a parlé de toi. Je ne vais pas te raconter toute la conversation.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm only asking whether I should thank you or him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je demande juste si je dois te remercier ou lui.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Neither until you've actually answered my question
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ni l'un ni l'autre tant que tu n'as pas vraiment répondu à ma question.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're enjoying watching me struggle now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu aimes me voir galérer maintenant.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little. I've been nervous about this all morning
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un peu. J'ai été nerveuse à ce sujet toute la matinée.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right. Why me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord. Pourquoi moi ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For once nobody can ask whether the next slide is important
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pour une fois, personne ne peut demander si la prochaine diapositive est importante

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I really wasn't expecting her to show up like that 👀
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Je ne m'attendais vraiment pas à ce qu'elle arrive comme ça 👀

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She's always had a crush on you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Elle a toujours eu un faible pour toi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Now she's just taking full advantage of it 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Maintenant, elle en profite à fond 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Bro it was actually hard to concentrate on the exercises 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Franchement, c'était vraiment dur de se concentrer sur les exercices 😭
Ça ne te dérange pas, quand même ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Everyone can do whatever they want
Looking forward to the next sessions 🔥
And you, take it easy on the leg
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Et toi, fais attention à ta jambe

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: The doctor only took your cast off two days ago
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Le médecin ne t’a retiré le plâtre qu’il y a deux jours.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: First real session without the cast and you already handled most of the exercises
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Première vraie session sans le plâtre et tu as déjà géré la plupart des exercices
{{name:hailey}} a aussi bien géré sa partie

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: It was really hard to stay focused during the session 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: C'était vraiment dur de rester concentré pendant la session 😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've just put dinner on the table, have you eaten or are you still negotiating with that game?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Salut ❤️ Je viens de mettre le dîner sur la table, tu as mangé ou tu es toujours en train de négocier avec ce jeu ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like talking to you like this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'aime te parler comme ça.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even when you ask questions I can't answer with a joke?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Même quand tu poses des questions auxquelles je ne peux pas répondre avec une blague ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Surtout dans ces moments-là

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Although I'm sure you'll make another attempt in a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Même si je suis sûre que tu vas réessayer d'ici une minute

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm waiting for an opening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'attends une occasion.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Predictable man
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Homme prévisible.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Anyway, I wanted to try something on before I get too comfortable to move
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: De toute façon, je voulais essayer quelque chose avant de devenir trop à l'aise pour bouger.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For tomorrow?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pour demain ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, I was going to wear whatever I pulled out first
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui, j'allais mettre ce que je sortirais en premier.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I realized I actually wanted to choose something I liked
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puis j'ai réalisé que je voulais vraiment choisir quelque chose que j'aimais.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Show me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Montre-moi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Give me a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Donne-moi une minute.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 6 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 6 MINUTES PLUS TARD

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one, with the jacket if it's cooler
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Celle-ci, avec la veste si jamais il fait frais.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'aime bien.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You answered very quickly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as répondu très vite.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Would you prefer a slower compliment?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu préfères un compliment plus lent ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd prefer one I believe
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'en préférerais un auquel je puisse croire

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look like you're about to enjoy your afternoon, not spend it worrying about your clothes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: On dirait que tu es sur le point de profiter de ton après-midi, pas de t'inquiéter pour tes vêtements.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça a l'air bon

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's actually exactly what I wanted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est exactement ce que je voulais.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you look beautiful
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et tu es magnifique.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That part helps too 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cette partie aide aussi 😌.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can walk in these shoes without thinking about every step, so they're staying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je peux marcher avec ces chaussures sans penser à chaque pas, donc elles restent.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A very practical fashion decision
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Une décision de mode très pratique.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I contain multitudes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis pleine de surprises.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm keeping the outfit, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je garde la tenue, alors.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner or me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Le dîner ou moi ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if I decide to send him a picture, you'll get that one too, like we said
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et si je décide de lui envoyer une photo, tu l'auras aussi, comme on a dit.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one was only for you, I haven't sent it anywhere else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Celle-ci était juste pour toi, je ne l'ai envoyée nulle part ailleurs.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like getting the preview
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'adore avoir un aperçu.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then appreciate it, there was a very undignified struggle with the jacket before I took it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alors apprécie-la, je me suis débattue avec la veste de façon très peu digne avant de prendre la photo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A shame I missed that part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dommage que j’aie raté ça

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You asked me about the dinner
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu me parlais du dîner

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one is just between us, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Celle-ci est juste entre nous, au fait.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not turning tomorrow into a collection of things you have to look at
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne vais pas transformer demain en une collection de choses que tu dois regarder.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd still have been disappointed to miss the dress
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'aurais quand même été déçue de rater la robe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your ordinary girlfriend pictures are not being discontinued 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne vais pas arrêter de t'envoyer les photos habituelles de ta petite amie 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This photo is just for you, not a report of something I've sent him
