story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cette photo est juste pour toi, pas un rapport de quelque chose que je lui ai envoyé.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can enjoy the dress and still let me keep some little things to myself tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu peux apprécier la robe et me laisser garder quelques petites choses pour moi demain.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can live with that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je peux vivre avec ça

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because I'm enjoying not planning every single sentence in advance
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien, parce que j'aime ne pas planifier chaque phrase à l'avance.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You are allowed to show initiative
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as le droit de faire preuve d'initiative

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This photo is only for you, I haven't sent it to him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cette photo est seulement pour toi, je ne la lui ai pas envoyée

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And tomorrow I can leave my phone alone while we're talking, then tell you about it afterward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et demain, je peux laisser mon téléphone de côté pendant qu'on parle, puis t'en parler après.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That still sounds right to me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça me semble toujours juste.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too, I don't want to spend our first coffee looking down at a screen
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Moi aussi, je ne veux pas passer notre premier café à regarder un écran.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Something else happened while I was trying this on
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il s'est passé autre chose pendant que j'essayais ça.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quoi ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner looks good, and I wish I was sitting opposite you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Le dîner a l'air bon, et j'aimerais être assise en face de toi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I caught myself wondering if he'd like it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je me suis surprise à me demander s'il aimerait ça.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then immediately wanting to see your face when you saw it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et juste après, j'ai eu envie de voir ta tête quand tu la découvrirais

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that you wanted both
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'aime que tu aies voulu les deux.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So do I, actually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Moi aussi, en fait.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought those feelings might get in each other's way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je pensais que ces sentiments pourraient nous compliquer la vie.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Instead I was just standing here wanting to show you the dress
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Au lieu de ça, je suis juste là à vouloir te montrer la robe.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis content que tu l'aies fait

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Moi aussi ❤️.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's better ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est mieux ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And our film afternoon is still happening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et notre après-midi film est toujours d'actualité.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I put the pasta container at the front of the fridge so I won't forget it when I come over
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai mis la boîte de pâtes à l'avant du frigo pour ne pas l'oublier quand je viendrai

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd let you in without it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je te laisserais entrer sans ça.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, but it's important that you understand what a generous visitor I am
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je sais, mais c'est important que tu comprennes à quel point je suis une visiteuse généreuse.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Generous with food, ruthless with the remote
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Généreuse avec la nourriture, impitoyable avec la télécommande.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You agreed I could choose
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as accepté que je choisisse.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je me souviens.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, I've found something where you can actually see the actors
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien, j'ai trouvé quelque chose où tu peux vraiment voir les acteurs.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're never letting that go, are you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu ne vas jamais lâcher ça, hein ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not until I find out who was standing in that doorway
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pas avant de savoir qui se tenait dans l'encadrement de cette porte

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Although you'd have to stop making me laugh while I'm trying to eat
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il faudrait quand même que tu arrêtes de me faire rire pendant que je mange

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody knows, that's part of the film
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Personne ne le sait, ça fait partie du film

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Terrible system
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quel système nul

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, I'm getting changed before I end up falling asleep in tomorrow's outfit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Attends, je vais me changer avant de finir par m'endormir dans ma tenue de demain

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 8 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 8 MINUTES PLUS TARD

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much better, I'm keeping these clothes for absolutely no audience at all
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est bien mieux. Cette tenue-là n'est destinée à aucun public

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not even me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Même pas moi ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have a small exception
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu peux avoir droit à une petite exception

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like this version too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'aime aussi cette version

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because this is the one you're getting during our film
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tant mieux, parce que c'est celle que tu auras pendant notre film

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No promises on that part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pas de promesses de ce côté

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: As long as I get to sit beside you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tant que je peux m'asseoir à côté de toi.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's rather the point ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est justement le but ❤️.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to put my phone down before I find another reason to keep you awake
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je vais poser mon téléphone avant de trouver une autre raison de te garder éveillé

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, pretty girl
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bonne nuit, ma belle

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bonne nuit, beau gosse

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And eat breakfast before I have to ask tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et demain, prends ton petit déjeuner avant que je sois obligée de te le demander

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There she is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La voilà.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I never left 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne suis jamais partie 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How's your leg after today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Comment va ta jambe après aujourd'hui ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I ate, and I actually played for a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai mangé, et j'ai effectivement joué un moment

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A bit tired, but I didn't push it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un peu fatigué, mais je n'ai pas forcé

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked getting outside, even if it wasn't exactly an adventure
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai aimé sortir, même si ce n'était pas vraiment une aventure

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't have to be an adventure to be good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça n'a pas besoin d'être une aventure pour être bien

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Listen to you being reasonable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Te voilà raisonnable

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've used a lot of courage today, I'm saving what's left
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai utilisé beaucoup de courage aujourd'hui, je garde le reste

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Speaking of which, tomorrow is arranged
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: En parlant de ça, demain c'est réglé

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: With the controls exactly where they were before?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Avec exactement les mêmes commandes qu'avant ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} finishes early enough, so we're meeting at the café near campus at half past three
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} finit assez tôt, donc on se retrouve au café près du campus à trois heures et demie

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The one with the mismatched chairs
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Celui avec les chaises dépareillées

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did he seem different when he messaged you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il avait l'air différent quand il t'a envoyé un message ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little more careful, maybe
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un peu plus prudent, peut-être

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not awkward, just less determined to make a joke out of everything
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pas maladroit, juste moins déterminée à faire une blague sur tout.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You might have surprised him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as peut-être réussi à le surprendre.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I definitely surprised myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: En tout cas, je me suis moi-même surprise

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was putting my things away when I remembered what I'd actually asked him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je rangeais mes affaires quand je me suis rappelée de ce que je lui avais vraiment demandé.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then I just stood in the hallway smiling at nothing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et puis je suis restée là dans le couloir à sourire pour rien.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd have liked to see that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'aurais aimé voir ça.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is no need to bring that up again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pas besoin d'en reparler

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you'd have asked what I was smiling about and made it worse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non, tu aurais demandé de quoi je souriais et ça aurait été encore pire.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Almost certainly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est presque certain.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The strange part is that I already know him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Le plus étrange, c'est que je le connais déjà.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tomorrow I'll be looking at someone familiar and wondering whether he's about to say something I haven't heard before
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Demain, je vais regarder quelqu'un de familier en me demandant s'il va dire quelque chose que je n'ai pas encore entendu.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the part you're curious about?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est ça qui t'intrigue ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, I think it is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui, je pense que c'est ça.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not trying to turn him into a different person, I just want to see what this feels like when we stop pretending it's an ordinary lunch
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne veux pas le transformer en une autre personne, je veux juste voir ce que ça fait quand on arrête de faire semblant que c'est un déjeuner ordinaire.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We're meeting at the café by the main shopping street at half past three
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: On se retrouve au café près de la grande rue commerçante à quinze heures et demie

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is a little need
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un petit peu, quand même

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I picked it because I know where it is and I won't have to spend the first ten minutes looking lost
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je l'ai choisi parce que je sais où il est et que je ne passerai pas les dix premières minutes à avoir l'air perdue

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good choice
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bon choix.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I'm going there on my own, no lifts from someone I haven't met yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et j'y vais par mes propres moyens, je ne me fais pas conduire par quelqu'un que je n'ai jamais rencontré

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you been talking much this evening?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vous avez beaucoup parlé ce soir ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little before dinner
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un peu avant le dîner.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I told him I was eating and would put the phone away
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puis je lui ai dit que je mangeais et que je mettrais le téléphone de côté.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take that?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Comment il a pris ça ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Like a normal person who also has things to do
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Comme une personne normale qui a aussi des choses à faire.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It sounds like such a small thing, but I liked not having to explain myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça a l'air d'un petit truc, mais j'ai aimé ne pas avoir à me justifier.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you think you'll get along in person?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu penses que vous allez bien vous entendre en personne ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did you make?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Qu'est-ce que tu as préparé ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hope so, but that's why I want to meet instead of making up his entire personality from messages
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'espère, mais c'est pour ça que je veux le rencontrer au lieu de me faire une idée de sa personnalité juste par messages.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't know whether he's quiet at first or talks with his hands or laughs at his own jokes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne sais pas s'il est silencieux au début, s'il parle avec ses mains ou s'il rit de ses propres blagues.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You already have someone who does the last one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as déjà quelqu'un qui fait ça.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, and he keeps insisting they're excellent jokes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui, et il insiste pour dire que ce sont d'excellentes blagues.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: They are
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Elles le sont.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: See? Completely unreasonable 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu vois ? Complètement déraisonnable 😌.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that there are things I don't know yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'aime qu'il y ait des choses que je ne sais pas encore.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not enough to invite him into my life all at once, just enough to want a coffee
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pas assez pour l'inviter dans ma vie d'un coup, juste assez pour vouloir un café.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An omelet and a salad
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Une omelette et une salade

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, your turn
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord, à toi !

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My turn for what?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: À moi pour quoi ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What was the first thing you thought when I said I was actually meeting him tomorrow?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quelle a été ta toute première pensée quand je t'ai dit que j'allais vraiment le retrouver demain ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not the very supportive answer, the first one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pas ta réponse très encourageante. La toute première

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honestly? I smiled before I'd even finished reading
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Honnêtement ? J'ai souri avant même d'avoir fini de lire

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want this, but it suddenly feels much more real
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'en ai envie, mais d'un coup, ça paraît beaucoup plus réel

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That quickly?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Si vite ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, especially because you sounded happy when you told me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ouais, surtout parce que tu avais l'air heureuse quand tu me l'as dit

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I tried to think of something less obvious to say than how much I was smiling
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ensuite, j'ai essayé de trouver quelque chose de moins révélateur à dire que de t'avouer à quel point je souriais

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could have just said that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu aurais pu simplement me le dire

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What happened to all the pasta?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Qu'est-ce qui est arrivé à toutes les pâtes ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't want to turn your entire afternoon into my reaction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne voulais pas ramener tout ton après-midi à ma réaction

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still want to hear your reaction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai quand même envie de savoir comment tu réagis

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want your part in this to be only asking whether I'm okay
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne veux pas que ton rôle dans tout ça se limite à me demander si je vais bien

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then yes, I'm excited, and I'm glad you wanted to ask him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alors oui, je suis excité, et je suis content que tu aies eu envie de lui demander

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'en avais envie

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I like knowing you're sitting there smiling at your phone too ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et j'aime savoir que tu es là, à sourire à ton téléphone aussi ❤️.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Real in a bad way?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vraiment, mais dans le mauvais sens ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not bad, just different from talking about some imaginary afternoon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pas mal, juste différent de parler d'un après-midi imaginaire.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm taking a break before the pasta and I start resenting each other
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je fais une pause avant que les pâtes et moi commencions à nous détester

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now there's an actual time, and tomorrow you'll get ready and go
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Maintenant, il y a un vrai moment, et demain tu te prépareras et tu y iras.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had that same little moment when I put it in my calendar
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai eu ce même petit moment quand je l'ai mis dans mon calendrier.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still want you to go, I just didn't expect to notice the difference so much
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je veux toujours que tu y ailles, je ne m'attendais juste pas à remarquer autant la différence.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for telling me instead of trying to sound completely relaxed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Merci de me le dire au lieu d'essayer de paraître complètement détendu.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not asking you to talk me out of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne te demande pas de me dissuader.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je sais

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I'm not going to spend tomorrow trying to give you a perfect story about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et je ne vais pas passer demain à essayer de te raconter une histoire parfaite à ce sujet.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because I'd rather hear about your actual afternoon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien, parce que je préfère entendre parler de ton vrai après-midi.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then that's what you'll get ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alors c'est ce que tu auras ❤️.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, here's proof I can make a different meal
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Attends, voici la preuve que je peux préparer un autre plat

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Getting back into sports actually felt really good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Reprendre le sport m'a vraiment fait du bien

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Isn't it more the flirting with {{name:aiden}} that felt good?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: C'est pas plutôt le flirt avec {{name:aiden}} qui t'a fait du bien ?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I have no idea what you're talking about 😇
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Je n'ai aucune idée de quoi tu parles 😇

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I'm just happy both of you are having fun
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Je suis juste contente que vous vous amusiez tous les deux

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And get ready to see even more 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Et prépare-toi à en voir encore plus 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I had a really good session
I feel like I'm actually going to succeed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: J'ai l'impression que je vais vraiment réussir

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Succeed at getting Ethan into your bed, yeah
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Réussir à mettre Ethan dans ton lit, ouais
Bien sûr que tu parles de ça

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And yet you keep texting me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Et pourtant, tu continues à m'envoyer des messages

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I need to rest after today
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: J'ai besoin de me reposer après aujourd'hui

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Because if you do, you’re being suspiciously quiet
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Parce que si tu en as, tu es étrangement silencieux.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Then why haven’t you complimented me yet
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Alors pourquoi tu ne m'as pas encore complimentée ?
Je commence à me sentir ignorée.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’m just extremely good at noticing when people are late with their compliments
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Je suis juste extrêmement douée pour remarquer quand les gens sont en retard avec leurs compliments.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Anyway I’m bored out of my mind

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Il n'y a rien à faire.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Why aren’t you getting ready for university?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Pourquoi tu ne te prépares pas pour l'université ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Because the year is basically over
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Parce que l'année est presque finie.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I don’t technically need to show up anymore
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Je n'ai techniquement plus besoin d'y aller.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: So I’m taking my well-deserved freedom very seriously
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Donc je prends ma liberté bien méritée très au sérieux.
Tu es juste en train de sécher.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: It’s not skipping if there’s nothing left to learn
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ce n'est pas du skipping s'il n'y a plus rien à apprendre
Je suis une femme libre maintenant

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: And a free woman is currently very bored
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Et une femme libre s'ennuie beaucoup en ce moment
Viens me tenir compagnie plus tard

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’ve been in bed too long
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Je suis restée au lit trop longtemps.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Or I’ll start posting worse stories just to force you to react
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Sinon je vais commencer à poster des histoires encore plus nulles juste pour te forcer à réagir

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: New day, same face, still cute 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Nouveau jour, même visage, toujours mignonne 😌.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I almost opened the racing game instead of my lecture notes 😭
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: J'ai failli ouvrir le jeu de course au lieu de mes notes de cours 😭

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What's up?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Quoi de neuf ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I have a presentation to prepare for university
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: J'ai une présentation à préparer pour l'université

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The slides are mostly done, but I keep losing my place when I practise out loud
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Les diapositives sont presque prêtes, mais je perds toujours ma place quand je pratique à voix haute

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Come over after your day. You can practise with me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Viens après ta journée. Tu peux pratiquer avec moi

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'd sit through it?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu serais capable de rester ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Of course. What is it about?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Bien sûr. C'est de quoi ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Customer loyalty. Why people keep going back to the same business
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: La fidélité des clients. Pourquoi les gens retournent toujours au même endroit

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I can ask questions. Especially when you lose me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je peux poser des questions. Surtout quand tu me perds

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Please do. I'd rather find the confusing parts with you than in front of everyone
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Fais-le, s'il te plaît. Je préfère trouver les parties confuses avec toi qu'en face de tout le monde

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then bring your notes
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Alors apporte tes notes

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Already planning your comeback?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu prépares déjà ton retour ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: D'accord ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: University, work, then you. That's my Monday sorted
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Université, travail, puis toi. Voilà mon lundi organisé

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Ready for the first part
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Prête pour la première partie

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Looking very prepared
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu as l'air très préparée

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The bag has the notes. I just have to remember to use them
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Le sac a les notes. Je dois juste me rappeler de les utiliser

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'll be fine
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu vas bien t'en sortir

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You have to listen properly tonight, though
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu dois bien écouter ce soir, par contre

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: No distracting me halfway through
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Pas de distractions en plein milieu

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll save it for after
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je le garderai pour après

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Maybe. But I remembered I actually have class this morning
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Peut-être. Mais je me suis rappelée que j'ai cours ce matin

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I walked right into that one 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je suis tombée dans le panneau 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll let you know when I can get away from work
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je te ferai savoir quand je pourrai m'échapper du travail

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Have a good morning, love
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Passe une bonne matinée, mon amour

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You too ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Toi aussi ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The rematch can wait
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Le match revanche peut attendre

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I really liked playing with you yesterday
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: J'ai vraiment aimé jouer avec toi hier

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You didn't make me feel stupid when I kept crashing
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu ne m'as pas fait sentir bête quand je continuais à m'écraser

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You were learning. And you got better
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu apprenais. Et tu t'es améliorée

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I know. I want another try soon ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je sais. Je veux réessayer bientôt ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Any time
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: À tout moment

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Today I need a slightly different kind of help, though
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Aujourd'hui, j'ai besoin d'un type d'aide un peu différent, par contre

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: LATER THAT EVENING — {{name:lena}} has gone home. You have cleared the table before joining {{name:hailey}} on the sofa.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: PLUS TARD CE SOIR — {{name:lena}} est rentrée chez elle. Tu as débarrassé la table avant de rejoindre {{name:hailey}} sur le canapé.
Ne te moque pas de moi

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Just come already before I eat everything
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Viens déjà avant que je ne mange tout

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: A bit later on the couch
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Un peu plus tard sur le canapé

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: What if I need to steal food from your plate?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Et si j'ai besoin de voler de la nourriture dans ton assiette ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You already stole half of it
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Tu as déjà volé la moitié

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The point is you’re being weirdly distant
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Le sujet, c'est que tu es bizarrement distant

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m literally right next to you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Je suis littéralement juste à côté de toi
Je ne prévois pas de le faire

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Because I might fall asleep like this
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Parce que je pourrais m'endormir comme ça
Tu es en gros mon prisonnier maintenant 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I even left space for you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: J'ai même laissé de la place pour toi

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Why are you texting me if you’re already in the living room?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Pourquoi tu me textotes si tu es déjà dans le salon ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Quick update before I start work: I should be out at six
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Petite mise à jour avant que je commence le travail : je devrais sortir à six heures

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I've rewritten the introduction during lunch
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: J'ai réécrit l'introduction pendant le déjeuner

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It sounds less like I'm reading a textbook now
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: On dirait moins que je lis un manuel maintenant

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: We'll try it out when you get here
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: On va essayer quand tu arriveras

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: And I'll finally collect my other bag
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Et je vais enfin récupérer mon autre sac

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: By bringing another one?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: En apportant un autre ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A bag full of notes. They're different categories
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Un sac plein de notes. Ce sont des catégories différentes

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Of course. I should have realised
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Bien sûr. J'aurais dû m'en rendre compte

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Don't worry. I'll leave with both this time 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ne t'inquiète pas. Je partirai avec les deux cette fois 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll put the old one by the door
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Je mettrai l'ancien près de la porte

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Thanks, love. I need to go now
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Merci, mon amour. Je dois y aller maintenant

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Want to come straight here?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Tu veux venir directement ici ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: See you tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: À ce soir ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yes. I'll stop for something to eat on the way
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Oui. Je vais m'arrêter pour manger quelque chose en chemin

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll have the table cleared for your notes
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Je vais dégager la table pour tes notes

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My very exclusive rehearsal venue
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Mon lieu de répétition très exclusif

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: One seat. Very selective audience
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Une place. Public très sélectif

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At least the audience already likes me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Au moins, le public m'aime déjà

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Very much
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Beaucoup

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Be useful as well as affectionate tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Bien. Sois utile tout en étant affectueux ce soir ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I can manage both
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Je peux gérer les deux

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re the one leaning on me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: C'est toi qui es appuyé sur moi

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If you keep looking at me like that I’m going to do something
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Si tu continues à me regarder comme ça, je vais faire quelque chose

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re really not scared of me huh
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Tu n'as vraiment pas peur de moi, hein
Je vais te montrer que je ne fais pas que parler
Merde, tu as de la chance

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK a archivé des preuves du premier baiser consenti entre {{name:hailey}} et {{name:player}}

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I don't need HAK to tell me that kiss meant something to me.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Je n'ai pas besoin de HAK pour savoir que ce baiser comptait pour moi.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK a archivé des preuves du premier baiser consenti entre {{name:hailey}} et {{name:player}}

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK a archivé des preuves du premier baiser consenti entre {{name:hailey}} et {{name:player}}

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Now you’re stuck with the consequences
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Maintenant, tu es coincé avec les conséquences

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re not the one who just made the first move
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: C'est pas toi qui viens de faire le premier pas

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You pull her back for a longer kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Tu la tires vers toi pour un baiser plus long

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK a archivé la preuve d'un baiser prolongé et consensuel

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I want to stay in this moment with her, without rushing whatever comes next.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Je veux profiter de ce moment avec elle, sans précipiter la suite.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK a archivé la preuve d'un baiser prolongé et consensuel

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK a archivé la preuve d'un baiser prolongé et consensuel

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: We’re definitely not going back to normal after this
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: On ne reviendra définitivement pas à la normale après ça

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: What can i do when you do that face
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Que puis-je faire quand tu fais cette tête ?
Je ne me plains pas, ceci dit

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re still bad at smooth answers
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Tu es toujours nulle pour les réponses smooth

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I’m going to bed before I start something we won’t stop
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Je vais me coucher avant de commencer quelque chose qu'on ne pourra pas arrêter

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Try not to miss me too much 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Essaie de ne pas trop me manquer 😌
Je pourrais commencer à en profiter
Je suis très douée pour ça

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK a archivé des preuves de réponse émotionnelle élevée lors du contact rapproché

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK a archivé des preuves de réponse émotionnelle élevée lors du contact rapproché

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK a archivé des preuves de réponse émotionnelle élevée lors du contact rapproché

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: EARLY EVENING — It is half past six. You are at home, waiting to hear from {{name:lena}} after work.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: DÉBUT DE SOIRÉE — Il est dix-huit heures trente. Tu es chez toi et tu attends des nouvelles de {{name:lena}} après son travail.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Without looking down once 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sans regarder en bas une seule fois 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's good. Keep the question at the start
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: C'est bien. Garde la question au début

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Already written in very large letters
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Déjà écrit en très grandes lettres

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Everything packed away. I'm done studying for tonight
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tout est rangé. J'ai fini d'étudier pour ce soir

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You earned the break
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu as bien mérité cette pause

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for tonight. The useful part AND the part on the sofa ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Merci pour ce soir. La partie utile ET celle sur le canapé ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I enjoyed both
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'ai aimé les deux

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So did I. Especially the part after I closed the laptop
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Moi aussi. Surtout la partie après avoir fermé l'ordinateur

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now I'm getting ready for bed before I start rehearsing the whole thing again
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Maintenant je me prépare à aller au lit avant de recommencer à répéter tout ça

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Understood. The floor is yours.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Compris. La scène est à toi.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bonne nuit, mon amour

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bonne nuit ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} opens her slides and starts her presentation. You listen as she explains how quality, convenience and personal service can encourage customers to return. Halfway through, she pauses and looks down at her notes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} ouvre ses diapositives et commence sa présentation. Tu l'écoutes expliquer comment la qualité, la commodité et le service personnalisé peuvent inciter les clients à revenir. À mi-chemin, elle fait une pause et regarde ses notes.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: This is where I always get stuck.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: C'est ici que je bloque toujours.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Can I ask something?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Puis-je demander quelque chose ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. That's what you're here for.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Oui. C'est pour ça que tu es là.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: If two places sell the same thing for the same price, what makes someone choose one over the other?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Si deux endroits vendent la même chose au même prix, qu'est-ce qui pousse quelqu'un à choisir l'un plutôt que l'autre ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The experience. Whether it's easy to shop there, whether the staff help you...
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: L'expérience. Si c'est facile d'y faire ses courses, si le personnel t'aide...

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That makes sense. Why not start that section with the question?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ça a du sens. Pourquoi ne pas commencer cette section par la question ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Instead of that long definition?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Au lieu de cette longue définition ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. Give me an example first, then explain it.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ouais. Donne-moi un exemple d'abord, puis explique-le.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm out. Getting our food, then coming straight over ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je suis sortie. Je prends notre nourriture, puis je viens directement ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. Let me write that down.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Attends. Laisse-moi noter ça.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She adds the question to her notes and tries the section again, using two neighbourhood cafes as an example. This time, she gets through it without stopping.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Elle ajoute la question à ses notes et essaie la section à nouveau, en utilisant deux cafés du quartier comme exemple. Cette fois, elle réussit sans s'arrêter.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I followed all of that.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'ai suivi tout ça.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Was it too simple?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: C'était trop simple ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: No. I understood what you meant. Then the definition made more sense.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Non. J'ai compris ce que tu voulais dire. Ensuite, la définition avait plus de sens.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. That's actually helpful.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: D'accord. C'est vraiment utile.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Actually?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vraiment ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Don't ruin your good work.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ne gâche pas ton bon travail.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} finishes the presentation, checks the time and closes her laptop. You ask one last question about her conclusion, and she answers without looking at her notes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 20 MINUTES PLUS TARD — {{name:lena}} termine sa présentation, vérifie l'heure et ferme son ordinateur. Tu poses une dernière question sur sa conclusion, et elle répond sans regarder ses notes.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That felt much better.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: C'était beaucoup mieux.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How was work?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Comment s'est passé le travail ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You looked up more on the second try, too.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu as regardé plus souvent lors de la deuxième tentative aussi.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You were looking right at me every time I did.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu me regardais à chaque fois que je le faisais.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You asked for an attentive audience.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu as demandé un public attentif.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did. And I liked having one.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je l'ai fait. Et j'aimais en avoir un.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for taking it seriously.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Merci de l'avoir pris au sérieux.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} moves beside your chair and bends down to kiss you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} se déplace à côté de ta chaise et se penche pour t'embrasser.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: After the Rehearsal
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Après la répétition

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You were waiting for me to close that laptop, weren't you?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu attendais que je ferme cet ordinateur, n'est-ce pas ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was following the rules. No kissing until you finished.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je respectais les règles. Pas de bisous tant que tu n'avais pas fini.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very disciplined of you.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Très discipliné de ta part.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Busy enough that I didn't have time to worry about the presentation
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Assez occupée pour ne pas avoir eu le temps de m'inquiéter pour la présentation

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Can I stop pretending I'm just someone in the audience now?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je peux arrêter de faire semblant d'être juste quelqu'un dans le public maintenant ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Please do.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Fais-le, s'il te plaît.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You didn't need a presentation to have a reason to come over.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu n'avais pas besoin d'une présentation pour avoir une raison de venir.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I know. But I did need to practise it.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je sais. Mais j'avais besoin de le pratiquer.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I wanted to spend the evening with you. This worked out nicely.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Et je voulais passer la soirée avec toi. Ça s'est bien passé.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It did.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ça l'a fait.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 25 MINUTES LATER — After eating, you move to the sofa. {{name:lena}} sits close beside you, leaving room for your recovering leg. Your arm settles around her shoulders, and she turns toward you for another kiss.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 25 MINUTES PLUS TARD — Après avoir mangé, tu te déplaces sur le canapé. {{name:lena}} s'assoit tout près de toi, laissant de la place pour ta jambe qui se remet. Ton bras se pose autour de ses épaules, et elle se tourne vers toi pour un autre bisou.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Much better than the table.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bien mieux que la table.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The table wasn't that bad.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: La table n'était pas si mal.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I couldn't sit like this there.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je ne pouvais pas m'asseoir comme ça là-bas.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've got our sandwiches. See you in a little while
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'ai pris nos sandwiches. À tout à l'heure

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come here, then.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Viens ici, alors.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: After the Sandwiches
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Après les sandwiches

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Your hand is wandering.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ta main s'égare.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You can tell me to stop.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu peux me dire d'arrêter.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I didn't say stop. Higher.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je n'ai pas dit d'arrêter. Plus haut.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Hands Where She Put Them
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mains où elle les a mises

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And the other one?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Et l'autre ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You can have that too. Under. I already decided.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu peux avoir ça aussi. En dessous. J'ai déjà décidé.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making it very difficult to keep the evening polite.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu rends ça très difficile de garder la soirée polie.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The presentation is over. I don't need polite.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: La présentation est terminée. Pas besoin d'être poli.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: See you soon
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: À bientôt

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: My turn too.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: À mon tour aussi.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You don't have to.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu n'es pas obligée.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I know. I want to. Open your jeans.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je sais. J'en ai envie. Ouvre ton jean.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Her Hand
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sa main

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tell me if that's too much.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dis-moi si c'est trop.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It isn't.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Pas du tout.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: On the Sofa
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sur le canapé

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: There. That was the point.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Voilà. C'était le but.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look very pleased with yourself.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu as l'air très satisfait de toi.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I am. You can thank me later
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je le suis. Tu pourras me remercier plus tard.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A LITTLE LATER — {{name:lena}} arrives at your place with her notes and a bag of food. You greet her with a kiss, put the sandwiches in the kitchen and sit together at the table.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: UN PEU PLUS TARD — {{name:lena}} arrive chez toi avec ses notes et un sac de nourriture. Tu l'accueilles avec un bisou, mets les sandwiches dans la cuisine et vous vous asseyez ensemble à la table.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 25 MINUTES LATER — After cleaning up, she nestles against you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 25 MINUTES PLUS TARD — Après avoir nettoyé, elle se blottit contre toi.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Comfortable?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: À l'aise ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. Are you?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Oui. Et toi ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Très.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then stop moving away to talk.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Alors arrête de t'éloigner pour parler.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was going to ask about your day.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je voulais te demander comment s'est passée ta journée.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How was university?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Comment était la fac ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. Though I spent lunch rewriting that introduction instead of eating properly.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ça va. Même si j'ai passé mon déjeuner à réécrire cette introduction au lieu de bien manger.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So the sandwich was important.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Donc le sandwich était important.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very important. Thank you for helping with the presentation before I got distracted.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Très important. Merci de m'avoir aidée avec la présentation avant que je ne me distraie.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. I need you to pretend you're not my boyfriend for ten minutes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: D'accord. J'ai besoin que tu fasses semblant de ne pas être mon petit ami pendant dix minutes.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You did most of the work before you came here.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu as fait la plupart du travail avant de venir ici.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You helped me say it out loud. That's the part I needed.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu m'as aidée à le dire à voix haute. C'est ça qui m'a manqué.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — Later, {{name:lena}} checks the time and gathers her notes. She puts her laptop away, picks up both bags and joins you by the door.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 20 MINUTES PLUS TARD — Plus tard, {{name:lena}} vérifie l'heure et rassemble ses notes. Elle range son ordinateur, prend ses deux sacs et te rejoint près de la porte.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Both bags accounted for?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Les deux sacs sont là ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. I'm leaving you with absolutely no administrative reason to invite me back.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Oui. Je te laisse sans aucune raison administrative de m'inviter à revenir.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I think I'll manage without one.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je pense que je vais me débrouiller sans.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was hoping you would.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'espérais que tu le ferais.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} sets the bags down for a moment and steps back toward you. She kisses you goodbye, one hand resting on your shoulder while your arm wraps around her waist.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} pose les sacs un instant et s'approche de toi. Elle t'embrasse au revoir, une main sur ton épaule pendant que ton bras l'entoure à la taille.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One More Before Leaving
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Encore un avant de partir

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Now I'm really going.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: D'accord. Maintenant, je m'en vais vraiment.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's a difficult opening request.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: C'est une demande d'ouverture difficile.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Text me when you get home.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Envoie-moi un message quand tu es chez toi.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I will. Love you.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je le ferai. Je t'aime.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Love you too.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je t'aime aussi.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} picks up both bags and leaves. You tidy the table and settle in for the rest of the evening.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} prend ses deux sacs et s'en va. Tu ranges la table et te prépares pour le reste de la soirée.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} IS HOME
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 20 MINUTES PLUS TARD — {{name:lena}} EST À LA MAISON

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Home ❤️ Both bags made it
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: À la maison ❤️ Les deux sacs sont là

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Excellent. Any forgotten notes?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Excellent. Des notes oubliées ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: No. I checked twice
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Non. J'ai vérifié deux fois.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I tried that difficult section again while I was unpacking
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Et j'ai réessayé cette section difficile pendant que je déballais.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How did it go?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Comment ça s'est passé ?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: An ordinary person in the audience, then. Who isn't allowed to kiss me until I'm finished.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Une personne ordinaire dans le public, alors. Qui n'a pas le droit de m'embrasser jusqu'à ce que j'aie fini.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Je sais que tu le fais

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I have a session later this morning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: J'ai une séance plus tard ce matin

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He moved it earlier than usual
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Il l'a déplacée plus tôt que d'habitude

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Just that it worked better for his schedule
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Juste que ça fonctionnait mieux pour son emploi du temps
Je n'ai pas posé plus de questions
Je n'avais pas vraiment envie de pousser
Je n'ai pas beaucoup dormi. Et toi ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm going to get ready slowly
I made some breakfast for you too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: J'ai préparé un petit déjeuner pour toi aussi
C'est trop gentil de ta part !

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I kept waking up for no reason
Then I just stayed in bed staring at the ceiling like an idiot
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Puis je restais allongée à fixer le plafond comme une idiote

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: It's just one of those mornings where the brain thinks too much
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: C'est juste un de ces matins où le cerveau pense trop

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ Do you need me to pick anything up for tonight?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Salut ❤️ Tu as besoin que je prenne quelque chose pour ce soir ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Kept waking up, but I'll be fine once I'm moving
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je me suis réveillée plusieurs fois, mais ça ira mieux quand je serai en mouvement

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How about you?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et toi ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Pretty well, and I made it down to the mailbox and back this morning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Plutôt bien, et je suis allé à la boîte aux lettres et revenu ce matin

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Bet it felt good not having to ask someone else
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je parie que ça fait du bien de ne pas avoir à demander à quelqu'un d'autre

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It did, even if all I collected was junk mail
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oui, même si tout ce que j'ai récupéré, c'était des courriers indésirables

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A disappointing prize for all that effort 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un prix décevant pour tout cet effort 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll survive
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je vais survivre

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What's on the menu tonight?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Qu'est-ce qu'il y a au menu ce soir ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Chicken and rice, nothing that needs an instruction manual
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Poulet et riz, rien qui nécessite un mode d'emploi

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can manage that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je peux gérer ça

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Just yourself, I've got the rest
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Juste toi, j'ai le reste

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got the lemonade you like too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai aussi la limonade que tu aimes

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You remembered?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu t'en souviens ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You always look for it when you're here
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu la cherches toujours quand tu es ici

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's really sweet ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est vraiment mignon ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm bringing dessert, let me do that part
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'apporte le dessert, laisse-moi faire ça

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not going to argue with dessert
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je ne vais pas discuter avec le dessert

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Excellent, one decision made without a fight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Excellent, une décision prise sans dispute

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still around six?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Toujours vers six heures ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, I finish at five. I'll stop on the way and come straight over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oui, je finis à cinq heures. Je vais m'arrêter en chemin et venir directement

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll be here
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je serai là.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You didn't have to do everything
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu n'avais pas besoin de tout faire

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm glad we're doing this tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je suis contente qu'on fasse ça ce soir

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Me too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Moi aussi

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I should finish getting ready before I manage to be late
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je devrais finir de me préparer avant d'être en retard

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're not ready yet?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu n'es pas encore prête ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Almost, I've been standing here with one earring in while talking to you 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Presque, je suis là avec une boucle d'oreille en parlant avec toi 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A few minutes later, before she leaves...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quelques minutes plus tard, avant qu'elle parte...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There, both earrings and everything 😊
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Voilà, les deux boucles d'oreilles et tout 😊

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu es magnifique

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Merci ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's dinner, not a wedding 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est juste un dîner, pas un mariage 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good day
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bonne journée

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too, and don't eat all the good bits before I get there
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Toi aussi, et ne mange pas tous les bons morceaux avant que j'arrive

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No promises about the crispy edges
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aucune promesse sur les bords croustillants

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Save me some or I'm keeping the dessert 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Garde-moi un peu ou je garde le dessert 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you, see you tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je t'aime, à ce soir

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je t'aime aussi

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know, I just wanted to help
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je sais, je voulais juste aider

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can help me eat it
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu peux m'aider à le manger

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That part I'm very qualified for 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est la partie où je suis très qualifiée 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning, by the way
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bonjour, au fait

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning handsome ❤️ I went straight into planning mode
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bonjour beau gosse ❤️ Je suis directement passée en mode planification

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep okay?
