story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as bien dormi ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 Quick important question before I go back: apple tart or chocolate?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Salut 😊 Petite question importante avant que je retourne : tarte aux pommes ou chocolat ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll let you finish then
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je te laisse finir alors

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you when I leave ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je te texterai quand je partirai ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shortly before five, in the manager's office...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Peu avant cinq, dans le bureau du manager...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Conversation de bureau détectée près de {{name:lena}}

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm supposed to be looking forward to seeing {{name:lena}} tonight. Instead, every update from that office pulls me back to last night.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je devrais avoir hâte de voir {{name:lena}} ce soir. Au lieu de ça, chaque nouvelle de ce bureau me ramène à hier soir.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//TRANSCRIPTION EN DIRECT

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Finished?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fini ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The updated totals are in your inbox, and the signed copies are in this folder
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Les totaux mis à jour sont dans ta boîte de réception, et les copies signées sont dans ce dossier

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Bring them over, I don't bite
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Apporte-les, je ne mords pas

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can leave a folder on a desk without instructions
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je peux laisser un dossier sur un bureau sans instructions

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There she is. You've hardly said a word to me all day
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: La voilà. Tu ne m'as presque pas parlé de la journée

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've been thinking about how last night ended
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai pensé à comment la nuit dernière s'est terminée

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apple tart
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tarte aux pommes

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So have I
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Moi aussi

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not like that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pas comme ça

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're going to tell me you didn't enjoy it?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu vas me dire que tu ne l'as pas aimé ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did. That's not the problem
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Si, je l'ai aimé. Ce n'est pas le problème

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I went home and talked to him like nothing had happened
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je suis rentrée chez moi et je lui ai parlé comme si de rien n'était

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was a kiss, not a marriage proposal
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'était un baiser, pas une demande en mariage

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He wouldn't see it that way
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il ne le verrait pas comme ça

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He wasn't there
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il n'était pas là

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That doesn't make it better
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça ne rend pas les choses meilleures

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You weren't nearly this worried outside the bar
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu n'étais pas aussi inquiet dehors du bar

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, that's what I was hoping you'd say
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien, c'est ce que j'espérais que tu dirais

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I should've been
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'aurais dû l'être

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I kissed you back that even worse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et je t'ai embrassé en retour, c'était encore pire

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then stop trying to talk yourself out of having enjoyed it
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alors arrête d'essayer de te convaincre que tu ne l'as pas aimé

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not. I just feel bad about what i did and that I'm keeping it from him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne le fais pas. Je me sens juste mal pour ce que j'ai fait et que je lui cache

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Who cares what he thinks? You kissed me, and you liked it. That's all that matters
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Qui se soucie de ce qu'il pense ? Tu m'as embrassée, et tu as aimé. C'est tout ce qui compte

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to hurt him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne veux pas lui faire de mal

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You won't. You can still be with him and have a good time with me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu ne le feras pas. Tu peux toujours être avec lui et passer un bon moment avec moi

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't know if I can do that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne sais pas si je peux faire ça

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can. You just have to want to
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu peux. Il te suffit de le vouloir

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come have a drink with me when you're done
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Viens prendre un verre avec moi quand tu as fini

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was this ever really a choice?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'était vraiment un choix ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, I'm seeing him tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non, je le vois ce soir

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dîner ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner and a film. I told him I'd be there around six
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dîner et un film. Je lui ai dit que je serais là vers six heures

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very domestic
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Très domestique

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's something I want to do, you don't have to make it sound boring
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est quelque chose que je veux faire, tu n'as pas à le rendre ennuyeux

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can see me another night
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu peux me voir une autre nuit

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could try not deciding that for me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu pourrais essayer de ne pas décider ça pour moi

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know you'd have a good time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je sais que tu t'amuserais bien

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You never get tired of hearing yourself, do you?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu ne te lasses jamais de t'entendre, hein ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not when I'm right
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pas quand j'ai raison

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were allowed to agree with me 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu pouvais être d'accord avec moi 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm leaving now
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je pars maintenant

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know where to find me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu sais où me trouver

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I work here. It would be difficult not to
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je travaille ici. Ce serait difficile de ne pas le faire

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:lena}} picks up her bag and moves toward the office door
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:lena}} prend son sac et se dirige vers la porte du bureau

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Her manager look at her ass as she leaves
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Son manager regarde son derrière alors qu'elle s'en va

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Capture visuelle archivée

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: She's leaving, and I finally let out the breath I've been holding. Even now, I hate the way he watches her go.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Elle part, et je laisse enfin échapper le souffle que je retenais. Même maintenant, je déteste la façon dont il la regarde s'en aller.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVIS

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Leaving on Time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Partir à l'heure

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At five, outside the office...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: À cinq heures, devant le bureau...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Five o'clock, I'm out ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cinq heures, je suis dehors ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All finished?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tout fini ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enough for today, I've left the rest where it belongs
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Assez pour aujourd'hui, j'ai laissé le reste là où il doit être

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At work?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Au travail ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How's your afternoon going?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Comment se passe ton après-midi ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Where it can bother someone else for an hour 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Là où ça peut déranger quelqu'un d'autre pendant une heure 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Stopping for the tart, then coming over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je m'arrête pour la tarte, puis j'arrive

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Take your time, the food isn't on yet
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Prends ton temps, la nourriture n'est pas encore prête

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After a quick stop at the bakery...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Après un rapide arrêt à la boulangerie...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They had two slices left. I consider that excellent planning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ils avaient deux parts restantes. Je considère ça comme une excellente planification

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You got lucky
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu as eu de la chance

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please don't ruin my very organised girlfriend image 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: S'il te plaît, ne ruine pas mon image de petite amie très organisée 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keep the box upright, that's all I'm asking
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tiens la boîte droite, c'est tout ce que je demande

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's getting a better seat on the bus than I am
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Elle a une meilleure place dans le bus que moi

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Nearly through the last batch of paperwork
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je suis presque à la fin de la dernière série de paperasse

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you around six ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: À tout à l'heure vers six heures ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you soon
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: À bientôt

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Still leaving at five, I'm not letting a folder steal our evening
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je pars toujours à cinq, je ne laisserai pas un dossier voler notre soirée

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I haven't started cooking yet, you've got time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je n'ai pas encore commencé à cuisiner, tu as le temps

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, I just want to get out on time for once
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je sais, je veux juste sortir à l'heure pour une fois

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: What are you planning to do once the exams are finally over?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Tu prévois de faire quoi une fois les exams finis ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I haven't really thought that far ahead yet
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Je n'y ai pas vraiment pensé encore

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But the first thing will probably be sleeping until my body forces me to get up
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Mais la première chose sera probablement de dormir jusqu'à ce que mon corps me force à me lever

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That would be a nice change
I have spent so much time stressed that I almost forgot what free time is supposed to feel like
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: J'ai passé tellement de temps stressée que j'ai presque oublié à quoi ressemble le temps libre

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You'll remember pretty quickly once it's over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Tu te souviendras vite une fois que ce sera fini

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I'm kind of looking forward to being completely useless for a while
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: J'ai un peu hâte d'être complètement inutile pendant un moment

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: {{name:evelyn}} cooked something that actually smells decent
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: {{name:evelyn}} a cuisiné quelque chose qui sent vraiment bon

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Come eat before she starts giving me that look
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Viens manger avant qu'elle ne commence à me lancer ce regard

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Come eat before she starts giving me that look
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Viens manger avant qu'elle ne commence à me lancer ce regard

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: We are sitting down for dinner with {{name:evelyn}}. Are you joining us?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: On est en train de dîner avec {{name:evelyn}}. Tu te joins à nous ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I've already eaten with {{name:lena}}. She's gone home now, so I'll come say hello.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: J'ai déjà mangé avec {{name:lena}}. Elle est rentrée chez elle, donc je vais venir dire bonjour.
Ne mets pas trop de temps

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You're in a great mood tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Tu as l'air de bonne humeur ce soir

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Just wanted to annoy you a little
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Je voulais juste t'embêter un peu

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm downstairs, and your dessert survived the bus
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Salut ❤️ je suis en bas, et ton dessert a survécu au bus

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Her phone goes back into her bag. When you pull the blanket over her feet, she turns toward you instead of the screen. "What?" you ask. "Nothing. Come here." She rests her head against you and holds your hand under the blanket. It takes a nudge from you before she notices the film has already started.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Son téléphone retourne dans son sac. Quand tu tires la couverture sur ses pieds, elle se tourne vers toi au lieu de l'écran. "Quoi ?" tu demandes. "Rien. Viens ici." Elle pose sa tête contre toi et prend ta main sous la couverture. Il faut un petit coup de coude de ta part avant qu'elle ne remarque que le film a déjà commencé.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 80 MINUTES LATER — You spend the film close together, occasionally arguing about whether the lead actor is meant to be funny. When the credits roll, she stays for another few minutes before getting her things. At the door, she gives you a longer hug, promises to text when she is home, and heads for the bus.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 80 MINUTES PLUS TARD — Vous passez le film proches l'un de l'autre, vous disputant parfois sur le fait que l'acteur principal est censé être drôle. Quand le générique défile, elle reste encore quelques minutes avant de prendre ses affaires. À la porte, elle te fait un câlin plus long, promet de t'envoyer un message quand elle sera chez elle, et se dirige vers le bus.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} IS HOME
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20 MINUTES PLUS TARD — {{name:lena}} EST À LA MAISON

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm home ❤️ Thank you for tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis chez moi ❤️ Merci pour ce soir

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you get back okay?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu es bien rentrée ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, got a seat and almost fell asleep before my stop 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ouais, j'ai eu une place et j'ai presque dormi avant mon arrêt 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You left your hair tie on the sofa
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as laissé ta pince à cheveux sur le canapé

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep it, I'll need an excuse to steal that cushion again
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Garde-la, j'aurai besoin d'une excuse pour voler ce coussin encore

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't need an excuse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu n'as pas besoin d'excuse

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What about you?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et toi ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je sais ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You went quiet a couple of times tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu es resté silencieux quelques fois ce soir

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry, I had a lot on my mind
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Désolée, j'avais beaucoup de choses en tête

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did I do something?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai fait quelque chose ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you didn't do anything wrong, your perfect
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non, tu n'as rien fait de mal, tu es parfait

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was really happy to be there with you
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'étais vraiment contente d'être là avec toi

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was happy you came
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'étais content que tu sois venue

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too, I'd missed being next to you instead of watching from my end of a screen
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Moi aussi, ça m'avait manqué d'être à côté de toi au lieu de regarder depuis mon écran

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much easier for you to steal the blanket
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est beaucoup plus facile pour toi de voler la couverture

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That too 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça aussi 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less impressive condition, but still edible
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Moins impressionnant, mais toujours comestible

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I liked your film, even if I still don't think that man was meant to be funny
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et j'ai aimé ton film, même si je ne pense toujours pas que cet homme était censé être drôle

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughed more than I did
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as ri plus que moi

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly at you laughing at him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Surtout de te voir rire de lui

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll take it
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je prends ça

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner was really good too ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Le dîner était vraiment bon aussi ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even without all my chicken on your plate?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Même sans tout mon poulet dans ton assiette ?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't start, I took one piece 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ne commence pas, j'ai pris un morceau 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get some sleep, you looked ready to fall asleep on me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Va te reposer, tu avais l'air prêt à t'endormir sur moi

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I nearly did. It was nice not having to go anywhere for a while
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai failli le faire. C'était agréable de ne pas avoir à aller nulle part pendant un moment

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We'll do it again
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: On le refera

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AVAILABLE 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DISPONIBLE 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça me plairait

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night handsome, love you ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bonne nuit beau gosse, je t'aime ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you too, sleep well
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je t'aime aussi, dors bien

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm opening the door before you make it worse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ouvre la porte avant que tu ne fasses pire

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please do
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fais-le

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around six, you open the door. {{name:lena}} sets the pastry bag down and wraps both arms around you before you've finished saying hello. She kisses your cheek and stays against you for another moment, then steps inside.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vers six heures, tu ouvres la porte. {{name:lena}} pose le sac à pâtisserie et t'enlace avant que tu aies fini de dire bonjour. Elle t'embrasse sur la joue et reste contre toi un moment, puis entre.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — Over dinner, you pour the lemonade you bought for her. She looks at the bottle, then at you. "You even put it in the fridge," she says. "I thought warm lemonade might get a bad review." She smiles, but goes quiet for a moment before reaching across the table for your hand.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20 MINUTES PLUS TARD — Pendant le dîner, tu verses la limonade que tu as achetée pour elle. Elle regarde la bouteille, puis te regarde. "Tu l'as même mise au frigo," dit-elle. "Je pensais que la limonade chaude pourrait avoir de mauvaises critiques." Elle sourit, mais se tait un moment avant de tendre la main à travers la table pour prendre la tienne.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The conversation loosens over dinner. She tells you about her morning and steals a piece of chicken from your plate while you answer. When you notice, she insists that yours had the crispy edge she was promised. When you set out the two slices of tart, she laughs at your attempt to decide which one is bigger.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La conversation se détend pendant le dîner. Elle te parle de sa matinée et vole un morceau de poulet dans ton assiette pendant que tu réponds. Quand tu le remarques, elle insiste sur le fait que le tien avait le bord croustillant qu'elle espérait. Quand tu sors les deux parts de tarte, elle rigole de ta tentative de décider laquelle est la plus grande.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — After helping you clear the plates, she leaves her shoes beside the sofa and claims the good cushion. She takes the tie out of her hair as she settles beside you. Before the film starts, she leans against your shoulder and takes a photo of the two of you. She sends you a copy to keep.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20 MINUTES PLUS TARD — Après t'avoir aidé à débarrasser les assiettes, elle laisse ses chaussures à côté du canapé et s'approprie le bon coussin. Elle enlève la cravate de ses cheveux en s'installant à côté de toi. Avant que le film ne commence, elle se penche contre ton épaule et prend une photo de vous deux. Elle t'envoie une copie à garder.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Quels sont tes plans pour aujourd'hui ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I have to go buy some revision books with {{name:ethan}}
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Je dois aller acheter des livres de révision avec {{name:ethan}}

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That’s just code for going to his place
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: C'est juste un code pour aller chez lui

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: No, I actually need the books
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Non, j'ai vraiment besoin des livres
Bien sûr que tu en as besoin

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Funny how you only start working hard at the end of the year
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: C'est drôle comme tu commences à bosser dur seulement à la fin de l'année

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That’s what happens when you have a professor who knows how to motivate 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: C'est ce qui arrive quand tu as un prof qui sait motiver 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’ll probably just rot in bed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Je vais probablement juste pourrir au lit
Je vais passer en mode super bombasse

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: {{name:aiden}} won’t even want to hang out with you anymore
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: {{name:aiden}} ne voudra même plus traîner avec toi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I invited {{name:aiden}} over to hang out

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tu aurais pu me prévenir plus tôt

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: All sore, messy hair, looking half dead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tout courbaturé, les cheveux en bataille, on dirait que tu es à moitié morte

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 I woke up before my alarm and now half past three feels about a week away
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Salut 😊 Je me suis réveillée avant la sonnerie du réveil, et maintenant j’ai l’impression qu’il reste une semaine avant quinze heures trente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I mostly want you to stop treating your own feelings like the least important part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je veux surtout que tu arrêtes de considérer tes propres sentiments comme ce qui compte le moins.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'essaie

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I like that you want me to do this as me, not as some version of myself I have to invent
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'aime que tu veuilles que je fasse ça en étant moi-même, pas en étant une version de moi que je dois inventer

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's the girl I'm in love with
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est la fille dont je suis amoureux

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was unfairly sweet ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'était injustement mignon ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now I've forgotten what I was looking for before you made me smile at the kitchen table
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Maintenant, j'ai oublié ce que je cherchais avant que tu ne me fasses sourire à la table de la cuisine

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Keys?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Les clés ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, actually
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oui, en fait

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look at me, useful and charming
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Regarde-moi, utile et charmant

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let's not ruin it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ne gâchons pas ça

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I'm getting ready later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je t'écrirai plus tard, pendant que je me préparerai.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good morning. And eat before the meeting swallows your lunch break
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bonne matinée. Et mange avant que la réunion n'avale ta pause déjeuner

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You really are stealing my job today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu es vraiment en train de me piquer mon boulot aujourd'hui

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That looks considerably better than what I made
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça a l'air beaucoup mieux que ce que j'ai fait

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could try putting something on the plate instead of eating over the sink
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu pourrais essayer de mettre quelque chose dans l'assiette au lieu de manger au-dessus de l'évier

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You weren't here. You can't prove anything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu n'étais pas là. Tu ne peux rien prouver

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je te connais

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have the group meeting this morning, then I'll come home and get changed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai la réunion de groupe ce matin, puis je rentrerai et je me changerai

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still wearing the dress from yesterday?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu portes encore la robe d'hier ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. I'm refusing to start that decision again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oui. Je refuse de revenir sur ce choix.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to ask you something before I go, though
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je veux te demander quelque chose avant de partir, quand même

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What is it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est quoi ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can go back to sleep. I'll wake you up in June
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu peux te rendormir. Je te réveillerai en juin

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: About today. About limits, I suppose
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: À propos d'aujourd'hui. À propos des limites, je suppose

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We've talked about what you want to know afterward, but not quite about this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: On a parlé de ce que tu veux savoir après, mais pas vraiment de ça

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When we said coffee, did we mean coffee and nothing else?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quand on a dit café, on voulait dire café et rien d'autre ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No. We picked somewhere for you to meet, not a rule about where the afternoon has to stop
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non. On a choisi un endroit où vous retrouver, on n'a pas fixé de règle sur le moment où l'après-midi doit se terminer.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So if it goes well and I want to stay longer, I'm not supposed to come home just because that's all we mentioned?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Donc si ça se passe bien et que je veux rester plus longtemps, je ne suis pas censé rentrer juste parce que c'est tout ce qu'on a mentionné ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Of course not
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bien sûr que non

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want you to do what you feel like doing, not keep checking whether it was on a list we made this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je veux que tu fasses ce que tu as envie de faire, pas que tu vérifies si c'était sur une liste qu'on a faite ce matin

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And if I want to kiss him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et si je veux l'embrasser ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then kiss him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Alors embrasse-le

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You say that very easily
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu dis ça très facilement

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very helpful
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Très utile

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Because I mean it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Parce que je le pense vraiment

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And if I want to go further than that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et si je veux aller plus loin que ça ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not going to set a limit for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je ne vais pas te mettre de limites.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No limits from me. I want you to decide what you want, not what you think I want you to do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pas de limites de ma part. Je veux que tu décides ce que tu veux, pas ce que tu penses que je veux que tu fasses.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Really?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vraiment ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Really. You don't have to ask me for permission at every step
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vraiment. Tu n'as pas à me demander la permission à chaque étape.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't know what I'll feel like yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je ne sais pas encore de quoi j'aurai envie.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You don't need to know already
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu n'as pas besoin de le savoir maintenant.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Maybe you have one coffee and leave. Maybe you want to spend the rest of the afternoon together
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Peut-être que tu prends un café et tu pars. Peut-être que tu veux passer le reste de l'après-midi ensemble.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't want you stopping yourself just to fit a plan, or pushing yourself to make the story more interesting for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je ne veux pas que tu te freines juste pour suivre un plan, ou que tu te forces à rendre l'histoire plus intéressante pour moi.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was fine last night. Now I'm checking the time while the kettle boils
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'étais bien hier soir. Maintenant, je regarde l'heure pendant que la bouilloire chauffe.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was the bit I was worried about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'était ça qui m'inquiétait.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Coming home and feeling like I'd either done too much or disappointed you by not doing enough
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Rentrer chez moi et avoir l'impression d'avoir trop fait ou de t'avoir déçu en ne faisant pas assez.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There's no amount you have to do to make today a success
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu n'as aucun quota à remplir pour que cette journée soit une réussite.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So I decide what I actually want, and see what he wants too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Donc je décide ce que je veux vraiment, et je vois aussi ce qu'il veut.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Exactement

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I can still change my mind in the middle of it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et je peux toujours changer d'avis en cours de route.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Obviously. This isn't you promising anything to either of us
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Évidemment. Ce n'est pas toi qui promets quoi que ce soit à l'un ou l'autre.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: D'accord

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's a much bigger answer than I was expecting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ta réponse va bien plus loin que ce à quoi je m’attendais.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I already had breakfast, before you ask
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai déjà pris mon petit-déjeuner, avant que tu ne demandes.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Last night you said it suddenly felt much more real. Has that changed?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hier soir, tu as dit que ça semblait soudainement beaucoup plus réel. Est-ce que ça a changé ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not entirely. I still notice it when I think about you actually being there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pas complètement. Je le remarque encore quand je pense à toi vraiment là.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But feeling nervous doesn't mean I want to make your decisions for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mais être nerveux ne veut pas dire que je veux prendre tes décisions à ta place.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't turn being relaxed into another thing you have to perform for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ne te force pas non plus à jouer les détendus pour me faire plaisir.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I won't. I'll tell you if something feels different
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je ne le ferai pas. Je te dirai si quelque chose semble différent.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I want the real answer from you, even when it takes a minute
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bien. Je veux la vraie réponse de ta part, même si ça prend un moment.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You remembered ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu t'en souviens ❤️.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Are you still smiling like you were last night?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu es toujours en train de sourire comme hier soir ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. A little distracted too, but I'm looking forward to hearing how you feel
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oui. Un peu distrait aussi, mais j'ai hâte d'entendre ce que tu ressens.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Just don't decide how my entire afternoon goes before I've even left the house
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ne décide pas de comment va se passer tout mon après-midi avant même que je sorte de la maison.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying to concentrate on the girl who keeps texting me instead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'essaie de me concentrer sur la fille qui continue de m'envoyer des messages à la place.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She sounds lovely
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Elle a l'air adorable

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She is ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Elle l'est ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I could practically hear tomorrow's lecture before I went to bed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Avant de me coucher, j'entendais déjà le sermon que tu me ferais demain.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Even with {{name:aiden}}? Knowing we'll still see him around afterward?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Même avec {{name:aiden}} ? En sachant qu'on va encore le croiser après ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. I haven't forgotten who we're talking about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oui. Je n'ai pas oublié de qui on parle.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I trust you. I'm not asking you to spend the whole date protecting me from finding it strange
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je te fais confiance. Je ne te demande pas de passer tout le rendez-vous à m'éviter de trouver la situation étrange.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He might be the one who needs a minute today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est peut-être lui qui a besoin d'un moment aujourd'hui.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still trying to understand yesterday?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Il essaie encore de digérer hier ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Probably. I'm not sure the words "my boyfriend knows" have completely settled in yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Probablement. Je ne suis pas sûre qu'il ait encore bien assimilé les mots « mon petit ami est au courant ».

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let him order something before you surprise him again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Laisse-le commander quelque chose avant de le surprendre encore.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not giving a second presentation. He can cope 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je ne vais pas faire une deuxième présentation. Il peut s'en sortir 😌.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's called being a good influence
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: On appelle ça être une bonne influence.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm still meeting someone I don't actually know yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et je vais toujours rencontrer quelqu'un que je ne connais pas encore.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly. Being free to choose doesn't mean you suddenly have to trust him with everything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Exactement. Être libre de choisir ne veut pas dire que tu dois soudainement lui faire confiance pour tout.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I still want to see what he's like over a coffee first. That hasn't changed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je veux toujours voir ce qu'il vaut autour d'un café d'abord. Ça n'a pas changé.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then that's where you start
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Alors c'est par là que tu commences.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I liked his messages. I don't want to spend the date wondering whether I'm matching the version I imagined
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai aimé ses messages. Je ne veux pas passer le rendez-vous à me demander si je corresponds à la version que j'ai imaginée.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You might find the real person more interesting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu pourrais trouver la vraie personne plus intéressante.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: As long as he leaves the cooking to the café, we have a chance
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tant qu'il laisse la cuisine au café, on a une chance

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have you eaten, or are you just supervising everyone else?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as mangé, ou tu supervises juste tout le monde ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And when you said I could keep some things to myself, we'd only talked about a first date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et quand tu as dit que je pouvais garder certaines choses pour moi, on ne parlait que d'un premier rendez-vous

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I wanted to say this part out loud before treating that answer like it meant anything more
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je voulais dire ça à voix haute avant de considérer cette réponse comme quelque chose de plus

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm glad you did. Now you know I want you to choose for yourself, rather than stop at the coffee because of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je suis contente que tu l'aies fait. Maintenant tu sais que je veux que tu choisisses pour toi, plutôt que de t'arrêter au café à cause de moi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay. Some things can stay mine without us misunderstanding each other
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: D'accord. Certaines choses peuvent rester pour moi sans qu'on se comprenne de travers.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. And anything that worries either of us is still something we talk about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oui. Et si quelque chose inquiète l'un de nous, on en parle toujours.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought you were going to give me a very careful answer about what was allowed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je pensais que tu allais me répondre avec beaucoup de précautions sur ce qui était permis.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have food right here, thank you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai de la nourriture juste ici, merci

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Buying the books took longer than expected
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Acheter les livres a pris plus de temps que prévu
Je suis sûre que ça a pris du temps

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER – LIVING ROOM
{{name:hailey}} gives {{name:aiden}} a kiss on the cheek
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} fait un bisou sur la joue de {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That greeting feels less casual every time, and I'm noticing my own reaction now.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Leurs retrouvailles semblent moins anodines à chaque fois, et je remarque maintenant ma propre réaction.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived evidence of {{name:hailey}} initiating a cheek kiss upon {{name:aiden}}’s arrival
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK a archivé la preuve que {{name:hailey}} a initié un bisou sur la joue à l'arrivée de {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Since when do you kiss him?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Depuis qu'il a commencé à m'entraîner 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He deserves a little reward for taking such good care of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Il mérite une petite récompense pour prendre si bien soin de moi
Vous êtes tous les deux impossibles

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} deliberately walks slowly in front of the couch
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} marche délibérément lentement devant le canapé

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Subject deliberately walked in front of both males while wearing revealing clothes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sujette a délibérément marché devant les deux gars en portant des vêtements révélateurs
Ne tombe pas dans le panneau

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I don’t really know how to play though… 😇
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je ne sais pas vraiment comment jouer… 😇
Sujette s'est assise sur les genoux de Aiden

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I can see the closeness increasing, but I still need to work out how comfortable I am with it.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je vois leur proximité grandir, mais j'ai encore besoin de comprendre jusqu'où je me sens à l'aise avec ça.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recorded {{name:hailey}} sitting on {{name:aiden}}’s lap under the pretext of learning how to play
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK a enregistré {{name:hailey}} assise sur les genoux de {{name:aiden}} sous prétexte d'apprendre à jouer

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: What? I need a good view of the screen 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Quoi ? J'ai besoin d'une bonne vue de l'écran 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Don’t you dare come down dressed like that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ne viens pas en bas habillée comme ça
Mais je ne me plains pas 😂

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Of course you’re not, you’re as bad as her
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Bien sûr que non, tu es aussi mauvaise qu'elle

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have a training session later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: J'ai une séance d'entraînement plus tard

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It was fun hanging out with you guys
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: C'était sympa de traîner avec vous

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Can you two do that in private?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vous pouvez faire ça en privé ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If it’s a dare then I’m doing it even harder 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Si c'est un défi, alors je vais le faire encore plus 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I warned you you’d pay for this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je t'avais prévenu que tu allais payer pour ce matin

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 I'm home and getting ready, and the dress has survived being reconsidered three times
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Salut 😊 Je suis rentrée et je me prépare, et la robe a survécu à trois reconsiderations

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently. I feel like I've missed an entire chapter
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Apparemment. J'ai l'impression d'avoir raté tout un chapitre

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It took me a while too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il m'a fallu un moment à moi aussi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you talk again before coming here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vous en avez reparlé avant que tu viennes ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This morning, yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ce matin, oui

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And? Am I allowed to ask how that went, or is that private?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et ? Je peux demander comment ça s'est passé, ou c'est privé ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some of it is private. But I asked whether coffee was supposed to be the limit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Une partie de la conversation reste privée. Mais je lui ai demandé si on devait s'en tenir à un café

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You asked him that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu lui as demandé ça ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What did he say?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Qu'est-ce qu'il a dit ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That he doesn't want to set a limit for me. He wants me to decide what I actually feel like doing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Qu'il ne veut pas me mettre de limites. Il veut que je décide vraiment ce que j'ai envie de faire.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look beautiful
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu es magnifique

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously? Just like that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sérieusement ? Comme ça ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked for longer than that. I'm giving you the useful part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: On a parlé plus longtemps que ça. Je te donne la partie utile.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying to imagine having that conversation and keeping a straight face
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'essaie de m'imaginer avoir cette conversation en gardant mon sérieux

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You didn't even manage the first sentence yesterday
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu n'as même pas réussi à dire la première phrase hier.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair point
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu marques un point.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's still strange to me. Not bad, but strange
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est encore étrange pour moi. Pas mauvais, mais étrange.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It can be strange without us spending the whole date explaining it again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça peut être étrange sans qu'on passe tout le rendez-vous à l'expliquer encore.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu as raison.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And it doesn't mean I've arrived with a promise about how today ends
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et ça ne veut pas dire que je suis arrivée en promettant quoi que ce soit pour la fin de la journée

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. It means I should ask you, not try to guess what he agreed to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je sais. Ça veut dire que je devrais te demander, pas essayer de deviner ce qu'il a accepté.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I feel good in it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je me sens bien dedans.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Exactement

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right. First question for you, then
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord. Première question pour toi, alors.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Go on
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Continue

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you actually want the window seat, or did you take the other one because I was already sitting here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu voulais vraiment la place près de la fenêtre, ou tu as pris l'autre parce que j'étais déjà assis ici ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wanted the window seat
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je voulais le siège près de la fenêtre.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then swap with me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alors échange avec moi.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Really?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vraiment ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. You're allowed to choose the chair too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui. Tu as le droit de choisir la chaise aussi.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're going to be very annoying about this now, aren't you?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu vas être très chiant à ce sujet maintenant, n'est-ce pas ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only until you stop pretending you don't have preferences
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Seulement jusqu'à ce que tu arrêtes de faire semblant de ne pas avoir de préférences.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was about to ask whether you thought it was too much, then I realized I actually liked it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'allais te demander si tu pensais que c'était trop, puis j'ai réalisé que j'aimais en fait.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Subjects switch seats
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Les sujets échangent de place.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Observed gaze lingers lower than intended
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Le regard observé s'attarde plus bas que prévu

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I knew there was curiosity here, but noticing their attention still catches me off guard.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je savais qu'il y avait de la curiosité, mais remarquer leur attention me prend encore au dépourvu.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVIS

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Caught Looking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pris à regarder

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: AFTER THEIR COFFEE ARRIVES
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: UNE FOIS LES CAFÉS SERVIS

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is it good?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est bon ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very. You're allowed to enjoy yours even if it's small
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui, c'est très bon. Tu as le droit d'apprécier le tien même s'il est petit

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is good. Irritatingly good
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il est bon. Tellement bon que c'en est agaçant

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's why you keep coming back
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est pour ça que tu reviens toujours

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That and it's quiet if you miss the lunch rush
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et c'est calme quand on évite l'affluence du déjeuner

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't think I've ever been here without watching the time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne pense pas avoir jamais été ici sans surveiller l'heure

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You usually have somewhere else to be
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu dois généralement être ailleurs

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then keep that answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alors garde cette réponse.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Classes, work, something I've forgotten to finish
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Des cours, du travail, quelque chose que j'ai oublié de finir

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Today I nearly brought my notes in my bag out of habit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aujourd'hui, j'ai failli prendre mes notes dans mon sac par habitude

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can leave them there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu peux les laisser là

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did. That's what I'm trying to tell you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je l'ai fait. C'est ce que j'essaie de te dire

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry. I'm enjoying the fact that you chose to be here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Désolé. J'apprécie le fait que tu aies choisi d'être ici

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a very inconveniently nice answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est tellement gentil que ça me déstabilise

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have those occasionally
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'en ai parfois

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I just don't always hear them without three jokes afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je sais. Je n'entends juste pas toujours sans trois blagues après

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying not to hide behind those as much today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'essaie de ne pas me cacher derrière ça aujourd'hui

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't need to stop being funny
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu n'as pas besoin d'arrêter d'être drôle

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je le ferai ❤️.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because being handsome and silent sounds exhausting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien, parce qu'être beau et silencieux, ça doit être épuisant.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There he is
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ah, je te retrouve

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What would you do with a whole afternoon free? Not what you should do. What you'd actually do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Que ferais-tu avec une après-midi entière de libre ? Pas ce que tu devrais faire. Ce que tu ferais vraiment.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd go for a walk without counting how long I was taking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'irais me promener sans surveiller le temps que ça me prend

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe find somewhere to sit, listen to something, not answer the class group for a while
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Peut-être trouver un coin où m'asseoir, écouter quelque chose, et ne pas répondre au groupe de classe pendant un moment.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There's a garden a couple of streets over
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il y a un jardin à quelques rues d'ici.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know the one. I always walk past the entrance
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je connais celui-là. Je passe toujours devant l'entrée.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We could go in this time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: On pourrait y entrer cette fois.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. I'd like that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui. Ça me plairait.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER, OUTSIDE THE CAFÉ
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: PLUS TARD, DEVANT LE CAFÉ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How are you feeling otherwise?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Comment tu te sens sinon ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Left here, isn't it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est à gauche ici, non ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. Unless you plan to keep going around the same block
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui. À moins que tu comptes encore faire le tour du même pâté de maisons

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I could pretend I was giving you a tour
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je pourrais faire semblant de te faire visiter.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of the place where I go to university?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: De l'endroit où je vais à l'université ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It needs work
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mon excuse est à retravailler

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un peu

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're being suspiciously quiet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu es étrangement silencieux.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were worried I'd make a joke
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu avais peur que je fasse une blague.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't ask you to stop speaking entirely
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne t'ai pas demandé de te taire complètement.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm having a nice time. I don't want to ruin every quiet bit by filling it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je passe un bon moment. Je ne veux pas gâcher chaque moment de silence en parlant.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Nervous, but not wishing I'd cancelled
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nerveuse, mais pas au point de souhaiter avoir annulé.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's new
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est nouveau.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un peu

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'aime ça

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A LITTLE LATER, IN THE GARDEN
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: UN PEU PLUS TARD, DANS LE JARDIN

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This is nicer than the path outside
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est plus sympa que le chemin dehors

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can hear yourself think in here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Au moins, ici, on peut réfléchir au calme

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was hoping to do less of that today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'espérais faire moins de ça aujourd'hui

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How's it going?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça va ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Better once we left the café
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'était mieux une fois qu'on a quitté le café

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was I that bad over coffee?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'étais si nul au café ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: More like the ten minutes before you have to do something and your brain runs out of useful things to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C’est plutôt comme les dix minutes avant de faire quelque chose, quand ton cerveau n’a plus rien d’utile à te dire.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No. I stopped imagining what I was supposed to do next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non. J'ai arrêté d'imaginer ce que je devais faire ensuite

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et maintenant ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I'd like you to stop for a second
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Maintenant, j'aimerais que tu t'arrêtes une seconde

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ici ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look like you're about to say something dangerous
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: On dirait que tu es sur le point de dire quelque chose de dangereux

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'allais le faire

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then maybe I got impatient
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alors peut-être que je me suis montré impatient

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Subject initiates a kiss
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Le sujet initie un baiser

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Contact reciprocated
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Contact partagé

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A kiss makes this real in a way talking about it never could, and I need a moment with that.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un baiser rend tout ça réel comme les mots n'auraient jamais pu le faire, et j'ai besoin d'un moment pour l'assimiler.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVIS

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to fill all ten minutes with thinking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu n'as pas besoin de remplir ces dix minutes à réfléchir.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: To Shut Him Up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pour le faire taire

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Salut

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't say you could do that first
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je n'ai pas dit que tu pouvais faire ça en premier

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You stopped walking and looked at me like that. I took a risk
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu t'es arrêtée et tu m'as regardé comme ça. J'ai pris un risque

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That wasn't a risk. That was you skipping ahead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ce n'était pas un risque. C'était toi qui devançais les choses

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So I was right about where this was going
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Donc j'avais raison sur la direction que ça prenait

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're really pleased with yourself right now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu es vraiment fier de toi en ce moment

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un peu

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were about to kiss me anyway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu allais de toute façon m'embrasser

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keep talking and see what happens
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Continue à parler et on verra ce qui se passe

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A radical suggestion
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Une suggestion radicale.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought you weren't starting that decision again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je pensais que tu n'allais pas recommencer avec cette décision.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What, you'll stop me again?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quoi, tu vas encore m'arrêter ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shush
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Chut

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So tell me honestly, who kisses better? Me or him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alors dis-moi honnêtement, qui embrasse mieux ? Moi ou lui ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:aiden}}
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What? It's a valid question
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quoi ? C'est une question valable

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You turn everything into a competition. In games, in class, in life
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu transformes tout en compétition. Dans les jeux, en classe, dans la vie

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now apparently in kissing too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et maintenant apparemment dans les baisers aussi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: If you really want to know, for now you're still very far behind
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Si tu veux vraiment savoir, pour l'instant tu es encore très loin derrière

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wow. That's cold
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Waouh. C'est dur

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You asked
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu as demandé

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, I like it. Now it sounds like a challenge
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non, j'aime ça. Maintenant ça ressemble à un défi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It wasn't supposed to be
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ce n'était pas censé être ça

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too late. I'm already taking it personally
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Trop tard. Je le prends déjà personnellement

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're impossible
