story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: T’es impossible

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And yet you kissed me to shut me up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et pourtant tu m'as embrassé pour me faire taire

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Which should tell you how effective words are with me right now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ce qui devrait te dire à quel point les mots sont efficaces avec moi en ce moment

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Want to sit for a little while?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu veux t'asseoir un moment ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. Over there, in the shade
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui. Là-bas, à l'ombre.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at that. A seating preference without an interrogation
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tiens, tu as choisi ta place sans que je mène un interrogatoire

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're one comment away from sitting by yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Encore une remarque et tu t'assois tout seul

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER THAT AFTERNOON
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: PLUS TARD DANS L'APRÈS-MIDI

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shall I walk you back to the stop?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je te raccompagne à l'arrêt ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça me plairait

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you want to make plans for another day now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu veux qu'on planifie un autre jour maintenant ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not right this second. I want a little time to take today in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pas tout de suite. J'ai besoin d'un peu de temps pour digérer cette journée

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That isn't a polite way of saying no
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ce n'est pas une façon polie de dire non.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't take it as one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne l'ai pas pris comme ça.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good. I'm glad we did this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien. Je suis contente qu'on ait fait ça

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So am I
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Moi aussi.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Text me when you're home?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Envoie-moi un message quand tu es chez toi ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je t'écrirai

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: AFTER THEY SAY GOODBYE
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: APRÈS QU'ILS SE SONT DIT AU REVOIR

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm on my way home ❤️ That was a good afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je rentre chez moi ❤️ C'était un bon après-midi.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad. How are you feeling?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je suis contente. Tu te sens comment ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Happy, and a bit quieter than I expected
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Heureuse, et un peu plus calme que je ne m'y attendais.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought I'd want to type everything at once. Mostly I just want to sit with it for a minute
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je pensais avoir envie de tout raconter d'un coup. En fait, j'ai surtout envie de prendre un moment pour savourer ça

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Take your time. You don't have to turn the walk home into a report
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Prends ton temps. Tu n'as pas à transformer le chemin du retour en rapport.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I still wanted to send you this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je sais. Je voulais quand même t'envoyer ça

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a lovely smile
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est un joli sourire

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I feel like I've had an actual afternoon off
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai l'impression d'avoir vraiment eu un après-midi de libre

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not just a gap between two things I needed to do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pas juste un trou entre deux choses que je devais faire

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you got that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je suis contente que tu aies compris ça

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Can we talk properly when I'm settled at home?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: On pourra discuter tranquillement quand je serai installée chez moi ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien sûr

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And tell me something from your day too. I don't want mine to take up all the space
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et raconte-moi quelque chose de ta journée aussi. Je ne veux pas que la mienne prenne toute la place

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just sent him a quick photo to say I'm on my way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je viens de lui envoyer une photo rapide pour dire que je suis en route.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took this before going in. I like how much light there is in there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai pris cette photo avant d'entrer. J'aime la lumière qu'il y a à l'intérieur

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm at the café by the shopping street. I found a table by the big windows
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je suis au café près de la rue commerçante. J'ai trouvé une table près des grandes fenêtres

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm early, so naturally I'm pretending choosing a drink is a very complicated task
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je suis en avance, alors évidemment, je fais comme si choisir une boisson était très compliqué

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least you'll have decided by the time he arrives
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Au moins, tu auras décidé quand il arrivera

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You would think so
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: On pourrait le penser

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait, he's outside. I recognize him from the photos
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Attends, il est dehors. Je le reconnais d'après les photos

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm putting my phone away now. Talk later ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je range mon téléphone maintenant. On se parle plus tard ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This one, not the mirror one I sent you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Celle-ci, pas celle du miroir que je t'ai envoyée.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: QUELQUES MINUTES PLUS TARD

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We ordered, and I asked if he'd be comfortable taking a photo together
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: On a commandé, et j'ai demandé s'il serait à l'aise de prendre une photo ensemble

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He said yes. I told him I'd like to send it to you as well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il a dit oui. Je lui ai dit que j'aimerais aussi te l'envoyer

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look more relaxed already
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu as l'air déjà plus détendu

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Actually speaking to someone is easier than trying to imagine the first sentence
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Parler à quelqu'un est plus facile que d'essayer d'imaginer la première phrase

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enjoy your coffee. You can tell me how you're doing later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Profite de ton café. Tu pourras me dire comment tu vas plus tard

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will 😊
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord 😊

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER THAT AFTERNOON
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: PLUS TARD DANS L'APRÈS-MIDI

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Beyond the Coffee
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Au-delà du café

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A LITTLE LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: UN PEU PLUS TARD

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An Unplanned Goodbye
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un au revoir imprévu

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: PLUS TARD

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm on my way home 😊 It went well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je rentre chez moi 😊 Ça s'est bien passé

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How are you feeling?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Comment tu te sens ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good. Better than I did when I was studying the drinks menu like there was going to be a test
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien. Mieux que moi quand j'étudiais le menu des boissons comme s'il y avait un examen

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was nice not having to carry the whole conversation myself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'était agréable de ne pas avoir à faire toute la conversation moi-même.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like that smile
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'aime ce sourire.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was he like you expected?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il était comme tu t'y attendais ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A bit quieter at first, actually. Which made me feel less silly for being nervous
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un peu plus calme au début, en fait. Ce qui m'a fait me sentir moins bête d'être nerveuse

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then he said he'd promised himself not to spend the first ten minutes explaining the pizza photograph
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puis il a dit qu'il s'était promis de ne pas passer les dix premières minutes à expliquer la photo de la pizza

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did he manage it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et il a réussi ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For about four minutes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pendant environ quatre minutes

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I asked because I wanted to hear the story, not because he'd run out of things to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai demandé parce que je voulais entendre l'histoire, pas parce qu'il n'avait plus rien à dire

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a better reason
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est une meilleure raison

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We ended up walking around afterward. I even came home with a secondhand book I wasn't planning to buy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: On a fini par se balader après. Je suis même rentrée avec un livre d'occasion que je ne prévoyais pas d'acheter

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A productive afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un après-midi productif

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took two. In the first one I looked like I was trying to remember whether I'd locked the door
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'en ai pris deux. Sur la première, on aurait dit que j'essayais de me souvenir si j'avais verrouillé la porte.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A completely unnecessary purchase, but I like it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un achat complètement inutile, mais je l'aime bien

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you enjoy being there, once the nerves settled?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu as passé un bon moment une fois le stress retombé ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. I stopped trying to decide whether it was going well and just had a nice time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui. J'ai arrêté d'essayer de décider si ça se passait bien et j'ai juste passé un bon moment

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping the small details for myself, but I wanted you to know that part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je garde les petits détails pour moi, mais je voulais que tu saches ça

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you went

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've had a shower and eaten something. Are you free for a proper conversation?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Salut ❤️ J'ai pris une douche et mangé quelque chose. Tu es libre pour une vraie conversation ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That is exactly how you choose films
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est exactement comme ça que tu choisis tes films.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He said something very similar
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il a dit quelque chose de très similaire.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was nice having the conversation wander off like that. I stopped thinking about it being a first date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'était sympa de laisser la conversation dériver comme ça. J'ai arrêté de penser que c'était un premier rendez-vous.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was anything different from how you'd imagined him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il y avait quelque chose de différent de ce que tu t'étais imaginé ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He listened longer before answering than I expected from the messages
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il a écouté plus longtemps avant de répondre que ce à quoi je m'attendais d'après les messages.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At first I thought I'd said something awkward. Then I realized he was actually thinking about what I'd asked
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Au début, je pensais avoir dit quelque chose de maladroit. Puis j'ai réalisé qu'il réfléchissait vraiment à ce que j'avais demandé.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not always the worst thing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ce n'est pas toujours la pire des choses.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I liked it once I stopped trying to fill every pause
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non. J'ai aimé une fois que j'ai arrêté d'essayer de combler chaque silence.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He checked that you knew about us meeting, but he didn't keep bringing you up as if I needed to defend being there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il s'est assuré que tu savais qu'on se voyait, mais il n'a pas passé son temps à parler de toi comme si je devais justifier ma présence.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if he wasn't sure about something, he asked me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et s'il n'était pas sûr de quelque chose, il me le demandait.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've finally sat down properly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je me suis enfin bien installée.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds like a good way to get to know you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça a l'air d'une bonne façon de te connaître.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It felt that way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est ce que j'ai ressenti.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We held hands for part of the walk
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: On s'est tenus la main pendant une partie de la balade.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And outside the bookshop I asked if I could kiss him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et devant la librairie, j'ai demandé si je pouvais l'embrasser.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You wanted to?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu voulais ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We were getting ready to say goodbye, and I realized I was trying to think of another reason to stay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: On se préparait à dire au revoir, et j'ai réalisé que j'essayais de trouver une autre raison de rester.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I said what I actually wanted instead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alors j'ai dit ce que je voulais vraiment à la place.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And he wanted that too?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et lui aussi le voulait ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He did
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il l'a fait

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was a little awkward finding the words. The kiss wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'était un peu gênant de trouver les mots. Le baiser n'était pas

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Afterward I was mostly pleased that I'd asked instead of spending the whole journey home wondering
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Après, j'étais surtout contente d'avoir demandé au lieu de passer tout le trajet du retour à me demander ce qui aurait pu se passer.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you felt comfortable doing that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis content que tu te sois sentie assez à l'aise pour le faire.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So am I. I didn't know this morning whether I'd even want to stay for a second drink
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Moi aussi. Je ne savais pas ce matin si j'aurais même envie de rester pour un deuxième verre

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to pretend I know him properly after one afternoon, but I enjoyed the afternoon we had
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne vais pas prétendre que je le connais bien après un après-midi, mais j'ai aimé l'après-midi qu'on a passé ensemble

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to decide anything bigger tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu n'as pas à prendre de décision plus importante ce soir.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I told him I'd enjoyed meeting him, and we'll talk again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je sais. Je lui ai dit que j'avais aimé le rencontrer, et on parlera à nouveau

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to describe every moment, like we said
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne vais pas décrire chaque moment, comme on a dit

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look comfortable
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as l'air à l'aise.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to. Tell me how you're doing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu n'as pas à le faire. Dis-moi comment tu vas

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Happy. A bit thoughtful, but not upset
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Heureuse. Un peu pensive, mais pas contrariée

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I stayed because I wanted to be there, and left when I felt like going home
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis restée parce que je voulais être là, et je suis partie quand j'ai eu envie de rentrer chez moi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't trying to make the afternoon last a certain amount of time or turn it into something bigger
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je n'essayais pas de faire durer l'après-midi un certain temps ou d'en faire quelque chose de plus grand

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you feel comfortable saying what you wanted?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu t'es sentie à l'aise pour dire ce que tu voulais ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. More comfortable once I stopped rehearsing everything in my head
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui. Plus à l'aise une fois que j'ai arrêté de répéter tout dans ma tête

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Some things I'd rather keep to myself for now, but there's nothing worrying me that I'm avoiding telling you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il y a des choses que je préfère garder pour moi pour l'instant, mais il n'y a rien qui m'inquiète que je t'évite de dire

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what matters to me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est ce qui compte pour moi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like being able to tell you I enjoyed it without having to explain every little reason
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'aime pouvoir te dire que j'ai aimé sans avoir à expliquer chaque petite raison

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can be happy for you without knowing every detail
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je peux être contente pour toi sans connaître chaque détail

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Extremely. Those shoes were a good decision, but I still wanted them off when I got in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Extrêmement. Ces chaussures étaient un bon choix, mais je voulais quand même les enlever en rentrant.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Because I am happy ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. Parce que je suis heureuse ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? What was today actually like on your side?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et toi ? Ça a été comment aujourd'hui de ton côté ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I checked the time more than usual when I knew you'd be meeting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai regardé l'heure plus souvent que d'habitude quand je savais que vous alliez vous retrouver.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I put the phone down and got on with my afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puis j'ai posé le téléphone et j'ai continué ma journée.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were you worrying?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu t'inquiétais ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you didn't choose the ones you can only walk five steps in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis content que tu n'aies pas choisi celles avec lesquelles tu ne peux faire que cinq pas.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly noticing that it was real, like we talked about last night
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Surtout en réalisant que c'était réel, comme on en a parlé hier soir.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I wasn't sitting here wishing I'd told you to cancel
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mais je ne suis pas resté là à regretter de ne pas t'avoir dit d'annuler.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you're saying that instead of pretending you didn't feel anything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis contente que tu le dises au lieu de faire semblant de n'avoir rien ressenti.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And hearing that you had a good time helps. I like that you sound like yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et savoir que tu t'es bien amusé, ça fait plaisir. J'aime que tu aies l'air d'être toi-même.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am still me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis toujours moi.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm looking forward to seeing you tomorrow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je sais. J'ai hâte de te voir demain.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? Was today what you expected?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et toi ? Aujourd'hui, c'était comme tu t'y attendais ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't know exactly what to expect
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne savais pas vraiment à quoi m'attendre.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do occasionally learn from my mistakes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'apprends parfois de mes erreurs.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was glad you'd gone, then I found myself looking forward to your message more than the game I was playing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'étais contente que tu sois parti, puis je me suis surprise à attendre ton message plus que le jeu auquel je jouais.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's quite an achievement
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est un sacré accomplissement.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An enormous one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un énorme.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly I liked how you sounded when you got back. You weren't just telling me things you thought I'd want to hear
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai surtout aimé comment tu parlais quand tu es revenu. Tu ne me disais pas juste ce que tu pensais que je voulais entendre.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I wanted to talk to you because I'd had a good afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non. Je voulais te parler parce que j'avais passé un bon après-midi.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what made me happy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est ça qui m'a rendue heureuse.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're making me want to come over and hug you again ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu me donnes envie de venir te faire un câlin encore ❤️.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Before I tell you anything else, what you said this morning really helped
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Avant de te dire autre chose, ce que tu as dit ce matin m'a vraiment aidée.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you like the photo together from the café?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as aimé la photo qu'on a prise ensemble au café ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did. It was nice that you wanted to include me in that moment
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je l'ai fait. C'était sympa que tu aies voulu m'inclure dans ce moment

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I asked him first, by the way. About taking it and sending it to you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je lui ai demandé d'abord, au fait. Pour le prendre et te l'envoyer

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, you told me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je sais, tu me l'as dit

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then I put the phone away. I didn't want to spend the whole date trying to send the next thing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et puis j'ai rangé le téléphone. Je ne voulais pas passer tout le rendez-vous à essayer d'envoyer la prochaine chose

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You didn't need to. I liked getting something you actually wanted to share
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu n'avais pas besoin. J'aimais recevoir quelque chose que tu voulais vraiment partager

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About choosing for yourself?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: À propos du fait de choisir pour toi-même ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad I could tell you about it in my own words afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis contente d'avoir pu t'en parler avec mes propres mots après

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I wanted. You didn't have to spend the date collecting things for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est ce que je voulais. Tu n'avais pas à passer le rendez-vous à collecter des choses pour moi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you still got a picture of your girlfriend on her way home
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et tu as quand même une photo de ta copine sur le chemin du retour

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I particularly liked that part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai particulièrement aimé cette partie

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your very ordinary privileges remain intact 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tes privilèges très ordinaires restent intacts 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Leaving my phone alone until we said goodbye helped
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Laisser mon téléphone de côté jusqu'à ce qu'on se dise au revoir a aidé

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not because I didn't want to talk to you. I just wasn't trying to be in two conversations at once
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pas parce que je ne voulais pas te parler. Je ne voulais juste pas être dans deux conversations en même temps

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I prefer getting to talk properly now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je préfère qu'on puisse discuter tranquillement maintenant.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. I wanted your attention when I actually had time to enjoy it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Moi aussi. Je voulais ton attention quand j'avais vraiment le temps de l'apprécier

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that keeping some moments to myself doesn't mean I have to be distant with you tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'aime que garder certains moments pour moi ne signifie pas que je dois être distante avec toi ce soir

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't want distance. I wanted you to have room to be yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne voulais pas de distance. Je voulais que tu aies de la place pour être toi-même

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It feels different now I've actually had that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est différent maintenant que j'ai vraiment eu ça

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At first I still caught myself wondering what you'd think of whatever I did next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Au début, je me surprenais encore à me demander ce que tu penserais de ce que je ferais ensuite.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am. Did you get home okay?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui, je suis là. Tu es bien rentré ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you free after lunch tomorrow?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu es libre après le déjeuner demain ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For a woman with a film and an unreasonable amount of pasta? Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pour une femme avec un film et une quantité déraisonnable de pâtes ? Oui

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I want to see you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. Je veux te voir

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll bring the container, and you're not allowed to pretend you don't remember agreeing to my choice of film
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'apporterai la boîte, et tu n'as pas le droit de faire semblant d'avoir oublié que tu m'as laissé choisir le film.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember. I even made room on the sofa
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je me souviens. J'ai même fait de la place sur le canapé.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For me or the pasta?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pour moi ou pour les pâtes ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We can discuss priorities when you arrive
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: On pourra discuter des priorités quand tu arriveras.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wrong answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mauvaise réponse.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For you. The pasta can have a chair
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pour toi. Les pâtes peuvent avoir une chaise.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much better
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien mieux

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I remembered you weren't sitting at home waiting for me to follow instructions
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puis je me suis rappelée que tu n'étais pas assis chez toi à attendre que je suive des instructions.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I missed sitting next to you today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu m'as manqué à côté de toi aujourd'hui.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have as much of that as you like tomorrow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu pourras en avoir autant que tu veux demain.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I intend to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je compte bien en profiter.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you tired now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu es fatiguée maintenant ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little. Not the miserable kind, just ready to stop looking at a screen
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un peu. Pas de la fatigue misérable, juste prête à arrêter de regarder un écran.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me get into bed before I end up sleeping here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Laisse-moi me mettre au lit avant que je ne finisse par dormir ici.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 7 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 7 MINUTES PLUS TARD

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Made it. I even remembered to plug the phone in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'y suis arrivée. J'ai même pensé à brancher le téléphone.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An organized woman
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Une femme organisée.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Briefly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Brièvement.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne l'étais pas.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one is just for you before I put it down
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Celle-ci est juste pour toi avant que je la pose.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wish I was there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'aimerais être là.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tomorrow. And then you can hear my excellent commentary on the film in person
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Demain. Et ensuite, tu pourras entendre mes excellents commentaires sur le film en personne.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that included in the visit?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est inclus dans la visite ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can't switch it off
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu ne peux pas l'éteindre

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't going to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je n'allais pas le faire

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bonne nuit, mon beau ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, pretty girl. I'm glad you had a good day
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bonne nuit, jolie fille. Je suis content que ta journée ait été bonne

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. I'm looking forward to seeing you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Moi aussi. J'ai hâte de te voir

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked being able to want something without immediately turning it into a question for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'aimais pouvoir vouloir quelque chose sans que ça devienne tout de suite une question pour toi.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I wanted you to have
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est ce que je voulais que tu aies.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I wasn't trying to go further just because you'd said I could
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et je n'essayais pas d'aller plus loin juste parce que tu avais dit que je pouvais.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That made a difference too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça a aussi fait une différence.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. No limits from me wasn't supposed to become a target you had to reach
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. Pas de limites de ma part, ce n'était pas censé devenir un objectif à atteindre.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It didn't. For once I wasn't trying to get the right answer 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça ne l'a pas fait. Pour une fois, je n'essayais pas d'avoir la bonne réponse 😌.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I put everything down and spent five minutes looking for the phone I'd just put in my pocket
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui. J'ai tout posé et j'ai passé cinq minutes à chercher le téléphone que je venais de mettre dans ma poche.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the café, we went to the little garden a couple of streets away
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Après le café, on est allées dans le petit jardin à quelques rues.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was he once you were actually on the date?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il était comment une fois que vous étiez vraiment en rendez-vous ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still himself. He complained about the cups before we'd even ordered
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Toujours lui-même. Il s'est plaint des tasses avant même qu'on ait commandé.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But he was more honest than usual when he wasn't sure what to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mais il était plus honnête que d'habitude quand il ne savait pas quoi dire.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He admitted he'd spent so long expecting you to be annoyed with him that he was still trying to get used to this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il a admis qu'il avait passé tellement de temps à s'attendre à ce que tu sois agacé par lui qu'il essayait encore de s'habituer à ça.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can imagine
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je peux imaginer

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't give him our whole conversation. Just told him I wasn't following a list of things you'd allowed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne lui ai pas raconté toute notre conversation. Je lui ai juste dit que je ne suivais pas une liste de choses que tu avais autorisées.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Distracted?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Distraite ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Comment il a pris ça ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He was surprised again. Then he understood that he should ask me what I wanted
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il a encore été surpris. Puis il a compris qu'il devait me demander ce que je voulais.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We stopped talking about the situation after that and actually had a date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: On a arrêté de parler de la situation après ça et on a vraiment eu un rendez-vous.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you got past explaining it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis content que vous ayez pu passer à autre chose après les explications.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too. He remembered a lot of little things about me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Moi aussi. Il se souvenait de plein de petites choses sur moi.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I got to hear him say something nice without immediately making it a joke
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et j'ai pu l'entendre dire quelque chose de gentil sans qu'il en fasse immédiatement une blague.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's worth a second coffee by itself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça, ça vaut un deuxième café à lui tout seul.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't tell him that. He'll start announcing every compliment
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ne lui dis pas ça. Il va commencer à annoncer chaque compliment.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then we stopped in the garden, and {{name:aiden}} kissed me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puis on s'est arrêtés dans le jardin, et {{name:aiden}} m'a embrassée.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kissed you first?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il t'a embrassée en premier ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un peu

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. Before I'd even finished deciding what I was going to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ouais. Avant même que j'aie fini de décider ce que j'allais dire.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I pushed him back a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je l'ai un peu repoussé.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were you okay?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu l'as bien vécu ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, he just caught me off guard
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui, il m'a juste surprise.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted a second. He stopped, then immediately started looking far too pleased with himself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'avais besoin d'une seconde. Il s'est arrêté, puis il a aussitôt pris un air beaucoup trop satisfait de lui.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds like him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça lui ressemble.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently he'd decided I was going to kiss him anyway, so he was only getting ahead of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Apparemment, il avait décidé que j'allais l'embrasser de toute façon, donc il prenait juste de l'avance.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course he found a way to make himself right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Évidemment, il a trouvé un moyen de se donner raison.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly 😭
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Exactement 😭

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kept teasing me about it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il n'arrêtait pas de me taquiner à ce sujet.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the missing sock ever turn up?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La chaussette manquante a-t-elle finalement été retrouvée ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I kissed him myself to shut him up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alors je l'ai embrassé moi-même pour le faire taire.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And because you wanted to?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et parce que tu en avais envie ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Annoyingly, those two things happened at the same time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui. Le problème, c'est que j'avais ces deux envies à la fois.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did the shutting him up part work?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça a marché pour le faire taire ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For the duration of the kiss
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pendant la durée du baiser.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then he asked who kisses better, him or you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puis il a demandé qui embrasse mieux, lui ou toi.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He actually asked you that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il t'a vraiment demandé ça ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Apparently it was a very important question
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui. Apparemment, c'était une question très importante.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I told him he turns everything into a competition. Games, classes, apparently this too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je lui ai dit qu'il transforme tout en compétition. Les jeux, les cours, apparemment ça aussi.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And that stopped him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et ça l'a arrêté ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Inside a sleeve. Nobody understands how it got there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dans une manche. Personne ne comprend comment elle a atterri là.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course not
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien sûr que non

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I told him that for now he was still very far behind
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alors je lui ai dit que pour l'instant, il était encore très loin derrière.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pour l'instant ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, don't you start
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oh, ne commence pas.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've spent the afternoon with one competitive idiot. I don't need another tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai passé l'après-midi avec un idiot compétitif. Je n'ai pas besoin d'un autre ce soir.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm just appreciating my lead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'apprécie juste ma position de leader

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And proving my point 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et tu confirmes ce que je dis 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Comment il a réagi ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He laughed and decided I'd just given him a challenge
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il a ri et a décidé que je venais de lui lancer un défi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said it wasn't meant to be one. Apparently that didn't matter
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai dit que ce n'était pas censé en être un. Apparemment, ça n'a pas d'importance

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your washing machine has a very small sense of humor
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ta machine à laver a un sens de l'humour très limité.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds about right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça lui ressemble bien.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I knew you'd recognize the behavior
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je savais que tu reconnaîtrais ce comportement

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You know you don't have to make it sound worse for my benefit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu sais que tu n'as pas besoin de présenter ça sous un jour moins agréable pour me rassurer.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not. I liked kissing him, even if he was impossible afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ce n'est pas ce que je fais. J'ai aimé l'embrasser, même s'il était impossible après.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you can tell me that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis content que tu puisses me dire ça.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And the second time, I wasn't surprised or trying to work out what I should do. I just wanted to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et la deuxième fois, je n'étais pas surprise ni en train de réfléchir à ce que je devrais faire. Je voulais juste

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was it strange afterward?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'était étrange après ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only for a moment. Then he was talking too much again and I stopped overthinking it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Juste un instant. Puis il a recommencé à trop parler et j'ai arrêté de trop réfléchir

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We sat in the shade for a while. I threatened to make him sit by himself if he kept commenting on everything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: On s'est assis à l'ombre un moment. Je l'ai menacé de le faire s'asseoir tout seul s'il continuait à commenter tout

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Romance is alive and well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Le romantisme a encore de beaux jours devant lui.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you'd appreciate the update
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je me suis dit que ça te ferait plaisir d'avoir des nouvelles.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You love the same woman. You know what you signed up for
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu aimes la même femme. Tu sais à quoi tu t'es engagé

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He asked about making plans again, but I didn't want to organize the next date while I was still on this one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il a demandé à faire des plans à nouveau, mais je ne voulais pas organiser le prochain rendez-vous alors que j'étais encore sur celui-ci

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That makes sense
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça se comprend

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It wasn't a way of putting him off. I just wanted to get home and let today settle a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ce n'était pas pour le repousser. Je voulais juste rentrer et prendre un peu de recul sur cette journée.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I told you we went for a walk after the café
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je t'ai dit qu'on est allés se promener après le café

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There was a bookshop he'd wanted to look in, so we ended up browsing the secondhand shelves
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il y avait une librairie dans laquelle il voulait jeter un œil, donc on a fini par fouiller les étagères de livres d'occasion

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's where the book came from?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est de là que vient le livre ?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I picked it because the description sounded ridiculous and I wanted to know whether the story could possibly be worse
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui. Je l'ai choisi parce que la description avait l'air ridicule et je voulais savoir si l'histoire pouvait vraiment être pire.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do. I'm interested in your very uneventful adventures too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui, ça me plaît. Tes aventures très peu mouvementées m'intéressent aussi.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I’m not that kind of person
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Je ne suis pas ce genre de personne
J'ai bien dormi pour une fois 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You’re allowed to compliment me again by the way
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Tu peux encore me faire des compliments, au fait
Tu as l'air douce ce matin

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I’m not getting up anytime soon
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Et je ne compte pas me lever de sitôt

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Planning to stay there all day?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Tu prévois de rester là toute la journée ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Unless someone comes to bother me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: À moins que quelqu'un ne vienne me déranger
Juste pour être sûr que tu te souviennes

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I was a little worried you’d wake up and pretend it never happened
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: J'avais un peu peur que tu te réveilles et que tu fasses comme si ça n'était jamais arrivé

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm presenting today and suddenly my introduction looks unfamiliar 😭
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je présente aujourd'hui et tout à coup mon introduction me semble inconnue 😭

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'd prefer having just you in the audience again
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je préférerais avoir juste toi dans le public encore une fois

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I might be biased
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je suis peut-être biaisée

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You're very biased. I like it ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu es très biaisé. J'aime ça ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I still listened properly
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: J'ai quand même bien écouté

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You did. That's why I'm messaging you instead of rewriting the whole thing
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Oui, c'est pour ça que je t'écris au lieu de tout réécrire

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Ready. Notes checked, laptop charged, no bags left at your place
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Prête. Notes vérifiées, ordinateur chargé, pas de sacs laissés chez toi

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then you're already ahead of yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Alors tu es déjà en avance par rapport à hier

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Please don't remind me of the bag situation 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: S'il te plaît, ne me rappelle pas de la situation des sacs 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You look good. Now go show them you know your subject
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu es belle. Maintenant, vas leur montrer que tu maîtrises ton sujet

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The same one you got through without your notes last night?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: C'est le même que celui que tu as réussi sans tes notes hier soir ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll tell you how it goes later
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je te dirai comment ça s'est passé plus tard

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll be waiting. Good luck, love ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: J'attendrai. Bonne chance, mon amour ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Thank you. Love you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Merci. Je t'aime

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Yes. My brain has chosen a very inconvenient time to doubt it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Oui. Mon cerveau a choisi un moment très inopportun pour en douter

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You explained it clearly yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu l'as expliqué clairement hier

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And you answered my questions without having to search through the slides
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Et tu as répondu à mes questions sans avoir à chercher dans les diapositives

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I know. It's just different with everyone looking at me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je sais. C'est juste différent avec tout le monde qui me regarde

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Take a second before you start. You don't have to rush into the first sentence
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Prends une seconde avant de commencer. Tu n'as pas besoin de te précipiter dans la première phrase

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I do rush when I'm nervous
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je me précipite quand je suis nerveuse

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then keep the cafe example in mind. You knew exactly how to explain that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Alors garde l'exemple du café en tête. Tu savais exactement comment l'expliquer

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay. Slow down and start with the example
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: D'accord. Ralentis et commence par l'exemple

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Then I’ll come by later tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Alors je passerai plus tard ce soir.
Non. Je viens plus tard ce soir.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Fine. Can I come over later tonight?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: D'accord. Je peux venir plus tard ce soir ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Now you’re asking after already deciding
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Maintenant tu demandes après avoir déjà décidé

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The door will be unlocked when you come over tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: La porte sera déverrouillée quand tu viendras ce soir.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Text me when you’re ready to come over
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Envoie-moi un message quand tu es prêt à venir.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Thinking about coming to your room
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Je pense à venir dans ta chambre

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Just so you know what you’re walking into
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Juste pour que tu saches dans quoi tu mets les pieds

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Your not talking about the room are you?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Tu ne parles pas de la chambre, si ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: What happened to the calm version of you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Qu'est devenu la version calme de toi ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: He just decided to enjoy life too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Elle a juste décidé de profiter de la vie aussi

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It's done. And it went well 😭❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: C'est fait. Et ça s'est bien passé 😭❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Very familiar 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Très familier 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I almost laughed because we'd talked about exactly that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: J'ai presque ri parce qu'on en avait parlé exactement

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I could answer without looking at my notes
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Je pouvais répondre sans regarder mes notes

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That's great. You knew it already, you just needed to practise saying it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: C'est super. Tu le savais déjà, il te suffisait de t'entraîner à le dire

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Apparently so
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Apparemment

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It wasn't flawless, though
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ce n'était pas parfait, cependant

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: What happened?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Que s'est-il passé ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I clicked to the next slide while I was still explaining the first one
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: J'ai cliqué sur la diapositive suivante alors que j'expliquais encore la première

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then clicked back too far
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Puis j'ai cliqué en arrière trop loin

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A surprise tour of the presentation
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Une visite surprise de la présentation

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: There she is. How are you feeling?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: La voilà. Comment tu te sens ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Exactly. Everyone got to admire the title twice 😭
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Exactement. Tout le monde a pu admirer le titre deux fois 😭

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you find the right slide again?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: As-tu retrouvé la bonne diapositive ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yes. I said the laptop was more impatient than I was
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Oui. J'ai dit que l'ordinateur portable était plus impatient que moi

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A few people laughed. Then I carried on
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Quelques personnes ont ri. Puis j'ai continué

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That's a pretty good recovery
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: C'est une belle récupération

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I thought so too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Je le pensais aussi

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I don't have the grade yet, but the professor said the examples were clear
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Je n'ai pas encore la note, mais le professeur a dit que les exemples étaient clairs

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You should be pleased with that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Tu devrais être content de ça

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I am ❤️ And I'm glad you helped me yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Je le suis ❤️ Et je suis contente que tu m'aies aidée hier

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm happy it helped. You did the presentation yourself
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Je suis contente que ça ait aidé. Tu as fait la présentation toi-même

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Relieved. I think I was holding my breath before I started
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Soulagée. Je pense que je retenais ma respiration avant de commencer

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Now I can stop rehearsing sentences every time I have a quiet minute
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Maintenant, je peux arrêter de répéter des phrases chaque fois que j'ai une minute tranquille

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Enjoy the quiet minute, then
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Profite de ta minute tranquille, alors

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: With lunch this time. A proper one
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Avec le déjeuner cette fois. Un vrai

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: An excellent follow-up to your academic success
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Un excellent suivi de ton succès académique

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Talk tonight? I want to hear about your day too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: On parle ce soir ? Je veux aussi entendre parler de ta journée

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Of course. Enjoy your lunch, love
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Bien sûr. Profite de ton déjeuner, mon amour

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Je vais ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did the introduction come back to you?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: L'introduction t'est revenue ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yes. I slowed down like you said
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Oui. J'ai ralenti comme tu as dit

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then once I got into the cafe example, it felt much easier
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Puis, une fois que je suis entrée dans l'exemple du café, c'était beaucoup plus facile

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. What about questions?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Bien. Et les questions ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You'll like this
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Tu vas aimer ça

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: The professor asked what would make someone choose between two places with similar products and prices
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Le professeur a demandé ce qui ferait qu'on choisirait entre deux endroits avec des produits et des prix similaires

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That sounds familiar
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ça me dit quelque chose

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: À quelle distance je devrais m'approcher

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: {{name:hailey}} lowers her phone and looks at you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: {{name:hailey}} baisse son téléphone et te regarde
Je n'étais pas sûr à 100% que tu viendrais.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate proximity in private room
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK a archivé des preuves de proximité intime dans une chambre privée

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re the one pressing against me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: C'est toi qui me presses contre toi

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If you keep looking at me like that I’m going to kiss you again
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Si tu continues à me regarder comme ça, je vais t'embrasser encore

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Why are you still texting me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Pourquoi tu continues à m'envoyer des messages ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate kiss in private setting
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK a archivé des preuves d'un baiser intime dans un cadre privé

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: That one was even better than yesterday
If we keep going I won’t want to stop
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Si on continue, je ne vais pas vouloir m'arrêter

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And if I don’t want to stop either?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Et si je ne veux pas m'arrêter non plus ?
Pas quand tu es si proche

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Go back to your room before I change my mind
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Retourne dans ta chambre avant que je change d'avis

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If I talk out loud right now I’m going to get all weird
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Si je parle à voix haute maintenant, je vais devenir bizarre.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Just… let me text for a bit
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Laisse-moi juste envoyer des messages un moment.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re standing there like you don’t know what to do
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Tu restes là comme si tu ne savais pas quoi faire.
Je suis en train de décider

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm home, and I'm putting those slides away for tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je suis à la maison, et je mets ces diapositives de côté pour ce soir

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Would you come over and stay the night with me?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu viendrais passer la nuit avec moi ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Dinner, time together, and no having to leave at the end
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dîner, du temps ensemble, et pas besoin de partir à la fin

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Oui ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: YesYesYesYesYesYesYes❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: OuiOuiOuiOuiOuiOuiOui❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd really like that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ça me plairait vraiment

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought about asking yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'ai pensé à demander hier

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You should have. I would've been tempted
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu aurais dû. J'aurais été tentée

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tomorrow's better, though. I can bring what I need instead of improvising
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mais demain c'est mieux. Je peux apporter ce qu'il me faut au lieu d'improviser

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: When can you come?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Quand est-ce que tu peux venir ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: My afternoon is free after university
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mon après-midi est libre après l'université

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Well earned. How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bien mérité. Comment s'est passée le reste de ta journée ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I can go home, get my things and come over around five
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je peux rentrer chez moi, prendre mes affaires et venir vers cinq heures

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Five sounds good
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Cinq heures, ça me va.

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And this time, I get to stay when you ask me to come closer 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Et cette fois, je peux rester quand tu me demandes de me rapprocher 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's what I'm looking forward to
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: C'est ce que j'attends avec impatience

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Moi aussi

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. I'm getting my bag now, before I forget something
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Attends. Je prends mon sac maintenant, avant d'oublier quelque chose

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: QUELQUES MINUTES PLUS TARD

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Toothbrush, clean clothes for Thursday, charger
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Brosse à dents, vêtements propres pour jeudi, chargeur

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very organised
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Très organisée

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm trying. Can I borrow a t-shirt to sleep in?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'essaie. Je peux emprunter un t-shirt pour dormir ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. Much easier once I wasn't thinking about presenting anymore
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ça va. Beaucoup plus facile une fois que je ne pensais plus à la présentation

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Of course. You've looked good in mine before
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bien sûr. Tu as déjà bien porté les miens

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then I'll let you choose one for me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Alors je te laisse en choisir un pour moi

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Consider it ready
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Considère ça prêt

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I hope you know I might get attached to it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'espère que tu sais que je pourrais m'y attacher

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll take the risk
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je prends le risque

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: There. Almost packed
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Voilà. Presque prête

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look very pleased about that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu as l'air très contente de ça
