story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I am. This bag is actually supposed to stay at your place tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je le suis. Ce sac est censé rester chez toi demain

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Along with its owner
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Avec son propriétaire

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What did you do?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Qu'est-ce que tu as fait ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Especially its owner ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Surtout son propriétaire ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Actually, before I finish packing...
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: En fait, avant de finir de faire ma valise...

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What are you up to?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Qu'est-ce que tu fais ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Giving you a little preview 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je te fais un petit aperçu 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: QUELQUES MINUTES PLUS TARD

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What do you think?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Qu'est-ce que tu en penses ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look gorgeous
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu es magnifique

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And that smile tells me you knew exactly what you were doing
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Et ce sourire me dit que tu savais exactement ce que tu faisais

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wanted to distract you a little 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je voulais te distraire un peu 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Some errands, a short walk, then a few things around the house
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Quelques courses, une courte promenade, puis quelques trucs à la maison

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It worked. Now I wish you were here
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ça a marché. Maintenant, j'aimerais que tu sois ici

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What would you do if I was?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Que ferais-tu si j'étais ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Pull you close and kiss you before you even unpacked that bag
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Te rapprocher et t'embrasser avant même que tu aies déballé ce sac

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then I'll leave the unpacking until later ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Alors je laisserai le déballage pour plus tard ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. One more before I change
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Attends. Encore un avant que je change

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A MINUTE LATER
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: UNE MINUTE PLUS TARD

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: There. Your last preview for tonight
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Voilà. Ta dernière avant-première pour ce soir

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making tomorrow feel very dangerous
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu fais en sorte que demain semble très dangereux

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm looking forward to seeing your face when I'm actually standing in front of you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'ai hâte de voir ta tête quand je serai vraiment devant toi

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How was the walk?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Comment était la promenade ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come close enough and you won't have to guess how much I like it
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Rapproche-toi assez et tu n'auras pas à deviner à quel point j'aime ça

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I intend to 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'ai l'intention de 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Keep those pictures just for yourself
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Garde ces photos juste pour toi

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Of course. They're staying between us
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bien sûr. Elles restent entre nous

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good. Tomorrow you can put your phone down and pay attention to me in person
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bien. Demain, tu pourras poser ton téléphone et faire attention à moi en personne

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You will have my full attention
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu auras toute mon attention

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's what I wanted to hear ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: C'est ce que je voulais entendre ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Should I worry about you stealing all the duvet?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je devrais m'inquiéter que tu voles toute la couette ?

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only if you plan to sleep very far away from me
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Seulement si tu prévois de dormir très loin de moi

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wasn't planning that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je ne prévoyais pas ça

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. Still taking it slowly, but it felt good to get out
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ça va. Je prends encore mon temps, mais ça faisait du bien de sortir

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then we'll be fine 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Alors ça ira 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Though I can't promise I won't put my cold feet against you
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bien que je ne puisse pas promettre de ne pas mettre mes pieds froids contre toi

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That wasn't in the invitation
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ce n'était pas dans l'invitation

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It comes with the girlfriend. You should have read the details
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ça vient avec la copine. Tu aurais dû lire les détails

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll survive
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je vais survivre

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good. I want you there when I wake up too
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bien. Je veux que tu sois là quand je me réveille aussi

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You will have me there
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu m'auras là

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's the part I keep thinking about
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: C'est la partie à laquelle je pense tout le temps

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Getting comfortable with you and not having to check when I need to go home
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Être à l'aise avec toi et ne pas avoir à vérifier quand je dois rentrer

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I liked having you beside me yesterday
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'ai aimé t'avoir à mes côtés hier

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm glad ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je suis contente ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tomorrow we can stay like that
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Demain, on peut rester comme ça

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making the wait feel longer 🤍
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu fais que l'attente semble plus longue 🤍

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only until tomorrow afternoon
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Seulement jusqu'à demain après-midi

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'll finish packing and try to stop looking at the time
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je vais finir de faire mes bagages et essayer de ne plus regarder l'heure

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tell me if you want me to bring anything for dinner
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dis-moi si tu veux que j'apporte quelque chose pour le dîner

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Just yourself and your bag. I've got the food covered
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Juste toi et ton sac. J'ai la nourriture sous contrôle

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Both will arrive together this time 😌
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Les deux arriveront ensemble cette fois 😌

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love. I'm looking forward to tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bonne nuit, mon amour. J'ai hâte à demain

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. Goodnight ❤️
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Moi aussi. Bonne nuit ❤️

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I wanted to ask you something about tomorrow
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je voulais te demander quelque chose pour demain

story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What's on your mind?
story/DAY19/love/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Qu'est-ce que tu as en tête ?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Morning ❤️ Is my hair tie still safe, or has your sofa claimed it?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bonjour ❤️ Ma pince à cheveux est-elle toujours en sécurité, ou ton canapé l'a-t-il réclamée ?
Le coussin est vraiment charmant

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was talking about you, idiot
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je parlais de toi, idiot
Je prends le compliment

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, I don't have time to explain another one 😌
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bien, je n'ai pas le temps d'expliquer un autre 😌
Matin chargé ?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Class first, then work. I'm just getting ready
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: D'abord les cours, puis le travail. Je suis juste en train de me préparer
Avec tes cheveux lâchés aujourd'hui ?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Unless your guard is also delivering the hair tie
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: À moins que ton garde ne livre aussi l'élastique à cheveux
Il ne travaille que sur place
Service terrible
Elle est à côté de mes clés
Voilà, prête sans 😊
Tu es magnifique

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️ What are you doing today?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Merci beau gosse ❤️ Que fais-tu aujourd'hui ?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Laundry, then I want to finish that game I started
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lessive, puis je veux finir ce jeu que j'ai commencé

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hang the washing up before you start playing
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Accroche le linge avant de commencer à jouer
Je sais

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather hear about your game than a machine full of damp clothes 😭
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je préfère entendre parler de ton jeu plutôt que d'une machine pleine de vêtements mouillés 😭
Je vais d'abord m'en occuper
Je choisis de te croire
Tu les perds aussi 😭
Tu travailles tard ?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I should finish at five again, then straight home
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je devrais finir à cinq heures encore, puis rentrer directement
Bonne journée

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too. I'd rather still be on your sofa, but the bus won't wait for me
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Toi aussi. Je préférerais être encore sur ton canapé, mais le bus ne m'attendra pas
Je garde ta place

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And my hair tie 😌 Love you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et mon élastique à cheveux 😌 Je t'aime
Je t'aime aussi

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll put a guard on it
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je vais mettre un garde dessus

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, it deserves proper treatment
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Merci, elle mérite un traitement approprié
As-tu bien dormi ?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, better than the night before
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ouais, mieux que la nuit précédente

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I could've stayed under that blanket another hour though
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'aurais pu rester sous cette couverture encore une heure
Tu l'as presque fait

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was comfortable, and I liked the company ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'était confortable, et j'ai aimé la compagnie ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Or are you afraid of me?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ou tu as peur de moi ?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You're going to be punished for that.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu vas être puni pour ça.
Le sujet a initié un contact physique

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Seeing how personal this has become makes my stomach drop.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Voir à quel point tout ça est devenu personnel me noue l'estomac.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recorded the subject initiating digital penetration during the private session after questioning the need for continued revision.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK a enregistré le sujet initiant une pénétration numérique pendant la session privée après avoir remis en question la nécessité de continuer la révision.
Tu te plains toujours de la révision ?
La réaction du sujet indique une acceptation

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I need to know how she actually feels, because HAK's interpretation isn't enough.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: J'ai besoin de savoir ce qu'elle ressent vraiment, parce que l'interprétation de HAK ne suffit pas.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Following the stimulation, the professor delivered a firm slap to the subject’s backside. Subject did not pull away.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Après la stimulation, le professeur a donné une claque ferme sur les fesses du sujet. Le sujet ne s'est pas éloigné.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just making sure you’re still paying attention.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je voulais juste m'assurer que tu faisais encore attention.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You’re enjoying this way too much.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu sembles vraiment trop apprécier ça.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m starting to actually like these private lessons.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je commence vraiment à aimer ces leçons privées.
Fais attention. Ça a presque sonné honnête.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Why do I still have to revise if we already have… an arrangement?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Pourquoi je dois encore réviser si on a déjà… un arrangement ?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Was in the middle of something
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: J'étais en plein milieu de quelque chose
Ça a juste pris plus de temps que prévu

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Because I still need to prove you’re working with me.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Parce que je dois encore prouver que tu travailles avec moi.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So it’s just for the paperwork?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Donc c'est juste pour la paperasse ?
Tu es tellement un adulte responsable.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 I've found a bench for lunch instead of eating next to the printer today
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Salut 😊 J'ai trouvé un banc pour le déjeuner au lieu de manger à côté de l'imprimante aujourd'hui

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is, before you ask for proof
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça l'est, avant que tu demandes une preuve

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Excellent, I'm proud of you ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Excellent, je suis fier de toi ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go back. I'll text you when I'm out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je dois retourner. Je te texte quand je sors

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Talk later
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: On se parle plus tard

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Later that afternoon, while they check the next day's schedule in the manager's office...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Plus tard dans l'après-midi, pendant qu'ils vérifient le planning du lendemain dans le bureau du manager...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Conversation de bureau détectée près de {{name:lena}}

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yesterday felt so easy when we were together. Now I'm watching this office again, afraid that one good evening hasn't changed anything.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hier, tout semblait si simple quand nous étions ensemble. Maintenant, je surveille encore ce bureau, de peur qu'une bonne soirée n'ait rien changé.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//TRANSCRIPTION EN DIRECT

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look good with your hair down
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu es belle avec les cheveux lâchés

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is that your contribution to this afternoon's work?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est ta contribution au travail de cet après-midi ?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can admire you and read a schedule
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je peux t'admirer et lire un planning

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then try doing the second one
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alors essaie de faire le deuxième

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A big improvement
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Une grande amélioration

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Much less interesting
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Beaucoup moins intéressant

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It'll take even longer if you keep looking at me instead
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça prendra encore plus de temps si tu continues à me regarder à la place

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were hardly subtle
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: T'étais pas vraiment discrète

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't trying to be
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je n'essayais pas de l'être

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Clearly
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Clairement

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come over tomorrow. I'll make dinner
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Viens demain. Je ferai le dîner

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: To your place?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Chez toi ?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's where my kitchen is
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est là où se trouve ma cuisine

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know why I'm asking
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu sais pourquoi je demande

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And you know I'm not inviting you over to discuss your work
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et tu sais que je ne t'invite pas pour parler de ton travail

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It makes much better background noise too
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça fait aussi un bien meilleur bruit de fond

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about this yesterday
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: On en a parlé hier

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You had plans yesterday. I'm asking about tomorrow
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: T'avais des plans hier. Je demande pour demain

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I meant the rest of that conversation
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je parlais du reste de cette conversation

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I had a really good evening with him
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai passé une super soirée avec lui

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm sure you did
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je suis sûre que c'était le cas

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then stop acting like there's something missing that you're going to fix
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alors arrête de faire comme s'il manquait quelque chose que tu allais réparer

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not offering to fix anything. I want another evening with you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne propose pas de réparer quoi que ce soit. Je veux une autre soirée avec toi

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You make everything sound so simple
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu fais tout sembler si simple

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner is simple. You're thinking about everything after it
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Le dîner est simple. Tu penses à tout ce qui vient après

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm thinking about whether I should be there at all
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je me demande même si je devrais y être

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What have you got?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Qu'est-ce que tu as ?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You enjoyed the other night
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu as aimé l'autre soir

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I felt awful afterwards. You keep leaving that part out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et je me suis senti mal après. Tu oublies toujours cette partie

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked having you to myself for an evening. I'd like to do it again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai aimé t'avoir juste pour moi pendant une soirée. J'aimerais le refaire

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not giving you an answer now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne te donne pas de réponse maintenant

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then think about it. Seven, if you decide you're coming
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alors réfléchis. Sept heures, si tu décides de venir

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Let me finish this first
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Laisse-moi d'abord finir ça

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:lena}} turns back to the open schedule on the desk
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:lena}} se tourne à nouveau vers le planning ouvert sur le bureau

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Her manager watches her ass from the other side, leaning back in his chair
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Son manager la regarde de l'autre côté, avachie dans sa chaise

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Capture visuelle archivée

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's watching her instead of the work in front of him. I hate feeling like I'm the only person who needs this to stop.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il la regarde au lieu de s'occuper du travail devant lui. Je déteste avoir l'impression d'être la seule personne à vouloir que ça s'arrête.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVIS

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An Invitation
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Une Invitation

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shortly before five, with the schedule checked and the last page signed...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Peu avant cinq heures, avec le planning vérifié et la dernière page signée...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's everything. I'll put these with the others
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est tout. Je vais mettre ça avec les autres

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A wrap and an apple. Nothing dramatic
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un wrap et une pomme. Rien de dramatique

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Leave them there, I'll take them out
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Laisse-les là, je vais les sortir

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have said that before I sorted them
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu aurais pu le dire avant que je les trie

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They're sorted now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est trié maintenant

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really do enjoy being in charge
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu aimes vraiment être aux commandes

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at me a second
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Regarde-moi une seconde

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quoi ?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want another kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je veux un autre bisou

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know why I'm hesitating
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu sais pourquoi j'hésite

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I'm asking whether you want one too
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je sais. Je demande si tu en veux un aussi

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay... just a kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord... juste un bisou

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After her answer, the manager gets up and steps closer to {{name:lena}}
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Après sa réponse, le manager se lève et s'approche de {{name:lena}}

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He leans in to kiss her and draws her a little closer by the waist; she returns the kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il se penche pour l'embrasser et la tire un peu plus près par la taille ; elle lui rend son baiser

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Capture visuelle archivée

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Another kiss, and she's returning it. The evening we spent together still matters to me, but right now it feels painfully far away.
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Encore un baiser, et elle le lui rend. Notre soirée ensemble compte toujours pour moi, mais là, elle me semble douloureusement lointaine.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVIS

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Another Kiss
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un autre baiser

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, that's enough
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord, ça suffit

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked that better than the paperwork
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai préféré ça aux paperasses

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I spent yesterday telling myself that wasn't happening again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hier, je me suis dit que ça ne se reproduirait plus

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I preferred today's decision
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai préféré la décision d'aujourd'hui

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course you did. You're not the one going home feeling guilty
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien sûr que tu l'as fait. Ce n'est pas toi qui rentres chez toi en te sentant coupable

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I liked kissing you. I'm not going to pretend I didn't
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'ai aimé t'embrasser. Je ne vais pas faire semblant que ce n'était pas le cas

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm leaving now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je pars maintenant

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you about dinner later
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je te texte pour le dîner plus tard

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Looks peaceful
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça a l'air paisible

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still haven't agreed
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je n'ai toujours pas accepté

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I heard you. Think about it
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je t'ai entendu. Réfléchis-y

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After leaving work, on the way to the bus stop...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Après avoir quitté le travail, en route pour l'arrêt de bus...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm out ❤️ Heading home now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je suis dehors ❤️ Je rentre chez moi maintenant

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything finished?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tout est fini ?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, tomorrow's schedule is finally done
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ouais, le planning de demain est enfin prêt

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something you won't have to worry about tonight then
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est quelque chose dont tu n'auras pas à te soucier ce soir alors

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, one less thing
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ouais, une chose de moins

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you when I'm inside
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je te texte quand je suis à l'intérieur

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, talk in a bit
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord, on se parle tout à l'heure

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is. I'm enjoying not being asked where something is for ten minutes
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui. J'apprécie de ne pas être demandé où est quelque chose pendant dix minutes

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Your washing supervisor is off duty then?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ton superviseur de linge est donc en congé ?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only if it's actually hanging up
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Seulement si ça pend vraiment

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You seem really happy about these private lessons lately
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Tu sembles vraiment heureux à propos de ces leçons privées dernièrement

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I even look forward to seeing him now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: J'ai même hâte de le voir maintenant

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You used to complain about every extra session
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Tu te plaignais de chaque session supplémentaire

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Or maybe I just found a better way to study
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ou peut-être que j'ai juste trouvé une meilleure façon d'étudier

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Now stop interrogating me and go to sleep
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Maintenant arrête de m'interroger et va dormir

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You’re in a good mood and smiling when you come home
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Tu es de bonne humeur et tu souris quand tu rentres à la maison

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Someone sounds jealous of my professor
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: On dirait que quelqu'un est jaloux de mon prof 😏

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: He’s just really good at what he does
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Il est juste vraiment bon dans ce qu'il fait

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm home. Did you manage to finish your game?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Salut ❤️ Je suis chez moi. Tu as réussi à finir ton jeu ?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very glamorous evening planned
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Une soirée très glamour de prévue

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look comfortable
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as l'air à l'aise.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am ❤️ Although your sofa had better company
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis ❤️ Même si ton canapé avait mieux à faire

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I saved that photo you took last night
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai enregistré la photo que tu as prise hier soir

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So did I ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Moi aussi ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was nice having you here
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'était sympa de t'avoir ici

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It really was. I'd missed that
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'était vraiment le cas. Ça m'avait manqué

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Next time I'll find something better to watch
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La prochaine fois, je trouverai quelque chose de mieux à regarder

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't mind the film that much
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Le film ne me dérange pas tant que ça

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughing at the wrong parts was half the entertainment anyway
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ton rire aux mauvais moments était déjà la moitié du spectacle

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not quite, I've been stuck on the same bit for an hour
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pas vraiment, je suis bloqué au même endroit depuis une heure

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently that's my role now
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Apparemment, c'est mon rôle maintenant

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're very good at it 😌
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu es très douée pour ça 😌

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little later, her manager sends a message...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un peu plus tard, son manager envoie un message...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Back in your conversation, a few minutes later...
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: De retour à votre conversation, quelques minutes plus tard...

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh, I might be home a bit later tomorrow
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oh, je pourrais rentrer un peu plus tard demain

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few people from work are having dinner
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quelques personnes du boulot sont en train de dîner

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your manager too?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ton manager aussi ?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ouais

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A group thing this time?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est un truc de groupe cette fois ?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, a few of us
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ouais, quelques-uns d'entre nous

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you tried doing anything differently? 😭
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: As-tu essayé de faire quelque chose différemment ? 😭

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right, just let me know when you're back
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord, fais-moi juste signe quand tu es de retour

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je le ferai ❤️.

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No need to keep checking your phone all evening
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pas besoin de vérifier ton téléphone toute la soirée

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I won't forget to text you
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je n'oublierai pas de t'envoyer un message

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I did have a lovely time yesterday
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et j'ai passé un super moment hier

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You already told me 😊
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu me l'as déjà dit 😊

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, I just wanted to say it again
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je sais, je voulais juste le redire

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Moi aussi ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to put my plate away and get into bed
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je vais ranger mon assiette et me mettre au lit

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A few things
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quelques trucs

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sleep well
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dors bien

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too handsome. Love you ❤️
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Toi aussi, beau gosse. Je t'aime ❤️

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je t'aime aussi

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Including blaming the controller?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Y compris blâmer la manette ?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was the first thing
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'était la première chose

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very thorough 😌
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Très complet 😌

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What are you doing?
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu fais quoi ?

story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Changed already. Making something quick, then I'm not moving much
story/DAY19/ntr/DAY19_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Déjà changé. Je fais quelque chose de rapide, puis je ne bouge pas beaucoup

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Alright, I’m coming to drag you out of bed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Bon, j'arrive pour te tirer du lit

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: {{name:player}} dragged {{name:hailey}} out of bed after multiple ignored messages
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: {{name:player}} a tiré {{name:hailey}} du lit après plusieurs messages ignorés

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And yet you’re the one still in bed
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Et pourtant c'est toi qui es encore au lit

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And put on a bit more clothes
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Et mets un peu plus de vêtements

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Don’t make me come up there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ne me fais pas monter là-haut

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 No alarm today, and I've decided getting dressed can wait until after breakfast ☕
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Salut 😊 Pas de réveil aujourd'hui, et j'ai décidé que m'habiller peut attendre après le petit-déjeuner ☕

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've been guarding it all morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je l'ai gardé toute la matinée.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: BEFORE SHE LEAVES HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: AVANT QU'ELLE QUITTE LA MAISON

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, I have the food, the film, and the lid that actually fits this time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: D'accord, j'ai la nourriture, le film, et le couvercle qui s'adapte vraiment cette fois.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've packed for a small expedition
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as fait tes bagages pour une petite expédition.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Only because you can't be trusted to own enough napkins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Seulement parce que je ne peux pas compter sur toi pour avoir assez de serviettes

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Bring yourself. Everything else is negotiable
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Amène-toi. Le reste est négociable.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was nice enough to make me stop complaining
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'était assez sympa pour me faire arrêter de râler.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll enjoy the silence while it lasts
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je vais profiter du silence tant que ça dure.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not for long. I'm on my way ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pas pour longtemps. Je suis en route ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For the next twenty minutes, absolutely 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pour les vingt prochaines minutes, absolument 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: After that I'm going to the little market by the bakery
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Après ça, je vais au petit marché près de la boulangerie

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For something you need?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pour quelque chose dont tu as besoin ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need to leave the house without taking the same route for once
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai besoin de sortir de la maison sans prendre le même chemin pour une fois

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I need something nice to eat with you later ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et j'ai besoin de quelque chose de bon à manger avec toi plus tard ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought the pasta was something nice
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je pensais que les pâtes étaient quelque chose de bien

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It is. But the pasta doesn't count as dessert, no matter how much you compliment it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est vrai. Mais les pâtes ne comptent pas comme dessert, peu importe combien tu les complimentes

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There goes my afternoon plan
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et voilà mon programme de l'après-midi qui tombe à l'eau

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're getting the film I chose as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et tu vas aussi regarder le film que j'ai choisi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I remember. I haven't arranged a mysterious power cut
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je me souviens. Je n'ai pas prévu de coupure de courant mystérieuse

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds suspiciously like a day off
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça ressemble étrangement à un jour de congé

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'd better not. I finally found one you haven't already told me the ending of
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as intérêt à ne pas l'avoir fait. J'ai enfin trouvé un film dont tu ne m'as pas déjà raconté la fin

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That happened once
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça m'est déjà arrivé une fois

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You said the brother looked suspicious before he'd even spoken
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as dit que le frère avait l'air suspect avant même qu'il ait parlé

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was wearing gloves indoors
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Il portait des gants à l'intérieur

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was washing dishes 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Il faisait la vaisselle 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A convincing disguise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un déguisement convaincant

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can keep your detective work to yourself today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu peux garder ton enquête pour toi aujourd'hui

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It is 😌 No shift, no rushing anywhere this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est vrai 😌 Pas de service, pas de précipitation ce matin

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm looking forward to actually seeing your face instead of wondering what the pause between messages means
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et j'ai hâte de voir enfin ton visage au lieu de me demander ce que signifie la pause entre les messages

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The pause was mostly me trying to find the right words
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Si je mettais du temps à répondre, c'est surtout parce que je cherchais les bons mots

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know. Today you can talk with your mouth full like a normal person
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je sais. Aujourd'hui, tu peux parler la bouche pleine comme une personne normale

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That I can manage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça, je peux le faire

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I want a nice afternoon with you, not another serious meeting
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bien. Je veux passer un bon après-midi avec toi, pas une autre réunion sérieuse

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You sounded so pleased last night that I nearly came over just to see the expression that went with it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu avais l'air si contente hier soir que j'ai failli venir juste pour voir l'expression qui allait avec

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can inspect it this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu peux l'examiner cet après-midi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've opened the window and I'm drinking my coffee while it's still hot ☕
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai ouvert la fenêtre et je bois mon café pendant qu'il est encore chaud ☕

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I intend to. From very close up
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai l'intention de le faire. De très près

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll try not to look too smug
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je vais essayer de ne pas avoir l'air trop satisfait

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That would be a lovely change 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ce serait un joli changement 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Are you staying in after that?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu restes chez toi après ça ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I haven't decided the whole evening yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je n'ai pas encore décidé pour toute la soirée.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's part of what I like about today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est une des choses que j'aime aujourd'hui.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: An unfamiliar experience
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Une expérience inhabituelle

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} sent me a picture of an arcade sign earlier
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} m'a envoyé une photo de l'enseigne d'une salle d'arcade tout à l'heure

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He's discovered somewhere else to complain about losing?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Il a trouvé un autre endroit pour se plaindre de ses défaites ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently he was only making a helpful suggestion for my day off
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Apparemment, il faisait juste une suggestion utile pour mon jour de repos.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's how he gets you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est comme ça qu'il t'attrape.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I told him I already had plans with you this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je lui ai dit que j'avais déjà des plans avec toi cet après-midi.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He said to ask you whether the air hockey table counts as neutral ground
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Il a dit de te demander si la table de air hockey compte comme terrain neutre.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Only until he loses. Then the table is involved in a conspiracy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Seulement jusqu'à ce qu'il perde. Ensuite, la table est impliquée dans une conspiration.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might go later. I'd enjoy watching him try to explain that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je pourrais y aller plus tard. J'aimerais bien le voir essayer d'expliquer ça.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't accept a best of three after you've already won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ne le laisse pas proposer une partie en deux manches gagnantes alors que tu as déjà gagné

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very. I might become difficult to live with if I get used to it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Très. Je pourrais devenir difficile à vivre si je m'y habitue

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm writing that down 😌📝
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je note ça 😌📝.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The guy from yesterday sent me a message about that book we looked at
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Le gars d'hier m'a envoyé un message à propos de ce livre qu'on a regardé.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The one from the shop?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Celui de la boutique ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. Apparently the first page was worth getting home for
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oui. Apparemment, la première page valait le coup de rentrer chez soi.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've only read the back cover, so I told him not to get smug about it yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je n'ai lu que la quatrième de couverture, alors je lui ai dit de ne pas faire le malin trop vite

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A promising start to a book club
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un bon début pour un club de lecture.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's mostly us finding new ways to avoid saying we want to keep talking
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est surtout nous qui trouvons de nouvelles façons d'éviter de dire qu'on veut continuer à parler.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've noticed, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as remarqué, alors.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Might?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Peut-être ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might stop being subtle later
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je pourrais arrêter d'être subtile plus tard

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For now I told him I'm spending the afternoon with you. We'll talk this evening 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pour l'instant, je lui ai dit que je passe l'après-midi avec toi. On se parle ce soir 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I'd hate to share my excellent film commentary with a phone
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bien. Je détesterais partager mes excellents commentaires de film avec un téléphone

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm leaving it in my bag. For the commentary, not for you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je le laisse dans mon sac. Pour les commentaires, pas pour toi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Right, I should put actual clothes on before the bakery sells everything I want 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est vrai, je devrais mettre des vêtements avant que la boulangerie ne vende tout ce que je veux 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You haven't even decided what you want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu n'as même pas décidé ce que tu veux

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's why I need options
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est pour ça que j'ai besoin d'options

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll await the investigation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'attendrai l'enquête

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't eat all your snacks before I get there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ne mange pas tous tes snacks avant que j'arrive

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Careful, I'm still deciding what to bring you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Attention, je suis encore en train de décider quoi t'apporter

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: LATER THAT MORNING
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: PLUS TARD CE MATIN

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Small update: the bakery woman remembered me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Petite mise à jour : la boulangère se souvient de moi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds nice
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça a l'air bien.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She remembered that I always say I'm only buying bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Elle se souvient que je dis toujours que j'achète juste du pain

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Less nice for your defense
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Moins sympa pour ta défense

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She had already reached for a bigger bag
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Elle avait déjà pris un sac plus grand

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's definitely not just bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ce n'est définitivement pas que du pain

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There is bread in there. Somewhere
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Il y a du pain là-dedans. Quelque part

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got two apple pastries for us, and enough other things to make the walk home worth it 🥐
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai pris deux pâtisseries aux pommes pour nous, et assez d'autres choses pour que le chemin du retour en vaille la peine 🥐

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as l'air heureux

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I am. I spent ten minutes looking at flowers without calculating where I needed to be next
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oui, je le fais. J'ai passé dix minutes à regarder des fleurs sans calculer où je devais être ensuite

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Didn't buy any. Just enjoyed being there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je n'en ai pas acheté. J'ai juste aimé être là

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We should have more days like that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: On devrait avoir plus de jours comme ça

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, we should
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oui, on devrait

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm going home to get the container, then I'll come over after lunch like we said
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je rentre chercher le contenant, puis je viendrai après le déjeuner comme on a dit.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Half past one still okay?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Une heure et demie, c'est toujours bon ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Perfect
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Parfait

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll put the drinks in the fridge
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je vais mettre les boissons au frigo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And leave my side of the sofa clear
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et laisse mon côté du canapé libre.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look like you've already made peace with doing nothing
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: On dirait que tu as déjà fait la paix avec le fait de ne rien faire

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Did you see the ass that i have in it 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu as vu le cul que j’ai là-dedans 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: To the gym or to your date with your coach?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Au gym ou à ton rendez-vous avec ton coach ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You better not be looking for another indecent outfit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu ne cherches pas une autre tenue indécente, j'espère ?
C’est une sacrée tenue de sport

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m spending the afternoon with some friends
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je passe l'après-midi avec des amis
Je vais probablement bosser un peu
Il faut bien que quelqu'un le soit

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm barely down the street and I've already thought of another reason your theory about the film makes no sense 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Salut ❤️ Je suis à peine au bout de la rue et j'ai déjà pensé à une autre raison pour laquelle ta théorie sur le film n'a aucun sens 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What next, then?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et après, on fait quoi ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The photo booth is tempting 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Le photomaton est tentant 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: To preserve the evidence of my defeat?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pour garder la preuve de ma défaite ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, because I want to see whether you can go four pictures without pulling a face
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non, parce que je veux voir si tu peux faire quatre photos sans tirer une grimace

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Unlikely. That's a very unfair challenge
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Peu probable. C'est un défi vraiment injuste

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER, IN THE PHOTO BOOTH
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: QUELQUES MINUTES PLUS TARD, DANS LE PHOTOMATON

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You realize I'm going to ruin at least one of these
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu te rends compte que je vais gâcher au moins une de ces photos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At least one? That's optimistic
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Au moins une ? C'est optimiste

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Move closer, then. I need every possible advantage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Rapproche-toi alors. J'ai besoin de chaque avantage possible

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not how photo booths work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ce n'est pas comme ça que fonctionnent les photomatons

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought most of it with you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu avais apporté presque tout ce qu'il fallait

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Too late. The countdown has started
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Trop tard. Le compte à rebours a commencé

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Subjects enter the photo booth
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Les sujets entrent dans le photomaton

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Series of personal photographs captured
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Série de photos personnelles prises

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want her to enjoy the evening, and I can admit that I'm curious about how close they're becoming.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je veux qu'elle profite de sa soirée, et je peux admettre que leur rapprochement éveille ma curiosité.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//AVIS

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Photo Booth Strip I
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bande de photomaton I

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Photo Booth Strip II
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bande de photomaton II

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You pulled a face in the first one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as fait une grimace sur la première

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you smiled in all of them, so I still think I won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et tu as souri sur toutes, donc je pense quand même que j'ai gagné

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That isn't how winning works
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ce n'est pas comme ça que ça marche de gagner

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then explain the last picture
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alors explique la dernière photo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You kissed me before the flash went off 😳
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu m'as embrassée avant que le flash ne se déclenche 😳

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And now it's preserved forever. You're welcome
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et maintenant, c'est préservé pour toujours. De rien

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I meant the part where we stopped talking and just sat together
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je parlais du moment où on a arrêté de parler et où on est juste restés assis ensemble

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're impossible 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu es impossible 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still choosing pinball after this?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu choisis toujours le flipper après ça ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. And I'm still not spending all evening keeping score
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui. Et je ne vais pas passer toute la soirée à compter les points

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's literally a score on that one too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il y a littéralement un score sur celui-là aussi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can keep yours to yourself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu peux garder le tien pour toi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: LATER, OUTSIDE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: PLUS TARD, DEHORS

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd forgotten how loud the street could sound quiet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'avais oublié qu'une rue aussi bruyante pouvait paraître calme

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My ears are still inside playing the racing game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mes oreilles sont encore à l'intérieur à jouer au jeu de course

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your dignity is in there somewhere too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ta dignité est aussi quelque part là-dedans

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je me suis bien amusée

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't realize how much I'd missed having you next to me until I was there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne réalisais pas à quel point ta présence me manquait jusqu'à ce que je sois là.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even though I won?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Même si j'ai gagné ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even though you're never going to let that go
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Même si tu ne vas jamais laisser ça de côté

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je me suis bien amusée aussi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Shall I walk with you for a bit?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je peux marcher avec toi un moment ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I was thinking of making tea when I get back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui. Je pensais faire du thé quand je rentre

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds sensible
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça a l'air sensé

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was almost an invitation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'était presque une invitation

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Almost?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Presque ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Would you like to come over for a cup of tea? We still have the pastry you refused to eat before your big performance
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu veux venir prendre une tasse de thé ? On a encore la pâtisserie que tu as refusé de manger avant ta grande performance.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça me plairait.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked that too. Even when your elbow found my ribs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai aimé ça aussi. Même quand ton coude a trouvé mes côtes.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And no asking where I keep a second controller
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et pas de questions sur où je cache une deuxième manette.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not even going to mention it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je n'en parlerai même pas.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going home and claiming the sofa for myself for a bit 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je rentre chez moi et je m'approprie le canapé un moment 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Already missing the film commentary?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mes commentaires sur le film te manquent déjà ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll survive. I've got a book and somebody who has apparently read further than me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je vais survivre. J'ai un livre et quelqu'un qui a apparemment lu plus loin que moi.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your new contact?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ton nouveau contact ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. We've been exchanging little messages since I left yours
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui. On échange des petits messages depuis que je suis partie de chez toi.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He remembered I was seeing you and waited until I said I was free
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il se souvenait que je te voyais et a attendu que je dise que j'étais libre.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were taking too much of the cushion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu prenais trop de place sur le coussin

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I was going to object to him interrupting the important cushion dispute
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. J'allais m'opposer à ce qu'il interrompe notre importante dispute sur les coussins.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody would have understood it without several photographs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Personne n'aurait compris sans plusieurs photos.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A shame there isn't a documentary
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est dommage qu'il n'y ait pas de documentaire.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't encourage me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ne m'encourage pas.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: BACK AT HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DE RETOUR À LA MAISON

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Found my place in the book. It was still the bookmark they put in at the shop 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai retrouvé ma place dans le livre. C'était toujours le marque-page qu'ils ont mis au magasin 😭.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not much progress
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est pas beaucoup de progrès.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've made more progress with the conversation than the reading
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai fait plus de progrès avec la conversation qu'avec la lecture.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to answer him properly instead of pretending I can do both
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je vais lui répondre correctement au lieu de faire semblant de pouvoir faire les deux.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Talk later, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: On se parle plus tard, alors.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes ❤️ This picture was for you, by the way. He hasn't earned the embarrassing bookmark story 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui ❤️ Cette photo était pour toi, d'ailleurs. Il n'a pas mérité l'histoire embarrassante du marque-page 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: LATER THAT EVENING
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: PLUS TARD CE SOIR

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An Answer in Pictures
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Une réponse en images

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have two pictures you might like. He said it was okay to show you his one as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai deux photos que tu pourrais aimer. Il a dit que je pouvais te montrer la sienne aussi.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been exchanging photos?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vous avez échangé des photos ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. This is the smile he asked for
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui. C'est le sourire qu'il a demandé.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Be nice. I left you actual leftovers this time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sois sympa. Je t'ai laissé de vraies restes cette fois.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And this is the photo he took in his kitchen. I'm forwarding it, not claiming the camera work 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et voici la photo qu'il a prise dans sa cuisine. Je te la transfère, je ne prétends pas l'avoir prise 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was the apron meant to establish his qualifications?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: L'apron était-il censé établir ses qualifications ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently the dinner couldn't smile for the camera
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Apparemment, le dîner ne pouvait pas sourire pour la caméra.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's an answer you would like
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est une réponse que tu aimerais.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was. I laughed before I could pretend not to
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui. J'ai ri avant de pouvoir faire semblant de ne pas trouver ça drôle
