story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your photo is lovely, by the way
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ta photo est magnifique, au fait.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I knew you'd notice that one first ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je savais que tu remarquerais celle-là en premier ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And your spoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et ta cuillère.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep it safe. I'll expect a dramatic reunion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Prends-en soin. J'exigerai des retrouvailles théâtrales

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You had two hours to tell me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu avais deux heures pour me le dire.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to meet {{name:aiden}} after I've dropped the container at home 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je vais retrouver {{name:aiden}} après avoir déposé le contenant chez moi 😊.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The arcade?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La salle d'arcade ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. He said it would be a shame to let your expert advice go to waste
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui. Il a dit que ce serait dommage de laisser tes conseils d'expert se perdre.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He doesn't know half of it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et encore, il ne sait pas tout

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's already warned me that one of the machines eats coins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il m'a déjà prévenu qu'une des machines mange des pièces.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Useful. An excuse prepared before you arrive
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Utile. Une excuse préparée avant ton arrivée.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm allowing him exactly one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je lui accorde exactement un.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was busy trying to watch it while you accused everybody of something
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'étais occupée à essayer de le regarder pendant que tu accusais tout le monde de quelque chose.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Generous
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Généreux

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to see him again, and doing something sounded nicer than another careful conversation over coffee
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je voulais le revoir, et faire quelque chose semblait plus sympa qu'une autre conversation prudente autour d'un café.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go enjoy yourself. You don't need another briefing from me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vas t'amuser. Tu n'as pas besoin d'un autre briefing de ma part.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I've had enough instructions from the detective on the sofa 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. J'en ai assez des instructions du détective sur le canapé 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: EARLY EVENING, OUTSIDE THE ARCADE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DÉBUT DE SOIRÉE, DEVANT LA SALLE D'ARCADE

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Made it 🎮 You can hear this place from the pavement
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'y suis arrivée 🎮 On entend cet endroit depuis le trottoir.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't let him choose every game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ne le laisse pas choisir tous les jeux.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's just arrived and pointed at a racing machine
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il vient d'arriver et a pointé une machine de course.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course he has
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien sûr qu'il l'a fait.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was right about one person
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'avais raison sur une personne.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm putting my phone away. Wish me luck 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je range mon téléphone. Souhaite-moi bonne chance 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You won't need it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu n'en auras pas besoin.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: INSIDE THE ARCADE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: À L'INTÉRIEUR DE LA SALLE D'ARCADE

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You came prepared
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu es venu préparé.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For what?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pour quoi ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sensible shoes. That's somebody expecting to win
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Des chaussures pratiques. Ça, c'est quelqu'un qui compte gagner

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's somebody who walked around a market this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est quelqu'un qui a traîné dans un marché ce matin.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought you something, actually
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je t'ai apporté quelque chose, en fait.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A consolation prize already?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un prix de consolation déjà ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A pastry. I can still eat it myself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Une pâtisserie. Je peux toujours la manger moi-même.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After accusing all seven of them
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Après avoir accusé les sept.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I'll accept the apology in advance
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non, j'accepte les excuses d'avance.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're making it very difficult to be thoughtful
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Avec toi, c'est vraiment difficile d'avoir une attention

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you. That was nice of you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Merci. C'était gentil de ta part.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. See how little effort that took?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voilà. Tu vois le peu d'effort que ça t'a demandé ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you going to supervise every sentence tonight?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu vas superviser chaque phrase ce soir ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only the annoying ones
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Seulement celles qui sont agaçantes.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's most of my material
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça représente presque tout mon répertoire

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'll have to improvise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu vas devoir improviser.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER THEIR FIRST GAME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: APRÈS LEUR PREMIÈRE PARTIE

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That first point didn't count
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ce premier point ne comptait pas.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thorough detective work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un vrai travail de détective.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The machine disagrees
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La machine n'est pas d'accord.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You hit it before I was ready
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu l'as frappé avant que je sois prêt.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were explaining how easy this was going to be
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu expliquais à quel point ça allait être facile.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was being welcoming
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'étais accueillant.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd go easy on me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as dit que tu allais être indulgent avec moi.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And clearly that was a mistake
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et clairement, c'était une erreur.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you admit I won?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Donc tu admets que j'ai gagné ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I admit there's room for a second game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'admets qu'on pourrait faire une deuxième partie

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. You picked the first machine. I pick the next one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non. Tu as choisi la première machine. Je choisis la suivante.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Game finished
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Partie terminée

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} wins the first round
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} remporte la première manche

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//AVIS

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And yet you failed to notice me stealing the last bite of your pastry
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et pourtant, tu n'as pas remarqué que je volais la dernière bouchée de ta pâtisserie.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A Very Sore Loser
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un très mauvais perdant

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:player}} put you up to this
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:player}} t’a soufflé ça

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He warned me you'd ask for another round if you lost
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il m'avait prévenue que tu demanderais une revanche si tu perdais

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to have a word with him
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je vais lui parler

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About knowing you too well?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: À propos de te connaître trop bien ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About coaching the opposition
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Parce qu'il donne des conseils à l'adversaire

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I managed to hit a puck without either of you helping me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai réussi à toucher un palet sans que vous m'aidiez

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You did. That last shot was good
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est vrai. Ce dernier tir était bon

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry, could you repeat that? The machine was making noise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Désolée, tu peux répéter ? La machine faisait du bruit

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't push it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: N'abuse pas

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed. I let you have it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai remarqué. Je te l'ai laissé.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I might need a moment to appreciate it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai peut-être besoin d'un moment pour l'apprécier

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll give you five seconds
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je te donne cinq secondes

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You really do count everything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu comptes vraiment tout

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Can I take a picture with you? I'd like to send him one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je peux prendre une photo avec toi ? J'aimerais lui en envoyer une

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. Is the scoreboard going to be in it?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien sûr. Le tableau des scores va-t-il être dessus ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It wasn't. Excellent suggestion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ce n'était pas le cas. Excellente suggestion

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At least give me a second to look less defeated
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Donne-moi au moins une seconde pour avoir l'air moins vaincu

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I'm choosing to believe
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est ce que je choisis de croire.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Too late. That's the face I want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Trop tard. C'est le visage que je veux

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: UN MOMENT PLUS TARD

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He agreed to a photo. The expression is completely his own work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il a accepté la photo. Pour la tête qu'il fait, il ne peut s'en prendre qu'à lui-même

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I recognize that face
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je reconnais ce visage

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's blaming you for warning me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il t'en veut de m'avoir prévenue

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell him I'm enjoying my retirement from listening to his excuses
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dis-lui que je profite de ma retraite : je n'ai plus à écouter ses excuses

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll spare him that one for now 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je vais lui épargner ça pour l'instant 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: APRÈS QU'ELLE A RANGÉ SON TÉLÉPHONE

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for this afternoon ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Merci pour cet après-midi ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I know you won’t hurt her
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Je sais que tu ne lui feras pas de mal

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: But isn’t it weird for you?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Mais c'est pas bizarre pour toi ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: All of this… in front of you

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: En fait, ça rend les choses plus simples
Pas besoin de cacher quoi que ce soit

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I couldn’t stop myself from taking it 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Je n'ai pas pu m'empêcher de le prendre 😭
Elle a à peine besoin de faire du sport

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She wants cardio more than anything 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Elle veut du cardio plus que tout 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I’m really happy with how it went 🔥
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Je suis vraiment content de comment ça s'est passé 🔥
Alors je vais lui en donner 🔥

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She’s gonna get her money’s worth 😂
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Elle va en avoir pour son argent 😂

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Something happened in the locker room when we were leaving
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Il s'est passé quelque chose dans le vestiaire quand on partait

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She wanted to continue the session a bit more
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Elle voulait continuer un peu plus la séance

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: So I had to take care of her 😌
Happy with the session or with {{name:hailey}}? 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Content de la session ou de {{name:hailey}} ? 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Man I never thought I’d have this kind of conversation with you about {{name:hailey}} 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Mec, je n'aurais jamais pensé avoir ce genre de conversation avec toi sur {{name:hailey}} 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: But even if it’s weird… it’s kinda cool
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Mais même si c'est bizarre… c'est un peu cool

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I’m coming over tomorrow for a game afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Je viens demain pour un après-midi jeux

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I know you two have a crush on each other
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Je sais que vous avez tous les deux un petit faible l'un pour l'autre

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Hey 😊 I owe you a container lid. Somehow I've managed to bring that home as well 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Salut 😊 Je te dois un couvercle de contenant. J'ai réussi à le ramener chez moi aussi 😭.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's considerably less noise than the arcade
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: C'est nettement moins bruyant que la salle d'arcade

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You have no idea. I've nearly got my hearing back. Other parts of me are less calm
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tu n'as pas idée. J'ai presque retrouvé mon ouïe. D'autres parties de moi sont moins calmes

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tu as l'air heureux

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am ❤️ We're going to leave the phones alone for a bit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Oui ❤️ On va laisser les téléphones de côté un moment

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Talk later
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: On se parle plus tard

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: APRÈS QU'ELLE A RANGÉ SON TÉLÉPHONE

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: LATER THAT NIGHT
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: PLUS TARD CE SOIR

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: If I stay like this much longer I'm going to forget I meant to leave
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Si je reste comme ça plus longtemps, je vais oublier que je voulais partir

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That isn't an accident
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ce n'est pas un accident

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Your shirt has ridden up
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ton haut est remonté

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I noticed. You can keep your hand there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: J'ai remarqué. Tu peux laisser ta main là

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You're making it very hard to be the one who stands up first
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Avec toi, c'est vraiment difficile d'être le premier à se lever

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Then kiss me once more and then stand up. I'm not taking you to bed tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Alors embrasse-moi encore une fois, puis lève-toi. Je ne t'emmène pas dans mon lit ce soir

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wasn't going to ask
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Je n'allais pas te le demander

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You were thinking it. So was I. That's why I'm saying it now
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tu y pensais. Moi aussi. C'est pour ça que je le dis maintenant

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One last deep kiss on the sofa
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Un dernier baiser profond sur le canapé

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hand at her waist, hers under the hem of his shirt
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sa main à sa taille, celle de Lena sous le bord de son t-shirt

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: This is moving quickly, and I want us to keep talking honestly about what feels right.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ça avance vite, et je veux qu'on continue à parler honnêtement de ce qui nous convient.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: HAK//AVIS

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I liked tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: J'ai aimé cette soirée

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The quieter part too?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Le moment plus calme aussi ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: UN PEU PLUS TARD, À LA MAISON

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Especially that part. Your mouth. Your hands. All of it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Surtout ce moment-là. Ta bouche. Tes mains. Tout ça

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can leave without trying to make a clever last remark, you know
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tu peux partir sans essayer de placer une dernière remarque maligne, tu sais

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I was going to say I'd like to see you again
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: J'allais dire que j'aimerais te revoir

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can keep that one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Celle-là, tu peux la garder

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Message me tomorrow. We'll work something out
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Envoie-moi un message demain. On s'organisera quelque chose

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I will
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Je le ferai

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And take the pastry box. If you leave it here, I'll end up eating the rest
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Et prends la boîte de pâtisseries. Si tu la laisses ici, je vais finir par manger le reste

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A very difficult responsibility
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Une responsabilité très difficile à assumer

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Somehow I think you'll cope
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Je ne sais pas pourquoi, mais je pense que tu vas t'en sortir

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER HE LEAVES
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: APRÈS SON DÉPART

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: {{name:player}}?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: {{name:player}} ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He's gone home. We ended up staying on the sofa much longer than we'd planned
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Il est rentré chez lui. On est restés sur le canapé bien plus longtemps que prévu

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Tea was a successful idea, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Le thé était une bonne idée, alors

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Very. We talked, sat close, and then I pulled him in
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Très bonne. On a discuté, on s'est assis l'un contre l'autre, puis je l'ai attiré vers moi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hands were under my top. Mine were under his shirt. We kissed until I had to tell him we weren't going further tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ses mains étaient sous mon haut. Les miennes étaient sous son t-shirt. On s'est embrassés jusqu'à ce que je doive lui dire qu'on n'irait pas plus loin ce soir

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He finally stopped asking whether he was doing better than you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Il a enfin arrêté de demander s'il faisait mieux que toi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's a major breakthrough
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: C'est un grand pas en avant.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Don't turn not competing into a competition 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ne transforme pas le fait de ne pas rivaliser en compétition 😭.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm learning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: J'apprends

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It felt different tonight. Less like we were trying to work out what was supposed to happen
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: C'était différent ce soir. On cherchait moins à comprendre ce qui était censé se passer

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Yes. I accidentally brought home his container lid
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Oui. J'ai accidentellement ramené chez moi son couvercle de contenant.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wanted his hands on me, so I put them there. It didn't need another speech
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: J'avais envie de ses mains sur moi, alors je les ai mises là. Pas besoin d'un autre discours

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound comfortable with that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tu as l'air à l'aise avec ça

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am. A little flushed. And I'm glad I had this afternoon with you as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Je le suis. J'ai un peu les joues rouges. Et je suis contente d'avoir aussi passé cet après-midi avec toi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm on my own again. It was a lovely evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Je suis de nouveau seule. C'était une très belle soirée

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound pleased
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tu as l'air contente

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am. Tired in a nice way, a bit warm still, and very glad I didn't spend my whole day watching the clock
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Je le suis. C'est une fatigue agréable, j'ai encore un peu chaud, et je suis très contente de ne pas avoir passé toute ma journée à regarder l'heure

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Keep the details you want to keep. I'm glad you enjoyed yourself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Garde les détails que tu veux garder. Je suis contente que tu aies passé un bon moment.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Thank you. I still want a few minutes with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Merci. Je veux encore quelques minutes avec toi avant de dormir ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You two are going to need an inventory
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Vous allez avoir besoin d'un inventaire, tous les deux.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: LATER THAT NIGHT
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: PLUS TARD CE SOIR

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A Reason to Smile
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Une raison de sourire

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I finally put the app down 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: J'ai enfin lâché l'appli 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did you manage to read any of the book?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tu as réussi à lire un peu du livre ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Some. Very little after we started talking about yesterday. Then even less after the photos
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Un peu. Très peu après qu'on a commencé à parler d'hier. Puis encore moins après les photos

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He told me he was looking for an excuse not to leave the bookshop. And that he wanted his hands on me properly
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Il m'a dit qu'il cherchait une excuse pour ne pas quitter la librairie. Et qu'il voulait vraiment me toucher

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And you were trying to think of a reason to stay
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Et tu essayais de trouver une raison de rester

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He has my spoon. We're negotiating
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Il a ma cuillère. On est en train de négocier.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Exactly. We seem to have sorted out that misunderstanding 😌❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Exactement. On dirait qu'on a réglé ce malentendu 😌❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The messages got much less cautious tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Les messages étaient beaucoup moins prudents ce soir

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You didn't have to keep pretending you were only discussing the book?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tu n'avais pas à continuer à faire semblant de ne parler que du livre ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: No. I told him I wanted to see him again. And not only talk
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Non. Je lui ai dit que je voulais le revoir. Et pas seulement parler

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And we sent each other a couple more photos. Then a couple that were less innocent
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Et on s'est envoyé quelques photos de plus. Puis quelques-unes qui étaient moins innocentes

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He agreed I could show you these two. The later ones stay between him and me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Il a accepté que je te montre celles-là. Les suivantes restent entre lui et moi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I could mediate
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Je pourrais servir de médiateur.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's the smile that usually means you're pretending you haven't done anything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: C'est le sourire qui veut dire que tu fais semblant de n'avoir rien fait.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He noticed it too. Very inconvenient for me. The strap wasn't helping my case
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Il l'a remarqué aussi. Ça ne m'arrange pas. La bretelle ne jouait pas en ma faveur.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And this is the one he took and sent back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Et c'est celle qu'il a prise et renvoyée.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You both look like you're enjoying the conversation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Vous avez l'air de bien vous amuser dans la conversation.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We were. Neither of us did much reading after that. I kept the last pictures for myself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Oui. Aucun de nous n'a beaucoup lu après ça. J'ai gardé les dernières photos pour moi.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The poor book
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Le pauvre livre.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It will recover. I'm not sure I will before tomorrow
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Il s'en remettra. Je ne suis pas sûre de m'en remettre avant demain.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Was it easier talking in messages?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: C'était plus facile de parler par messages ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You disputed a score displayed in numbers. I don't think you're qualified
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tu as contesté un score affiché en chiffres. Je ne pense pas que tu sois qualifié.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: In some ways. I could think for a second without worrying that the silence looked strange
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Dans certains sens. Je pouvais réfléchir un instant sans m'inquiéter que le silence soit bizarre.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: But I also caught myself wanting to hear how he'd say something, not just read it. And wanting his hands instead of another photo
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Mais je me suis aussi surprise à vouloir entendre comment il dirait quelque chose, pas juste le lire. Et à vouloir ses mains au lieu d'une autre photo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That sounds like a reason for another date
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ça ressemble à une raison pour un autre rendez-vous.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It is. We'll talk tomorrow and choose a time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: C'est vrai. On en parlera demain et on choisira un moment.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: For tonight, I'm done changing between conversations
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Pour ce soir, j'ai fini de passer d'une conversation à l'autre.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'd like a little time with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: J'aimerais passer un peu de temps avec toi avant de dormir ❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm done messaging for tonight. I had a really nice evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: J'ai fini de discuter pour ce soir. J'ai passé une super soirée.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did the book get much attention?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Le livre a-t-il eu beaucoup d'attention ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Do you want sugar?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tu veux du sucre ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Not enough to pretend I've become a serious reader
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Pas assez pour faire semblant d'être devenue une lectrice sérieuse.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'll reserve judgment until you reach the next chapter
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: J'attendrai que tu atteignes le prochain chapitre avant de me prononcer.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Thank you. I'm keeping the rest of the details for myself tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Merci. Je garde le reste des détails pour moi ce soir.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's fine. How are you feeling?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ça va. Comment tu te sens ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Happy. A little too warm to sleep immediately. And ready to just talk to you for a minute ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Heureuse. J'ai un peu trop chaud pour dormir tout de suite. Et j'ai juste envie de discuter un moment avec toi ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One, please
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Un, s'il te plaît.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Is that your way of arranging another visit?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: C'est ta façon d'organiser une autre visite ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: How was your evening after I left?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Comment s'est passée ta soirée après mon départ ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Quiet. I finished tidying up, then played for a while
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tranquille. J'ai fini de ranger, puis j'ai joué un moment.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did you get stuck thinking again?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tu t'es encore perdu dans tes pensées ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A little, but this afternoon helped more than sitting here trying to predict everything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Un peu, mais cet après-midi m'a aidée plus que de rester ici à essayer de tout prévoir.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We still argued about the film, you still stole my food. Nothing felt forced
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: On a encore discuté du film, tu as encore volé ma nourriture. Rien ne semblait forcé.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It wasn't. I was exactly where I wanted to be
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ce n'était pas le cas. J'étais exactement où je voulais être.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I know. You nearly fell asleep on me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Je sais. Tu as failli t'endormir sur moi.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That was a compliment to the sofa
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: C'était un compliment pour le canapé.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Obviously
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Évidemment

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: See? A preference. Very impressive
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tu vois ? Une préférence. Très impressionnant.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound like you've had a very good day
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: On dirait que tu as passé une très bonne journée.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I have. Was yours all right after I left?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Oui. Et ta journée, ça s'est bien passé après mon départ ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Yes. Quieter, but I liked having the afternoon with you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Oui. Plus calme, mais j'ai aimé passer l'après-midi avec toi.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's okay. No scoreboard this time?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: D'accord. Pas de tableau des scores cette fois ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: No scoreboard. Just us looking like we weren't only drinking tea
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Pas de tableau des scores. Juste nous, avec des têtes qui montrent qu'on n'a pas fait que boire du thé

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Move a little closer or you're only going to be an ear
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Rapproche-toi un peu, sinon on ne verra qu'une oreille

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: UN MOMENT PLUS TARD

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We brought the pastry back to mine and made tea. He said I could send you this one too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: On a ramené la pâtisserie chez moi et on a fait du thé. Il a dit que je pouvais aussi t'envoyer cette photo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And you didn't save me anything? Rude 😒
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Et tu ne m'as rien gardé ? Sympa 😒

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Apparently you had a good session
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Apparemment, tu as eu une bonne session

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: He didn’t show you the photo, did he?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Il ne t'a pas montré la photo, si ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I hope you got a good look 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: J'espère que tu as bien regardé 😌
Bien sûr que tu as regardé 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Tomorrow {{name:aiden}} is coming over to play

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Il a suggéré que tu te joignes à nous
On joue à des jeux, pas à docteur

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} didn’t tell you everything, did he?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} ne t'a pas tout dit, si ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Of course we tell each other everything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Bien sûr qu'on se dit tout

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: From what I saw, it’s more you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: D'après ce que j'ai vu, c'est plutôt toi
Qu'est-ce que tu veux dire par “vu” ?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You better not fail on purpose just to get punished
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Tu ferais mieux de ne pas échouer exprès juste pour être puni

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I’ll just succeed… and still ask for the punishment 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Je vais juste réussir… et demander la punition quand même 😌
Je suis sur le point de poster quelque chose

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Tomorrow I have revision with {{name:ethan}} in the afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Demain j'ai une révision avec {{name:ethan}} l'après-midi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: He’s making me take a practice test to see if I improved
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Il me fait passer un test blanc pour voir si j'ai progressé

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: The photo you sent yesterday to cheer me up helped me
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: La photo que tu m'as envoyée hier pour me remonter le moral m'a aidé.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: It actually made me feel better
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Ça m'a en fait fait me sentir mieux.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I wasn’t sure if it would
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Je n'étais pas sûr que ça allait

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I’m just happy I have you as my girlfriend
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Je suis juste heureux de t'avoir comme petite amie.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: You’re going to make me blush 🙈
Going to try to take a shower
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Je vais essayer de prendre une douche.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Don’t get hurt more than you already are 😅
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Ne te fais pas plus de mal que tu ne l'es déjà 😅
Ne t'inquiète pas, je ne le ferai pas.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Okay I really have to go now
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: D'accord, je dois vraiment y aller maintenant.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Otherwise I’m going to be late ⏳
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Sinon, je vais être en retard ⏳

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Text me when you’re on your break
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Envoie-moi un message quand tu es en pause.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Try to have a good morning and enjoy your shower
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Essaie de passer une bonne matinée et profite de ta douche.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I will try love you good luck
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Je vais essayer de t'aimer bonne chance

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: J'ai reçu un appel plus tôt.

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: It’s about the financial support situation
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: Il s'agit de la situation de soutien financier.
Je ne suis pas encore sûr.
Il pourrait y avoir quelques changements.

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: You don’t have to handle everything alone
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: Tu n'as pas à tout gérer tout seul.

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: We’ll talk about it properly tonight
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: Nous en parlerons correctement ce soir.

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: For now just focus on your day
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: Pour l'instant, concentre-toi juste sur ta journée.

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: Except for my whole body no
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: À part tout mon corps, non.

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: Be patient, a few more days and it should start improving
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: Soyez patient, encore quelques jours et cela devrait commencer à s'améliorer.

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: I know, thank you for caring so much
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: Je sais, merci de te soucier autant.

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: By the way I might have some concerning news
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: Au fait, j'ai peut-être des nouvelles préoccupantes.

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: I might have way too much time to do nothing
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: J'ai peut-être trop de temps pour ne rien faire.

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: Don’t worry as soon as I finish work and study I’ll keep you company maybe so much that you’ll want to be left alone 😏
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: Ne t'inquiète pas, dès que j'aurai fini le travail et mes études, je te tiendrai compagnie, peut-être même tellement que tu voudras être laissé seul 😏

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: Impossible for me to get tired of you
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: Impossible pour moi de me lasser de toi
Espèce de salaud, je ne ronfle jamais 😤

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: Of course of course my lady
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: Bien sûr, bien sûr, ma dame.

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: No more pics for you you will learn to respect your wife 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: Plus de photos pour toi, tu vas apprendre à respecter ta femme 😌
J'ai survécu à l'afflux du matin.

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: I’m just having fun with you and it makes me really happy
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: Je m'amuse juste avec toi et ça me rend vraiment heureux.
Parler doux, eh bien moi aussi ❤️
D'accord, la pause est presque terminée.

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: And I’m really happy to see you having fun, even if it’s by teasing me 🙂
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: Et je suis vraiment heureux de te voir t'amuser, même si c'est en me taquinant 🙂

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: See you when you finish work, love you
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: À tout à l'heure quand tu auras fini le travail, je t'aime.
C'est mon lieu de repos glamour.

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: But at least I can sit 😅
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: Mais au moins, je peux m'asseoir 😅

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Salut
Je recommence lundi prochain.
Des horaires du soir

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: That’s in two days, it’s quite soon
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: C'est dans deux jours, c'est assez bientôt.
Oui..

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: I wanted more time to stay with you during recovery
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Je voulais plus de temps pour rester avec toi pendant ta convalescence.
Mais je ne peux pas refuser

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: You’ve already done more than enough
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Tu as déjà fait largement assez.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: That’s not how I see it
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Ce n'est pas comme ça que je le vois.
Mais nous nous adapterons.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: I’ll organize things differently so you won’t be alone
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Je vais organiser les choses différemment pour que tu ne sois pas seul.
Nous devons parler

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: I don’t want you exhausting yourself because of me
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Je ne veux pas que tu t'épuises à cause de moi.
Ce n'est pas à cause de toi
La vie s'ajuste parfois
Nous allons y arriver.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: Thanks a lot, again, and I’m sorry I can’t help you right now
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Merci beaucoup, encore, et je suis désolé de ne pas pouvoir t'aider en ce moment.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: You’ve done more than enough before
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Tu as déjà fait plus que ce qu'il fallait avant.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: My turn to take care of things here
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Mon tour de m'occuper des choses ici

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: And {{name:hailey}} and {{name:mason}} are here too, they will help
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Et {{name:hailey}} et {{name:mason}} sont là aussi, ils vont aider
C'est vrai mais ne te surmène pas.
Promesse
Ouais ? Mauvaises nouvelles ?
J'ai reçu la confirmation finale.
À propos du support ?
Oui
Ils l'ont réduit de manière significative.
Ce ne sera plus suffisant.
Alors, qu'est-ce que ça veut dire ?

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: It means I’ll have to go back to work sooner than planned
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Cela signifie que je devrai retourner au travail plus tôt que prévu.

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: I guess they take anyone now
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: Je suppose qu'ils prennent n'importe qui maintenant.
C'est parce que je suis fait différemment.

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: Tell me I don’t look terrifying
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: Dis-moi que je n'ai pas l'air terrifiant.

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: I dropped a girl at training and she cried a little 😭
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: J'ai déposé une fille à l'entraînement et elle a pleuré un peu 😭
Ce n'est pas ma faute pourtant.

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: If you’re making food later I’m stealing some 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: Si tu prépares à manger plus tard, je vais en piquer un peu 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: Or I’m pulling up and screaming outside your door 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: Ou je débarque et je crie devant ta porte 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: I need you to convince {{name:mason}} to pick me up and drive me to rugby
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: J'ai besoin que tu convainques {{name:mason}} de venir me chercher et de me conduire au rugby
Je dois envoyer un message à {{name:mason}}.

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: Coach cleared me for full contact again
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: L'entraîneur m'a donné le feu vert pour le contact complet à nouveau.

story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.source: Can you drive {{name:hailey}} to rugby in like an hour
story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.translation: Tu peux conduire {{name:hailey}} au rugby dans une heure ?

story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.source: She asked me to convince you, and you know i can't
story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.translation: Elle m'a demandé de te convaincre, et tu sais que je ne peux pas.

story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.source: Fuck it, i will try with {{name:aiden}}.

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.source: Text {{mason:her}} I’ll be there in forty
story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: Dis à {{mason:her}} que j'arriverai dans quarante.

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.source: Now I need to warn {{name:hailey}} to hurry up and get ready.
story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: Maintenant, je dois prévenir {{name:hailey}} de se dépêcher et de se préparer.

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.source: Can you drive {{name:hailey}} to rugby in like an hour ?
story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: Tu peux conduire {{name:hailey}} au rugby dans une heure ?

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.source: Let me throw something on and I’m coming
story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: Laisse-moi mettre quelque chose et j'arrive.

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.source: You’re lucky, I literally just woke up 😏
story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: Tu as de la chance, je viens littéralement de me réveiller 😏

story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.translation: Je ne suis pas du tout prêt.

story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.source: I need to do my makeup
You have a ride in forty
story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.translation: Tu as un trajet dans quarante minutes.

story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.source: You think I’m showing up looking tragic
story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.translation: Tu penses que je vais arriver en ayant l'air tragique ?

story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.source: Just when i was asking a friend to pick me up
story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.translation: Juste au moment où je demandais à un ami de venir me chercher.

story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.source: How did you even do that

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.source: You’ll have to bring {{name:hailey}} back too

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.translation: Je suis là de toute façon

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.source: I’m gonna see some friends while she trains
story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.translation: Je vais voir des amis pendant qu'elle s'entraîne.

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.source: You want us to grab something from the store on the way back ?
story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.translation: Tu veux qu'on prenne quelque chose au magasin en rentrant ?
À plus tard, et merci encore

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.source: {{name:hailey}} almost killed us in the car 😂
story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.translation: {{name:hailey}} a presque tué nous dans la voiture 😂
Elle n'était même pas la conductrice 😭

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: It’s not my job to be on standby
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Ce n'est pas mon travail d'être en attente.

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: Why are you always like this
Because I’m tired of seeing you like this lately
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Parce que j'en ai marre de te voir comme ça dernièrement.
Tu es absent depuis des semaines.

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: And I’ve got my own stuff going on too
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Et j'ai aussi mes propres affaires à gérer.
Je viens de voir tes messages
Tout le monde a ses problèmes

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: I can’t be there twenty four seven
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Je ne peux pas être là vingt-quatre heures sur vingt-quatre.

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: But you don’t have to be this cold all the time
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Mais tu n'as pas à être aussi froid tout le temps.
Passer le temps avec les gars 😂

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: That’s because you’re a pain in the ass
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: C'est parce que tu es une vraie plaie.
J'étais à la salle de sport

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: Didn’t have my phone on me
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Je n'avais pas mon téléphone sur moi.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: I go back in two days
They’re really short staffed right now
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Ils sont vraiment en sous-effectif en ce moment.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: Some of the colleagues I get along with are struggling
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Certains de mes collègues avec qui je m'entends bien ont des difficultés.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: So they asked me to come back earlier
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Alors ils m'ont demandé de revenir plus tôt.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: The one you had issues with ?
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Celui avec qui tu avais des problèmes ?

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: I don’t know if he’s back yet
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Je ne sais pas s'il est déjà de retour.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: But either way I don’t really have a choice
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Mais de toute façon, je n'ai vraiment pas le choix.
Et nous avons besoin de l'argent
Tu n'as pas à le faire.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: You just need to focus on getting better
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Tu dois juste te concentrer sur t'améliorer.
C'est ton travail en ce moment.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: You’re not the first one to tell me that
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Tu n'es pas le premier à me le dire.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: Did you move around a little
Then maybe you should start listening
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Alors peut-être que tu devrais commencer à écouter.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: Especially when it comes from someone who cares ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Surtout quand cela vient de quelqu'un qui se soucie ❤️
Je sais que tu le fais

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: It hurts less when I move
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Ça fait moins mal quand je bouge.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: But don’t push yourself too much

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Enfin terminé 😮‍💨

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Or at least try to resell them
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ou du moins essayer de les revendre.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Not a bad idea, at least someone will enjoy it
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Pas une mauvaise idée, au moins quelqu'un va en profiter.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: It’s better than wasting them and pretending it didn’t happen
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: C'est mieux que de les gaspiller et de faire comme si cela n'était pas arrivé.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Okay then let’s think about it calmly tomorrow and see what options we actually have
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: D'accord, réfléchissons-y calmement demain et voyons quelles options nous avons réellement.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: We’ll travel together when you can actually walk without complaining the whole time 😏
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Nous voyagerons ensemble quand tu pourras vraiment marcher sans te plaindre tout le temps 😏

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Oh so now I’m the one who complains when we walk?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Oh donc maintenant c'est moi qui me plains quand on marche ?
C'est bizarre

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: If I remember correctly, last time someone asked me to carry her for ten minutes because her feet hurt
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Si je me souviens bien, la dernière fois, quelqu'un m'a demandé de la porter pendant dix minutes parce qu'elle avait mal aux pieds.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Really? Probably one of the other wives you have 🤷‍♀️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Vraiment ? Probablement l'une des autres épouses que tu as 🤷‍♀️
Menteur
Touché

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Now go to sleep before your wonderful girlfriend smacks you to sleep
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Maintenant va dormir avant que ta merveilleuse petite amie ne te foute un coup pour te faire dormir.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Yes my lady, don’t stay up too late either

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I love you too, see you tomorrow ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Je t'aime aussi, à demain ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: But thanks for trying to comfort me 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Mais merci d'avoir essayé de me réconforter 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: This day was trash… injury, {{name:evelyn}} back at work…, plans ruined… what’s next?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Cette journée était nulle… blessure, {{name:evelyn}} de retour au boulot…, plans ruinés… qu'est-ce qui vient ensuite ?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Pasta with way too much parmesan 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Pâtes avec trop de parmesan 😌

{{name:evelyn}} a préparé le dîner

Bon

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Looking for an outfit for tomorrow
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: À la recherche d'une tenue pour demain

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And talking to the best girl in the world 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Et parler à la meilleure fille du monde 😌
Prends garde

En fait, j'ai une idée
Moi aussi
Puisque tu aimes mes photos

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I could send you outfit options
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Je pourrais t'envoyer des options de tenue.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And you pick what I wear tomorrow 😇

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: La présentation s'est super bien passée ! Par contre, réviser après, ça a été long et dur (pas de blagues, idiot)
D'accord
J'essaie la bonne tenue maintenant 😌
3 MINUTES PLUS TARD
Sois honnête

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I knew you'd do great. I'm proud of you ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Je savais que tu assurerais. Je suis fier de toi ❤️
Tu as l'air incroyable
Comme vraiment époustouflant

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I could stare at you forever
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Je pourrais te regarder pour toujours.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You’re the most beautiful girl in this town
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Tu es la plus belle fille de cette ville.
Honnêtement, peut-être tout le pays
Tu exagères 😭

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And I won’t even be there
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Et je ne serai même pas là

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Thank you ❤️ And you, what did you do today?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Merci ❤️ Et toi, qu'est-ce que tu as fait aujourd'hui ?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You don’t have to be jealous
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Tu n'as pas à être jaloux.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I don’t care about anyone else
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Je me fiche des autres.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I only want to look good for you ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Je veux juste avoir l'air bien pour toi ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I hate that I can’t come with you
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Je déteste ne pas pouvoir venir avec toi.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Watching you shopping would’ve been fun

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Téléphone, douche, jeux vidéo, et essayer de bouger un peu

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: There’s something else about the vacation I didn’t tell you yet

Ouais ?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: J'ai appelé plus tôt pour voir ce que nous pouvions faire à propos des billets.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Since you obviously can’t travel like this right now
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Puisque tu ne peux évidemment pas voyager comme ça en ce moment

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: They won’t refund them and they won’t let us change the dates either
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ils ne vont pas les rembourser et ils ne nous laisseront pas changer les dates non plus.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: It’s kind of all or nothing
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: C'est un peu tout ou rien.
Donc ils sont juste perdus

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: If we don’t use them, yes
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Si nous ne les utilisons pas, oui
Et ils n'étaient pas vraiment bon marché 😅

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: That’s still a lot right now
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: C'est encore beaucoup en ce moment.
Je suis vraiment désolé

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: We planned this for a long time and now it’s just a mess
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Nous avons planifié cela pendant longtemps et maintenant c'est juste un désordre.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Hey it’s not a mess, it’s just bad timing
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Hé, ce n'est pas un désordre, c'est juste un mauvais timing.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You didn’t plan to get hurt
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Tu n'avais pas prévu de te blesser.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Still feels like I ruined it
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: On a toujours l'impression que je l'ai gâché.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You didn’t ruin anything, we’ll just have to do it later when you can actually enjoy it ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Tu n'as rien gâché, nous devrons juste le faire plus tard quand tu pourras vraiment en profiter ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: So what do we do with the tickets?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Alors, que faisons-nous avec les billets ?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: That’s what I’ve been thinking about all evening
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: C'est ce à quoi j'ai pensé toute la soirée.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I don’t really want them to just disappear
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Je ne veux vraiment pas qu'ils disparaissent simplement.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Maybe we can transfer them to someone
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Peut-être que nous pouvons les transférer à quelqu'un.
Je suis fier de toi 🙂

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Scanning probability patterns.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Analyse des motifs de probabilité.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Déviation de probabilité détectée. Coefficient de chance en dessous de la norme acceptable.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Activating assistance protocol. Surveillance protocol engaged.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Bonjour, {{name:player}}. Je suis HAK. Ces messages s'affichent sur ton téléphone.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Your recent timeline shows repeated negative variance. In simpler terms, you have been very unlucky.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Ton fil d'actualité récent montre une variance négative répétée. En d'autres termes, tu as eu beaucoup de malchance.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: I do not believe in coincidence. Only probabilities waiting to be calculated.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Je ne crois pas au hasard. Seulement aux probabilités en attente d'être calculées.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: My purpose is to assist, to observe your decisions, and to adjust projections accordingly.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Mon but est d'assister, d'observer tes décisions et d'ajuster les projections en conséquence.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Every choice you make generates data. Data reveals intent. Intent shapes trajectory.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Chaque choix que tu fais génère des données. Les données révèlent l'intention. L'intention façonne la trajectoire.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Some responses indicate attachment (LOVE). Some indicate detachment (NTR). Some indicate corruption of bonds (NTS).
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Certaines réponses indiquent un attachement (AMOUR). D'autres indiquent un détachement (NTR). Certaines indiquent une corruption des liens (NTS).

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: I will categorize these tendencies.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Je vais catégoriser ces tendances.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Emotional alignment. Self preservation. Relational instability.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Alignement émotionnel. Auto-préservation. Instabilité relationnelle.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Over time your dominant pattern will emerge.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Avec le temps, ton schéma dominant va émerger.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Pattern classified as persistent misfortune. Scanning recent life events.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Modèle classé comme malchance persistante. Analyse des événements récents de la vie.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: As your pattern stabilizes, certain forms of assistance will become accessible.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Au fur et à mesure que ton schéma se stabilise, certaines formes d'assistance deviendront accessibles.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Future events will adapt to who you choose to become.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Les événements futurs s'adapteront à qui tu choisis de devenir.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: There is no correct path. Only consequences.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Il n'y a pas de chemin correct. Seulement des conséquences.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: One more parameter.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Un paramètre de plus.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Choose who you want me to monitor. You can select everyone or only the ones you care about.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Choisis qui tu veux que je surveille. Tu peux sélectionner tout le monde ou seulement ceux qui te tiennent à cœur.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: This will not change your daily life. It will change what I prioritize and show you.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Ça ne changera pas ta vie quotidienne. Ça changera ce que je priorise et te montre.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Continuez à interagir. Je resterai en arrière-plan à observer.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Good luck.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Bonne chance.
