story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Bonjour ❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll be here
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je serai là

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Ready for university. And impatient for it to finish
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Prête pour l'université. Et impatiente que ça se termine

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Good luck paying attention today
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Bonne chance pour rester concentré aujourd'hui

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You could help by behaving until lunchtime
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu pourrais aider en te comportant jusqu'à l'heure du déjeuner

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll try
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je vais essayer

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Very reassuring
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Très rassurant

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Your t-shirt is ready, by the way
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ton t-shirt est prêt, au fait

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Good ❤️ And I've remembered my toothbrush
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Bien ❤️ Et j'ai pensé à ma brosse à dents

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then we're set
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Alors tout est prêt

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: My bag is packed and I'm trying to concentrate on getting to class
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Mon sac est prêt et j'essaie de me concentrer pour aller en cours

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I packed clean clothes for tomorrow too
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: J'ai aussi préparé des vêtements propres pour demain

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: So I won't have any reason to rush home tonight
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Donc je n'aurai pas de raison de rentrer vite ce soir

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: That's exactly what I wanted
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: C'est exactement ce que je voulais

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Me too. See you this afternoon, love
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Moi aussi. À cet après-midi, mon amour

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: See you soon ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: À bientôt ❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Having trouble?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu as des problèmes ?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A little. I keep thinking about this afternoon
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Un peu. Je pense toujours à cet après-midi

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You're not the only one
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu n'es pas la seule

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Did my pictures have anything to do with that? 😌
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Mes photos ont quelque chose à voir avec ça ? 😌

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: They definitely helped
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Elles ont clairement aidé

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm looking forward to seeing that smile in person
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: J'ai hâte de voir ce sourire en vrai

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You will. Around five, like we said
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu vas le faire. Vers cinq heures, comme on a dit

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll go home after class, get my bag and come straight over
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Je rentre chez moi après les cours, je prends mon sac et j'arrive tout de suite

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: EARLY AFTERNOON — You have arranged your plans with {{name:hailey}} early enough to be home before {{name:lena}} arrives at five.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: APRÈS-MIDI — Tu as organisé tes plans avec {{name:hailey}} assez tôt pour être chez toi avant que {{name:lena}} n'arrive à cinq heures.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: These are a crime against fashion
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: C'est un crime contre la mode

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: A few minutes later on the lane
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Quelques minutes plus tard sur la route
Je pensais que tu t'étais perdue
C'est une partie de mon charme

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: By the way, that's quite the outfit you have on
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Au fait, c'est une sacrée tenue que tu as là
Je savais que ça te plaisait

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Well everyone seems to like it
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Eh bien, tout le monde semble aimer
Je suis déjà sur la piste.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Your form is ridiculous by the way
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ta posture est ridicule au fait

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Did you just take a picture of me?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Tu viens de me prendre en photo ?
Le perdant doit relever un défi
Essaie de ne pas te ridiculiser

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Finished class. Going home for my bag, then I'm coming to you ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: J'ai fini les cours. Je rentre chercher mon sac, puis je viens vers toi ❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Longer than necessary, but I survived
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Plus long que nécessaire, mais j'ai survécu

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yeah. I've got something for us to snack on later too
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ouais. J'ai aussi quelque chose à grignoter plus tard

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then I'll see you at five
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Alors je te verrai à cinq heures

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: LATE AFTERNOON — Back home after bowling.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: APRÈS-MIDI TARD — De retour à la maison après le bowling.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: A few minutes later in your room
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Quelques minutes plus tard dans ta chambre

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Damn it you’re really doing it
You’re sure you want to cross that line?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Tu es sûre de vouloir franchir cette ligne ?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate moment after bowling bet
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAK a archivé des preuves d'un moment intime après le pari de bowling

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: You’re enjoying this way too much
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Tu prends trop de plaisir à ça

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Don’t get used to me being this obedient
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Ne t'habitue pas à me voir aussi obéissante

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: If I do this you better not make fun of me after
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Si je fais ça, tu ferais mieux de ne pas te moquer de moi après

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate  act
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAK a archivé des preuves d'un acte intime

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Nice to hear you say that
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: C'est agréable de t'entendre dire ça
Tu es juste une mauvaise perdante

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Did you just take a picture
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Tu viens de prendre une photo ?
Tu ferais mieux de la supprimer
Gagne le pari la prochaine fois

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: HAK archived evidence of continued intimate act
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAK a archivé des preuves d'un acte intime continu
Tu es sur le point d'y arriver, non ?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Since we got that far, you can finish in my mouth
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Puisqu'on en est là, tu peux finir dans ma bouche

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: HAK archived evidence of climax during intimate act
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAK a archivé des preuves de climax durant un acte intime
Je ne suis pas une mauvaise perdante
Ne me fais pas de compliments maintenant
Je suis encore en train de digérer

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: And don’t talk to me until I come to you
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Et… ne me parle pas avant que je ne vienne te voir

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: I’m a competitive person who was robbed
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Je suis une personne compétitive qui a été volée

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: {{name:lena}} is about to arrive. I have to let you go.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: {{name:lena}} est sur le point d'arriver. Je dois te laisser.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Then go. Have a good evening with her.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Alors vas-y. Passe une bonne soirée avec elle.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Try not to look so pleased with yourself when you open the door 😏
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Essaie de ne pas avoir l'air si satisfait de toi quand tu ouvres la porte 😏.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Sure you will. And delete that photo before she gets here.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Bien sûr que tu vas le faire. Et supprime cette photo avant qu'elle n'arrive.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: {{name:hailey}} leaves your room to clean up. You put things away.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: {{name:hailey}} quitte ta chambre pour nettoyer. Tu ranges les affaires.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: {{name:hailey}} leaves your room to clean up. You put things away before {{name:lena}} arrives.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: {{name:hailey}} quitte ta chambre pour nettoyer. Tu ranges les affaires avant l'arrivée de {{name:lena}}.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: At your door ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: À ta porte ❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You take her bag to the bedroom together. {{name:lena}} places her things beside the chair, puts her toothbrush in the bathroom and comes back to find the t-shirt you have left for her.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Vous prenez son sac ensemble jusqu'à la chambre. {{name:lena}} place ses affaires à côté de la chaise, met sa brosse à dents dans la salle de bain et revient pour trouver le t-shirt que tu as laissé pour elle.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: This one?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Celle-ci ?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I thought you'd like it.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Je pensais que ça te plairait.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I do. I'm leaving it right here for later.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Je le fais. Je le laisse ici pour plus tard.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Make yourself at home.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Fais comme chez toi.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You might regret telling me that.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Tu pourrais regretter de m'avoir dit ça.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You settle in the living room with drinks and a snack. After a while, {{name:lena}} notices the controllers and reaches for one.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Vous vous installez dans le salon avec des boissons et un snack. Après un moment, {{name:lena}} remarque les manettes et en prend une.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Can we try another race?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: On peut essayer une autre course ?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Absolutely. Same track as Sunday?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Absolument. Même circuit que dimanche ?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Yes. I want you to see the corners I've been thinking about.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Oui. Je veux que tu vois les virages auxquels j'ai pensé.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: AT FIVE — {{name:lena}} arrives at your door with her overnight bag. You let her inside, then gently draw her close before she can start unpacking.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: À CINQ HEURES — {{name:lena}} arrive à ta porte avec son sac de nuit. Tu la laisses entrer, puis tu l'attires doucement vers toi avant qu'elle ne puisse commencer à déballer.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Now I get to see you lean sideways with the controller, too.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Maintenant, je peux te voir te pencher sur le côté avec la manette aussi.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: No comments from the instructor, please.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Pas de commentaires de l'instructeur, s'il te plaît.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You sit side by side for a few races. {{name:lena}} still finishes behind you, but handles the difficult corners more confidently. You point out the clean turns and help her adjust her timing between rounds.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Vous êtes assis côte à côte pendant quelques courses. {{name:lena}} termine toujours derrière toi, mais gère les virages difficiles avec plus de confiance. Tu lui fais remarquer les virages bien exécutés et l'aides à ajuster son timing entre les manches.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: That corner was good. You slowed down before turning this time.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Ce virage était bien. Tu as ralenti avant de tourner cette fois.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I remembered. I could practically hear you telling me to brake.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Je me suis souvenu. Je pouvais presque t'entendre me dire de freiner.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You're much quicker through that section now.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Tu es beaucoup plus rapide dans cette section maintenant.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I'm enjoying this more when you aren't a whole track away from me.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: J'apprécie beaucoup plus ça quand tu n'es pas à un circuit de moi.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: In the game or on the sofa?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Dans le jeu ou sur le canapé ?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Both.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Les deux.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: {{name:lena}} sets the controller on the coffee table and turns toward you. She kisses you, then settles close against your side, her hand resting on your arm.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: {{name:lena}} pose la manette sur la table basse et se tourne vers toi. Elle t'embrasse, puis se blottit contre toi, sa main reposant sur ton bras.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Do I get to put this down first?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Je peux poser ça d'abord ?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Capture visuelle archivée

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: HAK//AVIS

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: A Pause Between Races
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Une pause entre les courses

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Another round?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Une autre manche ?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: In a bit. Stay here with me first.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Dans un moment. Reste ici avec moi d'abord.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Gladly.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Avec plaisir.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: 45 MINUTES LATER — You put your controller down beside hers and stay together on the sofa. Later, {{name:lena}} helps you set the table while you finish preparing dinner.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 45 MINUTES PLUS TARD — Tu poses ta manette à côté de la sienne et vous restez ensemble sur le canapé. Plus tard, {{name:lena}} t'aide à mettre la table pendant que tu finis de préparer le dîner.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: The bag, yes. You, no.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Le sac, oui. Toi, non.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: She leaves the bag by the door and steps into your arms. You kiss her, keeping one hand at her waist
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Elle laisse le sac près de la porte et se glisse dans tes bras. Tu l'embrasses, gardant une main à sa taille

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Capture visuelle archivée

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: HAK//AVIS

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Here to Stay
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Ici pour rester

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You remembered what you said last night.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Tu te souviens de ce que tu as dit hier soir.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I did.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Je m'en souviens.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Good. We've got plenty of time for that today.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Bien. On a plein de temps pour ça aujourd'hui.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: EVENING — You eat together on the couch, talking about the afternoon and {{name:lena}}'s plans for Thursday
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: SOIR — Vous mangez ensemble sur le canapé, parlant de l'après-midi et des plans de {{name:lena}} pour jeudi.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} leans in to kiss you. You go to your room and close the door
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} se penche pour t'embrasser. Tu vas dans ta chambre et fermes la porte

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Do you want to go further tonight?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu veux aller plus loin ce soir ?
Eh bien, la chambre est insonorisée.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm taking that as a yes.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je prends ça comme un oui.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've been looking forward to being here with you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: J'attendais avec impatience d'être ici avec toi.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You sit together on the edge of the bed. {{name:lena}} puts her arms around your shoulders and kisses you. You hold her close, taking your time together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vous êtes assis ensemble au bord du lit. {{name:lena}} t'entoure de ses bras et t'embrasse. Tu la tiens près de toi, profitant de ce moment ensemble.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A Kiss Before the Lights Dim
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Un baiser avant que les lumières s'éteignent

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm glad I don't have to think about leaving tonight.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je suis contente de ne pas avoir à penser à partir ce soir.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You help her out of her sweater. She stays close while you finish undressing her.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu l'aides à enlever son pull. Elle reste près de toi pendant que tu finis de la déshabiller.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: He pulls her sweater over her head
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Il lui enlève son pull par-dessus la tête.
De la dentelle noire en dessous.
Encore mieux que sur les photos.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was hoping you'd say that.
She lies back on the bed
So am I. Though I'm still thinking about those pictures you sent yesterday.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Moi aussi. Même si je pense encore à ces photos que tu as envoyées hier.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She takes him in her mouth
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Elle le prend dans sa bouche.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come here. I want you inside me.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Viens ici. Je veux que tu sois en moi.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 45 MINUTES LATER — She has changed into the t-shirt you prepared for her. You are both under the duvet. She curls against you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 45 MINUTES PLUS TARD — Elle a enfilé le t-shirt que tu as préparé pour elle. Vous êtes tous les deux sous la couette. Elle se blottit contre toi.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It was. I'm really happy with you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: C'était le cas. Je suis vraiment heureux avec toi.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. I love how things are going between us now.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Moi aussi. J'adore comment ça se passe entre nous maintenant.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So do I. These last few days with you have been perfect.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Moi aussi. Ces derniers jours avec toi ont été parfaits.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm happy I get to stay here tonight.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Je suis contente de pouvoir rester ici ce soir.
Je suis contente que tu sois ici aussi.
Bonne nuit. Fais de beaux rêves.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You know which ones. The little preview. And the one after.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu sais lesquelles. Le petit aperçu. Et celle d'après.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Elle se blottit contre toi, sa main dans la tienne. Tu la tiens près de toi et vous vous endormez ensemble.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Elle se blottit contre toi, sa main dans la tienne. Tu la tiens près de toi et vous vous endormez ensemble.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close as she falls asleep. You stay awake a little longer.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Elle se blottit contre toi, sa main reposant dans la tienne. Tu la tiens près de toi pendant qu'elle s'endort. Tu restes éveillé un peu plus longtemps.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You were packing in black lace and smiling at me like you knew exactly what you were doing.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tu faisais tes valises en dentelle noire et tu me souriais comme si tu savais exactement ce que tu faisais.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It worked. I've been waiting to see that in person.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ça a marché. J'attendais de voir ça en personne.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Let's go to your room so you can see better
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Allons dans ta chambre pour que tu puisses mieux voir.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Start with the living room, I’ll take the kitchen.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Commence par le salon, je m'occupe de la cuisine.
{{name:mason}} s'occupe de la salle de bain.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Someone has to be responsible in this house.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Quelqu'un doit être responsable dans cette maison.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Did you seriously just take a picture of me cleaning?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tu viens vraiment de prendre une photo de moi en train de nettoyer ?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That you actually do chores sometimes.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Que tu fais parfois des corvées.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’m going to put soap in your coffee.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Je vais mettre du savon dans ton café.
Tu ne peux pas y échapper
De toute façon, le salon est fait.
C'est ce que disent les gens lents.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Keep talking and I’ll make you clean the toilet.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Continue de parler et je te ferai nettoyer les toilettes.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I can hear you still in bed

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Morning ❤️ Did you beat that level, or is the controller still the problem?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bonjour ❤️ Tu as battu ce niveau, ou c'est toujours la manette le problème ?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've got a parcel to collect, then not much
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai un colis à récupérer, puis pas grand-chose

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Anything exciting in it?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Il y a quelque chose d'excitant dedans ?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A phone charger
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un chargeur de téléphone

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Try to contain yourself when you open it 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Essaie de te contenir quand tu l'ouvres 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll save the wrapping for you
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je vais garder l'emballage pour toi

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How thoughtful ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Comme c'est attentionné ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Full day for you again?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Une journée bien remplie pour toi encore ?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes, then work. I'm going home before dinner tonight
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cours, puis boulot. Je rentre avant le dîner ce soir

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Changing before you go?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu changes avant de partir ?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, I don't want to take all my work things with me
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ouais, je ne veux pas emporter toutes mes affaires de boulot

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Finally beat it. Turns out I needed to stop rushing
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je l'ai enfin battu. Il s'avère que je devais arrêter de me précipiter

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your bag will appreciate a night off
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ton sac va apprécier une nuit de repos

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's earned one 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Il l'a bien mérité 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't leave your keys in it when you change bags
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ne laisse pas tes clés dedans quand tu changes de sac

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That does sound like something I'd manage
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça a l'air d'être quelque chose que je ferais

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I haven't even decided what to wear yet
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je n'ai même pas encore décidé quoi mettre

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'll look good either way
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu seras beau peu importe ce que tu mets

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Merci beau gosse ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm ready for this part of the day, at least
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je suis prête pour cette partie de la journée, au moins

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: See? Looking good already
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu vois ? Ça commence déjà à bien rendre

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So the controller made a miraculous recovery 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Donc la manette a fait une récupération miraculeuse 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're making it difficult to leave my phone alone 😊
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu me compliques la tâche pour lâcher mon téléphone 😊

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll let you get going. Hope dinner's nice tonight
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je te laisse y aller. J'espère que le dîner sera sympa ce soir

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, and sorry if today I can't talk much ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Merci, et désolée si aujourd'hui je ne peux pas trop parler ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get there, and when I'm back
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je t'enverrai un message quand j'arriverai, et quand je serai de retour

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's okay, no rush to reply in between
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pas de souci, prends ton temps pour répondre

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay. Have a good day
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: D'accord. Passe une bonne journée

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Toi aussi

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you, talk later ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je t'aime, on se parle plus tard ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je t'aime aussi

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather not discuss that part
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je préfère ne pas parler de cette partie

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very convenient 😌 Did you get some sleep afterwards?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Très pratique 😌 Tu as réussi à dormir un peu après ?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah. What about you?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ouais. Et toi ?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Slept okay, and I got up when the alarm rang for once
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai bien dormi, et je me suis levée quand le réveil a sonné pour une fois

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A successful morning for both of us
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Une matinée réussie pour nous deux

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let's not get carried away, I haven't left the house yet
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ne nous emballons pas, je ne suis pas encore sortie de la maison

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What are you doing later?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu fais quoi plus tard ?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: THIS AFTERNOON — You have arranged your plans with {{name:hailey}} early enough to be home before {{name:lena}} arrives at five.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: CET APRÈS-MIDI — Tu as organisé tes plans avec {{name:hailey}} assez tôt pour être chez toi avant l'arrivée de {{name:lena}} à cinq heures.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’ll wait in the car then
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je vais attendre dans la voiture alors

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: No point going back and forth
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Pas la peine de faire des allers-retours
Ne mets pas trop de temps.
10 MINUTES PLUS TARD – PAS DE RÉPONSE

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So what, I don’t know how to teach?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Alors quoi, je ne sais pas enseigner ?
Sujette répondant à la domination verbale

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: This doesn't sound like teaching anymore, and I can't shake the worry underneath my jealousy.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ça ne ressemble plus à de l'enseignement, et l'inquiétude derrière ma jalousie ne me quitte pas.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK captured the beginning of the oral act after the professor ordered the subject to suck harder.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK a capturé le début de l'acte oral après que le professeur a ordonné au sujet de sucer plus fort.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m just too good, that’s all.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je suis juste trop douée, c'est tout.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I need to go see my professor
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je dois aller voir mon prof

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Subject showing mixed resistance and compliance
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sujette montrant une résistance et une conformité mêlées

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That mixed reaction worries me, and a report can't tell me whether she's okay.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Cette réaction mitigée m'inquiète, et un rapport ne peut pas me dire si elle va bien.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Following the subject’s teasing, the professor forced a deeper penetration. Subject emitted a muffled reaction.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Suite aux taquineries du sujet, le professeur a forcé une pénétration plus profonde. Le sujet a émis une réaction étouffée.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You’ll only be done when I finish.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu ne finiras que quand je finirai.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But there’s no bus for another hour
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mais il n'y a pas de bus avant une heure

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: The subject took the professor’s challenge and brought him to climax. Post-act verbal exchange confirms mutual anticipation of future sessions.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Le sujet a relevé le défi du professeur et l'a amené au climax. L'échange verbal après l'acte confirme l'anticipation mutuelle de futures sessions.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Next time you better be ready.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: La prochaine fois, tu ferais mieux d'être prête.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I was stuck on the last exercise
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: J'étais bloquée sur le dernier exercice

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: 15 MINUTES LATER — You have driven {{name:hailey}} home. She heads to her room, and you put your keys away.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 15 MINUTES PLUS TARD — Tu as raccompagné {{name:hailey}} chez elle. Elle se dirige vers sa chambre, et tu ranges tes clés.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Can you drive me if your leg isn’t too bad?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu peux me conduire si ta jambe va bien ?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: How long is it going to take?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ça va prendre combien de temps ?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm ready to leave, and I remembered to move my keys into the other bag
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Salut ❤️ Je suis prête à partir, et j'ai pensé à mettre mes clés dans l'autre sac

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I'd let him know when I was home
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai dit que je lui ferais savoir quand je serais chez moi
Tu n'es pas encore chez toi

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. That's not the part I'm having trouble with
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je sais. Ce n'est pas ça qui me pose problème

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The manager has brought her bag over; {{name:lena}} takes out her phone
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Le manager a apporté son sac; {{name:lena}} sort son téléphone

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She sits a little apart from him now, looking down at the screen; both are fully dressed
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Elle est assise un peu à l'écart de lui maintenant, regardant l'écran; tous deux sont entièrement habillés
Capture visuelle archivée

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She's looking at her phone now. I'm waiting for a message from the same person, but I don't know how to read her words the way I did this morning.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Elle regarde son téléphone maintenant. J'attends un message de la même personne, mais je ne sais plus lire ses mots comme ce matin.
HAK//AVIS
Retour à Son Téléphone
Tu pourrais rester la nuit
Non, je rentre chez moi
C'est dommage

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I enjoyed dinner. That's not all I'm thinking about now
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai aimé le dîner. Ce n'est pas tout ce à quoi je pense maintenant

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't have to become an argument
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça ne doit pas devenir une dispute
D'accord, profite de ta soirée

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not arguing with you. I'm thinking about what I'm going to say to him
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne me dispute pas avec toi. Je pense à ce que je vais lui dire

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I need a bit of time on my own
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai besoin d'un peu de temps pour moi

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. Your jacket's by the door
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord. Ta veste est près de la porte

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's a bus in twenty minutes. I'll get that one
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il y a un bus dans vingt minutes. Je vais prendre celui-là

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} stands at the open apartment door with her jacket on and her bag over her shoulder
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} est là, à la porte de l'appartement, avec sa veste et son sac sur l'épaule

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The manager steps aside and look at her ass again

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Une conversation est détectée près de {{name:lena}} à l'intérieur de l'appartement

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'apprécie l'effort. C'est bien mieux que les papiers d'hier

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's food and you haven't mentioned a spreadsheet. That helps
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il y a de la nourriture et tu n'as pas mentionné de tableau. Ça aide

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Dinner ends with an argument about whether his music is chosen for the guests or to show off his speakers. When she finally admits she likes the song, he looks far too satisfied. He clears the plates and leaves her water on the coffee table.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: After putting your phone down, you settle back beside {{name:lena}} and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Après avoir posé ton téléphone, tu te réinstalles à côté de {{name:lena}} et vous vous endormez ensemble.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Alors fais-lui la même chose

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Give him an exercise just as hard
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Donne-lui un exercice tout aussi difficile

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Why do you want to know?
By the way, did you hear {{name:mason}} last night?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Au fait, t'as entendu {{name:mason}} hier soir ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Shut up and come eat before it gets cold
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tais-toi et viens manger avant que ça refroidisse

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Too bad I’m already awake though
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Dommage que je sois déjà réveillée

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You can’t come drag me out of bed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tu peux pas venir me tirer du lit

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 Before my day gets away from me, did you sleep well?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Salut 😊 Avant que ma journée ne m'échappe, tu as bien dormi ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: High praise
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quel compliment

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was thinking about yesterday at your place while I made breakfast
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je pensais à hier chez toi pendant que je préparais le petit déjeuner.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have you finally admitted I was right about the film?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as enfin admis que j'avais raison à propos du film ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No. The bit where I had my head on your shoulder
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non. Le moment où j'avais ma tête sur ton épaule.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Oh. I liked that bit too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oh. J'ai aimé ce moment aussi.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You went quiet for once. It was very nice ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pour une fois, tu n'as rien dit. C'était très agréable ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I could offer that service again
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je pourrais te rendre ce service à nouveau.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Please do. I'd like another afternoon like that soon
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: S'il te plaît, fais-le. J'aimerais avoir un autre après-midi comme ça bientôt.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We'll find one. Have you actually eaten yet?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: On va en trouver un. Tu as déjà mangé ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, before you start. Look
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oui, avant que tu commences. Regarde.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I did. How about you?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oui. Et toi ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu es magnifique

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you 😊 The breakfast is just out of frame, but I promise it exists
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Merci 😊 Le petit déjeuner est juste hors cadre, mais je te promets qu'il existe.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll take your word for it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je te crois sur parole.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There is something I wanted to ask you before I leave
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Il y a quelque chose que je voulais te demander avant de partir.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} messaged me this morning
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} m'a envoyé un message ce matin.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Pretty well, considering I set an alarm and then argued with it twice 😭
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Plutôt bien, sachant que j'avais mis un réveil et que je lui ai tenu tête deux fois 😭

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He's asked if I'd like to come over to his place tonight, just the two of us
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Il m'a demandé si je voulais venir chez lui ce soir, juste nous deux.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No arcade rematch attached to the invitation?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: L'invitation ne comprend pas une revanche à la salle d'arcade ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I checked. Apparently he can spend an evening without a scoreboard 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai vérifié. Apparemment, il peut passer une soirée sans tableau de score 😌.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to go. Is that okay with you?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'aimerais y aller. Ça te va ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He messaged me about meeting again tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Il m'a envoyé un message pour qu'on se revoie ce soir

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The guy from the café?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Le gars du café ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes 😊 He's invited me to have dinner at his place
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oui 😊 Il m'a invitée à dîner chez lui.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently he's ready to defend his cooking in person
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Apparemment, il est prêt à défendre sa cuisine en personne

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you win?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as gagné ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like an evening worth surviving the workday for
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Voilà une soirée qui donne une raison de survivre à la journée de travail

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to go. Are you okay with me going to his place?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: J'aimerais y aller. Ça te dérange si j'y vais ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, sweetheart. I am ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oui, mon chéri. Ça me va ❤️.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I meant what I said. I'd like you to do what you feel like doing
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je pensais ce que j'ai dit. J'aimerais que tu fasses ce dont tu as envie

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know. I still wanted to ask how you felt about tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je sais. Je voulais quand même savoir comment tu te sentais pour ce soir

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm glad you did. You don't need to talk yourself out of something you want
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et je suis content que tu m'aies demandé. Tu n'as pas à te convaincre de renoncer à quelque chose dont tu as envie

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay 😊 I'll go home and get ready first, then head over around eight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: D'accord 😊 Je vais rentrer, me préparer d'abord, puis j'arriverai vers huit heures.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Take care of yourself, though. Keep your phone charged and text me when you get there
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Prends soin de toi, quand même. Garde ton téléphone chargé et envoie-moi un message quand tu arrives

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got up. Interpret that however you like
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je me suis levée. Interprète ça comme tu veux

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will. I've got the address, and I can get a taxi back whenever I need to
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Promis. J'ai l'adresse et je peux prendre un taxi pour rentrer quand j'en ai besoin

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: If I decide to stay instead, I'll let you know too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Si je décide de rester, je te le dirai aussi

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I don't need a message every five minutes. I just want to know you're okay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bien. Je n'ai pas besoin d'un message toutes les cinq minutes. Je veux juste savoir que tu vas bien.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That part I can promise ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça, je peux te le promettre ❤️.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And you can tell me if you're feeling nervous again
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Et tu peux me dire si tu te sens nerveux encore.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A little. But that doesn’t mean I wish you weren’t going
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un peu. Mais ça ne veut pas dire que je voudrais que tu n'y ailles pas.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Work today?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Du travail aujourd'hui ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yesterday helped. I liked knowing we could still just be ourselves together
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hier, ça a aidé. J'aimais savoir qu'on pouvait encore être nous-mêmes ensemble.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We can. Including me stealing your cushion ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: On peut. Y compris moi qui vole ton coussin ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That part was never in doubt
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cette partie n'a jamais été en doute

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're being very calm about this
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu es très calme à ce sujet

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm smiling at my phone, actually 🙂
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je souris à mon téléphone, en fait 🙂

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. Then we have matching stupid faces
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bien. Alors on a des têtes bêtes assorties

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yours is prettier
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: La tienne est plus jolie

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now you're just trying to keep me here ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Là, tu essaies juste de me garder ici ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Until six, then I need to pick up a couple of things on the way home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Jusqu'à six heures, puis je dois prendre quelques trucs en rentrant

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Right, I need to leave before my quiet morning becomes me running down the street
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bon, je dois partir avant de finir par courir dans la rue après cette matinée tranquille

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good day. Eat something proper during your break
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bonne journée. Mange quelque chose de correct pendant ta pause

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look at you taking over my job 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Regarde-toi prendre mon job 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Somebody has to remind you when you’re busy
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Il faut bien que quelqu'un te le rappelle quand tu es occupée

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I love you. I'll text you when I'm home and getting ready ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je t'aime. Je te texterai quand je serai chez moi et prête ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too. Speak tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je t'aime aussi. On se parle ce soir

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm going to be busy for most of the day, so don't be surprised if I'm quiet
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je vais être occupée la plupart de la journée, donc ne sois pas surpris si je suis silencieuse.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll try not to take being abandoned for a shopping list personally
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Je vais essayer de ne pas le prendre personnellement si tu m'abandonnes pour une liste de courses

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It has considerably less interesting things to say than you 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça a beaucoup moins de choses intéressantes à dire que toi 😌.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: EARLY AFTERNOON — You have arranged your plans with {{name:hailey}} early enough to be home before {{name:lena}} arrives at five.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: APRÈS-MIDI — Tu as organisé tes plans avec {{name:hailey}} assez tôt pour être chez toi avant que {{name:lena}} n'arrive à cinq heures.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just don’t react to her nonsense
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ne réagis pas à ses bêtises
{{name:hailey}} arrive et saute dans les bras de {{name:aiden}}
Le sujet a sauté dans les bras de {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: They make this look easy, while I'm still trying to name the knot in my stomach.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Avec eux, tout semble facile, alors que je cherche encore à mettre un mot sur ce nœud à l'estomac.
{{name:hailey}} a sauté dans les bras de {{name:aiden}} à son arrivée

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Come on, at least put on an underwear
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Allez, mets au moins une culotte
{{name:aiden}} glisse sa main en la tenant

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You better not pull out another crazy outfit
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu ferais mieux de ne pas sortir une autre tenue folle

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It’s the reward for the best coach 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: C'est la récompense pour le meilleur coach 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Alright, let’s play before he nags at us
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Allez, jouons avant qu'il ne nous saoule
{{name:hailey}} est de nouveau assise sur les genoux de {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Let's see if you can stay focused too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Voyons si toi aussi tu arrives à rester concentré
Le sujet bouge intentionnellement sur les genoux de {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} kept moving on {{name:aiden}}’s lap during the games
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} n'a pas arrêté de bouger sur les genoux de {{name:aiden}} pendant les jeux

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: LAST GAME – FIRST TO FINISH WINS EVERYTHING
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: DERNIER JEU – LE PREMIER À FINIR GAGNE TOUT
Non, il ne l'a pas fait

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m telling {{name:aiden}} not to look at you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Je dis à {{name:aiden}} de ne pas te regarder

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Subject claiming victory under unusual circumstances
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Le sujet revendique la victoire dans des circonstances inhabituelles

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} claimed {{name:aiden}} finished first during the last game
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} a affirmé que {{name:aiden}} avait fini premier lors du dernier jeu

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: These are honestly the best game afternoons
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Honnêtement, ce sont les meilleurs après-midis de jeu

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Looking forward to the next one

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Le sujet a initié le baiser

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm glad she isn't hiding what she wants, but I need to be honest about my feelings too.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ça me fait plaisir qu'elle ne cache pas ce qu'elle veut, mais j'ai aussi besoin d'être honnête sur ce que je ressens.
{{name:hailey}} a embrassé {{name:aiden}} pour dire au revoir

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Man I was really looking forward to playing again 🔥
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mince, j'avais vraiment hâte de rejouer 🔥

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:ethan}} already came to pick me up
Do you want me to wait for you for dinner?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tu veux que j'attende pour le dîner ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: At least I won’t have to eat alone with {{name:mason}} like last time
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Au moins, je ne vais pas manger seule avec {{name:mason}} comme la dernière fois

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:lena}} is staying over tonight. I'll leave you a plate for when you get back.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:lena}} reste ce soir. Je te laisserai une assiette pour quand tu reviendras.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Thanks. Save me some dessert too.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Merci. Garde-moi un peu de dessert aussi.
Ne mets pas trop de temps

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey 😊 Finally home, and I'm getting ready to leave in a little while. How was your day?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Salut 😊 Enfin chez moi, et je me prépare à partir dans un petit moment. Comment s'est passée ta journée ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not tonight. I came over, I didn’t come to sleep here
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pas ce soir. Je suis venue, je ne suis pas là pour dormir

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s a shame. He gets you after this?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est dommage. Il te voit après ça ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He gets a message that I got home. You get to message me tomorrow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il reçoit un message que je suis rentrée. Tu peux m'envoyer un message demain

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll take that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je prends ça

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Walk me to the door without a clever last remark
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. Accompagne-moi à la porte sans une remarque intelligente

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE GETS HOME
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: APRÈS QU'ELLE SOIT RENTRÉE

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I’m home. I didn’t stay the night
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Salut ❤️ Je suis rentrée. Je ne suis pas restée dormir

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for telling me
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Merci de me l'avoir dit.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We didn’t go all the way. I wanted to tell you what did happen, rather than leave you guessing
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: On n'est pas allés jusqu'au bout. Je voulais te dire ce qui s'est passé, plutôt que de te laisser deviner

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look beautiful
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu es magnifique

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After dinner we kissed on the sofa. Then he put his hand under my dress and fingered me until I came
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Après le dîner, on s'est embrassés sur le canapé. Ensuite, il a mis sa main sous ma robe et m'a fait jouir

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I went down on him after. He came in my mouth. I swallowed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je lui ai fait une fellation après. Il a joui dans ma bouche. J'ai tout avalé

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I came home. That was the whole of it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puis je suis rentrée. C'était tout

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How are you feeling?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Comment tu te sens ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Happy. A little flushed. Glad I went, and glad I left when I meant to
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Heureuse. Un peu rouge. Contente d'y être allée, et contente d'être partie quand je le voulais

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was my decision. I wasn’t trying to get to some next step because I thought I should
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'était ma décision. Je ne cherchais pas à passer à l'étape suivante parce que je pensais que je devais.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m glad you know how you feel about it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis content que tu saches ce que tu ressens

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do. He spent half the evening trying to work out whether he was doing better than you. I didn’t answer
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui. Il a passé la moitié de la soirée à essayer de savoir s'il était meilleur que toi. Je n'ai pas répondu

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s probably kinder than a ranking
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est probablement plus gentil qu'un classement

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was the idea 😌 And I wanted a minute with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'était l'idée 😌 Et je voulais une minute avec toi avant de dormir ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was the answer I was hoping for ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'était la réponse que j'espérais ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m happy. I’m keeping the rest of the details to myself tonight, like we talked about
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis heureuse. Je garde le reste des détails pour moi ce soir, comme on en a parlé.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s okay. Knowing you’re home and comfortable is enough
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est bon. Savoir que tu es chez toi et à l'aise suffit

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am. I still wanted a minute with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je le suis. Je voulais encore une minute avec toi avant de dormir ❤️.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HIS PLACE
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: UN PEU PLUS TARD, CHEZ LUI

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm here 😊 Found the right building and everything's fine
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis là 😊 J'ai trouvé le bon bâtiment et tout va bien

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. How’s the evening looking?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. Comment se passe la soirée ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were there other acceptable answers?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il y avait d'autres réponses acceptables ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It smells like dinner rather than smoke, so I’m choosing to be optimistic 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça sent le dîner plutôt que la fumée, donc je choisis d'être optimiste 😌.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please tell me you didn’t open with that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dis-moi que tu n'as pas commencé par ça.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I said hello first
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non. J'ai d'abord dit bonjour.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very diplomatic
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Très diplomate.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He’s setting the table. Here, your promised proof that I arrived
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il met la table. Tiens, ta preuve promise que je suis arrivée.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Safe, smiling, and not about to be poisoned by a burnt pizza 😊
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: En sécurité, souriante, et pas prête à être empoisonnée par une pizza brûlée 😊.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m reassured about at least two of those things
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis rassurée sur au moins deux de ces choses.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t start 😭 I’m good, really
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ne commence pas 😭 Je vais bien, vraiment.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Enjoy yourself, sweetheart. I’m here if you need anything
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Amuse-toi, mon cœur. Je suis là si tu as besoin de quoi que ce soit.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Several. Yours was the best one
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Plusieurs. La tienne était la meilleure

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️ I’ll check in later. I’m putting my phone away now
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Merci ❤️ Je te donnerai des nouvelles plus tard. Je range mon téléphone maintenant

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: APRÈS QU'ELLE A RANGÉ SON TÉLÉPHONE

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You found it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu l'as trouvé

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: First try. Of course
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Du premier coup. Bien sûr

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I would have come down
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je serais descendue

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. That’s why I didn’t text you from the pavement
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je sais. C'est pour ça que je ne t'ai pas envoyé de message depuis le trottoir

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks much better than the dinner you carefully left out of your photograph
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça a l'air bien mieux que le dîner que tu as soigneusement omis de photographier

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was going to lead with an apology
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'allais commencer par des excuses

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m joking. You can stop apologizing for one burnt pizza
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je rigole. Tu peux arrêter de t'excuser pour une pizza brûlée

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I’ll stop. Sit. I set your side already
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alors je vais arrêter. Assieds-toi. J'ai déjà préparé ton côté

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get there safely, sweetheart
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fais attention sur le trajet, ma chérie

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My side. We’ve had one bookshop and a lot of messages
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mon côté. On a eu une librairie et beaucoup de messages

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was paying attention
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je faisais attention

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DURING DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: PENDANT LE DÎNER

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How have you been?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Comment ça va ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Better than I expected to be. Work was busy. This is the first part of today that feels like mine
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mieux que ce à quoi je m'attendais. Le travail était chargé. C'est la première partie de la journée qui me semble à moi

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And your boyfriend?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et ton copain ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He’s all right. Quieter than he lets on. He spends a lot of time deciding what he’s allowed to want
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il va bien. Plus calme qu'il ne le laisse paraître. Il passe beaucoup de temps à décider ce qu'il a le droit de vouloir.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds tiring
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ça a l'air épuisant.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It is, for him. He used to plan everything so nothing could surprise him. He’s trying not to do that with me
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est le cas pour lui. Avant, il planifiait tout pour ne rien laisser au hasard. Il essaie de ne pas faire ça avec moi.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he know you’re here?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il sait que tu es ici ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will. You'll get your arrival message, I haven't forgotten
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Promis. Tu auras ton message à mon arrivée, je n'ai pas oublié

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I told him I arrived. He doesn’t need a transcript of the dinner
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui. Je lui ai dit que j'étais arrivée. Il n'a pas besoin d'un compte rendu du dîner.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Fair. I wouldn’t want one of his evenings either
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est juste. Je ne voudrais pas d'une de ses soirées non plus.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’d be surprised what you’d recognize
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu serais surprise de ce que tu pourrais reconnaître.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pardon ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nothing. The sauce. This is actually recognizable. I’m impressed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Rien. La sauce. C'est en fait reconnaissable. Je suis impressionnée.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t sound so surprised
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ne fais pas cette tête surprise.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m allowed to be surprised. You sent me a picture of your face instead of the food
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai le droit d'être surprise. Tu m'as envoyé une photo de ta tête au lieu de la nourriture.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The food didn’t know what to do with its face
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La nourriture ne savait pas quoi faire de sa tête.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: If you’re going to stare, you can at least feed me the next bite
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Si tu vas me fixer, tu peux au moins me donner la prochaine bouchée.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Open, then
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ouvre, alors.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Now we’re even with last night’s photos
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voilà. Maintenant, on est quitte avec les photos d'hier soir.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don’t think we’re even
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne pense pas qu'on soit quittes.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t look so proud. You still have sauce on your thumb
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ne fais pas cette tête fière. Tu as encore de la sauce sur ton pouce.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could deal with that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu pourrais gérer ça.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Eat first. You’re very easy to distract
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mange d'abord. Tu es très facile à distraire.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You came over. I’m allowed to be distracted
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu es venu. J'ai le droit d'être distraite.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I came over for dinner. The rest can wait until the plates are clear
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis venue pour le dîner. Le reste peut attendre que les assiettes soient vides.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: APRÈS LE DÎNER

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought the book
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as apporté le livre.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought the book. I’ve even made it past the bookmark
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai apporté le livre. J'ai même dépassé le marque-page.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s more than I expected
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est plus que ce à quoi je m'attendais.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t get used to it. I read one page on the way here and then thought about you instead
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ne t'habitue pas à ça. J'ai lu une page en venant ici et puis j'ai pensé à toi à la place.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s a better review than the book was going to get
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est une meilleure critique que ce que le livre allait recevoir.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Here, I marked the page I wanted to talk to you about
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tiens, j'ai marqué la page dont je voulais te parler.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We can talk about it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: On peut en parler.
