story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Actually, the book can wait. I didn’t come here just to compare notes
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: En fait, le livre peut attendre. Je ne suis pas venue juste pour comparer des notes.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Come here
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Viens ici

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Beyond the Messages
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Au-delà des messages.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s what I was trying to say without typing it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est ce que j'essayais de dire sans le taper.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sit. I want my hand on you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Assieds-toi. Je veux ma main sur toi.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t look so surprised. Last night’s photos were the warning
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ne fais pas cette tête surprise. Les photos d'hier soir étaient l'avertissement.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Her Hand
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sa main

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Slower. Yes, like that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Plus lentement. Oui, comme ça.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your turn. I want your mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: À ton tour. Je veux ta bouche.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: His Mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sa Bouche

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Don’t stop
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voilà. Ne t'arrête pas.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m close
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis proche.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She Comes
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Elle vient

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. That was really good
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord. C'était vraiment bien.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still got it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je l'ai toujours

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Quiet. I got outside for a bit, then came back to the incredibly demanding task of doing nothing
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tranquille. Je suis sortie un moment, puis je suis revenue à la tâche incroyablement exigeante de ne rien faire

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Shut up
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tais-toi

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m not staying the night. I should go while I still mean that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne reste pas cette nuit. Je devrais partir tant que je le pense encore

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Message me tomorrow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Envoie-moi un message demain

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Peut-être

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE GETS HOME
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: APRÈS QU'ELLE SOIT RENTRÉE

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I’m home. I didn’t stay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Salut ❤️ Je suis rentrée. Je ne suis pas restée

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. Thank you for letting me know
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord. Merci de m'avoir prévenu

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We didn’t go all the way. I wanted to tell you what did happen
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: On n'est pas allées jusqu'au bout. Je voulais te dire ce qui s'est passé

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After dinner we kissed by the window. I used my hand on him
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Après le dîner, on s'est embrassées près de la fenêtre. J'ai utilisé ma main sur lui

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HIS PLACE
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: UN PEU PLUS TARD, CHEZ LUI

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then he went down on me until I came. I came home after that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puis il m'a fait plaisir jusqu'à ce que je jouisse. Je suis rentrée après ça

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How are you feeling about it?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Comment tu te sens par rapport à ça ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Happy I went, and happy I didn’t keep everything behind a screen
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. Je suis contente d'être allée, et contente de ne pas avoir tout gardé derrière un écran

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We talked over dinner first. By the time I decided, I knew that was what I wanted. I also knew I wanted to sleep in my own bed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: On a d'abord discuté pendant le dîner. Quand j'ai décidé, je savais que c'était ce que je voulais. Je savais aussi que je voulais dormir dans mon propre lit

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m glad you felt comfortable with him
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis content que tu te sois sentie à l'aise avec lui

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did. The dinner was good too, in case you were still worried about that 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui. Le dîner était bon aussi, au cas où tu t'inquiéterais encore pour ça 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll stop preparing the restaurant rescue plan, then
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je peux arrêter de préparer le plan de secours au restaurant, alors

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep the plan. We could use it for ourselves sometime ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Garde le plan. On pourrait l'utiliser pour nous un jour ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm at {{name:aiden}}'s 😊 All good, as promised
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis chez {{name:aiden}} 😊 Tout va bien, comme promis

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m happy. I’m keeping the details to myself tonight, but I wanted you to know I got home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis contente. Je garde les détails pour moi ce soir, mais je voulais que tu saches que je suis rentrée

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s fine. You don’t have to tell me more than that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est bon. Tu n'as pas besoin de me dire plus que ça

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️ It was a good decision to go
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Merci ❤️ C'était une bonne décision d'y aller

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? How are you doing?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et toi ? Comment ça va ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Found it easily?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu l'as trouvé facilement ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I needed a second before answering, but I’m okay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai eu besoin d'une seconde avant de répondre, mais ça va

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It feels different now we’re actually here. I’d rather say that than pretend I never get nervous
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est différent maintenant qu'on en est vraiment là. Je préfère le dire plutôt que de faire semblant de ne jamais être nerveux

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’d rather you said it too. Would you like me to call?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je préférerais que tu le dises aussi. Tu veux que je t'appelle ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I’m glad we’re talking. I just needed a moment
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non, je suis content qu'on parle. J'avais juste besoin d'un moment.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. You can tell me if that changes ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: D'accord. Tu peux me dire si ça change ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will. I’m glad you had a good evening
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je le ferai. Je suis content que tu aies passé une bonne soirée.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? How are you doing?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et toi ? Comment ça va ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I liked seeing your message come in
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. J'aimais voir ton message arriver.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. He opened the door holding two plates
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui. Il a ouvert la porte en tenant deux assiettes

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re very sweet tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu es très tendre ce soir

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have my moments 🙂
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai mes moments 🙂

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You do. More than I give you credit for sometimes ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est vrai. Plus que je ne te le reconnais parfois ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll try not to ruin this one
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je vais essayer de ne pas gâcher celui-ci.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I love you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je t'aime.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I love you too ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je t'aime aussi ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll message you in the morning, before you start making plans to keep my spoon
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je t'enverrai un message demain matin, avant que tu ne commences à faire des plans pour garder ma cuillère.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought it was mine now
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je pensais que c'était à moi maintenant.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Absolutely not. Neither is my side of the sofa 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Absolument pas. Ni mon côté du canapé 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Actual plates. I was mentally preparing to eat straight from a takeaway box 😭
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: De vraies assiettes. Je me préparais mentalement à manger directement dans une boîte à emporter 😭

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Both are safe. Get some sleep, sweetheart
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Les deux sont en sécurité. Dors un peu, mon cœur.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And thanks again for all of that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et merci encore pour tout ça

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't thank me. We both wanted it. I’m glad we’re doing this together ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ne me remercie pas. On le voulait tous les deux. Je suis contente qu'on fasse ça ensemble ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bonne nuit

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bonne nuit ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He’s making an effort, then
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il fait un effort, alors

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently. One quick picture while he puts them down
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Apparemment. Une petite photo pendant qu'il les pose

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Safe, indoors, and about to be fed 😊 You can stop wondering whether I got lost
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: En sécurité, à l'intérieur, et sur le point d'être nourrie 😊 Tu peux arrêter de te demander si je me suis perdue

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for letting me know. Enjoy your evening
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Merci de m'avoir prévenue. Profite de ta soirée

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please accept my sympathy 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as toute ma compassion 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️ I’m putting my phone away now. Speak later
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Promis ❤️ Je range mon téléphone maintenant. On se parle plus tard

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m here if you need anything
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis là si tu as besoin de quoi que ce soit

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: APRÈS QU'ELLE A RANGÉ SON TÉLÉPHONE

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have I passed the inspection?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ai-je réussi l'inspection ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I arrived. I wasn’t writing a review of your home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai dit que j'étais arrivée. Je n'écrivais pas une critique de ta maison

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. The chair with everything piled on it would lose me a star
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. La chaise avec tout empilé dessus me ferait perdre une étoile

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai remarqué

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course you did
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien sûr que tu l'as fait

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He told me to have a good evening. You could start by feeding me
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il m'a dit de passer une bonne soirée. Tu pourrais commencer par me nourrir

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I bought dinner on the way home. I’m not pretending I suddenly learned to cook
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai acheté le dîner en rentrant. Je ne fais pas semblant d'avoir appris à cuisiner du jour au lendemain

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was work?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Comment s'est passé le travail ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honest and organized. That’s an unexpected combination
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Honnête et organisé. C'est une combinaison inattendue

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Careful. Another compliment and I’ll think you like being here
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Attention. Un autre compliment et je vais penser que tu aimes être ici

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do. You can accept that without building a whole speech around it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est le cas. Tu peux l'accepter sans en faire tout un discours

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll get the food
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je vais chercher la nourriture

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Excellent decision
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Excellente décision

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DURING DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: PENDANT LE DÎNER

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re watching my mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu regardes ma bouche

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re taking too long. Open
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu mets trop de temps. Ouvre

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he get fed like this, or is this a special service?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il est nourri comme ça, ou c'est un service spécial ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re stalling
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu fais traîner

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Busy enough that I kept finding my coffee cold whenever I remembered it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Assez chargée pour que mon café soit froid chaque fois que je repensais à lui

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And now you’ve got sauce on your thumb
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Et maintenant tu as de la sauce sur ton pouce

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then deal with it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alors gère ça

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Gladly. He doesn’t get this part, does he?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Avec plaisir. Il n'a pas droit à cette partie, n'est-ce pas ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Eat. Then you can be annoying somewhere more useful
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mange. Ensuite, tu pourras être embêtant ailleurs où c'est plus utile

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: APRÈS LE DÎNER

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, is that the strip from the photo booth?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Attends, c'est la bande de la cabine photo ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It looked better there than in my pocket
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Elle avait meilleure mine là-bas que dans ma poche

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You put the one with your eyes closed at the front
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu as mis celle où tu as les yeux fermés devant

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn’t looking at the camera
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne regardais pas l'objectif

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je me souviens

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But everything on my list is done, and my phone is charged
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mais tout ce qui était sur ma liste est fait, et mon téléphone est chargé

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you want me to turn it around?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu veux que je le retourne ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. Leave it there
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non. Laisse-le là

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’ve gone quiet
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu es devenu silencieux

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that you kept it somewhere you’d see it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'aime que tu l'aies gardé quelque part où tu peux le voir

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked the evening. Keeping the pictures seemed obvious
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai aimé la soirée. Garder les photos semblait évident

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was a nice answer
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'était une belle réponse

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can occasionally manage one. Better than a briefing?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je peux en gérer un de temps en temps. Mieux qu'un briefing ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Come here before you spoil it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Viens ici avant que tu ne gâches tout.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Here?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ici ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You know what I mean
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu sais ce que je veux dire

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You sound pleased to have the evening back
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: On dirait que tu es content de retrouver ta soirée

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No Need for a Score
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pas besoin de score.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was that the reward for a nice answer?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'était la récompense pour une belle réponse ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. That was because I wanted to kiss you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non. C'était parce que je voulais t'embrasser.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even better. Does he get kissed like that after dinner?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Encore mieux. Il reçoit des bisous comme ça après le dîner ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stop talking. Sit, and keep your hands where I put them
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Arrête de parler. Assieds-toi, et garde tes mains où je les ai mises

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Under the dress?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sous la robe ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: ON THE SOFA
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: SUR LE CANAPÉ

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Two fingers?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Deux doigts ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Slow, then less slow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui. Lentement, puis moins lentement

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very. Let me show you something before I put my shoes on
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oui, très. Laisse-moi te montrer quelque chose avant que je mette mes chaussures

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell me if I’m doing better than he does
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dis-moi si je fais mieux que lui

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m not answering that. Keep going
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne réponds pas à ça. Continue

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Under the Dress
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sous la robe

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Don’t you dare keep score of that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voilà. N'ose pas faire le compte

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re close
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu es proche

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. Don’t stop
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je sais. Ne t'arrête pas

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sound. Does he get that too?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ce son. Il le ressent aussi ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sit back. My turn
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Repose-toi. Mon tour

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HER TURN
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: À SON TOUR

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don’t have to—
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu n'es pas obligé de—

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I want to
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je sais. J'ai envie de

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is this the part where I lose to him on purpose?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est la partie où je perds contre lui exprès ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This is the part where you stop talking. Hands in my hair. Don’t pull me off unless I say
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'est le moment où tu arrêtes de parler. Mains dans mes cheveux. Ne me tire pas à moins que je ne le dise

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Between His Knees
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entre Ses Genoux

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m close
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Je suis proche

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Stay there
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bien. Reste là

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: In Her Mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dans Sa Bouche

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You didn’t have to swallow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu n'étais pas obligé de tout avaler

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to. Don’t look that pleased
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: J'en avais envie. Ne fais pas cette tête satisfaite

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Reste

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There 😊 I managed to look like I had longer than twenty minutes to get ready
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voilà 😊 J'ai réussi à avoir l'air d'avoir eu plus de vingt minutes pour me préparer

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It’s to reward me for being so attentive to my studies 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: C’est pour me récompenser d’être si attentive à mes études 😌
Je sais que ça te plaît

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I still have the rest of the reward to enjoy
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: J'ai encore le reste de la récompense à savourer

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You really sent that to him?
How did the practice test go?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Comment s'est passé le test blanc ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: She seems sure of herself here, and I'm still learning what that means for me.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Elle semble sûre d'elle ici, et j'apprends encore ce que ça signifie pour moi.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: {{name:ethan}} giving cunnilingus as a reward after the successful practice test
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: {{name:ethan}} fait du cunnilingus en récompense après le test blanc réussi

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Careful… if you finish too early you’ll get penalty points
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Fais gaffe… si tu finis trop tôt, tu vas prendre des points de pénalité

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re not only good at studies…
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: T'es pas seulement doué pour les études…

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: For the next lessons… what’s the objective?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Pour les prochaines leçons… quel est l'objectif ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But we’ll have to go deeper into the subjects
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Mais on va devoir approfondir les sujets

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Then I’m really looking forward to going deeper into all of that 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Alors j'ai vraiment hâte d'approfondir tout ça 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But I passed it with flying colors 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Mais je l'ai réussi haut la main 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Not too disappointed you didn’t get the punishment?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Pas trop déçue de ne pas avoir eu la punition ?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Did you enjoy this little day?
The part where you watched everything during the game session 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: La partie où tu as tout regardé pendant la session de jeu 😌
Et toi, tu aimes ça aussi

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Looking forward to the next training session 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: J'ai hâte à la prochaine séance d'entraînement 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: If you admit properly I’ll show you something even better
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Si tu admets vraiment, je te montrerai quelque chose d'encore mieux

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Look what your best friend left me like when he left
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Regarde comment ton meilleur ami m'a laissée quand il est parti

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: The part where I sent you a photo of my reward 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: La partie où je t'ai envoyé une photo de ma récompense 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And that’s the kind of crazy you love
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Et c'est ce genre de folie que tu aimes

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Be ready to see even more
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Prépare-toi à en voir encore plus

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I don’t know what you’re talking about
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Je ne sais pas de quoi tu parles

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Too bad… I had another surprise for you if you liked it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Dommage... J'avais une autre surprise pour toi si ça t'avait plu

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: For finally admitting it, you get a reward too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Pour enfin l'admettre, tu as aussi droit à une récompense

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: After putting your phone down, you settle back beside {{name:lena}} and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Après avoir posé ton téléphone, tu te réinstalles à côté de {{name:lena}} et vous vous endormez ensemble.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Good morning ☀️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Bonjour ☀️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Trying to wake up slowly
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Essayer de se réveiller lentement

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Of course you are 😏
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Bien sûr que tu l'es 😏

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I swear you never rest your thumbs
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Je jure que tu ne reposes jamais tes pouces.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're happy when my fingers are used to text you, no?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Tu es heureux(se) quand mes doigts sont utilisés pour t'envoyer des messages, non ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That's true ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: C'est vrai ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: By the way…
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Au fait…

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: About the tickets for our trip
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: À propos des billets pour notre voyage

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I don't even know what to do with them now
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Je ne sais même pas quoi faire avec eux maintenant.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: What do you think I should do?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Que penses-tu que je devrais faire ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Give them to someone who really needs a break
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Donnez-les à quelqu'un qui a vraiment besoin d'une pause.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Keep them and why not go with {{name:aiden}}?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Garde-les et pourquoi ne pas y aller avec {{name:aiden}} ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Keep them and find someone else to go with
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Garde-les et trouve quelqu'un d'autre avec qui y aller.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Hey you 🙂
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Salut toi 🙂

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That's actually really kind of you 😊
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: C'est vraiment gentil de ta part 😊

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You always try to do the right thing
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Tu essaies toujours de faire ce qu'il faut.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Of course I am, look at how much luck I have these days thanks to karma 😅
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Bien sûr que je le suis, regarde combien de chance j'ai ces jours-ci grâce au karma 😅

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Well having me as your girlfriend is not good enough?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Eh bien, m'avoir comme petite amie n'est pas suffisant ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: It is! I'm the luckiest man in the world ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: C'est vrai ! Je suis l'homme le plus chanceux du monde ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Really?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Vraiment ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I swear
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Je jure

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I'm also the luckiest girl in the world
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Je suis aussi la fille la plus chanceuse du monde.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: How are you feeling this morning?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Comment te sens-tu ce matin ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: For having a vegetable as your man? Not sure about that 😄
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Pour avoir un légume comme homme ? Pas sûr de ça 😄

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You know how much I love vegetables 😉
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Tu sais combien j'aime les légumes 😉

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're too sweet
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Tu es trop gentil.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: With {{name:aiden}}?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: With {{name:aiden}}?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Why?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Pourquoi ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: He always wanted to go to that island and at least he has his two legs
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Il a toujours voulu aller sur cette île et au moins il a ses deux jambes.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I don't think I will be very comfortable going alone with him
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Je ne pense pas que je me sentirai très à l'aise d'y aller seul avec lui.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I'm okay
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Je vais bien

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Even if he is my friend and your best friend, it feels weird no?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Même s'il est mon ami et ton meilleur ami, c'est bizarre non ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Now that you said it like that I guess it does
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Maintenant que tu l'as dit comme ça, je suppose que ça l'est.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: But I trust you both and I don't want you to miss the trip just because of me and at the same time he will finally have the trip to the island he wanted so much
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Mais je vous fais confiance tous les deux et je ne veux pas que vous manquiez le voyage à cause de moi, et en même temps, il aura enfin le voyage sur l'île qu'il voulait tant.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're right I'm thinking too much
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Tu as raison, je pense trop.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: And it is in more than a month so I got time to think about it
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Et c'est dans plus d'un mois, donc j'ai le temps d'y réfléchir.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Exactly
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Exactement

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You won't be jealous?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Tu ne seras pas jaloux ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Of course I will
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Bien sûr que je le ferai

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: My best friend going to the vacation we prepared and spending time with my girlfriend in my place, who on earth won't be jealous!
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Mon meilleur ami part en vacances que nous avons préparées et passe du temps avec ma copine chez moi, qui sur terre ne serait pas jaloux !

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That's true, and sweet it shows that you care a lot about me ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: C'est vrai, et c'est mignon ça montre que tu tiens beaucoup à moi ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: What about you?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Et toi ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That's called love
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Ça s'appelle l'amour

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're too much of a sweet talker
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Tu es trop un charmeur.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Only with you ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Seulement avec toi ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You better 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Tu ferais mieux 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Someone else?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Quelqu'un d'autre ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That feels a little cold 😕
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Ça fait un peu froid 😕

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Sorry I didn't mean it that way
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Désolé, je ne voulais pas dire ça comme ça.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I'm good 😊
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Je vais bien 😊

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: It's more like you need to find someone else who would like to go to the island with you so you can enjoy the trip even if it's not with me
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: C'est plutôt que tu dois trouver quelqu'un d'autre qui aimerait aller sur l'île avec toi pour que tu puisses profiter du voyage même si ce n'est pas avec moi.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Yeah…
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Ouais…

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're upset?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Tu es contrarié ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: No
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Non

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I mean I just wasn't expecting you to say something like that
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Je ne m'attendais pas à ce que tu dises quelque chose comme ça.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Why? I did not mean it in a bad way
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Pourquoi ? Je ne le pensais pas de manière négative.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I know sorry I made a big deal out of nothing
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Je sais, désolé, j'ai fait tout un plat pour rien.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: It's just that I'm sad that I won't go with you
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: C'est juste que je suis triste de ne pas pouvoir y aller avec toi.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Me too and you know it
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Moi aussi et tu le sais.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: But next time as soon as I'm healed we will go together ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Mais la prochaine fois, dès que je serai guéri, nous irons ensemble ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Still in bed actually 🛌
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Encore au lit en fait 🛌

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I hope so
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: J'espère que oui

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Promise
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Promesse

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Also
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Aussi

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I’m coming over today
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Je viens aujourd'hui

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Sasha and I postponed our plans, so I can spend the day with you 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Sasha et moi avons reporté notre sortie, alors je peux passer la journée avec toi 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You really don’t have to come all the way here on your only day off
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Tu n'as vraiment pas besoin de venir ici pour ton seul jour de congé.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I don’t want you to feel like you have to
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Je ne veux pas que tu te sentes obligé de

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I know
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Je sais

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: But I want to
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Mais je veux...

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I miss you
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Tu me manques

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: And I’d come anyway even if you tried to stop me 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Et je viendrais quand même même si tu essayais de m'arrêter 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Thank you
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Merci

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That really means a lot
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Cela signifie vraiment beaucoup.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: See you in half an hour ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: À tout à l'heure ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: 5 MINUTES PLUS TARD

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Saving last night's outfit for my rescheduled day out with Sasha. Plans change, good choices stay.
