story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Playing on the PlayStation
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Jouer sur la PlayStation

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Are you awake?
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Es-tu réveillé ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: It’s going to be okay. Don’t overthink it
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Ça va aller. Ne te prends pas trop la tête.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: And if something happens, we’ll figure out a solution together
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Et si quelque chose se passe, nous trouverons une solution ensemble.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Yes..  you're right
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Oui.. tu as raison

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: By the way, {{name:lena}} is coming over today
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Au fait, {{name:lena}} vient aujourd'hui.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: That’s good
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: C'est bien

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: You shouldn’t stay alone too much
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Tu ne devrais pas rester seul trop longtemps.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: I’ll come by later and air your room a little
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Je passerai plus tard et aérerai un peu ta chambre.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: It needs fresh air anyway
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Il a besoin d'air frais de toute façon.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Thank you
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Merci

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: You’re welcome
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: De rien

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: How is the leg this morning?
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Comment va la jambe ce matin ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: It’s okay. Still a little stiff
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: C'est bon. Encore un peu raide.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: That’s normal
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: C'est normal

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Just don’t try to be brave and overdo it
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Ne tente pas d'être courageux et de trop en faire.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: How are you?
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Comment ça va ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: I’m alright
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Je vais bien

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Stress is starting to get to me about going back to work, but I’ll manage
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Le stress commence à me peser à propos de mon retour au travail, mais je vais m'en sortir.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: You don’t need to worry about me
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Tu n'as pas besoin de t'inquiéter pour moi.

story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.source: Are you sure?
story/DAY3/DAY3_02_EVELYN_MORNING.json::.translation: Es-tu sûr ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do one chill match later, no ranked sweat
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Fais un match tranquille plus tard, pas de sueur classée.

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: One game later if you want. Doctor mode orders
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Une partie plus tard si tu veux. Ordres du mode docteur

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Ping me if your leg hurts later
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Fais-moi signe si ta jambe te fait mal plus tard.

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: How are you actually doing this morning?

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Encore en train de me réveiller

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Head is still heavy from yesterday
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: La tête est encore lourde d'hier.

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: I almost called because your replies were slow
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: J'ai failli appeler parce que tes réponses étaient lentes.

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: If those guys ever show up again, I swear I'll break their...
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Si ces gars réapparaissent un jour, je jure que je vais leur casser...

story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Forget it, bad idea. I am trying to stay calm
story/DAY3/DAY3_03_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Oublie ça, mauvaise idée. J'essaie de rester calme.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Où est {{name:hailey}} ?
Tu es la police de la salle de sport maintenant ? 🙄

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: Stop acting like everything is an attack
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Arrête de faire comme si tout était une attaque.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: I was just asking because I've seen you going more often lately
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Je demandais juste parce que je t'ai vu y aller plus souvent dernièrement.
Ne me fais pas la leçon.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: I'm getting in shape and it takes work
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Je me mets en forme et ça demande du travail.
Tu devrais aussi essayer.
Regarde-toi en ce moment.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: And don't blame the leg for all of it
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Et ne blâme pas la jambe pour tout ça.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: I know what my body looks like
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Je sais à quoi ressemble mon corps.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: Right now I can't do any sport
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: En ce moment, je ne peux pas faire de sport.
J'ai besoin de mon chargeur de rechange.

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: But when I'm healed, I'll get back in shape
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Mais quand je serai guéri, je retrouverai la forme.
Nous verrons
Est-ce qu'elle est déjà partie ?
Je ne l'ai pas vue depuis le petit-déjeuner.
Super

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: If you see her, tell her I want it back before lunch
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Si tu la vois, dis-lui que je veux que ce soit de retour avant le déjeuner.
Compris 👍

story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.source: You're going to the gym today?
story/DAY3/DAY3_04_MASON_HAILEY_CHECK.js.translation: Tu vas à la salle de sport aujourd'hui ?
Peut-être
Pourquoi ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: In my '{{name:hailey}} owes me one' book
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: Dans mon livre '{{name:hailey}} me doit une'

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: Thanks for dealing with my rugby mess yesterday 🏉
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: Merci d'avoir géré mon bazar de rugby hier 🏉

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: I know I kind of dropped it on you like a little menace 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: Je sais que je t'ai un peu balancé ça comme une petite menace 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.source: You made it sound like a house emergency
story/DAY3/DAY3_05_HAILEY_RUGBY_THANKS.j.translation: Tu as fait ça sonner comme une urgence à la maison.
C'était une urgence à la maison 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.source: Or I'll climb through the window
story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.translation: Ou je passerai par la fenêtre.
Et ne te fais pas mal 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.source: I'm really fast when I want something
story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.translation: Je suis vraiment rapide quand je veux quelque chose.

story/DAY3/DAY3_06_LENA_DOOR.json::steps.source: And I want to see youuu

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: And I can move a little by myself already
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Et je peux déjà bouger un peu tout seul.
Cela prend juste plus de temps.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: I just don’t want you to push it and hurt yourself because nobody is around
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Je ne veux juste pas que tu forces et que tu te blesses parce que personne n'est là.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: So ask if you need anything
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Alors demande si tu as besoin de quoi que ce soit.
À tout à l'heure pour le dîner
Profite bien de ton temps avec {{name:lena}} !

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: Everything is folded. I’ll give it to you when {{name:lena}} is gone
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Tout est plié. Je te le donnerai quand {{name:lena}} sera partie.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: Also, don’t forget. I start work again tomorrow
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Aussi, n'oublie pas. Je recommence le travail demain.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: So in the afternoon I won’t be here to help you
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Donc cet après-midi, je ne serai pas là pour t'aider.

story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.source: But {{name:hailey}} and {{name:mason}} will be here to help me
story/DAY3/DAY3_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_LAUN.translation: Mais {{name:hailey}} et {{name:mason}} seront là pour m'aider.

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Did you hurt yourself when you came to open the door?
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: T'es-tu blessé en venant ouvrir la porte ?
Mais ça en valait la peine ❤️
La prochaine fois, ne fais pas ça.

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I’ll call {{name:hailey}} or {{name:evelyn}} if they’re there
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Je vais appeler {{name:hailey}} ou {{name:evelyn}} s'ils sont là.
Ne t'inquiète pas. Je vais bien 😊
Hmm… fais attention la prochaine fois

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Anyway, I’m sending you the photos I took today 📸
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Quoi qu'il en soit, je t'envoie les photos que j'ai prises aujourd'hui 📸

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: And send me the ones you took 😏
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Et envoie-moi ceux que tu as pris 😏
Moi ? Je ne me souviens pas de ça.

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: And if I did… I’d keep them for myself 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Et si je le faisais… je les garderais pour moi 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I don’t care 😤 Send them or I curse you forever
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Je m'en fiche 😤 Envoie-les ou je te maudis pour toujours

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Oh wow 😳 You took more than I thought
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Oh wow 😳 Tu as pris plus que je ne le pensais

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I look ugly… you should delete them
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Je fais moche… tu devrais les supprimer

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: You’re the most beautiful girl I know ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Tu es la plus belle fille que je connaisse ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: But thank you… that means a lot 🥺
Thank you for taking care of me today
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Merci de prendre soin de moi aujourd'hui.

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: Stop… that’s too many compliments 😅, but i feel the same
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Arrête… c'est trop de compliments 😅, mais je ressens la même chose.

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: I’m going to take a shower now 🚿
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Je vais prendre une douche maintenant 🚿
Alors je vais manger quelque chose.
Envoie-moi un selfie sous la douche ? 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: In the shower? You never stop!
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: Sous la douche ? Tu ne t'arrêtes jamais !
Peut-être 😌 Si tu te comportes bien
Repose-toi pendant que je suis parti, d'accord ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.source: It was the best part of my week
story/DAY3/DAY3_08_LENA_EVENING_HOME.jso.translation: C'était le meilleur moment de ma semaine.

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: But seriously, if you need water, food, or someone to reach a shelf because your leg is being dramatic, just say it 🤍
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Mais sérieusement, si tu as besoin d'eau, de nourriture, ou de quelqu'un pour atteindre une étagère parce que ta jambe fait des siennes, dis-le simplement 🤍

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: Try not to abuse the service though 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Essayez de ne pas abuser du service cependant 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: {{name:evelyn}} told me she starts work again tomorrow
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: {{name:evelyn}} m'a dit qu'elle reprend le travail demain.

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: So if you need something while she's out, she said you'll have to beg for my help 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Alors si tu as besoin de quelque chose pendant qu'elle est sortie, elle a dit que tu devras supplier pour mon aide 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: That sounds surprisingly unlike something {{name:evelyn}} would say
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Cela semble étonnamment peu comme quelque chose que {{name:evelyn}} dirait.

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: She said it, I was there 😌
Alright, alright, maybe she didn't say anything about begging 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: D'accord, d'accord, peut-être qu'elle n'a rien dit sur le fait de supplier 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: Wow, how quick of you to turn to the truth
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Wow, comme tu es rapide à te tourner vers la vérité

story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.source: Please appreciate how much personal growth this is 😇
story/DAY3/DAY3_09_HAILEY_EVELYN_ABSENCE.translation: Apprécie à quel point je grandis personnellement 😇

story/DAY3/DAY3_10_MASON_EVELYN_FOOD_LEG.translation: Bouge doucement pour que {{name:evelyn}} arrête de s'inquiéter.
Tu veux une assiette à l'étage ?
Je ne suis que le messager.

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: I need to pick an outfit for tomorrow
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Je dois choisir une tenue pour demain.

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: You look good in all of them
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Tu as l'air bien dans tous.

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: I don’t want to look out of place
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Je ne veux pas avoir l'air déplacé.

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: I feel a little better now
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Je me sens un peu mieux maintenant

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: Yes, see you and good luck
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Oui, à bientôt et bonne chance

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: It’s been so long that I don’t even know what to wear anymore
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Ça fait si longtemps que je ne sais même plus quoi porter.

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: Just tell me which one makes me look the least ugly
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Dis-moi juste lequel me rend le moins moche.

story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.source: Show me and I’ll tell you which one looks best
story/DAY3/DAY3_11_EVELYN_NIGHT_OUTFIT_H.translation: Montre-moi et je te dirai lequel a l'air le mieux.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Talk nicely or I delete the photo 😈
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Parle gentiment ou je supprime la photo 😈

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Now I feel clean and sleepy 😌
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Maintenant, je me sens propre et somnolent 😌

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: But I may have a little gift for you
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Mais j'ai peut-être un petit cadeau pour toi.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Now I need to see it
You don't even know what it is 😶
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Tu ne sais même pas ce que c'est 😶

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: If it's from you it's already perfect
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Si c'est de toi, c'est déjà parfait.
Queue de cheval ou cheveux attachés ? 🤭
Je n'ai même pas de mots 😳

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And don't show them to anyone
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Et ne les montre à personne

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: So now I can talk to you until I fall asleep 💤
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Alors maintenant je peux te parler jusqu'à ce que je m'endorme 💤

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Emotional reassurance strengthens trust and intimacy
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: L'assurance émotionnelle renforce la confiance et l'intimité.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Playful ambiguity detected, tension may increase attraction
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ambiguïté ludique détectée, la tension peut augmenter l'attraction.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Critical moment detected, distancing may weaken emotional security
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Moment critique détecté, la distanciation peut affaiblir la sécurité émotionnelle.
Bien sûr que je ne le ferai pas ❤️
À quel point es-tu en colère exactement ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: That's why I sent them to you
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: C'est pourquoi je te les ai envoyés.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I loved having you here with me
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: J'ai adoré t'avoir ici avec moi

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: When you're better we should go somewhere together
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Quand tu iras mieux, nous devrions aller quelque part ensemble.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: We'll do it when you're completely healed
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Nous le ferons quand tu seras complètement guéri.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: To make up for the missed trip

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ce ne sont que des pyjamas 🙄

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: She has to go back to work tomorrow
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Elle doit retourner au travail demain.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Money is getting tight and they need her
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: L'argent devient serré et ils ont besoin d'elle.
Et le manager, il est toujours là ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I just hope it's not like last time
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: J'espère juste que ce n'est pas comme la dernière fois.
Même en pyjama, tu es belle.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And when you're better you'll be able to help her
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Et quand tu iras mieux, tu pourras l'aider.
Je commence à avoir sommeil maintenant
Une bonne image de bonne nuit s'il te plaît ?

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I’m removing my makeup before bed
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Je retire mon maquillage avant d'aller au lit.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I'm sure they'll feel the same so don't worry
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Je suis sûr qu'ils ressentiront la même chose, alors ne t'inquiète pas.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I made breakfast and it's ready
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: J'ai préparé le petit déjeuner et c'est prêt.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Do you want me to bring it to you?
Are you going to take a shower this morning?
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Vas-tu prendre une douche ce matin ?
Si tu le fais, fais attention.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: How are you feeling this morning?

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: {{name:hailey}} a réussi à mettre de l'eau partout !

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: The store doesn't want to take her back
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Le magasin ne veut pas la reprendre.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: So we will have to endure her mess until we die
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Donc nous devrons endurer son désordre jusqu'à ce que nous mourions.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Or we find some crazy guy who wants her
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Ou nous trouvons un gars fou qui la veut.
Fais juste attention où tu mets les pieds, d'accord ?

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I will be a bit busy this morning
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Je serai un peu occupé ce matin.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I need to prepare everything for going back to work
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Je dois préparer tout pour retourner au travail.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: My bag my clothes and a few documents
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Mon sac, mes vêtements et quelques documents.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: So if you need something ask {{name:hailey}} or {{name:mason}}
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Alors si tu as besoin de quelque chose, demande à {{name:hailey}} ou {{name:mason}}.
À moins que ce ne soit urgent

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Just do what you have to do
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Fais juste ce que tu as à faire

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Thank you for taking care of me
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Merci de prendre soin de moi

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: The same stress as a first day I guess
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Le même stress qu'un premier jour, je suppose.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: But I'm happy to see my colleagues!
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Mais je suis heureux de voir mes collègues !

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Hello mister secretary 😌
(I'm a grown woman, I'm a grown woman 😌)
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: (Je suis une femme adulte, je suis une femme adulte 😌)

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: ( Don't kill him 😇)
How many of you are there in your head?
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Combien vous êtes dans ta tête ?

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Enough to bury you in the garden 🌸
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Assez pour te enterrer dans le jardin 🌸

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Anyway
How are you doing today?
Better than yesterday
Still slow though
Slow is fine, or more like your normal speed 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Lent, c'est bien, ou plutôt comme ta vitesse normale 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: You better train to run fast
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Tu ferais mieux de t'entraîner à courir vite.

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Random warning 😇
You'll see what happens to bad frogs when I'm fully healed
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Tu verras ce qui arrive aux mauvaises grenouilles quand je serai complètement rétablie.

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Threats don't reach my princess ears
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Les menaces n'atteignent pas mes oreilles de princesse.

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Goodbye peasant 😇
I need either {{name:aiden}} or {{name:mason}} to take me to rugby on Wednesday
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: J'ai besoin de {{name:aiden}} ou {{name:mason}} pour me conduire au rugby mercredi.

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: I'm planning ahead because apparently that's what mature women do 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Je planifie à l'avance parce qu'apparemment c'est ce que font les femmes matures 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Who are you?
What have you done to my {{name:hailey}}
How dare you say that 😤
That's not how a proper majordomo is supposed to behave 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Ce n'est pas comme ça qu'un bon majordome est censé se comporter 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Are you a princess?
More like a frog to me
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Plus comme une grenouille pour moi.

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: You can stay if you want
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Tu peux rester si tu veux.
Elles ont une discussion entre filles
Ils n'arrêtent pas de parler de {{name:aiden}}.

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: They say he's the most handsome guy at uni
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Ils disent qu'il est le gars le plus beau de l'université.

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: We both know how he really is
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Nous savons tous les deux comment il est vraiment.

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: Still, it's true that he's handsome
But I only look at you so I don't care 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Mais je ne regarde que toi, donc je m'en fiche 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: I only look at you too ❤️
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Je ne regarde que toi aussi ❤️
On se parle après le cours.

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: I'll let you enjoy lunch with your friends
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Je vais te laisser profiter du déjeuner avec tes amis.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Like caring about each other a little
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Comme se soucier un peu les uns des autres

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Since when do you care what I do
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Depuis quand ça t'intéresse ce que je fais ?

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: It's just hard to have a conversation with you without you getting mad
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: C'est juste difficile d'avoir une conversation avec toi sans que tu te fâches.
Je ne me fâche pas toujours.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I just wish we could talk a little less aggressively
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Je souhaite juste que nous puissions parler un peu moins agressivement.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: And care about each other a little more
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Et prenez un peu plus soin les uns des autres.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: It was in the living room
So I don't care about you
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Alors je me fiche de toi
Ce n'est pas ce que j'ai dit

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I stayed with you the whole time at the hospital
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Je suis resté avec toi tout le temps à l'hôpital.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I even carried you to your bed when we got home
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Je t'ai même porté jusqu'à ton lit quand nous sommes rentrés à la maison.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: And that's just about the accident
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Et c'est à peu près tout sur l'accident.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Never mind the rest of the year
And thank you again for that
I just want us to talk for reasons other than needing something
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Je veux juste qu'on parle pour des raisons autres que le besoin de quelque chose.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Don't you have a girlfriend for that
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Tu n'as pas de petite amie pour ça ?
Ce n'est pas une question de te fréquenter.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I just want to know you better
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Je veux juste mieux te connaître.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: And have a good time with you sometimes
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Et passer un bon moment avec toi parfois

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I'll try to be less aggressive
Then {{name:hailey}} took it or the couch ate it
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Alors soit {{name:hailey}} l'a pris, soit le canapé l'a mangé.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Is it too hard for you to text me for anything other than complaints?
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Est-ce trop difficile pour toi de m'envoyer un message pour autre chose que des plaintes ?

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: I can carry ranked later if you are up for it
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Je peux faire du classé plus tard si ça te dit.

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Keep laughing, I am dropping 30 tonight
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Continue à rire, je lâche 30 ce soir.

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Before you roast me, yes my hair looks stupid
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Avant de me critiquer, oui mes cheveux ont l'air stupides.

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Say that louder, I need motivation
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Dis ça plus fort, j'ai besoin de motivation.

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do your rehab and stop trying to be a hero
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Fais ta rééducation et arrête d'essayer d'être un héros.

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: It can get busy in the evening
story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Ça peut devenir animé le soir.
Envoie-moi un message quand tu peux.
C'est tout ce que je veux

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: I checked your medication and your food
story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: J'ai vérifié tes médicaments et ta nourriture.
S'il te plaît, ne saute pas le déjeuner

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: Try not to stress too much okay
story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Essaie de ne pas trop stresser d'accord

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: It still feels a little strange going back
story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Ça fait encore un peu étrange de revenir.

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: You look like the kind of person who would file a very sad complaint from bed 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: On dirait que tu es le genre de personne qui déposerait une plainte très triste depuis son lit 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: A very bad one if it's really late, so hurry 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Un très mauvais si c'est vraiment tard, alors dépêche-toi 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Let me just buy some rat poison on the way home
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Laisse-moi juste acheter du poison pour rats sur le chemin du retour.
Nous avons des rats à la maison ?

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Don't starve before I get there mister rat🤍
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Ne meurs pas avant que j'arrive, monsieur rat🤍

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: How no, what about your limousine?
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Comment non, qu'en est-il de ta limousine ?

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Don't you dare make fun of me 😒
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: N'ose pas te moquer de moi 😒

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Since you're broken and no one is home
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Puisque tu es cassé et que personne n'est à la maison

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: I'm coming back with a friend instead
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Je reviens avec un ami à la place.

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Which means your food is getting delivered to your room a little later than planned 😇
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Ce qui veut dire que ta nourriture va être livrée dans ta chambre un peu plus tard que prévu 😇

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: You say that like I'm about to file a complaint
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Tu le dis comme si j'allais porter plainte.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Then I went straight to the shower 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Puis je suis allé directement sous la douche 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: So now you look unfairly pretty?
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Alors maintenant tu as l'air injustement jolie ?

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Pretty enough that I need proof with my own eyes
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Assez joli pour que j'aie besoin de preuves de mes propres yeux

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I'm tired and now I'm blushing
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Je suis fatigué et maintenant je rougis.
Tu es impossible, je te jure 😒
Mieux une fois que tu m'as envoyé un message.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: So you don't have to worry
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Donc tu n'as pas à t'inquiéter
Parce que j'étais sur le point de
Tu n'as pas besoin de t'inquiéter.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: But I want to talk to you a little more
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Mais je veux te parler un peu plus.
Tu as besoin de te reposer

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I want to stay and talk to you
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Je veux rester et te parler

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Go rest, you need it after your long day
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Va te reposer, tu en as besoin après ta longue journée.
Tu ne peux pas me faire la tête.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: But it's true, so that makes me even more annoyed 🙄
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Mais c'est vrai, donc ça me rend encore plus agacé 🙄

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I'm only saying it because I care about you
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Je le dis seulement parce que je tiens à toi.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I want you in good shape tomorrow
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Je veux que tu sois en forme demain.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Then go sleep if you understand
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Alors va dormir si tu comprends

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I made something quick when I got back
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: J'ai fait quelque chose de rapide quand je suis rentré.

story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.source: Stopped at the gym on the way back
story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.translation: Arrêté au gymnase sur le chemin du retour

story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.source: A couple idiots there tried to waste my time
story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.translation: Un couple d'idiots là-bas a essayé de me faire perdre mon temps.

story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.source: Didn't want you wondering where I was
story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.translation: Je ne voulais pas que tu te demandes où j'étais.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: Or maybe he just understood boundaries this time
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Ou peut-être qu'il a juste compris les limites cette fois.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: I was a little slow at first
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: J'étais un peu lent au début.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: But muscle memory comes back quickly
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Mais la mémoire musculaire revient rapidement.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: And you, how was your day?
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Et toi, comment s'est passée ta journée ?

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: I'm going to prepare dinner earlier today, tell me when you're hungry, I will bring it to you directly
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Je vais préparer le dîner plus tôt aujourd'hui, dis-moi quand tu as faim, je te l'apporterai directement.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: I had forgotten how exhausting it can be
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: J'avais oublié à quel point cela peut être épuisant.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: But it felt good to be back
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Mais c'était agréable d'être de retour

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: I saw him during the evening
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Je l'ai vu pendant la soirée
Il était en fait très poli.

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Would have been better with you next to me
story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Ça aurait été mieux avec toi à mes côtés.

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: And you, eat something this morning
story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Et toi, mange quelque chose ce matin.
Je te texterai à l'heure du déjeuner 💕

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: So thank you for forcing me to go to bed early 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Alors merci de m'avoir forcé à aller au lit tôt 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I do have good ideas sometimes
But yes, this one was good

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Comment va ta jambe ce matin ?

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Better I think, i can move around more
story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Mieux je pense, je peux me déplacer plus.

story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: And how he's going to drag you outside the second you can walk again
story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Et comment il va te traîner dehors dès que tu pourras marcher à nouveau.

story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: And the girls are drinking his every word 🙄
story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Et les filles boivent ses moindres mots 🙄

story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: At this point I think the girls would eat him alive if they could
story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: À ce stade, je pense que les filles le mangeraient vivant si elles le pouvaient.
À plus tard après le cours ❤️

story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: He just sat down like he owns the table 😭
story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Il vient de s'asseoir comme s'il possédait la table 😭

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I'm thinking about you a lot today
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Je pense beaucoup à toi aujourd'hui.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I wish I could just leave and come lay next to you for ten minutes
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Je souhaite pouvoir partir et venir m'allonger à côté de toi pendant dix minutes.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Ten minutes would turn into two hours
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Dix minutes se transformeraient en deux heures.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Uni is finally over for today
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: L'université est enfin terminée pour aujourd'hui.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: And then I would fail everything because of you
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Et puis je raterais tout à cause de toi.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Text me if you need anything okay?
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Envoie-moi un message si tu as besoin de quoi que ce soit d'accord ?

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I have to go back now
Now I still have work until 14
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Maintenant, j'ai encore du travail jusqu'à 14.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Then my part time job until 18 😭
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Alors mon job à temps partiel jusqu'à 18 😭

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do not get used to it
I just want your brain occupied for a bit
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Je veux juste que ton cerveau soit occupé un moment.

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Send me one word later: alive
Or are you pretending to be productive today?
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Ou tu fais semblant d'être productif aujourd'hui ?

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Liar, but I respect the confidence
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Menteur, mais je respecte la confiance.

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Then we do chill games, no screaming
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Alors nous faisons des jeux tranquilles, pas de cris.

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: And if you do not feel it, we skip
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Et si tu ne le sens pas, on passe.

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Occupé ? 😌
Qu'est-ce qui a provoqué cela ?

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: A girl in class is losing her mind over some guy she barely knows
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Une fille en classe perd la tête à cause d'un gars qu'elle connaît à peine.

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: So now everyone is doing that whole crush autopsy 😭
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Alors maintenant, tout le monde fait cette autopsie de crush 😭
Et tu t'es joint ?
Juste un peu 😇

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: I said people like confidence and good timing
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: J'ai dit que les gens aiment la confiance et le bon timing.
Ce n'est pas un mauvais conseil.

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: I know, what would your advice be?
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Je sais, quel serait ton conseil ?

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Just be yourself, be funny, be kind, be honest, that's probably all
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Sois juste toi-même, sois drôle, sois gentil, sois honnête, c'est probablement tout.

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: So all I need is a sparkling personality? 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Alors tout ce dont j'ai besoin, c'est d'une personnalité pétillante ? 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Do you have five minutes or are you pretending to be very important?
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: As-tu cinq minutes ou fais-tu semblant d'être très important ?
Pas exactement ce que j'ai dit
Ça ressemble exactement à moi 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Okay, that's enough emotional labor for your afternoon 😇
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: D'accord, c'est assez de travail émotionnel pour ton après-midi 😇
Merci de répondre sérieusement 🤍
De rien

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: If you need more help for your monologue, I'm here 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Si tu as besoin de plus d'aide pour ton monologue, je suis là 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: I can make time for the small people
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Je peux trouver du temps pour les petites personnes.
Mauvaise réponse 😌
Je me demandais juste quelque chose

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Do you fall for people fast or do you act difficult first?
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Tombes-tu rapidement amoureux des gens ou fais-tu d'abord la difficile ?
Cela dépend de la personne

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Why? Are you planning on jumping from the roof onto someone? 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Pourquoi ? Tu prévois de sauter du toit sur quelqu'un ? 😌
Connard 🖕

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: Then soda and a few biscuits 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: Alors du soda et quelques biscuits 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: Want me to change your clothes and brush your teeth too
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: Veux-tu que je te change de vêtements et que je te brosse aussi les dents ?

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: Might grab food too if the line doesn't piss me off
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: Je pourrais prendre de la nourriture aussi si la file d'attente ne m'énerve pas.
Tu veux quelque chose ou pas ?

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: A drink and whatever is easiest 🙂
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: Une boisson et ce qui est le plus facile 🙂
Please provide the game dialogue you would like translated into French.

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: You asked a guy with one busted leg
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: Tu as demandé à un gars avec une jambe cassée.

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: Your leg's hurt, you're not sick, asshole
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: Ta jambe te fait mal, tu n'es pas malade, espèce de con.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: I will pretend i didnt see that
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Je vais faire semblant de ne pas avoir vu ça.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: I knew keeping you around had value
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Je savais que te garder près de moi avait de la valeur.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: Don't get emotional, you still haven't seen the options yet 😇
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Ne t'énerve pas, tu n'as pas encore vu les options 😇

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: I have a party on Saturday night
So I may need your opinion on hair tomorrow
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Donc, je pourrais avoir besoin de ton avis sur les cheveux demain.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: And if it goes badly, you are legally required to save me
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Et si ça se passe mal, tu es légalement obligé de me sauver.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: Or you will have to pay for the damage
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Ou tu devras payer pour les dégâts.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: How am I saving you from hair?
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Comment est-ce que je te sauve des cheveux ?

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: By telling me when I look insane before I leave the house 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: En me disant quand j'ai l'air folle avant de quitter la maison 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: That seems hard, you will hear me everyday
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Ça semble difficile, tu m'entendras tous les jours.

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Je peux à peine penser clairement.
Fatigué aussi, la guérison est épuisante

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: I'm going to sleep early tonight
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Je vais me coucher tôt ce soir.

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: Then don't stay up for me
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Alors ne reste pas éveillé pour moi.
Tu as besoin de te reposer aussi.

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: At least you didn't skip dinner
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Au moins, tu n'as pas sauté le dîner.

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: Look at you sounding all responsible now 🙄
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Regarde-toi, tu as l'air si responsable maintenant 🙄

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: I still need to finish one thing for tomorrow
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Je dois encore finir une chose pour demain.

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: Just don't drag it out too long
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Ne le prolonge pas trop longtemps.

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: Uni and both jobs in one day
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Uni et les deux emplois en une seule journée

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: Listen to you ordering me around 😒
Someone has to protect your last brain cell
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Quelqu'un doit protéger ta dernière cellule cérébrale.

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: Not sure I'll fall asleep right away
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Je ne suis pas sûr de m'endormir tout de suite.
Pas étonnant que tu sois épuisé.
Je suis à bout de nerfs 😭

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: So you can copy me and finally get some muscle
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: Alors tu peux me copier et enfin obtenir un peu de muscle.
Wow, tu as demandé si gentiment 🙂

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: I'm making the first post tonight
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: Je fais le premier post ce soir.

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: You better be the first like
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: Tu ferais mieux d'être le premier à aimer.

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: I finally made my fitness page
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: J'ai enfin créé ma page de fitness.

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: Or at least make it look like I have more than three followers
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: Ou au moins faire en sorte que j'ai l'air d'avoir plus de trois abonnés.

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: Is that a request or an order
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: Est-ce une demande ou un ordre ?
Les photos sont bonnes de toute façon.

story/DAY5/DAY5_10_EVELYN_NIGHT_LATE_HOM.source: I will be very late tonight
story/DAY5/DAY5_10_EVELYN_NIGHT_LATE_HOM.translation: Je vais être très en retard ce soir.

story/DAY5/DAY5_10_EVELYN_NIGHT_LATE_HOM.source: Okay, be careful on your way back
story/DAY5/DAY5_10_EVELYN_NIGHT_LATE_HOM.translation: D'accord, fais attention sur le chemin du retour.

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: He looked at me strangely a few times
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Il m'a regardé étrangement quelques fois.

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: It was still quite a long day
I slept as soon as I got home
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Je me suis endormi dès que je suis rentré chez moi.

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: I will make breakfast in a few minutes
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Je vais préparer le petit déjeuner dans quelques minutes.

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: Tell me if you want it brought to you
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Dis-moi si tu veux que je te l'apporte.

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: Don't worry take your time, {{name:hailey}} already made me breakfast, just rest
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Ne t'inquiète pas, prends ton temps, {{name:hailey}} m'a déjà préparé le petit déjeuner, repose-toi juste.

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: Thank you to both of you

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Ma jambe ne me fait pas mal aujourd'hui.
Et toi, comment s'est passée ta journée de travail ?

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: We had more people than expected
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Nous avons eu plus de personnes que prévu.

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Still stiff when I get up, but I can feel it's getting better
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Encore raide quand je me lève, mais je sens que ça s'améliore.

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Someone has to keep you in one piece 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Quelqu'un doit te garder en un seul morceau 😌
Mon réveil avait une mauvaise aura aujourd'hui.

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Only because you keep cheering me on
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Seulement parce que tu continues à m'encourager.

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Now that's the kind of answer I like
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Maintenant, c'est le genre de réponse que j'aime.

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Come on, only two more weeks and then you're free
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Allez, encore deux semaines et ensuite tu es libre.
D'accord, ça a un peu aidé 😌
Je te texterai à l'heure du déjeuner 💕

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Did you sleep better at least?

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Donc je ne peux pas me plaindre 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: How are you feeling this morning?

story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.source: Move faster and I become nicer
story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.translation: Bouge plus vite et je deviens plus sympa.

story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.source: I actually made it all the way to the bathroom and now I'm stuck here
story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.translation: Je suis en fait allé jusqu'à la salle de bain et maintenant je suis coincé ici.

story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.source: You said two minutes ten minutes ago
story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.translation: Tu as dit deux minutes il y a dix minutes.
L'entretien de la beauté prend du temps 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.source: And I still need to wash too
story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.translation: Et je dois encore me laver aussi.

story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.source: Also this is very rude for someone loitering outside a bathroom door 😭
story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.translation: C'est aussi très impoli pour quelqu'un qui traîne devant une porte de salle de bain 😭

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: Le travail à temps partiel, c'est bien.

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: I get a lot of time for myself
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: J'ai beaucoup de temps pour moi.

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: And sorry I can't help much around the house
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: Et désolé, je ne peux pas beaucoup aider à la maison.

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: I really need to save money for next year
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: J'ai vraiment besoin d'économiser de l'argent pour l'année prochaine.

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Peut-être que je vais porter le moins de vêtements possible pour que rien ne gêne.

story/DAY6/DAY6_10_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Quel genre de vêtements ferait ça ?

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.source: I felt bad when I woke up
story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.translation: Je me suis senti mal quand je me suis réveillé.

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.source: I thought it was cute that you fell asleep like that
story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.translation: Je trouvais ça mignon que tu t'endormes comme ça.

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.translation: Je t'imaginais en train de ronfler et de baver sur ton oreiller.

story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.source: But I'll make it up to you, today
story/DAY7/DAY7_00_LENA_MORNING_NO_CLASS.translation: Mais je vais me rattraper aujourd'hui.

story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.source: We will find another way if needed
story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.translation: Nous trouverons un autre moyen si nécessaire.

story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.source: I just need a little time to settle things
story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.translation: J'ai juste besoin d'un peu de temps pour régler les choses.
