story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.source: I need to move if I want my leg to heal
story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.translation: Je dois bouger si je veux que ma jambe guérisse.

story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.source: Staying in bed will not help
story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.translation: Rester au lit ne va pas aider.

story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.source: It got complicated near the end of the shift
story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.translation: Ça s'est compliqué vers la fin du service.

story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.source: It can also hurt you more if you push too much
story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.translation: Cela peut aussi te blesser davantage si tu pousses trop.

story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.source: Just a long day and some issues with the staff
story/DAY7/DAY7_01_EVELYN_MORNING_REPLY_.translation: Juste une longue journée et quelques problèmes avec le personnel.

story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.source: You want to do nothing faster?
story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.translation: Tu veux ne rien faire plus vite ?

story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.source: I'll see if I get out on time
story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.translation: Je vais voir si je sors à temps.
À tout à l'heure pour le déjeuner 👍

story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.source: I'm waiting on a delivery this morning
Did anything show up or did {{name:hailey}} grab it first? 🙄
story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.translation: Quelque chose est arrivé ou {{name:hailey}} l'a pris en premier ? 🙄

story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.source: I'll let you know if it shows up
story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.translation: Je te ferai savoir s'il apparaît.

story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.source: Are you at work until lunch?
Can you stop by the store and get me an energy drink? 🥤
story/DAY7/DAY7_02_MASON_HAILEY_OR_PACKA.translation: Peux-tu passer par le magasin et me prendre une boisson énergisante ? 🥤

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.source: But there will be a next time
story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: Mais il y aura une prochaine fois

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.source: You always make that very easy
story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: Tu rends toujours ça très facile.

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.source: It still means a lot that you stopped by
story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: Cela signifie encore beaucoup que tu sois passé.

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.source: Because you keep taking care of me
story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: Parce que tu continues à prendre soin de moi

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.source: By the way, I'm meeting a friend for lunch
story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: Au fait, je rencontre un ami pour le déjeuner.

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.source: I might be a little busy
story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: Je pourrais être un peu occupé.

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.source: But I'll keep you updated as much as I can
story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: Mais je te tiendrai au courant autant que je le peux.

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.source: Enjoy lunch with your friend and text me later
story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: Profite du déjeuner avec ton ami et envoie-moi un message plus tard.

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.source: Even just for a little while
story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: Même juste pour un petit moment

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.source: It's a shame everyone was home though
story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: C'est dommage que tout le monde était à la maison cependant.

story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.source: I could have eaten a whole person
story/DAY7/DAY7_03_LENA_VISIT_PLAYER.jso.translation: J'aurais pu manger une personne entière.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: Lunch time 😊
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Heure du déjeuner 😊

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: He's kind of weird apparently
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Il est apparemment un peu bizarre.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: Weird how?
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Bizarre comment ?

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: He stares too much
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Il regarde trop.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: And he gets way too friendly with new girls
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Et il devient beaucoup trop amical avec les nouvelles filles.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: Does he bother you?
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Est-ce qu'il te dérange ?

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: Not really
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Pas vraiment

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: I barely talk to him
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Je lui parle à peine.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: But from what Amanda said, he's one of the higher-ups
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Mais d'après ce qu'Amanda a dit, c'est un des supérieurs

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: He might end up running the company one day
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Il pourrait finir par diriger l'entreprise un jour.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: And you know how badly I want to work there after I graduate
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Et tu sais à quel point je veux travailler là-bas après ma graduation.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: I'm eating with Amanda from work
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Je mange avec Amanda du boulot

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: So I need to be careful around him
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Donc je dois faire attention autour de lui

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: But I already don't like the vibe
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Mais je n'aime déjà pas l'ambiance.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: Protective response detected. Clear boundaries strengthen trust and emotional safety
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Réponse protectrice détectée. Des limites claires renforcent la confiance et la sécurité émotionnelle.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: Social leverage detected. Controlled warmth could create future opportunities without full commitment
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Leverage social détecté. Une chaleur contrôlée pourrait créer des opportunités futures sans engagement total.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: Power imbalance detected. Enduring discomfort for future gain may increase long-term risk
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Déséquilibre de pouvoir détecté. Endurer l'inconfort pour un gain futur peut augmenter le risque à long terme.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: Be careful and shut him down if he crosses the line
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Fais attention et éteins-le s'il dépasse les limites.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: You may have to put up with it if you want a real chance there later
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Tu devras peut-être faire avec si tu veux vraiment avoir une chance là-bas plus tard.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: Try getting on his good side, it could help you later
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Essaie de te mettre dans ses bonnes grâces, cela pourrait t'aider plus tard.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: I will
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Je vais

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: If he crosses the line I'll make it clear
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: S'il franchit la ligne, je ferai comprendre.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: But hopefully it won't come to that
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Mais j'espère que cela ne sera pas nécessaire.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: I know
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Je sais

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: I hate it but you're probably right
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Je déteste ça mais tu as probablement raison.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: I just don't want it to get weird
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Je ne veux tout simplement pas que ça devienne bizarre.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: Ugh maybe
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Ugh peut-être

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: I could stay nice without encouraging him too much
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Je pourrais rester gentil sans trop l'encourager.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: If it helps later, maybe it's worth it
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Si cela peut aider plus tard, peut-être que ça en vaut la peine.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: Nice
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Bien

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: But don't worry
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Mais ne t'inquiète pas

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: Work is work anyway 😒
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Le travail, c'est le travail de toute façon 😒

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: Good
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Bon

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: Keep me updated just in case
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Tiens-moi au courant juste au cas où.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: I will
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Je vais

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: I'm heading to work now
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Je pars au travail maintenant.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: Talk to you on my break ❤️
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Je te parle pendant ma pause ❤️

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: 2 hours later
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: 2 heures plus tard

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: How is she?
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Comment va-t-elle ?

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: She's fun
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Elle est amusante

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: And she talks a lot 😭
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Et elle parle beaucoup 😭

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: Right now she's giving me all the work gossip
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: En ce moment, elle me raconte tous les potins du travail.

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: What kind of gossip?
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Quel genre de ragots ?

story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.source: There's a guy there
story/DAY7/DAY7_04_LENA_LUNCH_COWORKER_F.translation: Il y a un gars là-bas

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: Université souffrante 😭
Il peut
Nonooooo 😭

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.source: Please support me in this difficult time
story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: S'il te plaît, soutiens-moi en ce moment difficile.
Tu veux des encouragements ou des collations ?
Tous les deux 😌
Principalement des collations

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.source: Too bad I can't move to buy them
story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: Dommage que je ne puisse pas me déplacer pour les acheter.

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.source: But if you do well in your extra class I'll ask {{name:mason}} to get some for you 😌
story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: Mais si tu réussis bien dans ta classe supplémentaire, je demanderai à {{name:mason}} d'en obtenir pour toi 😌
Qu'est-ce que je suis, un chien ? 😒
Une grenouille 😌

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.source: I'm on my break and I already want to escape 😭
story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: Je suis en pause et j'ai déjà envie de m'échapper 😭

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.source: I hate you as much as I hate extra classes 😭
story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: Je te déteste autant que je déteste les cours supplémentaires 😭

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.source: I take that as a compliment 😌
story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: Je prends ça comme un compliment 😌
C'est si mauvais ?
Pire 😒

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.source: I have an extra class tonight with my main teacher because I messed up my exams
story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: J'ai un cours supplémentaire ce soir avec mon professeur principal parce que j'ai raté mes examens.

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.source: Apparently natural charm is not accepted as an academic strategy 😒
story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: Apparemment, le charme naturel n'est pas accepté comme une stratégie académique 😒

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.source: Too bad because I'm sure I could convince the teacher to give me good grades 😇
story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: Dommage, car je suis sûr que je pourrais convaincre le professeur de me donner de bonnes notes 😇

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.source: Or he could make you do extra classes all summer
story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: Ou il pourrait te faire suivre des cours supplémentaires tout l'été.
Il ne peut pas
N'est-ce pas ? 😭

story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: But I still don't like the vibe around him
story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Mais je n'aime toujours pas l'ambiance qui l'entoure.
Alors fais confiance à ton instinct

story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Don't worry, I'm keeping my distance
story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Ne t'inquiète pas, je garde mes distances.

story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I wish I had more than ten quiet minutes with you today
story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Je souhaite avoir plus de dix minutes tranquilles avec toi aujourd'hui.
Combien de temps jusqu'à ce que tu aies fini ?

story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I'll text you again when I can ❤️
story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Je te recontacterai quand je pourrai ❤️

story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Just too many people, too much noise, too many things at once
story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Trop de gens, trop de bruit, trop de choses en même temps

story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.source: And you take care of yourself too
story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.translation: Et prends soin de toi aussi.

story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.source: It might be a little tense again
story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.translation: Ça pourrait être un peu tendu à nouveau.

story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.source: But I will stay focused on my work
story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.translation: Mais je vais rester concentré sur mon travail.

story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.source: Do not let him get to you
And I know when to step back if needed
story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.translation: Et je sais quand prendre du recul si nécessaire.

story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.source: Text me if something feels off
story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.translation: Envoie-moi un message si quelque chose te semble étrange.

story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..translation: Tu es mignon(ne) quand tu t'inquiètes.

story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..source: I don't like weird people around you
story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..translation: Je n'aime pas les gens bizarres autour de toi.
Et maintenant je suis chez moi

story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..source: Tired, but one more day and it's the weekend
story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..translation: Fatigué, mais encore un jour et c'est le week-end.

story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..source: And better now that I'm talking to you
story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..translation: Et mieux maintenant que je te parle.

story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..source: I'm going to shower and relax a little
story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..translation: Je vais prendre une douche et me détendre un peu.

story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..source: Try not to miss me too much for ten minutes
story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..translation: Essaie de ne pas trop me manquer pendant dix minutes.

story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..source: So the day went by faster
story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..translation: Alors la journée est passée plus vite.

story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..source: That's all I wanted to hear
story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..translation: C'est tout ce que je voulais entendre.

story/DAY7/DAY7_09_HAILEY_ASKS_PLAYER_TO.source: My extra class is dragging and I need {{mason:him}} to come pick me up after
story/DAY7/DAY7_09_HAILEY_ASKS_PLAYER_TO.translation: Mon cours supplémentaire traîne et j'ai besoin que {{mason:him}} vienne me chercher après

story/DAY7/DAY7_09_HAILEY_ASKS_PLAYER_TO.source: You want me to text {{mason:him}} now?
story/DAY7/DAY7_09_HAILEY_ASKS_PLAYER_TO.translation: Tu veux que j'envoie un message à {{mason:him}} maintenant ?

story/DAY7/DAY7_09_HAILEY_ASKS_PLAYER_TO.source: If I do it, {{mason:he}}'ll act like I personally invented traffic 😌
story/DAY7/DAY7_09_HAILEY_ASKS_PLAYER_TO.translation: Si je le fais, {{mason:he}} va agir comme si j'avais personnellement inventé le trafic 😌

story/DAY7/DAY7_09_HAILEY_ASKS_PLAYER_TO.source: Don't let it go to your head 😌
story/DAY7/DAY7_09_HAILEY_ASKS_PLAYER_TO.translation: Ne te laisse pas emporter par ça 😌

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..source: Why would I show you my ass ??
story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..translation: Pourquoi est-ce que je te montrerais mon cul ??

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..source: It was my back and arm !
story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..translation: C'était mon dos et mon bras !

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..source: You're not in a rush for just a few days, are you?
story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..translation: Tu n'es pas pressé pour juste quelques jours, n'est-ce pas ?

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..source: Any lead on the coach thing?
story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..translation: Des nouvelles sur le truc du coach ?

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..source: Did you find someone legit or not?
story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..translation: As-tu trouvé quelqu'un de légitime ou pas ?

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..source: I need to check a few things first
story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..translation: Je dois d'abord vérifier quelques éléments.

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..source: How am I not gaining muscle when I work out this much? 😒
story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..translation: Comment se fait-il que je ne prenne pas de muscle alors que je m'entraîne autant ? 😒

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..source: Are you showing your back or your ass ??
story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..translation: Montres-tu ton dos ou ton cul ??

story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.source: I might know someone who could help
story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.translation: Je pourrais connaître quelqu'un qui pourrait aider.
Ce n'est pas un oui non plus.

story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.source: Just find out if he has something real
story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.translation: Il suffit de découvrir s'il a quelque chose de réel.

story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.source: He knows trainers and too many people in general
story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.translation: Il connaît des entraîneurs et trop de gens en général.

story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.source: He could still point you to someone solid
story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.translation: Il pourrait encore te diriger vers quelqu'un de fiable.

story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.source: If he keeps it useful and short
story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.translation: S'il le garde utile et court
Donc ce n'est pas un non.

story/DAY7/DAY7_13_HAILEY_PICKUP_FOLLOWU.source: {{mason:He}} looked annoyed, but I think that's just {{mason:his}} face after dark 😇
story/DAY7/DAY7_13_HAILEY_PICKUP_FOLLOWU.translation: {{mason:He}} avait l'air agacé, mais je pense que c'est juste {{mason:his}} son visage après la nuit 😇

story/DAY7/DAY7_13_HAILEY_PICKUP_FOLLOWU.source: Hero only when I do what you ask?
story/DAY7/DAY7_13_HAILEY_PICKUP_FOLLOWU.translation: Héros seulement quand je fais ce que tu demandes ?

story/DAY7/DAY7_13_HAILEY_PICKUP_FOLLOWU.source: So do it more often if you want to rise in my esteem 😇
story/DAY7/DAY7_13_HAILEY_PICKUP_FOLLOWU.translation: Fais-le donc plus souvent si tu veux élever mon estime pour toi 😇

story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: How is the house chaos level tonight?
story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Quel est le niveau de chaos de la maison ce soir ?

story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do you really need to ask?
Also I still owe you a clean win in co-op
story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Je te dois aussi une victoire nette en coop.

story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: You mean I carry you again?
story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Tu veux dire que je te porte encore ?

story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Keep talking and I mute your mic
story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Continue à parler et je coupe ton micro.
Envoie-moi un message quand tu es prêt.

story/DAY7/DAY7_15_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_NO.translation: Envoie-moi un message quand tu peux.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Tomorrow is the last push before the weekend
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Demain, c'est le dernier effort avant le week-end.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Do you have anything planned this weekend?
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: As-tu quelque chose de prévu ce week-end ?

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You mean drooling on your pillow?
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Tu veux dire baver sur ton oreiller ?

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I'm really going to break your other leg, by accident of course
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Je vais vraiment casser ton autre jambe, par accident bien sûr.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Yeah, I was waiting for you
I'm showing this text to my lawyer, madame
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Je montre ce texte à mon avocat, madame

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I'll just kill you with kisses instead
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Je vais juste te tuer avec des bisous à la place.
Je n'ai pas peur, jolie dame

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You do have some guts, I'll give you that
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Tu as du courage, je te l'accorde.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Now sleep before I change my mind and come annoy you some more
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Maintenant dors avant que je change d'avis et que je vienne t'embêter encore un peu.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Can I at least get a goodnight pic?
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Puis-je au moins avoir une photo de bonne nuit ?

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Only because you waited for me
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Seulement parce que tu m'as attendu

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Wow, harder and harder to fall asleep now
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Wow, de plus en plus difficile de s'endormir maintenant.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I didn't want to end the day without hearing from you
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Je ne voulais pas finir la journée sans avoir de tes nouvelles.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I thought you said I talk too much
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Je pensais que tu avais dit que je parlais trop.
Ne te souviens pas de ça.

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: That's the only thing keeping me alive 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: C'est la seule chose qui me garde en vie 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Pretty good, I'm feeling better and better
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Plutôt bien, je me sens de mieux en mieux
Laisse ça comme ça, s'il te plaît.

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Text me if you need me
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Envoie-moi un message si tu as besoin de moi.

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: My body already knows it's the end of the week
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Mon corps sait déjà que c'est la fin de la semaine.

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I'll text you when I can
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Je te texterai quand je pourrai.
Tu viens littéralement de te réveiller.

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Did you sleep okay at least?
But not enough to make me a morning person
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Mais pas assez pour faire de moi une personne du matin.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Pouvons-nous parler ?
Tu n'es pas un fardeau.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: We need to find a solution
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Nous devons trouver une solution.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Then tell me what you want me to do
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Alors dis-moi ce que tu veux que je fasse.
Parce que nous avons encore besoin d'argent

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Commitment choice detected, your answer will permanently lock {{name:evelyn}} into a stable route
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Choix d'engagement détecté, ta réponse va verrouiller {{name:evelyn}} dans une voie stable.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Commitment choice detected, your answer will permanently lock {{name:evelyn}} into a shared tension route
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Choix d'engagement détecté, ta réponse va verrouiller {{name:evelyn}} dans une route de tension partagée.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Commitment choice detected, your answer will permanently lock {{name:evelyn}} into a high risk route
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Choix d'engagement détecté, ta réponse va verrouiller {{name:evelyn}} dans un chemin à haut risque.
Continue à travailler là-bas pour l'instant.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: We find a safer plan together
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Nous trouvons un plan plus sûr ensemble.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I will find a job, something I can do from home
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Je vais trouver un emploi, quelque chose que je peux faire depuis chez moi.
J'ai vu tes messages

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: You should not do that alone
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Tu ne devrais pas faire ça seul.
Je m'en occuperai

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: You do not need to suffer there
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Tu n'as pas à souffrir là-bas.
Es-tu vraiment sûr ?
Bien sûr que je le suis.
Je connais quelqu'un

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: If I bribe him a little he should find me something quickly
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Si je lui donne un petit pot-de-vin, il devrait me trouver quelque chose rapidement.
Alors ne t'inquiète pas
Bien

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I did not answer because it was too late
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Je n'ai pas répondu parce qu'il était trop tard.
Alors je resterai à la maison

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But I will take care of you even more
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Mais je prendrai encore plus soin de toi.
Est-ce même possible ?
Bien sûr que c'est le cas.
Tu vas voir
Un plan plus sûr ?
Ça devient de plus en plus difficile là-bas.
Oui

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Give me one or two days and I will find something
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Donne-moi un ou deux jours et je trouverai quelque chose.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: In the meantime, just say you are sick
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: En attendant, dis juste que tu es malade.
Plus de barres

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I do not want you to carry everything
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Je ne veux pas que tu portes tout.
Es-tu vraiment sûr ?
Je peux encore y travailler.
Ce sera juste difficile.
J'ai dit non
Je vais trouver un moyen

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: My manager is making it difficult for me
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Mon manager me rend la tâche difficile.
Ne t'inquiète pas

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: A few days will not kill us
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Quelques jours ne nous tueront pas.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: We are not that poor yet
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Nous ne sommes pas encore si pauvres.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I still have the money I saved for the trip
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: J'ai encore l'argent que j'avais économisé pour le voyage.
Garde cet argent
C'est à toi.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I will use it if we need to
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Je l'utiliserai si nous en avons besoin.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But I do not think we will
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Mais je ne pense pas que nous le ferons.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I just need the right opportunity
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: J'ai juste besoin de la bonne opportunité.
D'accord
Encore ?

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Then I will not go back tonight
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Alors je ne rentrerai pas ce soir.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But tell me quickly when you find something for me
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Mais dis-moi vite quand tu trouves quelque chose pour moi.
Oui {{name:evelyn}}
D'accord
Je vais y aller

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I just have to bear with him
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Je dois juste faire avec lui.
Oui
À quel point cela peut-il être difficile ?

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I know it is not the best
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Je sais que ce n'est pas le meilleur

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But I cannot help you yet
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Mais je ne peux pas t'aider encore.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: As soon as I can walk again I will work
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Dès que je pourrai marcher à nouveau, je travaillerai.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: And you will be able to leave
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Et tu pourras partir.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I am sorry you have to endure him
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Je suis désolé que tu doives le supporter.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: If he gets too annoying just kick him in the balls
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: S'il devient trop ennuyeux, frappe-le juste dans les couilles.
Pas une mauvaise idée
Mais je serais renvoyé.
Donc pas pour l'instant

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: He watches me like I owe him something
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Il me regarde comme si je lui devais quelque chose.
Mais peut-être un jour
Je déteste cet endroit

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But I also hate feeling like a burden to you
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Mais je déteste aussi avoir l'impression d'être un fardeau pour toi.

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: If I find a few options, you might be forced to give your opinion later 🤍
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Si je trouve quelques options, tu pourrais être obligé de donner ton avis plus tard 🤍

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: Too bad it wasn't a question 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Dommage que ce ne soit pas une question 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: Better than yesterday and the day before

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: J'espère que je serai guéri bientôt.

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: Finally my room is going to get cleaned 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Enfin, ma chambre va être nettoyée 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: You're so sweet in the morning
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Tu es si doux le matin.

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: I might go shopping this afternoon
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Je pourrais faire du shopping cet après-midi.

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: I need to find an evening outfit for Saturday night
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Je dois trouver une tenue de soirée pour samedi soir.

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: So this is a fashion emergency?

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: But still, how dare he try to steal my job and brag about it
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Mais quand même, comment ose-t-il essayer de voler mon travail et s'en vanter ?
Il n'y a qu'une seule solution

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: I'm going to break his leg too
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Je vais lui casser la jambe aussi.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: I get it but that's not a good idea
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Je comprends mais ce n'est pas une bonne idée.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: He'd make you nurse him too
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Il te ferait aussi le soigner.
Il a de la chance cette fois.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: He won't even know how close to death he was
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Il ne saura même pas à quel point il était proche de la mort.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: I have to go back now
I'm going straight to work after this
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Je vais directement au travail après ça.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: I guess he feels lonely without you
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Je suppose qu'il se sent seul sans toi.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: So now I have to put up with him instead
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Alors maintenant, je dois le supporter à la place.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: He's telling everyone he's your nurse now
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Il dit à tout le monde qu'il est maintenant ton infirmier.

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: I never say no to gaming
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Je ne dis jamais non aux jeux.

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Except when I kick your ass
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Sauf quand je te botte le cul
La sorcière ne se produit jamais

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: My setup is finally clean for once
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Mon installation est enfin propre pour une fois.

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do not zoom in, my cable management is still criminal
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Ne zoomez pas, ma gestion des câbles est toujours criminelle.

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: That is a generous lie but I'll take it
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: C'est un mensonge généreux mais je vais le prendre.

story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: How are you doing right now?
story/DAY8/DAY8_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Comment ça va en ce moment ?

story/DAY8/DAY8_05_MASON_NORMAL_DAY_TEXT.source: If you need something else, ask {{name:hailey}} or {{name:evelyn}} before they leave
story/DAY8/DAY8_05_MASON_NORMAL_DAY_TEXT.translation: Si tu as besoin de quelque chose d'autre, demande à {{name:hailey}} ou {{name:evelyn}} avant qu'elles ne partent.
Il y a du poulet dans le frigo 🍗
Dépêche-toi avant que {{name:hailey}} n'arrive en premier !

story/DAY8/DAY8_05_MASON_NORMAL_DAY_TEXT.source: Just enough to text you once 🙄
story/DAY8/DAY8_05_MASON_NORMAL_DAY_TEXT.translation: Juste assez pour t'envoyer un message une fois 🙄
Regarde comme je suis devenu gentil.

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: For a moment you did sound like an adult 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: Pendant un instant, tu avais vraiment l'air d'un adulte 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: Help me or I set your PC on fire 😇
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: Aide-moi ou je mets le feu à ton PC 😇

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: Tell me which one suits me best 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: Dis-moi lequel me convient le mieux 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: All of them look good on you 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: Je savais que tu avais du goût 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: So you admit I'm already a femme fatale 😇
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: Alors tu admettes que je suis déjà une femme fatale 😇
Dommage que tu ne puisses pas 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.source: One look is cute and safe, one is a little bolder, and one makes me look like I'm pretending to be older than I am
story/DAY8/DAY8_06_HAILEY_SHOPPING_ADVIC.translation: Un regard est mignon et sûr, un est un peu plus audacieux, et un me fait ressembler à quelqu'un qui fait semblant d'être plus vieux que je ne le suis.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: I really needed you to say that
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: J'avais vraiment besoin que tu dises ça.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Even if I have homework, I'm going to monopolize you tomorrow 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Même si j'ai des devoirs, je vais te monopoliser demain 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Be prepared, you won't be playing any video games
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Prépare-toi, tu ne vas pas jouer à des jeux vidéo
Et j'ai enfin mangé quelque chose

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: What can I do for you so I can play a little?
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Que puis-je faire pour toi pour que je puisse jouer un peu ?
D'accord, peut-être que ça va marcher 😉

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Of course on your beautiful lips
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Bien sûr sur tes belles lèvres
Qui ne voudrait pas de ça ❤️

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Since we're talking about it, I wanted to ask you something...
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Puisque nous en parlons, je voulais te demander quelque chose...
Tu te sens un peu mieux ?

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: You know it's been a while since we... you know 😳
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Tu sais, ça fait un moment depuis que nous... tu sais 😳

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: And before your accident we only did it twice
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Et avant ton accident, nous ne l'avons fait que deux fois.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Even if we talked about it last time...
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Même si nous en avons parlé la dernière fois...

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Sometimes I wonder if I'm too tense
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Parfois, je me demande si je suis trop tendu.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: You're beautiful and you drive me crazy
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Tu es belle et tu me rends fou.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Then why do you hold back sometimes?
Sometimes it kind of feels like you don't enjoy it
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Parfois, on a l'impression que tu n'en profites pas.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: And because it's you, I don't want to mess up, so I hold back
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Et parce que c'est toi, je ne veux pas tout gâcher, alors je me retiens.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: What do you actually want when it's just us?
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Que veux-tu vraiment quand c'est juste nous ?

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Emotional openness detected. Reassurance and mutual discovery strengthen trust and intimacy
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Ouverture émotionnelle détectée. La réassurance et la découverte mutuelle renforcent la confiance et l'intimité.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Ambiguity window detected. Revealing unusual desire may open a different kind of bond
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Une fenêtre d'ambiguïté détectée. Révéler un désir inhabituel peut ouvrir un autre type de lien.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Less messy in my head at least
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Moins de désordre dans ma tête, au moins.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Withdrawal signal detected. Pulling back now may create lasting emotional distance
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Signal de retrait détecté. Se retirer maintenant pourrait créer une distance émotionnelle durable.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: I want to understand what you like and what makes you feel good
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Je veux comprendre ce que tu aimes et ce qui te fait te sentir bien.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: I think some situations turn me on more than they should
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Je pense que certaines situations m'excitent plus qu'elles ne le devraient.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: I still don't feel comfortable doing it again right now
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Je ne me sens toujours pas à l'aise de le refaire maintenant.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: I want to understand what you like and what makes you feel safe
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Je veux comprendre ce que tu aimes et ce qui te fait sentir en sécurité.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: I don't want to rush you
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Je ne veux pas te presser.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: I think I need time too
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Je pense que j'ai besoin de temps aussi.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: And to feel like we're really together in it
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Et pour sentir que nous sommes vraiment ensemble là-dedans

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Then we'll take all the time you need
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Alors nous prendrons tout le temps dont tu as besoin.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Next time we see each other, we'll go at our own pace
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: La prochaine fois que nous nous verrons, nous irons à notre propre rythme.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: It's hard to explain without sounding strange
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: C'est difficile à expliquer sans avoir l'air étrange.
Parfois, ce n'est pas seulement toi

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: It's the situation around you that gets in my head
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: C'est la situation autour de toi qui me prend la tête.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Do you promise you won't judge?
Do you even have to ask?

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Il n'a rien fait de grand.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Lately I've had thoughts about you sleeping with someone else
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Dernièrement, j'ai pensé à toi en train de coucher avec quelqu'un d'autre.
Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into French.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: That was not on my bingo card
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Ce n'était pas sur ma carte de bingo.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: I... don't know what to say
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Je... ne sais pas quoi dire
Tu veux un peu de temps ?

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: But he kept hovering around me all day
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Mais il a continué à tourner autour de moi toute la journée.

story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Text me tonight if you're free
story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Envoie-moi un message ce soir si tu es libre.

story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: I heard your starting to walk way more
story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: J'ai entendu que tu commences à marcher beaucoup plus.

story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Not completely but I am getting there
Soon i will be able to kick your ass
story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Bientôt, je pourrai te botter le cul.

story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Maybe i should break your arms now just to be safe
story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Peut-être devrais-je te casser les bras maintenant juste pour être sûr.

story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: You can't do that to a gamer
story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Tu ne peux pas faire ça à un gamer.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_LO.source: I'll make sure you actually do the exercises too
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_LO.translation: Je vais m'assurer que tu fasses bien les exercices aussi

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_LO.source: Your leg decides the pace, not your ego
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_LO.translation: C'est ta jambe qui décide du rythme, pas ton ego
On dirait que tu es plutôt motivé 😌

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_LO.source: Someone has to stop you from doing something stupid
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_LO.translation: Il faut bien que quelqu'un t'empêche de faire des bêtises
Mets juste quelque chose de confortable 👍

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_LO.source: Pretty sure I'm supposed to be the coach here 😏
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_LO.translation: Je suis censée être l'entraîneuse ici 😏

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.source: Do you wear a cape when nobody is looking? 😌
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.translation: Tu portes une cape quand personne ne regarde ? 😌
Tu as besoin d'aide ou de flirt ?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.source: (I know you cannot run but like emotionally)
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.translation: (Je sais que tu ne peux pas courir mais émotionnellement)

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.source: Your outfit choice is still under investigation
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.translation: Ton choix de tenue est toujours en enquête

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.source: If I look cute, you get credit
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.translation: Si je suis mignonne, tu as du crédit

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.source: If I look TOO cute, you get blamed 😌
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.translation: Si je suis TROP mignonne, tu es blâmé 😌
Pas le temps pour des salutations normales

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.source: I looked at the assignment again
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.translation: J'ai regardé le devoir à nouveau

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.source: Send it later and I will help
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.translation: Envoie-le plus tard et je t'aiderai

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.source: Honestly, it will keep me busy
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.translation: Honnêtement, ça va me tenir occupé

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.source: And I am happy if it means you can finally rest a little
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.translation: Et je suis content si ça veut dire que tu peux enfin te reposer un peu

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.source: Just keep me updated when you hear more about the work
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.translation: Tiens-moi juste au courant quand tu en sais plus sur le boulot

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.source: I wanted to thank you again
And for offering to handle the financial side for a while
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.translation: Et pour proposer de gérer le côté financier pendant un moment

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.source: But I still do not feel right letting you manage that while you are injured
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.translation: Mais je ne me sens toujours pas bien de te laisser gérer ça pendant que tu es blessé
Il n'y a pas de problème

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: And... thank you for last night
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Et... merci pour la nuit dernière

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: I was scared of saying it wrong
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: J'avais peur de le dire mal.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: You're not making it easy for me to stay serious 😭
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Tu ne me facilites pas la tâche pour rester sérieux 😭
Ce que je veux dire, c'est...

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: I feel better after talking like that
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Je me sens mieux après avoir parlé comme ça.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: I don't need everything to be perfect right away
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Je n'ai pas besoin que tout soit parfait tout de suite.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: I just want us to keep being like this
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Je veux juste que nous restions comme ça.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: Because I really like where this is going with us
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Parce que j'aime vraiment où cela nous mène.
Et pour que ce soit clair

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: You being careful with me is not a bad thing
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Le fait que tu sois prudent avec moi n'est pas une mauvaise chose.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: It actually makes me feel loved
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Ça me fait en fait me sentir aimé.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: Now I need five more minutes in bed after that
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Maintenant, j'ai besoin de cinq minutes de plus au lit après ça.
J'avais vraiment besoin de ce sommeil.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: But I should clean a little and work from home for a while
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Mais je devrais nettoyer un peu et travailler de chez moi pendant un moment.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: Still soft and sleepy but better
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Encore doux et endormi mais mieux

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:hailey}} is showing you the question on her computer
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:hailey}} te montre la question sur son ordi

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.source: The teacher said compare the two examples
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.translation: Le prof a dit de comparer les deux exemples
Mon cerveau a dit non merci 💅

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.source: Start with what changes between them
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.translation: Commence par ce qui change entre eux
Parce que TOI tu as travaillé

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.source: Okay I wrote the first answer
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.translation: Ok, j'ai écrit la première réponse

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.source: You focused and you did it well
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.translation: Tu t'es concentré et tu l'as bien fait

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.source: You need to do better than that 😤
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.translation: Tu dois faire mieux que ça 😤
Je vais essayer la prochaine fois 😇

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.source: I have to get ready before the party eats my evening 😇
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.translation: Je dois me préparer avant que la fête ne me vole ma soirée 😇
On dirait que tu es prête à négocier
Une feuille d'exercice pour un compliment

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est... en fait un bon point

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: Unless you somehow manage to lose a dumbbell overnight
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: À moins que tu ne réussisses à perdre un haltère pendant la nuit

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm talented, but not that talented
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je suis douée, mais pas à ce point

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm still keeping an eye on you
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je garde un œil sur toi

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm mostly waiting for my shift to end
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'attends surtout que mon service se termine

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: So I started looking for games instead
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alors j'ai commencé à chercher des jeux à la place

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: I was thinking about this morning

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu as trouvé quelque chose d'intéressant ?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: Looks like the kind of game that tests the player's teamwork 😅
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: On dirait le genre de jeu qui teste le travail d'équipe des joueurs 😅

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't expect me to carry you
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ne t'attends pas à ce que je te porte

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: Confident for someone who almost got defeated by a yoga mat this morning 😂
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: T'es confiant pour quelqu'un qui a failli se faire battre par un tapis de yoga ce matin 😂

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: We spent more time getting everything ready than actually exercising
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: On a passé plus de temps à tout préparer qu'à vraiment s'entraîner

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: By the time we finally started, we were almost done
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quand on a enfin commencé, on était presque à la fin

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything is already in place for tomorrow
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tout est déjà prêt pour demain

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Hey
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Hey

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I would not need to move from the house
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Je n'aurais pas besoin de quitter la maison

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Just me, my PC, and some work I can handle from here
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Juste moi, mon PC, et un peu de travail que je peux gérer d'ici

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: That would be wonderful
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Ce serait merveilleux

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Really wonderful
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Vraiment merveilleux

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Do you need anything else from me?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: As-tu besoin de quelque chose d'autre de ma part ?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: No
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Non

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I think I have everything I need
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Je pense que j'ai tout ce qu'il me faut

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: What about you?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Et toi ?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Do you need anything?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Tu as besoin de quelque chose ?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I already have more than enough good things for me
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: J'ai déjà plus que suffisamment de bonnes choses pour moi

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I was trying not to ask too soon
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: J'essayais de ne pas demander trop tôt

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: That sounds suspiciously sweet
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Ça sonne suspectement doux

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: It was supposed to be
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: C'était censé l'être

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: You taking care of me like this is already a lot
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Prendre soin de moi comme ça, c'est déjà beaucoup

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Careful
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Fais attention

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: If you keep saying things like that, I might start feeling useful
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Si tu continues à dire des choses comme ça, je pourrais commencer à me sentir utile

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Then maybe I should keep saying them
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Alors peut-être que je devrais continuer à les dire

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: You deserve to feel useful too
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Tu mérites aussi de te sentir utile

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I'll remember that
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Je m'en souviendrai

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Good
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Bien

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Just keep me updated tonight
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Tiens-moi juste au courant ce soir

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: But do you have any news about that work you mentioned?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Mais as-tu des nouvelles sur ce travail dont tu as parlé ?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I'm curious about this mysterious job now
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Je suis curieux à propos de ce mystérieux job maintenant

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: You'll be the first to know
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Tu seras le premier à le savoir

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I'll hold you to that 😌
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Je te tiendrai à ça 😌

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Almost
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Presque

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I checked most of it already
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: J'ai déjà vérifié la plupart des choses

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I just want to verify a few more things before I promise anything
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Je veux juste vérifier quelques détails avant de promettre quoi que ce soit

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: So it is serious?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Donc c'est sérieux ?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Yeah
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Ouais

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: If everything is clean, I will tell you properly tonight
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Si tout est en ordre, je te le dirai correctement ce soir

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: It should be something pretty cool for me
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Ça devrait être quelque chose de plutôt cool pour moi

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Do you have two minutes?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: As-tu deux minutes ?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: I'll be doing moderation for a website and live channel
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Je vais faire de la modération pour un site web et une chaîne en direct

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: The pay is pretty good
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: La paye est plutôt bonne

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: And everything can be done from my PC
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Et tout peut être fait depuis mon PC

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: That already sounds much better than having to leave the house
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Ça sonne déjà beaucoup mieux que de devoir quitter la maison

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: The only downside is the schedule
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Le seul inconvénient, c'est l'emploi du temps

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: How so?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Comment ça ?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: There aren't really any fixed hours
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Il n'y a pas vraiment d'heures fixes

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: When they need me, I have to be available immediately
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Quand ils ont besoin de moi, je dois être disponible immédiatement

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: And once a moderation session starts, I can't leave my PC until it's finished
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Et une fois qu'une session de modération commence, je ne peux pas quitter mon PC tant que ce n'est pas fini

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Not for food
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Pas même pour manger

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Just finishing drying my hair 😌
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Je viens juste de finir de sécher mes cheveux 😌

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Barely for the bathroom
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: À peine pour aller aux toilettes

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: That does sound a little rough
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Ça a l'air un peu difficile

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: But I understand it too
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Mais je comprends aussi

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: If they need urgent moderation, they probably need someone there immediately
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: S'ils ont besoin d'une modération urgente, ils ont probablement besoin de quelqu'un sur place tout de suite

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Will that be okay for you?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Ça te va ?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: I think so
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Je pense que oui

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: It's not perfect, but it's something I can actually do from home
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Ce n'est pas parfait, mais c'est quelque chose que je peux vraiment faire depuis chez moi

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Then that's what matters
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: C'est ça qui compte

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: And now that I'm not working anymore, I'll have plenty of time
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Et maintenant que je ne travaille plus, j'aurai plein de temps

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: So don't worry about the rest
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Alors ne t'inquiète pas pour le reste

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: I'll make sure you always have food, water and everything you need nearby
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Je vais m'assurer que tu aies toujours de la nourriture, de l'eau et tout ce dont tu as besoin à portée de main

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: You can focus on your work without worrying about anything else
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Tu pourras te concentrer sur ton travail sans te soucier de rien d'autre

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: You're going to spoil me
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Tu vas me gâter

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: After everything you've done for me lately?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Après tout ce que tu as fait pour moi dernièrement ?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: I think it's only fair 😌
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Je pense que c'est juste 😌

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Thanks, {{name:evelyn}}
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Merci, {{name:evelyn}}

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Anytime
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Avec plaisir

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: DAY 10
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: JOUR 10

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Give me five minutes and I'll be there
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Donne-moi cinq minutes et j'arriverai

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 5 MINUTES PLUS TARD

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Alright, I'm available now
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: D'accord, je suis disponible maintenant

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: What's up?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Qu'est-ce qu'il y a ?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: It was about the work I mentioned earlier
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: C'était à propos du travail dont j'ai parlé plus tôt

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: I wanted to explain what it actually is
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Je voulais expliquer ce que c'est vraiment

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Yes finally, I was curious about it
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Oui enfin, j'étais curieuse à ce sujet

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: Honestly, I hope I can get the cast off soon
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: Honnêtement, j'espère pouvoir enlever le plâtre bientôt

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: But don't get stupid with it
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: Mais ne fais pas de bêtises avec ça

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: That's exactly what someone stupid would say
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: C'est exactement ce que dirait quelqu'un de bête

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: Don't go to bed too late
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: Ne te couche pas trop tard

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: The game won't be ready tonight
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: Le jeu ne sera pas prêt ce soir

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: It's downloading like it has somewhere better to be
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: Il télécharge comme s'il avait mieux à faire
Au moins, on va se coucher tôt
En forme pour l'entraînement de demain
Tout va bien après ce matin ?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Je ne reste pas trop tard

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Do not start pacing like an old man
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Ne commence pas à faire les cent pas comme un vieux
Je me suis rappelé le truc des études

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Start with what changes, then why it matters
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Commence par ce qui change, puis pourquoi c'est important
Mon cerveau fait plusieurs choses à la fois
Version officielle de la fête qui arrive

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: And you did a good job picking the outfit
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Et tu as bien choisi la tenue

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Do not make it a thing
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Ne fais pas de ça un truc.
C'est toi qui a fait ça

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Cute and safe, exactly like you ordered
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Mignonne et en sécurité, exactement comme tu l'as demandé

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Tell me how cute i am 😌
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Dis-moi à quel point je suis mignonne 😌
Je vais avec les filles maintenant

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Mise à jour du bureau à domicile 😮‍💨

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: I was scared of how things would feel between us
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: J'avais peur de ce que cela donnerait entre nous.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: But I think we handled it well
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Mais je pense que nous avons bien géré ça.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: And I kept thinking about what you said this morning
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Et je n'arrêtais pas de penser à ce que tu as dit ce matin.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: Also I changed into one of your shirts
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: J'ai aussi enfilé une de tes chemises.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: That feels illegal when I'm not there
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Ça semble illégal quand je ne suis pas là.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: Are you flirting with me, lady?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Tu flirtes avec moi, ma belle ?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: What a lucky man I am
And I'm a really lucky girl to have you ❤️
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Et je suis une fille vraiment chanceuse de t'avoir ❤️

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: I'm going to wash my face and get in bed before I start missing you too loudly
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Je vais me laver le visage et me mettre au lit avant de commencer à te manquer trop fort.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: And lay down staring at the ceiling for a while
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Et reste allongé à regarder le plafond pendant un moment.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: Just letting you know I handled it myself
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Je te fais savoir que je m'en suis occupé moi-même.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: I'm going back to that gym on my own terms
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Je retourne à cette salle de sport selon mes propres conditions.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: If they start bothering me again, we can settle it outside 😒
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: S'ils commencent à me déranger à nouveau, nous pouvons régler ça dehors 😒

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: But you could also ask to have them kicked out of the gym
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Mais tu pourrais aussi demander à les faire expulser de la salle de sport.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: One of them owns the place

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Réveille-toi 😭
Ouais

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: He said I can stay after class and he will go through the assignment with me
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Il a dit que je peux rester après les cours et qu'il va passer en revue le devoir avec moi
Comme une vraie étudiante en détresse 😭

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: That is probably the fastest way to make you learn
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est probablement le moyen le plus rapide de te faire apprendre
Je sais
C'est la partie agaçante
Il avait l'air calme à ce sujet

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Like I am not doomed, just badly organized
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Comme si je n'étais pas foutue, juste mal organisée
Ça sonne juste 😇
Rude mais juste 😌
Petite crise académique
Aussi, fête ce soir

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Your outfit choice is still under investigation
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Ton choix de tenue est toujours en enquête
Même avec le mode sauvetage du prof ?
Surtout avec le mode sauvetage du prof

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: If I have to suffer academically, I deserve to look amazing later
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Si je dois souffrir académiquement, je mérite de briller après

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I will update you after his help session 😇
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Je te tiendrai au courant après sa séance d'aide 😇
En fait, crise académique moyenne
Le devoir est toujours moche

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Send it later and I will look
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Envoie-le plus tard et je regarderai
C'était le plan

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: But school already answered about the private lessons
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Mais l'école a déjà répondu pour les cours particuliers

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: They want me with my main professor
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Ils veulent que je sois avec mon prof principal
À partir de demain 😭
Déjà ?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Morning
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Matin

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: New outfits or something like that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Nouveaux vêtements ou quelque chose comme ça

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I feel like it will be somthing stupid and i don't want to change outfit anyway
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Je sens que ce sera quelque chose de stupide et je ne veux de toute façon pas changer de tenue.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: What should I do if he pushes that on me?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Que devrais-je faire s'il me met ça sur le dos ?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Your reply here can have effect in the near future
