story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ta réponse ici peut avoir un impact dans un avenir proche

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Wait to see the outfits, then talk to him if you do not like them
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Attends de voir les tenues, puis parle-lui si ça ne te plaît pas.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Trust him, even if he is annoying he does run the bar well right?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Fais-lui confiance, même s'il est agaçant, il gère bien le bar, non ?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: If it is not okay, tell him calmly and set a boundary
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Si ce n'est pas acceptable, dis-le-lui calmement et fixe une limite.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: So I do not refuse before I even know what it is
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Donc je ne refuse pas avant même de savoir ce que c'est.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Exactement

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Alright
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: D'accord

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Morning, so how did it go at the bar last night?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Bonjour, alors comment ça s'est passé au bar hier soir ?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You're right maybe im making a big fuse for nothing
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as raison, peut-être que je fais tout un foin pour rien.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Try to trust him on the work side
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Essaie de lui faire confiance sur le plan du travail.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: He is annoying, but the bar is still running, so he is doing something right
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Il est agaçant, mais le bar fonctionne toujours, donc il fait quelque chose de bien.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You really think so?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu le penses vraiment ?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Oui

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Just stay calm and do not assume the worst too early
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Reste juste calme et ne suppose pas le pire trop tôt.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: D'accord

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will try to give him the benefit of the doubt
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Je vais essayer de lui donner le bénéfice du doute.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It was okay
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: C'était correct

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Either way, don't worry about him that much, just work normally
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Quoi qu'il en soit, ne t'inquiète pas trop pour lui, travaille normalement

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good time with your colleagues too
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Amuse-toi bien avec tes collègues aussi

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And text me the moment something feels wrong
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Et envoie-moi un message dès que quelque chose te semble bizarre

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Je vais

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you for being in my corner
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Merci d'être dans mon coin

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It's normal don't worry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est normal, ne t'inquiète pas.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I kept my head down and did my work
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai gardé la tête baissée et j'ai fait mon travail.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But the manager watched everything like a hawk, quit annoying
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Mais le manager surveillait tout comme un faucon, c'est agaçant.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is going to be fine
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça va bien se passer

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You just have to endure him for a bit and he will leave you alone
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu dois juste le supporter un peu et il te laissera tranquille.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes you're right
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Oui, tu as raison.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: At least I enjoy working with my colleagues
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Au moins, j'apprécie de travailler avec mes collègues

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Oh also, that bastard said he might bring new dress code rules soon
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Oh aussi, ce bâtard a dit qu'il pourrait bientôt apporter de nouvelles règles de code vestimentaire.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Je viens de me réveiller 😴

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: But I guess I needed the truth
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Mais je suppose que j'avais besoin de la vérité
Tu as l'air un peu froid.
Je suis juste en train de penser
Est-ce vraiment okay ?
J'ai dit que je comprends

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: That doesn't mean it felt good
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Cela ne veut pas dire que c'était agréable.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Knowing that you don't want me
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Sachant que tu ne me veux pas

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: It's not that I don't want you
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Ce n'est pas que je ne te veux pas

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: It's just that right now I'm not ready for that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: C'est juste qu'en ce moment je ne suis pas prêt pour ça.
Je comprends
Enfin

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I just need a little time
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: J'ai juste besoin d'un peu de temps
D'accord

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I really didn't want to hurt you
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Je ne voulais vraiment pas te blesser.
Je sais
C'est pourquoi je suis encore ici

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I'm going to clean a bit and work from home for a while
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Je vais nettoyer un peu et travailler de chez moi pendant un moment.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I need to keep my mind busy
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Je dois garder mon esprit occupé.
Tu peux m'envoyer un message plus tard ?
Ouais
Je te texterai plus tard.
Ne commence pas
J'avais vraiment besoin de ce sommeil.
Comment te sens-tu ?
Mieux
Encore fatigué cependant

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And... thank you for being honest last night
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Et... merci d'avoir été honnête hier soir
Bien sûr
Ce n'était pas facile à entendre.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Your room finally lost the fight
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ta chambre a enfin perdu la bataille
Ma chambre n'est pas en désordre

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Finally ! I always had hope in you
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Enfin ! J'ai toujours cru en toi

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You look like you are supervising more than cleaning
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: On dirait que tu supervises plus que tu ne nettoies

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Hurry up and clean your room
Say that again and I am putting you in the donation bag
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dis ça encore et je te mets dans le sac de dons

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:evelyn}} found a box under my bed and gave me the mother look
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:evelyn}} a trouvé une boîte sous mon lit et m'a lancé le regard de maman
Je ne réponds pas à ça

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: My lawyer said I should stay silent
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mon avocat m'a dit de rester silencieuse

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I need to go before she finds more evidence 😭
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il faut que j'y aille avant qu'elle ne trouve plus de preuves 😭

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:evelyn}} decided today is apparently war against dust
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:evelyn}} a décidé qu'aujourd'hui c'est apparemment la guerre contre la poussière

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: We are doing a huge cleaning session
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: On fait une grande session de nettoyage

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Est-ce que tu le reposes vraiment ?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Mostly is not a medical term
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Principalement n'est pas un terme médical.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Especially when you act like you're fine
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Surtout quand tu fais comme si tout allait bien
Je n'agis pas tant que ça.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: You don't trust me at all
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Tu ne me fais pas du tout confiance.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I just don't trust your survival instincts
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Je ne fais tout simplement pas confiance à tes instincts de survie.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Just take it easy until I finish
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Prends juste ça tranquillement jusqu'à ce que j'ai fini.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Okay, my break is almost over
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: D'accord, ma pause est presque terminée.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I need to go act useful again
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Je dois retourner agir de manière utile.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'll text you after my shift 😌
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Je te texterai après mon service 😌

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Not terrible, just enough to make time feel slow
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Pas terrible, juste assez pour que le temps semble lent.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'm basically living my dream right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Je vis essentiellement mon rêve en ce moment.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Thank you, I practiced that lie

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Then you'd probably break the other one too 😒
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Alors tu casserais probablement l'autre aussi 😒
Je t'enverrai un message plus tard

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: I'm about to leave for the gym
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Je suis sur le point de partir pour la salle de sport

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: The sooner I go, the sooner it's over
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Plus je pars tôt, plus c'est vite fini

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: I'm still sorry I can't really help
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Je suis encore désolé de ne pas pouvoir vraiment aider

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Just tell me if anything happens
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Dis-moi juste si quelque chose se passe

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: You'll run over there on one leg?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Tu vas courir là-bas sur une jambe ?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Good news, I don't work tonight or tomorrow night
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bonne nouvelle, je ne travaille pas ce soir ni demain soir

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Just focus on getting better, that's the most important thing right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Concentre-toi juste sur ta guérison, c'est le plus important en ce moment

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you for everything you do
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Merci pour tout ce que tu fais

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm sorry for being such a burden right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je suis désolée d'être un tel fardeau en ce moment

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't say that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ne dis pas ça

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You are not a burden
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu n'es pas un fardeau

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And none of this is your fault
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et rien de tout ça n'est de ta faute

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You just need time to recover, that's all
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu as juste besoin de temps pour te rétablir, c'est tout

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: After dinner tonight, we can spend some time together if you want 😊
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Après le dîner ce soir, on peut passer un moment ensemble si tu veux 😊

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd love that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'adorerais ça

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we'll do that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alors on fera ça

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: So I'll finally have some free time
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je vais enfin avoir un peu de temps libre

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I think I'm going to use it to clean the house and do some laundry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je pense en profiter pour nettoyer la maison et faire une lessive

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you have anything that needs washing too?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu as des choses à laver aussi ?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, I have a few things
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui, j'ai quelques trucs.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But are you sure you don't need help?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mais es-tu sûre de ne pas avoir besoin d'aide ?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: No, don't worry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non, ne t'inquiète pas

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You need to rest until you're fully healed
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu dois te reposer jusqu'à ce que tu sois complètement guérie

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You're sure ?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu es sûre ?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, I know you want to help but I can handle this
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oui, je sais que tu veux aider mais je peux gérer ça

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I might be a little late
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Je vais peut-être être un peu en retard

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for setting everything up
Take your time, i'm not starting without you 😊
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Prends ton temps, je ne commence pas sans toi 😊

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:mason}} is using the bathroom right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:mason}} est aux toilettes en ce moment

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I can't even brush my teeth yet
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne peux même pas me brosser les dents encore

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I'll come downstairs in about fifteen minutes
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Je descends dans environ quinze minutes

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I prepared the movie and the popcorn
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai préparé le film et le popcorn

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Now i'm only missing you and {{name:mason}}
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Il ne me manque plus que toi et {{name:mason}}

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Certaines personnes ne vivent pas seules
Ça a l'air d'être ton problème
Ça devrait répondre à ta question

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: Are you almost done in the bathroom?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Tu as presque fini dans la salle de bain ?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: And yet you keep talking to me
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Et pourtant tu continues à me parler

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: I'll come out when I'm done

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Tu survivras une minute de plus

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: Because you've been in there forever
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Parce que tu es là-dedans depuis une éternité

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: I need to brush my teeth too
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: J'ai aussi besoin de me brosser les dents

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: You don't need forty minutes to brush your teeth
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Tu n'as pas besoin de quarante minutes pour te brosser les dents

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne reste pas trop tard

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Also yes I did the worksheet before leaving
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Et oui, j'ai fait la feuille d'exercice avant de partir

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Professor would probably materialize from the shadows if I skipped it
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Le prof apparaîtrait probablement des ombres si je l'avais zappée
Vous êtes tous les deux impossibles

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: But the party is actually at the principal's son's place 😭
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Mais la fête est en fait chez le fils du principal 😭
Version officielle de la fête qui arrive

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I just crossed paths with him
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Je viens de croiser son chemin

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He only gave me a little wave
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Il m'a juste fait un petit signe

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: But now I feel weirdly shy because of the outfit
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Mais maintenant je me sens étrangement timide à cause de la tenue

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Because I did not plan to be seen by him dressed like this
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Parce que je ne voulais pas qu'il me voie habillée comme ça

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Stop looking smug through the phone
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Arrête de sourire comme ça à travers le téléphone
C'est toi qui a fait ça

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He said I look more mature than usual and now I am blaming both of you 😇
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Il a dit que j'avais l'air plus mature que d'habitude et maintenant je vous en veux à tous les deux 😇

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: My professor said it was nice too, which was weirdly stressful 💅
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Mon prof a dit que c'était sympa aussi, ce qui était étrangement stressant 💅

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Cute and safe, exactly like you ordered
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Mignonne et en sécurité, exactement comme tu l'as demandé

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Please say I look like a responsible student who definitely revises 😌
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Dis s'il te plaît que j'ai l'air d'une étudiante responsable qui révise bien 😌

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: The party was actually really fun
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: La fête était vraiment sympa en fait

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I saw a bunch of people I had not seen in forever
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai vu plein de gens que je n'avais pas vus depuis une éternité

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: So now my social battery is fully dead
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Donc maintenant ma batterie sociale est complètement à plat
Tu as survécu d'une manière ou d'une autre

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I talked a little with my professor
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai un peu parlé avec mon prof

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He asked if I was enjoying the party and said the outfit suited me
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Il m'a demandé si je m'amusais à la fête et a dit que ma tenue me va bien
Ce qui était un peu stressant en fait
Tu commences à avoir honte maintenant ?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I was not expecting to run into him there
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Je ne m'attendais pas à le croiser là
Bonne nuit, petit fauteur de troubles
Je vais avec les filles maintenant

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: But I feel like I'm getting better at it
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: Mais j'ai l'impression que je m'améliore.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: It makes it a little more worth it
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: Cela le rend un peu plus intéressant.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: Can I see you before you go to bed?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: Puis-je te voir avant que tu ailles te coucher ?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: I'm going to shower and go to bed
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: Je vais prendre une douche et aller au lit.
Les mêmes choses encore et encore

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Come play with me so i can kick your ass
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Viens jouer avec moi pour que je puisse te botter le cul.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: So who is it and when do I start?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Alors, qui est-ce et quand est-ce que je commence ?
Tu auras sûrement besoin d'un peu de matériel.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Your coach should text me during the day if everything is good
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Ton coach devrait m'envoyer un message dans la journée si tout va bien.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Why won't you say his name?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Pourquoi ne veux-tu pas dire son nom ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Or is it because you have no one? 😒
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Ou est-ce parce que tu n'as personne ? 😒

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds way too dramatic for homework help 😭
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça a l'air beaucoup trop dramatique pour de l'aide aux devoirs 😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: If this saves my grades and keeps me out of school humiliation then I owe you one 😇
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Si ça sauve mes notes et me garde à l'abri de l'humiliation scolaire, alors je te dois une 😉

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: So your {{name:tutor}} plan is becoming a real thing
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Donc ton plan de {{name:tutor}} devient une réalité !

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I still can't believe I actually need help that badly 😭
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Je n'arrive toujours pas à croire que j'ai vraiment besoin d'aide à ce point 😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: But having someone at home or online already sounds way less awful than staying after class with teachers
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Mais avoir quelqu'un à la maison ou en ligne semble déjà beaucoup moins horrible que de rester après les cours avec les profs

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I do have good ideas sometimes
Sometimes is doing a lot of work there 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Parfois, c'est faire beaucoup de travail là 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Did you actually find someone serious or are you just improvising with confidence again?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as vraiment trouvé quelqu'un de sérieux ou tu improvises encore avec confiance ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I told you I would handle it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Je t'ai dit que je m'en occuperais

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Your future is safe with me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Ton avenir est en sécurité avec moi

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Hey, are you awake?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Hey, tu es réveillée ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I want to help
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Je veux aider

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You are not useless, you are the one keeping everything running here
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu n'es pas inutile, c'est toi qui fais tourner tout ici

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Also I am looking for something we can do together
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Je cherche aussi quelque chose qu'on peut faire ensemble

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I might have a lead
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: J'ai peut-être une piste

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But I want to verify it before I commit you to anything
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Mais je veux vérifier avant de t'engager dans quoi que ce soit

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: What kind of work?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Quel genre de travail ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Is it safe?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est sûr ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And is it legal?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Et c'est légal ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes of course
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Oui, bien sûr

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is mostly scheduling and meeting people in public
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est surtout de la planification et des rencontres avec des gens en public

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Morning, yeah I woke up a few minutes ago
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Bonjour, ouais je me suis réveillé il y a quelques minutes

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No bar
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Pas de bar

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No late nights forced by a manager
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Pas de nuits tardives imposées par un manager

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Meeting people?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Rencontrer des gens ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: For what?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Pour quoi faire ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Passive Insight says how you frame your next response can change her reaction
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Passive Insight dit que la façon dont tu cadres ta prochaine réponse peut changer sa réaction

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is like being a friend for a day, they pay for your time and company
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est comme être un ami pour une journée, ils paient pour ton temps et ta compagnie

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is basically paid dates, but with strict rules and public places only
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est en gros des rendez-vous payés, mais avec des règles strictes et uniquement dans des lieux publics

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds strange
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça a l'air étrange

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: People pay just to talk?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Les gens paient juste pour parler ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Some people feel really lonely
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Certaines personnes se sentent vraiment seules

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: How are you feeling today?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Comment te sens-tu aujourd'hui ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: They want company without pressure
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Elles veulent de la compagnie sans pression

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And you are good at making people feel safe
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Et tu es doué pour faire sentir aux gens qu'ils sont en sécurité

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And who knows, maybe you will find someone you like
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Et qui sait, peut-être que tu trouveras quelqu'un qui te plaît

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You took care of us for a long time, it is time for you to live your life too
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as pris soin de nous pendant longtemps, il est temps que tu vives ta vie aussi

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I am too old for that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Je suis trop vieux pour ça

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No you are not, you are beautiful and still young, just give yourself a chance
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Non, tu ne l'es pas, tu es belle et encore jeune, donne-toi juste une chance

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Hmm..I will see
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Hmm... je vais voir

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Paid dates?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Des rendez-vous payés ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Better
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Mieux.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: That is not really my world
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ce n'est pas vraiment mon monde

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It does not mean you owe anything to anyone, it is more like acting for a day
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça ne veut pas dire que tu dois quelque chose à quelqu'un, c'est plus comme jouer un rôle pour une journée

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is time and conversation
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est du temps et de la conversation

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It pays really well
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ça paie vraiment bien

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And we set boundaries before you accept any client so there is no risk
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Et on fixe des limites avant que tu acceptes un client, donc il n'y a pas de risque

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And who knows, maybe you will find someone
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Et qui sait, peut-être que tu trouveras quelqu'un

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You took care of us for a long time, it is time for you to live your life too
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu as pris soin de nous pendant longtemps, il est temps que tu vives ta vie aussi

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I am too old for that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Je suis trop vieux pour ça

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No you are not, you are beautiful, just give yourself a chance
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Non, tu ne l'es pas, tu es belle, donne-toi juste une chance

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will see
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Je vais voir

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But I still feel guilty
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Mais je me sens toujours coupable

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But i do not like the idea of being judged
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Mais je n'aime pas l'idée d'être jugé

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No one will judge you
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Personne ne te jugera

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And you will not be alone in this, I will check everything, check with the client and watch over you all day
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Et tu ne seras pas seul là-dedans, je vais tout vérifier, voir avec le client et veiller sur toi toute la journée

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: For now I will verify the platform and the rules
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Pour l'instant, je vais vérifier la plateforme et les règles

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: If anything feels wrong we drop it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Si quelque chose ne va pas, on abandonne

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Alright
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: D'accord

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I can try it and if I do not like it I will stop
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Je peux essayer et si ça ne me plaît pas, j'arrête

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Of course, you only have a one week obligation anyway
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Bien sûr, tu n'as qu'une obligation d'une semaine de toute façon

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I stayed home like you said but I feel like I let my colleagues down
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Je suis resté chez moi comme tu l'as dit, mais j'ai l'impression d'avoir déçu mes collègues

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Alright, when do I start?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: D'accord, quand est-ce que je commence ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will text you once I know more
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Je te texterai dès que j'en saurai plus

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: D'accord

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you for taking care of me and finding me work
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Merci de prendre soin de moi et de me trouver du travail

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is normal, go rest a little you deserve your day off
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: C'est normal, va te reposer un peu, tu mérites ton jour de congé

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Do not feel guilty, working there was not good for you anyway
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ne te sens pas coupable, travailler là-bas n'était de toute façon pas bon pour toi

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I told you I would handle it for the work, and for your coworkers it is fine, you can still see them outside work
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Je t'ai dit que je m'en occuperais pour le travail, et pour tes collègues, ça va, tu peux toujours les voir en dehors du travail

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes that is true
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Oui, c'est vrai

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But I do not want to be useless
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Mais je ne veux pas être inutile

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: It was a lot to hear
But I'm glad you told me instead of hiding it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Mais je suis content que tu me l'aies dit au lieu de le cacher.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I didn't want to lie to you
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Je ne voulais pas te mentir.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I just think I need a little time now
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Je pense juste que j'ai besoin d'un peu de temps maintenant.
C'est le moment de quoi exactement ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: To understand where I stand in all this
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Pour comprendre où je me situe dans tout ça

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And where I stand with us 😕
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Et où j'en suis avec nous 😕

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Not because I think you love me less
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Pas parce que je pense que tu m'aimes moins.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: More because I didn't expect things to feel like that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Plus parce que je ne m'attendais pas à ce que les choses se sentent comme ça.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And you don't have to force anything for me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Et tu n'as pas besoin de forcer quoi que ce soit pour moi.
C'est pourquoi je ne panique pas.
Je suis juste... en train de beaucoup réfléchir
Je suis toujours là, n'est-ce pas 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I just want to move carefully
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Je veux juste me déplacer prudemment.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Because this really matters to me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Parce que cela compte vraiment pour moi

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Then give me a little time to figure out how I feel about all of this
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Alors donne-moi un peu de temps pour comprendre ce que je ressens à propos de tout ça.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Take all the time you need
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Prends tout le temps qu'il te faut
J'avais vraiment besoin de ce sommeil.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: That helps more than you think 🥺
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Ça aide plus que tu ne le penses 🥺

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I'm going to clean a little and work from home for a bit
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Je vais nettoyer un peu et travailler de chez moi pendant un moment.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Still a little foggy but better 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Encore un peu brumeux mais mieux 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And... thank you for being honest with me last night
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Et... merci d'avoir été honnête avec moi hier soir.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: I walked past a clothing store after class
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je suis passée devant un magasin de vêtements après les cours

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: And they had a huge sale 😭
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et ils avaient une énorme vente 😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you know how hard it was not to go inside?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu sais à quel point c'était difficile de ne pas entrer ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You say that like it's a real struggle
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu parles comme si c'était une vraie galère

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Your shopping addiction needs professional treatment
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ton addiction au shopping a besoin d'un traitement pro

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: At least my clothes look good
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Au moins, mes vêtements sont jolis

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You were definitely planning to buy it
Trying to enjoy a peaceful afternoon
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: J'essaie de profiter d'un après-midi tranquille

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: I should have an answer sometime today
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je devrais avoir une réponse aujourd'hui

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll let you know as soon as I hear back
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je te tiendrai au courant dès que j'ai des nouvelles

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Please don't hire some terrifying genius
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: S'il te plaît, ne prends pas un génie terrifiant

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You need to get better soon
I miss making fun of the way you walk 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça me manque de me moquer de ta façon de marcher 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Hello
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Salut

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: That sounds like exactly what she needs
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Ça a l'air exactement de ce dont elle a besoin

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I usually start by identifying the subjects causing the most trouble
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Je commence généralement par identifier les matières qui posent le plus de problèmes

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Then we create a study plan and work through it step by step
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Ensuite, on crée un plan d'étude et on avance étape par étape

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: She's capable of doing well, but...
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Elle est capable de bien faire, mais...

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: She just struggles to stay motivated sometimes
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Elle a juste du mal à rester motivée parfois

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: That's very common
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: C'est très courant

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Most students are more capable than they think
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: La plupart des étudiants sont plus capables qu'ils ne le pensent

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: They just need structure and consistency
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Ils ont juste besoin de structure et de régularité

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: When would you be available?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Quand serais-tu dispo ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Tomorrow afternoon would work for me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Demain après-midi, ça me va

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: It's Ethan
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: C'est Ethan

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I can come by, meet her and evaluate where she currently stands
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Je peux passer, la rencontrer et évaluer où elle en est

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Perfect
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Parfait

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I'll let her know
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Je vais lui dire

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Great
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Super

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Feel free to message me if you have any questions before then
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: N'hésite pas à m'envoyer un message si tu as des questions avant

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I received your tutoring request earlier today
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: J'ai reçu ta demande de tutorat plus tôt aujourd'hui

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Thanks for reaching out
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Merci de m'avoir contacté

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I'm looking for someone who can help {{name:hailey}} prepare for her exams
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Je cherche quelqu'un qui peut aider {{name:hailey}} à se préparer pour ses examens

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: What students do you usually work with?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Avec quels étudiants travailles-tu habituellement ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I mainly work with high school and college students
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Je travaille principalement avec des lycéens et des étudiants

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Perfect
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Parfait

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: And my goal isn't just to explain lessons
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Et mon but n'est pas seulement d'expliquer les leçons

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I also help students build study habits and stay focused
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: J'aide aussi les étudiants à construire des habitudes d'étude et à rester concentrés

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: J'ai eu une réponse
Tu as vu son corps ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: The guy clearly knows what he's doing
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Le gars sait clairement ce qu'il fait
D'accord, c'est vrai

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: He does have a crazy body
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Il a un corps de fou

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Well that actually makes me feel a little better
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Eh bien, ça me fait déjà me sentir un peu mieux

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: At least I already know him
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Au moins, je le connais déjà

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: And I know he isn't some random creep you found online
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Et je sais qu'il n'est pas un creep random que tu as trouvé en ligne

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: You really have no faith in me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Tu n'as vraiment pas confiance en moi

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: You wanted to keep his name a surprise
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Tu voulais garder son nom secret
Tu l'as bien cherché
Enfin
Petit ingrat

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Still more grateful than you deserve 🙂
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Je suis encore plus reconnaissante que ce que tu mérites 🙂

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Tell {{name:aiden}} I'm ready whenever he is
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Dis à {{name:aiden}} que je suis prête quand il l'est

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: He's a young coach who just moved to town
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: C'est un jeune coach qui vient d'arriver en ville
Il a à peu près ton âge
Il est disponible combien de temps ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Has he actually coached anyone before?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Il a déjà coaché quelqu'un avant ?
Qui est-ce ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: And where did you even find him?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Et tu l'as trouvé où, lui ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: He used to be one of {{name:aiden}}'s coaches
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: C'était un des coachs de {{name:aiden}}.
Oh

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Okay that sounds a lot less suspicious
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Ok, ça a l'air beaucoup moins suspect.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: If he coached {{name:aiden}}, he probably knows what he's doing
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: S'il a coaché {{name:aiden}}, il doit savoir ce qu'il fait.
C'est ce que je pensais
Alors je suis partante !

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: I'm curious to see what he can do
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Je suis curieuse de voir ce qu'il peut faire.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Tell that Chris I'm ready whenever he is
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Dis à Chris que je suis prête quand il l'est !
C'est {{name:aiden}}
Il s'appelle Chris
Attends
Tu parles de ta meilleure amie ?
Ouais
Pourquoi lui as-tu demandé ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Est-ce que tu le reposes vraiment ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Mostly is not a medical term
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Principalement n'est pas un terme médical.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Especially when you pretend you're fine
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Surtout quand tu fais semblant d'aller bien
Je ne fais pas semblant autant.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: You don't trust me at all
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Tu ne me fais pas du tout confiance.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I just don't trust your survival instincts
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Je ne fais tout simplement pas confiance à tes instincts de survie.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Please take it easy until I finish
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: S'il te plaît, prends-le doucement jusqu'à ce que j'aie fini.
D'accord, la pause est presque terminée.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I need to go act useful again
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Je dois retourner agir de manière utile.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'll text you after my shift 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Je te texterai après mon service 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Not terrible, just enough to make time move slowly
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Pas terrible, juste assez pour faire passer le temps lentement.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'm basically living my dream right now
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Je vis essentiellement mon rêve en ce moment.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Thank you, I practiced that lie

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey, are you really sure I'll be able to do that job?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hé, tu es vraiment sûr que je vais pouvoir faire ce boulot ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But I can't help but worry about it a little
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mais je ne peux pas m'empêcher de m'inquiéter un peu à ce sujet

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That's perfectly normal, it's a big change after all
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est tout à fait normal, c'est un grand changement après tout

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But I am confident that you will do great
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mais j'ai confiance que tu vas très bien t'en sortir

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Right now I am mostly making sure everything is legitimate
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pour l'instant, je m'assure surtout que tout soit légitime

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to verify all the details before I tell you to start
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je veux vérifier tous les détails avant de te dire de commencer

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That makes me feel a little better
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ça me fait me sentir un peu mieux

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Normally I should have all the answers tomorrow
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Normalement, je devrais avoir toutes les réponses demain

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: If everything checks out, you will be able to begin after that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Si tout est en ordre, tu pourras commencer après ça

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Already tomorrow?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Déjà demain ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That is sooner than I expected
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est plus tôt que je ne l'attendais

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bien sûr

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I will explain everything in more detail tomorrow
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je vais tout expliquer en détail demain

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Now you have my attention
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Maintenant, tu as mon attention

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I am curious to know what you found
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je suis curieuse de savoir ce que tu as trouvé

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And maybe a little nervous too
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et peut-être un peu nerveuse aussi

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That is perfectly normal
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'est tout à fait normal

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: We will take it one step at a time
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: On va y aller étape par étape

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Alright
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accord

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I will wait for your message later 😊
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alors j'attendrai ton message plus tard 😊

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Why are you asking?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pourquoi tu demandes ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Because I keep thinking about it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Parce que j'y pense tout le temps

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not that smart and don't have much experience in those things
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je ne suis pas si intelligent et je n'ai pas beaucoup d'expérience dans ces choses-là

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And I am wondering if I will actually be good enough
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et je me demande si je serai vraiment à la hauteur

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That's not true, you are more capable than you think
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ce n'est pas vrai, tu es plus capable que tu ne le penses

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And even if you don't have experience, you can learn
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Et même si tu n'as pas d'expérience, tu peux apprendre

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I will be there to help you with everything you need
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je serai là pour t'aider avec tout ce dont tu as besoin

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, and I really appreciate that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Je sais, et j'apprécie vraiment ça

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Hey 😊 le dîner est presque prêt

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I figured this might motivate you 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Je me suis dit que ça pourrait te motiver 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I made steak and french fries
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai préparé un steak avec des frites

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I know how much you love that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Je sais combien tu adores ça

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Now I'm even more motivated to come downstairs
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Maintenant, je suis encore plus motivé à descendre

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I'll see you in a minute then
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Je te vois dans une minute alors

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Do you want to come downstairs?
Or should I bring your plate upstairs?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ou je devrais apporter ton assiette en haut ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I should force myself to move a little
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Je devrais me forcer à bouger un peu

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Hey, just imagine how unfair this is going to be
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Hey, imagine à quel point ça va être injuste !

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Careful or I'll cancel your coach
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Fais attention ou je vais annuler ton coach.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Thanks for taking the time to look for someone and finding me a coach
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Merci d'avoir pris le temps de chercher quelqu'un et de me trouver un coach.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: That's one less thing I have to deal with
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: C'est une chose de moins à gérer.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: You dealing with anything by yourself would have been a miracle anyway
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Te voir gérer quelque chose tout seul aurait été un miracle de toute façon.
Je suis contente d'avoir pu aider.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: I'm about to get a dream body while you're stuck in bed with your broken body
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Je vais avoir un corps de rêve pendant que tu es coincé au lit avec ton corps cassé.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: A dream body won't fix your face
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Un corps de rêve ne réparera pas ta tête.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Jealousy doesn't look good on you
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: La jalousie ne te va pas du tout.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Neither will all that muscle when you still lose to me at everything
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Et tous ces muscles ne serviront à rien si tu perds toujours contre moi.
Continue de te le dire, handicapé.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I was hoping you'd forget about it

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Quand est-ce que je le rencontre ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He wants to see where you're at and what needs work
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Il veut voir où tu en es et ce qui doit être amélioré

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He's going to discover how cooked you are 😔
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Il va découvrir à quel point tu es à la ramasse 😔

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: You're enjoying this way too much
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Tu prends trop de plaisir à ça
Bon, le prof particulier demain, la fête ce soir 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I'll try to make a good first impression tomorrow 😊
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Je vais essayer de faire bonne impression demain 😊
C'est tout ce que je demande

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I'm heading to the party with the girls now. Goodnight, coach
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Je pars à la fête avec les filles. Bonne nuit, coach

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Have fun at the party, and get home safe
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Amuse-toi bien à la fête et rentre prudemment

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I talked to him this afternoon
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: J'ai parlé avec lui cet après-midi

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: And he knows how to work with students preparing for exams
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Et il sait comment travailler avec des étudiants qui préparent des examens

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: So you're saying my academic rescue mission is officially happening 😭
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Donc tu dis que ma mission de sauvetage académique est officiellement lancée 😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: But I feel like I'm getting better at it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.translation: Mais j'ai l'impression que je m'améliore.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: It makes it a little more worth it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.translation: Cela le rend un peu plus intéressant.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: Can I see you before you go to bed?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.translation: Puis-je te voir avant que tu ailles te coucher ?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: I'm going to shower and go to bed
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.translation: Je vais prendre une douche et aller au lit.
Les mêmes choses encore et encore

If you want to support the project, get new episodes, and access exclusive content, you can subscribe to my Patreon.

Merci d'avoir joué à iNTeRcepted.

À bientôt dans le prochain chapitre.

ui.auto.laurent_runs_his_own_consulting_.source: Laurent runs his own consulting firm and spends most of his time working. He values discretion, easy conversation, and a quiet hour without expectations.

ui.auto.lucas_is_confident_without_rushi.source: Lucas is confident without rushing. He enjoys polished plans, quiet generosity, and dates that feel chosen rather than improvised.

ui.cardvault.pack.legendary.art_alt.translation: Paquet booster de coffre de cartes iNTeRcepted légendaire

ui.cardvault.pack.legendary.description.translation: Un paquet premium avec au moins une carte légendaire.

ui.cardvault.pack.premium.art_alt.translation: Paquet booster de coffre de cartes iNTeRcepted premium

ui.cardvault.pack.premium.description.source: Improved odds for Rare, Epic, and Legendary cards.
ui.cardvault.pack.premium.description.translation: Cotes améliorées pour les cartes rares, épiques et légendaires.

ui.cardvault.special_bonus_hint.source: Enter your private Card Vault bonus code.
ui.cardvault.special_bonus_hint.translation: Saisissez votre code bonus Card Vault privé.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.cards.permanent.source: Every new card is permanently added to your Collection. Character filters adapt to every available character.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.cards.permanent.translation: Chaque nouvelle carte est ajoutée définitivement à ta Collection. Les filtres de personnages s'adaptent à chaque personnage disponible.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.cards.rarity.source: Cards have different rarities, and rarer cards are harder to obtain.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.cards.rarity.translation: Les cartes ont différentes raretés, et les cartes plus rares sont plus difficiles à obtenir.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.codes.body.source: Enter the code associated with your supporter tier to claim its exact-once Card Vault reward. Promotional reward codes are supported when available.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.codes.body.translation: Entre le code associé à ton niveau de soutien pour réclamer sa récompense unique du Card Vault. Les codes de récompense promotionnels sont acceptés quand ils sont disponibles.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.codes.security.source: Claimed codes cannot grant their reward again. Private QA and developer codes are never shown here.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.codes.security.translation: Les codes réclamés ne peuvent pas donner leur récompense à nouveau. Les codes privés QA et développeur ne sont jamais affichés ici.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.collection.body.source: Every card you unlock is stored here. Browse discovered cards and identify cards that are still locked.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.collection.body.translation: Chaque carte que tu débloques est stockée ici. Parcours les cartes découvertes et identifie celles qui sont encore verrouillées.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.collection.filters.source: Filters automatically include all current and future Card Vault characters.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.collection.filters.translation: Les filtres incluent automatiquement tous les personnages actuels et futurs du Card Vault.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.dust.body.source: A card you already own becomes Card Dust. Dust records the value of your duplicates and is preserved for future use.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.dust.body.translation: Une carte que tu possèdes déjà devient de la Poussière de Carte. La Poussière enregistre la valeur de tes doublons et est conservée pour une utilisation future.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.free.body.source: To get you started, your first Basic Pack is on us.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.free.body.translation: Pour te lancer, ton premier Pack de Base est offert.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.free.discover.source: Open it and discover your first {count} cards.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.free.discover.translation: Open it and discover your first 3 cards.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.points.body.source: Card Points open Card Vault packs. Rewards, supporter benefits, and special Card Vault codes can grant them. Card Points and Card Dust are separate currencies.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.points.body.translation: Les Points de Carte ouvrent des packs du Card Vault. Les récompenses, les avantages pour les soutiens et les codes spéciaux du Card Vault peuvent les accorder. Les Points de Carte et la Poussière de Carte sont des monnaies distinctes.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.ready.noncanon.source: Remember: Card Vault is bonus content, and its cards are not canon to the official iNTeRcepted story.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.ready.noncanon.translation: Souviens-toi : le Card Vault est un contenu bonus, et ses cartes ne sont pas canon dans l'histoire officielle d'iNTeRcepted.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.ready.summary.source: Open packs, discover cards, complete your Collection, convert duplicates into Card Dust, spend Card Points, and claim supporter rewards in Codes.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.ready.summary.translation: Ouvre des packs, découvre des cartes, complète ta Collection, convertis des doublons en Poussière de Carte, dépense des Points de Carte et réclame des récompenses de soutien avec des Codes.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.viewer.body.source: After all cards are revealed, select any card to inspect it fullscreen. Close the viewer to return to the complete pack result.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.viewer.body.translation: Après que toutes les cartes soient révélées, sélectionne n'importe quelle carte pour l'inspecter en plein écran. Ferme le visualiseur pour revenir au résultat complet du pack.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.viewer.controls.source: Use touch or mouse, the visible close button, the area outside the card, or Escape on desktop.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.viewer.controls.translation: Utilise le tactile ou la souris, le bouton de fermeture visible, la zone en dehors de la carte, ou Échap sur desktop.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.welcome.bonus.source: Card Vault is a bonus collectible system where you can unlock exclusive cards featuring characters from iNTeRcepted.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.welcome.bonus.translation: Le Card Vault est un système de collection bonus où tu peux débloquer des cartes exclusives mettant en vedette des personnages d'iNTeRcepted.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.welcome.independen.source: Opening packs, collecting cards, and spending Card Points never affect story progress, choices, relationships, or routes.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.welcome.independen.translation: Ouvrir des packs, collectionner des cartes et dépenser des Points de Carte n'affecte jamais la progression de l'histoire, les choix, les relations ou les routes.

ui.cardvault.tutorial.welcome.noncanon.source: These cards are not canon. Their scenes do not necessarily happen in the official story and are bonus collectible artwork.
ui.cardvault.tutorial.welcome.noncanon.translation: Ces cartes ne sont pas canon. Leurs scènes ne se déroulent pas nécessairement dans l'histoire officielle et sont des œuvres d'art collectables bonus.

ui.conversation.auto_fast.source: Auto Play: fast (green). Pauses for choices. Select to turn off.
ui.conversation.auto_fast.translation: Lecture auto : rapide (vert). Pause aux choix. Sélectionnez pour désactiver.

ui.conversation.auto_normal.source: Auto Play: normal (yellow). Pauses for choices. Select for fast playback.
ui.conversation.auto_normal.translation: Lecture auto : normale (jaune). Pause aux choix. Sélectionnez pour accélérer.

ui.conversation.auto_off.source: Auto Play off. Tap to read. Select to enable automatic playback.
ui.conversation.auto_off.translation: Lecture auto désactivée. Touchez pour lire. Sélectionnez pour activer la lecture automatique.

ui.conversation.preview.sent_audio.translation: Désolé, je ne peux pas traiter les fichiers audio. Peux-tu me donner le texte que tu veux traduire ?

ui.dev_support.dev_updates.translation: Actualités du développement et suivi des progrès

ui.dev_support.intro.source: Your support gives me more time to create new conversations, scenes and choices for iNTeRcepted. Choose the tier that suits you and enjoy the rewards below. Thank you for being part of the story!
ui.dev_support.intro.translation: Votre soutien me permet de consacrer plus de temps à la création de nouvelles conversations, scènes et choix pour iNTeRcepted. Choisissez la formule qui vous convient et profitez des récompenses ci-dessous. Merci de faire partie de l'aventure !

ui.dev_support.patreon.source: Support the game on Patreon and choose your rewards
ui.dev_support.patreon.translation: Soutenez le jeu sur Patreon et choisissez vos récompenses

ui.dev_support.points_note.source: Enter your supporter code in Settings, then claim your bonus points in Card Vault to open more packs. Your tier also unlocks any unclaimed lower-tier bonuses. Each bonus can be claimed once.
ui.dev_support.points_note.translation: Saisissez votre code de soutien dans les paramètres, puis récupérez vos points bonus dans Card Vault pour ouvrir plus de paquets. Votre formule débloque aussi les bonus des formules inférieures que vous n'avez pas encore récupérés. Chaque bonus ne peut être récupéré qu'une seule fois.

ui.dev_support.subscribestar.translation: Vous préférez SubscribeStar ? Vous y trouverez les mêmes avantages pour chaque formule.

ui.dev_support.test_builds.source: Play test builds and unfinished versions earlier, while the next update is still in development
